rows.translation: 当你醒来时，格温已经不在了，而你的胃也恢复了正常状态。 [var0|你没有试图起身，而是环顾着自己那间狭小的卧室，虚弱地呼唤着格温的名字。|你慌忙坐起来，但身体立刻因剧痛而发出抗议；你只好又重重躺了回去，彻底认输了。]幸好，你只需要等待几分钟，门就会大开，然后她就会推着一辆木制推车进来。推车里整齐地摆放着各种围巾和布料，将物品温暖地包裹着。 [var1] 拳头大小的鸡蛋。那些属于你的鸡蛋。那个穿着狼族服装的女孩弯下腰，把胸部紧紧挤在一起，调皮地眨了眨眼，然后对你说： “你做得太棒了——当第一个鸡蛋被取出来的时候，我都有点手忙脚乱了呢。 [var0|即使过了这么长时间，我想对来说，这仍然是一件相当忙碌、充满紧张感的事情。|我没想到这些“德莱德蛋”会这么快接连出现。这和普通的蛋孵化过程有点不一样……至少我是这么认为的。] 我就把它们留在这里一会儿吧，你好好休息吧，好吗？我相信它们很快就会孵化出来的。 既然你仍然非常疲惫，其实你也没有别的选择。Gwyn把推车推到你的床边后就离开了，让你可以好好休息。幸运的是，二十分钟后你的双腿开始有了力气，你终于又能活动了。但当你离开婴儿房时，你不禁意识到自己其实离开了好长时间 至少已经过了四个小时了。![silly| 你可以吃点东西来充饥——比如鸡蛋吧。毕竟，你已经习惯了经常吃鸡蛋来满足自己的饥饿感！]
rows.raw: " When you awaken, Gwyn is absent and your stomach is back to normal. [var0|Rather than trying to get up, you look around your small bedroom and weakly call out for Gwyn|You hurriedly sit up but your body yells in agony; you plop right back down in immediate defeat]. Thankfully, you're only stuck for a few minutes before the door opens nice and wide and she wheels in a wooden cart. Nestled in a warm arrangement of scarves and cloth are [var1] fist-sized eggs. Your eggs. The lupine girl hunches over her cart, forcing her tits to press together teasingly so she can give you a nice wink. "You did great — once that first one came out, I was scrambling a bit. [var0|Even after all this time, I guess it's still quite the hectic event for me.|I didn't realize drider eggs came out so quickly after one another. It's a bit different than normal egg pregnancies... I think.] I'm going to leave them here for a bit; you rest up, okay? I'm sure they'll be hatching sooner than later." Given you're exhausted still, you really don't have a choice in the matter. The cart rolls its way over just beside your bed before Gwyn departs, leaving you to rest. Thankfully for you, your legs start working after another twenty minutes and you're finally back up. But by the time you leave the nursery, you can't help but realize how long you've been out — it's been at least four hours![silly| You could use a bite to eat — maybe eggs. You're so used to being filled up with them, after all!]"

[var0
        |Your egg-laying instincts freeze you in place — it's time for your eggs to hatch.
        |You're uncertain why but you freeze — you need to get to the nursery, don't you? Your eggs are there and... are they hatching?
    ]
rows.translation:
[var0
        |你的产卵本能让你僵在原地——是时候让这些蛋孵化了。
        |你不知道为什么，但突然间，你停住了脚步——你必须去育婴室，对吧？你的蛋就在那里，而且……它们是不是已经开始孵化了？
    ]
rows.raw:
"
    [var0
        |Your egg-laying instincts freeze you in place — it's time for your eggs to hatch.
        |You're uncertain why but you freeze — you need to get to the nursery, don't you? Your eggs are there and... are they hatching?
    ]"

rows.original: You step inside the nursery and hustle over to the incubator. Gwyn is hunched over and clutching the sides of the boxes, staring down in awe. All of your eggs are arranged in a neat circle[var0||... or at least, you think they're yours]. Every egg seems to have inflated in size — rather than merely the size of a fist, they're more comparable to pumpkins now. [var0 |"Drider eggs never cease to amaze me." Gwyn gently strokes one of the massive eggs. "It's incredible that they get this big so quickly!" |Gwyn grabs and tugs your wrist, pulling you over with a wolfish grin. "Did you know they'd grow so big? Every time I checked on them today, they were an inch or so bigger! Aren't driders so cool?" ] You return her energy with a smile; the pair of you stop talking and fully focus on the eggs. It takes a minute or two, but one of the first clicks of shell rupturing draws both of your gazes. Seconds pass until another clack answers before a third responds with a puncture of black chitin through the shell. Your eggs set off into a chain reaction chorus of cracking and shaking — tiny knife-like black points poking and pushing free from the white shells. Until finally, you see more than just tiny drider feet. A hand smacks and pushes one piece of shell away and a drider flops free. [a] [rand|blonde|gray|black|brown]-fuzzed drider [rand|boy|girl] lands facedown in the warm incubator hay, squeezing tiny fistfuls of it. Their eyes are clenched nice and tight against the incubator's lighting, their tiny legs clacking and pushing off the ground. Another egg pops free... but rather than fall, they come stumbling out and teetering about. [var0|Each of their goofy first steps only add to your smile.|Each drider emerges more or less as gracefully as the last, yet you can't help but realize they're more like toddlers than babies.] [var0|Gwyn sighs and reaches over, ruffling one of their fuzzy backs. "Hopefully this bunch isn't going to crawl around all over the place. These little girls and boys have so much energy!"|"So they come out able to walk... and seeming older. They're about the same as a toddler currently... but I guess they still take just as long to mature, huh?"] Straightening and circling the incubator, the lupine scoops up one drider at a time. Each one curls their legs around her arm, shoulder, or tits; in a matter of seconds, your entire clutch is proudly dangling and covering much of the motherly lass. Except for the still unhatched egg. [var2 |You patiently shift around the incubator and rub the egg; is your last child the timid one? The last time you had an egg like this, it was because she was special — so too is this child. |You're uncertain what could be wrong — it looks healthy and had been shaking, but didn't truly rupture. There's no open hole so the egg isn't hollow. ] But while Gwyn set your other children down into a nearby playpen, you finally spot a small hole in the shell. You lean down and peek inside... right into the glistening black eye of a very familiar-looking girl. This drider — unlike her siblings — sports beautiful white hair and matching fuzz. Not only that, but she seems a bit more cramped within the egg. Gwyn walks back over and blinks, yet seems to pick up on your last egg standing. [var2|"Another princess? Wow, that's... unusual, you'd think. I wonder how you got more than one..."|"Is everything alright? I didn't even think to make sure all the eggs were emptied!"] You [var2|nod|shrug], turning your attention back to the egg just in time for the shy drider girl to poke her hands out and tug at the shell, pulling away just enough to peek at you. Although she doesn't know words, your parental bond does seem to resonate; she pokes a wider hole and teeters out, flopping over and clinging to your [pc.hasHorns|horns|head]. You wrap your arms around her, lowering her into your grasp. You lift the pair of you up out of the incubator and move her over to the pen with her siblings in one smooth motion. At first she doesn't want to let go, yet you soothe her with a head pat. Now in the pen, she nervously steps and clicks her way toward the rest of her family. They've all piled up, snuggling with one another's fuzzy spider bodies but take quick notice of their approaching sister. In one wave of motion, they quickly rise and terrifyingly swarm to her. All of the drider kids converging startles her but they're too fast — in a few seconds, all of them are now snuggling and comforting her at the center of a mosh pit of arachnid cuteness. [silly|Are you fucking happy? This is the writer — I want you guys to know I have some pretty rough arachnophobia and I'm writing this for you. Do you understand my anguish? Enjoy these adorable shits! ENJOY 'EM!] "I guess that's that, huh?" Gwyn pokes her head over your shoulder, squeezing your arm in an obvious attempt of reassurance. "I'll take good care of them — all of them. Your little princess and her kin aren't going to have a single strand of fuzz on their adorable abdomens hurt as long as I'm around!" You nod and linger for a while longer, gazing out over the newly born drider clutch. A few more minutes and you'll set back off on your adventure... hopefully.
rows.translation: 你走进育婴室，快步走向孵化器。格温正弯着腰，双手部紧握着那些孵化箱的边缘，敬畏地注视着里面的景象。你所有的蛋都被整齐地排列成一个圆圈。[var0||……或者至少，你以为它们是你的。]每一个蛋的大小似乎都变大了——它们不再只是拳头大小，现在更像是南瓜了。 [var0 |这些巨型蛋类总是让我感到惊奇，”格温轻轻抚摸着其中一个巨大的蛋。“它们能这么快就长到这么大，真是不可思议！ |格温抓住你的手腕，扯着你，露出狡黠的笑容：“你知道它们会长得这么大吗？今天我每次去看它们，它们都又长高了一英寸左右！这些飞龙真的太酷了，不是吗？ ] 你微笑着回应她的举动，两人停止了交谈，全神贯注地观察那些鸡蛋。过了一两分钟，终于有第一个蛋壳破裂的声音响起，你们的目光立刻被吸引过去。几秒钟后，又一个破裂声传来，紧接着第三个鸡蛋的壳也被击破了，黑色的几丁质从壳中渗了出来。 你的鸡蛋开始发生一连串的破裂和震动——那些细小的、像刀一样的黑色颗粒从白色的蛋壳中不断冒出来，互相挤压、碰撞，最终从蛋壳中脱离出来。 直到最后，你看到的已经不再只是那些微小的“飞行器足部”了。 一只手部拍打并推开了那片贝壳，一只飞虫就这样被释放了出来。 [a] [rand|金发女郎|灰色|黑色|棕色]-模糊效果的飞行器 [rand|男孩|女孩] 它们脸朝下躺在温暖的保温箱里的干草上，用小小的拳头紧紧抓着那些干草。它们的眼睛紧紧闭着，以躲避保温箱内的光线；它们那细小的腿不停地蹬着地面，试图移动。又有一颗蛋裂开了……但它们并没有掉下来，而是摇摇晃晃地爬了出来。 [var0|他们那些滑稽可笑的初次尝试，只会让你更加发笑。|每一个飞行生物出现时的姿态都差不多那么优雅，但你不得不意识到，它们其实更像学步的幼儿，而不是婴儿。] [var0|格温叹了口气，伸手轻轻抚了抚它们那柔软的背毛。“希望这群小家伙不会到处乱爬。这些小孩子可真是精力充沛啊！|所以它们出生后就能走路了……而且看起来也更成熟了。现在它们的体型大概和幼儿差不多……不过我想，它们的成长过程所需要的时间应该也是一样的吧？] 狼蛛在孵化器中来回移动，一次抓起一只飞虫。这些飞虫会将自己的腿缠绕在她的手部臂、肩膀或胸部上；短短几秒钟内，她的整个身体就被这些飞虫覆盖住了，几乎看不出她原本的形态。 当然，还有那颗尚未孵化的蛋除外。 [var2 |你耐心地转动着孵化器，轻轻抚摸着那个蛋；你的最后一个孩子，是不是那个性格胆小的那个呢？上一次你得到这样的蛋，是因为那个孩子很特别——这个孩子，也同样特别。 |你不确定到底出了什么问题——它看起来很正常，也确实有过晃动，但并没有真正破裂。也没有出现任何开口，所以这个蛋并不是空心的。 ] 但当格温把你的其他孩子们放到附近的玩耍区时，你终于在蛋壳上发现了一个小洞。你弯下腰往里面窥视……立刻看到了那双闪闪发亮的黑色眼睛，那是一个你非常熟悉的女孩。与她的兄弟姐妹不同，这只飞龙女拥有美丽的白色毛发和与之相配的绒毛。不仅如此，她似乎在蛋壳里显得有些局促不安。格温走回来，眨了眨眼，似乎注意到了你还剩下的那个蛋。 [var2|又有一位公主？哇，这真是……不同寻常，你不会觉得吗？我很好奇，你是怎么得到不止一位公主的……|一切都还好吗？我甚至都没想到要确认所有的鸡蛋都已经被清空了！] 你 [var2|点头表示同意。|耸耸肩]就在这时，你的注意力重新回到了那个蛋上，只见那个害羞的飞行少女伸出了手部，轻轻拉了拉蛋壳，然后把壳拉开了一点，以便能够看到你。虽然她不会说话，但你们之间的亲子纽带似乎让她感到了什么；她把蛋壳拉开了一个更大的洞，然后摇摇晃晃地爬了出来，摔倒在地后紧紧抱住了你。 [pc.hasHorns|角|头部]你将手部臂环绕在她身上，将她轻轻抱入怀中。然后你一把将你们俩从保温箱中抱出来，动作流畅地将她移到和她兄弟姐妹们在一起的围栏里。起初，她并不愿意松开你的怀抱，但你轻轻拍了拍她的头，安抚了她。 此刻，她紧张地迈着步子，小心翼翼地走向自己的家人。它们都挤在一起，依偎着彼此柔软的身体，但很快就注意到了正在靠近的妹妹。它们一下子全都站了起来，然后以惊人的速度向她涌去。 所有那些小蜘蛛怪聚集在一起，这一幕让她吓了一跳，但它们的动作实在太快了——短短几秒钟后，它们就已经全都围在她身边，用它们那可爱的方式安慰着她，把她包围在一片充满蜘蛛元素的温馨氛围之中。 [silly|你们他妈的高兴了吧？我就是这个作者——我想让你们知道，我其实有很严重的蜘蛛恐惧症，但还是为了你们写了这些内容。你们明白我的痛苦吗？好好享受吧。 可爱的小东西们尽情享受吧！] 我想事情应该就这样解决了，对吧？”格温把头探到你的肩膀后面，紧紧握住你的手部臂，显然是想让你放心。“我会好好照顾他们的——所有人。只要我在身边，你的小公主和她的伙伴们，他们的可爱小肚子上就不会有一根毛发受到伤害！” 你点了点头，又停留了一会儿，凝视着那些刚刚出生的飞龙幼崽。再过几分钟，你就要继续开始你的冒险了……希望如此吧。

rows.original: You stow your [pc.weapon] and stride up towards the strange woodland estate's front door. Warmth radiates from the house, beating back the ever-present chill of the forest. It's gotten noticeably worse the further north you've gone, far faster than should be natural, and yet this secluded villa seems like a bastion against the freeze; a much-needed reprieve. You [party.has cait|give your kitty companion a reassuring look and ]reach for the big brass knocker on the door. It's shaped like a raccoon's tail, big and poofy, but solid in your hand, and it strikes the wood of the door with authority, producing a ringing thud that echoes through the clearing. A flock of ravens take flight, drawing your gaze up with a chorus of screeches and beating wings. By the time the murder of black-feathered birds has left and you return your attention to the house, the door is open, and a woman is standing in the frame with a smirk on her coal-dark lips. The first thing you think of is that doorknocker — the woman has a tail just like the brass adornment, and her whole body is covered in a thick layer of soft brown fur, creamy and light on her chest and ending in dark gloves and stockings on her limbs. Her fur darkens to a black mask just above her short little snout, making her rose-red eyes look all the more mischievous. She has one hand on the door frame and the other on her hip, drawing your eyes all the way down over a swelling bust that's threatening to rip its way free from the thin, silky black dress that hugs all her motherly curves like a second layer of skin from her cleavage to her thighs. "Has a mute wandered up to my door?" the raccoon-woman wonders aloud, still grinning, "Or has my caller simply forgotten [pc.hisHer] manners?" You [pc.dcb|grunt an apology|gasp an apology|stare at her tits for a few moments longer]. "I'm [pc.name], [pc.title]." "Ah, you must be the one that dealt with my little gardening problem beyond the bridge. Enchante! I am Lady Oxana Evergreen. If you've heard tales of a witch of the frozen forest... I assure you only the most flattering stories of me are true. Ah, but where are my manners now, leaving you out in the cold for so long. It's simply been too long since I had visitors, ever since that off-season blizzard. Please, come in." You'd take any chance to get out of the cold, and find your feet carrying you in the witch's wake before you've consciously made up your mind.

rows.original: Despite the relatively humble exterior of the manor, the grand foyer cements in your mind that this is indeed a mansion, fit for nobility. Rich gold decor covers the walls, and a crystal device hangs from the ceiling bearing a hundred candles inside it, shedding a wonderful aurora of light all throughout the house. A set of grand stairs lead to the second floor, and you're treated to the sight of several more raccoon-girls — some with human features, others as fluffy as their mother — staring down at you with blatant curiosity from above. "My daughters," Lady Evergreen explains, gesturing to the gaggle. "The ones I haven't succeeded in marrying off yet, anyway. Girls! Go fetch tea and bread for our guest[party.solo||s]." As soon as their mother gives a command, the younger raccoon-girls hop to it, scrambling towards what you suppose must be the kitchen. Evergreen smiles proudly and leads you past the stairs and through a large inner hall, wide enough for five minotaurs to stand shoulder to shoulder — or would be, if it wasn't for the collection of glass display cases, clothing stands, shelves lining the walls, and the several tables adorned with arcane devices and bearing countless trinkets. You see crystal balls, strange reagents, arms and armor from half a world away, and many paintings done in styles old and new, all of your hostess. Such a collection must have taken lifetimes to assemble. Finally, she leads you through a side door and into a cozy red-painted sitting room, with a pair of couches facing each other over a little tea table. Lady Evergreen gestures to one for your[party.solo|self| party] and takes the other, sprawling down to rest on an elbow, bare legs crossed and tail draped down onto the floor behind her. "I imagine," she begins, watching you sit down with keen interest, "that you've noticed my little barrier of thorns around the northern forest. An unfortunate necessity. No doubt that you've noticed how things have changed here in the Marches since that blizzard. New monsters seem to be crawling out of every dark corner to attack and harass anything with two legs. The overgrown avocado past the bridge was hardly the worst of the lot." That's what you were afraid of. It seems Kasyrra was being genuine about waiting for you in the north. No telling what she's been up to here, unchecked for so long. Damn, you need to hurry. "Suddenly a little anxious, are you?" she laughs. "It's all over your face. Don't worry: now that someone capable has finally made [pc.hisHer] way to the Frostwood, I'll dispel enough of the thorn barrier for you to slip through. I've no intention of impeding someone as powerful as you are... in fact, I'd like to aid you, if I can." [pc.dcb|You aren't typically in the business of taking un-asked-for aid from mysterious forest witches, but you suppose there's no harm in hearing her out...|She wants to help you? That's an unexpected twist. You can't help but wonder what this help might cost.|Oh, she wants to help? Yay!] "What're you offering?"

rows.original: Lady Evergreen smiles disarmingly, running a hand down her thick, fluffy thigh. "My services, of course. I have a selection of intimate magical items and a host of ritual tomes that an adventurer such as yourself might find useful. The first, I can make you for free. No strings attached. We can discuss payment for anything else you may want from my expansive inventory..." She pushes herself up to her feet and closes the distance, reaching out for your neck. You lean back on instinct, but her slender, brown fingers don't so much as brush your [pc.skinFurScales]; instead, she pinches the strange blue gem Kasyrra gave you, yanking it off its leather thong and holding it up to the light. "This... this is power. I could feel you walking up the path with this thing long before my daughters saw you. It radiates an otherworldly aura. You have but to unlock the arcane energy roiling away inside." Evergreen passes her hand over the blue gem, and you feel a tingle rush across your [pc.skinFurScales]. Then there's an eruption of power accompanied by an audible crack in the air between you and the witch. Wind howls through the house, strong enough to blow the shutters open and snap Evergreen's dress around her legs, momentarily revealing a pair of very large somethings hanging free between her thighs before being drawn back into the mage's hands as she chants spells against the forces she's unleashed. The whole exchange doesn't even last long enough for you to react, before the winds and static in the air die down to nothing, and Evergreen's left panting. "No mere magical trinket," Evergreen huffs, offering the gem back to you. "I felt... memories within it. Not a consciousness. Not a life. The echoes of one, fading and fleeting. Ephemeral. Almost like a soul. I think whoever gave you this is dangerous, [pc.name]. Stay away from him." "From her." From Kasyrra. Did she give you a soul? Lady Evergreen sighs as you take the gem back, and glances towards the door. One of her daughters, a shapely young woman with nearly human features save her raccoon's tail and ears, is standing nervously with a wind-mussed head of hair and a number of tea stains all over her blouse. Her mother tuts and waves her off. "I suppose tea will have to wait. Listen: that gem of yours... there are old statues scattered around the Marches. Nobles like my dear friend Carmen once had keystones that would activate them, allow their owners to move from place to place in the blink of an eye. The Waystones have stood silent for many years now, but I think you've got something strong enough to force the lock. So to speak. Try the old Wayfort back south, there should be a Waystone idol somewhere on the grounds. Of course, you'll need to unlock a destination, too. Perhaps that old statue in Hawkethorne square. Consider this a sample of my services. I'm sure there's more I can do to aid you, if you'd like to stay and speak awhile. If not... I'll unweave my wall of thorns once you've left."
rows.translation: 常青女士露出迷人的微笑，将手部抚过自己粗壮而柔软的大腿。“当然，我可以为您提供帮助。我拥有一些私密的魔法物品，还有一些仪式用的典籍，对于像您这样的冒险者来说，这些可能会非常有用。 首先，我可以免费为你制作。没有任何附加条件。对于你可能从我丰富的库存中挑选的其它物品，我们可以再讨论付款方式……” 她站起身来，走到你面前，伸手部揽住了你的脖子。 你下意识地向后仰，但她那纤细的棕色手部指却丝毫没有碰到你。 [pc.skinFurScales]相反，她捏住了卡希拉送给你的那颗奇异的蓝色宝石，将它从皮革绳子上拔下来，然后在轻型线下仔细观察。 “这……这就是力量。在我的女儿们看到你之前，我就已经感觉到你带着这个宝石走了过来。它散发着一种超凡的力量气息。你只需要释放其中蕴含的神秘能量就可以了。” 常青女士抚过那颗蓝色宝石，你顿时感到一阵刺痛感从身体里传遍开来 [pc.skinFurScales]随后，一股强大的能量爆发了，同时还伴随着可听见的声响。 破解 你和那位女巫之间的气氛充满了紧张与未知。风在屋子里呼啸着，强劲得足以将百叶窗吹开，同时也使常青女士的裙子在她的腿间飞舞，有那么一瞬间，人们看到了她那双非常大的 有些东西 那根法杖在她的大腿间自由地悬挂着，直到她开始念咒语，对抗那些她所释放出来的力量时，法杖才又被她收回手部中。 整个过程发生得如此迅速，以至于你甚至来不及做出任何反应，那些狂风和空气中的静电就渐渐消失了，而常青女士也终于喘了口气。 这可不是什么普通的魔法小饰品，”常青女士愤愤地说，同时把那颗宝石递还给你，“我感觉到……里面蕴含着一些记忆。不是意识，也不是生命，只是那些记忆的残余，正在逐渐消逝。如此短暂而易逝，几乎就像灵魂一样……我觉得，把这种东西送给你的那个人，一定很危险。 [pc.name]离他远点。 她来自卡希拉……她是不是把她的灵魂也给了你？” 你将那颗宝石收了回来，常青女士轻叹了一声，然后朝门口瞥了一眼。她的一个女儿——一个身材窈窕的年轻女子，除了那条浣熊尾巴和耳朵外，其他特征几乎与人类无异——正紧张地站在那里，她的头发乱蓬蓬的，衬衫上还沾满了茶渍。 她的母亲发出啧啧声，然后挥手部让她走开。 “我想喝茶的事就先放一放吧。听着：你说的那个宝贝……在边境地区到处都散布着一些古老的雕像。像我亲爱的朋友卡门这样的贵族，曾经拥有可以激活这些雕像的钥匙石，有了它们，主人就可以在瞬间移动到任何地方。 这些路标已经沉默了许多年，但我觉得你拥有足够的力量来打破这个束缚。这么说吧。 试试从老荒废驿堡往南走，应该在那个地方附近的某个地方能找到一座路标神像。 当然，你也需要解锁某个目的地。也许就是鹰棘镇广场上的那座古老雕像吧。把这个看作是我服务的一个样本吧。如果你愿意多留一会儿继续交谈，我相信我还能为你提供更多帮助。但如果不是的话……等你离开后，我就会解除我那由荆棘构成的屏障。
rows.raw: " Lady Evergreen smiles disarmingly, running a hand down her thick, fluffy thigh. "My services, of course. I have a selection of intimate magical items and a host of ritual tomes that an adventurer such as yourself might find useful. The first, I can make you for free. No strings attached. We can discuss payment for anything else you may want from my expansive inventory..." She pushes herself up to her feet and closes the distance, reaching out for your neck. You lean back on instinct, but her slender, brown fingers don't so much as brush your [pc.skinFurScales]; instead, she pinches the strange blue gem Kasyrra gave you, yanking it off its leather thong and holding it up to the light. "This... this is power. I could feel you walking up the path with this thing long before my daughters saw you. It radiates an otherworldly aura. You have but to unlock the arcane energy roiling away inside." Evergreen passes her hand over the blue gem, and you feel a tingle rush across your [pc.skinFurScales]. Then there's an eruption of power accompanied by an audible crack in the air between you and the witch. Wind howls through the house, strong enough to blow the shutters open and snap Evergreen's dress around her legs, momentarily revealing a pair of very large somethings hanging free between her thighs before being drawn back into the mage's hands as she chants spells against the forces she's unleashed. The whole exchange doesn't even last long enough for you to react, before the winds and static in the air die down to nothing, and Evergreen's left panting. "No mere magical trinket," Evergreen huffs, offering the gem back to you. "I felt... memories within it. Not a consciousness. Not a life. The echoes of one, fading and fleeting. Ephemeral. Almost like a soul. I think whoever gave you this is dangerous, [pc.name]. Stay away from him." "From her." From Kasyrra. Did she give you a soul? Lady Evergreen sighs as you take the gem back, and glances towards the door. One of her daughters, a shapely young woman with nearly human features save her raccoon's tail and ears, is standing nervously with a wind-mussed head of hair and a number of tea stains all over her blouse. Her mother tuts and waves her off. "I suppose tea will have to wait. Listen: that gem of yours... there are old statues scattered around the Marches. Nobles like my dear friend Carmen once had keystones that would activate them, allow their owners to move from place to place in the blink of an eye. The Waystones have stood silent for many years now, but I think you've got something strong enough to force the lock. So to speak. Try the old Wayfort back south, there should be a Waystone idol somewhere on the grounds. Of course, you'll need to unlock a destination, too. Perhaps that old statue in Hawkethorne square. Consider this a sample of my services. I'm sure there's more I can do to aid you, if you'd like to stay and speak awhile. If not... I'll unweave my wall of thorns once you've left." "

rows.original:
"I'll take my leave then," you say, standing. 

                The witch sighs softly and stretches out on her couch. "Very well. See yourself out, will you? And don't forget... I'll be here if you decide you need my services."
                
                You're sure she will be.

那我就告辞了。”你说着站了起来。

女巫轻轻叹了口气，然后在沙发上躺了下来。“好吧。你自己出去吧，记得……如果你需要我的帮助，我随时都在这里。”

你确信她一定会在那里的。

rows.original: "It would be a shame if that tea went to waste." Evergreen smiles, a mischievous glint in her ruby-red eyes. "Wouldn't it just! Well, what shall we talk about, hmm? Some of my services must interest you already, for surely you wouldn't just want to spend time talking to an old woman like me, would you?" [party.has etheryn|"Old?" Etheryn whispers, glancing from the witch to you. "Very old..."] [party.has arona|Arona chuckles. "How come there ain't any ugly old hag witches, huh? You're all so damn fuckable. It drives me nuts." Evergreen stifles a laugh. "What would be the use of magic if I looked my age, hmm? Come back when that supple green skin starts to wrinkle and those muscles start to fade... I'll show you my secrets — and just how fuckable they'll make you!" "Sorry, I [arona.isSub|only bottom for [pc.name],|don't bottom]," Arona shoots back, licking her tusks.]
rows.translation: 如果那些茶就这样被浪费掉，那就太可惜了。” 常青女士露出微笑，她那红宝石般的眼睛里闪烁着调皮的光芒。“不是吗？那么，我们该聊些什么呢？我的一些服务肯定会引起你的兴趣吧？毕竟，你总不会只是想陪一个像我这样的老妇人聊天吧？ [party.has etheryn|老？”艾瑟琳轻声说道，目光在女巫和你之间来回扫视。“非常老……] [party.has arona|阿罗娜轻笑起来：“怎么没有那些丑陋的老巫婆呢？你们一个个都这么容易上钩，真让我抓狂。” 常青女士强忍住笑意：“如果我看起来和实际年龄一样，魔法还有什么用呢？等我的皮肤开始出现皱纹，肌肉也开始松弛的时候，你再来吧……到那时，我会告诉你我的秘密——以及你们到底会有多容易上当受骗。 你抱歉，我 [arona.isSub|只有最差的结果 [pc.name],|别处于最底层的地位。]哼，”阿罗娜回嘴道，同时舔了舔自己的獠牙。]

rows.original: While you're standing and getting ready to say your farewells to Lady Evergreen, Cait interjects with a cough and a tug on the hem of the witch's dress. "E-excuse me, Miss Evergreen? I'm-" "Caitriss Zethra," the sorceress answers with a smirk. "Surprised? Don't be. Your father was very specific about his charming daughter's pretty pink hair, and I'd recognize a Jassiran harlot's choice of attire anywhere." Cait blinks. "M-my father!?" "Oh, very well, be surprised if you must," Evergreen laughs. "Your father came calling a few days before the blizzard. He'd gone ahead of his beloved daughters to investigate the ruins here in the Frostwood, he said, but first wished to confirm the veracity of the rumors of my presence — the fabled witch of the woods that all the common-folk scare their children with. Quite a pleasant man, if a bit nosey. I was almost certain he was going to take charcoal rubbings of my doormat after circling the house half a dozen times. You... [cait.thicknessRange 0 60|don't really resemble him overmuch, to be honest. Maybe a few children and a few years will put some weight on you.|have his look about you. Much prettier, of course, but your figure certainly matches his. I'm sure you get plenty of stares when you walk through town, don't you?]" Cait blushes, but can't help but smile. Lady Evergreen strides up and runs a softly-furred hand over the catgirl's cheeks. "There's the smile he was so proud of. So tell me, kitten, weren't there supposed to be two of you?" Your companion's expression immediately loses its normal cheer, collapsing into a frown with eyes downcast. "There were," she answers slowly. "M-my sister, Calla, she was kidnapped in the blizzard by some strange men in black robes. [pc.name] helped me track them up the mountain, outside Hawkstone Castle, but there was some sort of... of tear in reality there. A portal. And they threw Calla through it before we could save her." "Ah. And you want to know if I can save her?"
rows.translation: 就在你准备向常青女士道别时，凯特轻咳了一声，然后拉了拉那位女巫的裙摆，插话道： “打、打扰一下，常青女士小姐？我……” “凯特·泽特拉。”女巫带着一丝笑意回答道。 感到惊讶吗？别这样。你父亲可是特别强调过他那迷人的女儿那漂亮的粉色头发的，而且我在任何地方都能认出贾西兰妓女们会选择的服装。” 凯特眨了眨眼：“我、我父亲！？” “哦，好吧，如果你非得感到惊讶的话，那就随你吧。”常青女士笑道。 在暴风雪来临前的几天，你的父亲来找过你。他说，他比他的女儿们先来到这片霜林，想要调查这里的废墟，但首先他想确认那些关于我存在的传闻是否属实——那些被普通百姓用来吓唬孩子们的、关于森林女巫的传说。 他是个挺不错的人，就是有点爱管闲事。他绕着房子转了半圈后，我几乎可以肯定他会把我的门垫用炭笔描下来……你…… [cait.thicknessRange 0 60|说实话，你和他真的不太像。也许等过几年，生几个孩子之后，你的体型就会发生变化，就会变得更像他一些了。|别人看到你肯定也会多看几眼的。当然，你现在漂亮多了，但你的身材确实很适合他。我敢肯定，每次你在镇上走动时，都会吸引很多目光，对吧？]凯特的脸颊顿时泛起了红晕，但还是忍不住笑了起来。常青女士走上前，用那只柔软的手轻轻抚摸着猫女孩子的脸颊：“这就是他一直引以为豪的笑容啊。那么，告诉我，小猫咪，你们不应该有两个人吗？” 你的同伴的表情立刻失去了往日的欢快，低下了头，皱起了眉头：“本来应该是的……我的姐姐卡拉，在暴风雪中被一些穿着黑色长袍的陌生男人绑架了。 [pc.name] 他们帮助我找到了那些东西，就在霍克斯通城堡外的山上，不过那里似乎有些……某种奇怪的情况。 泪水 事实上，那里有一个传送门。在我们来得及救下卡拉之前，他们就把她推进了传送门。” “啊，那么你想知道我能不能救她出来吗？

rows.original:
Cait sniffles. "Or at least tell me where she went! Is she safe? Is she even alive?"

        "Oh, my sweet little kitty," Evergreen sighs, putting her hands on Cait's shoulders. "I'm sorry. Portals are an enigma to even the greatest scholars; the why and how they connect the myriad worlds together eludes us. But I know that every portal is a tunnel, and it always travels between the same two points when it opens. Most allow for free travel between those points, but one... the portal in Hawkstone's ancient temple... has always been different."
        
        You arch an eyebrow. "Different how?"
        
        [pc.bg arcanist scholar|You've read what little scholarship survives from Estelore about portals, and Hawkstone was never mentioned. Of course, nothing in the Marches is mentioned much in the history books. Does Evergreen know something the greatest scholars of Belhar didn't? If so, perhaps she really can help you in your conflict against Kasyrra.|You're no expert on portals, but if the one Kasyrra came out of is different somehow, perhaps that could help you in your conflict against her.]
        
        Evergreen nods, reclining back on her divan. "The Hawkstone portal opens only once a year, and when it does, only one transaction occurs. Most portals allow passage freely, if you can find them and force them open with the correct rituals, but this one... wherever it leads seems to operate differently than other worlds. One thing goes through, and one thing comes back. And only once each year."
        
        "The cult you mentioned..." she continues, "they've operated in this area for some time. Perhaps since the Godswar ended. Once a year, someone always goes missing. Usually a nameless vagrant or a traveler from the south. I doubt the residents of Hawkethorne are even aware of it. I only truly become aware of the phenomenon due to the surge of magical energies from the temple. But it has never caused such as massive aetheric flux as when your demon appeared..."
        
        "So there's no way to save her... not until a year's passed," Cait sighs, shoulders slumping. "Is that what you're saying?"
        
        Evergreen's fingers tighten around Cait's shoulders. "I know that tone of voice, pretty kitty. You don't believe me... you want to try and force the portal open. Don't try it. Your sister is doubtless alive, though I don't know if she is safe and well. The world that portal connects to is a dark and dangerous place, I should think, but perhaps not one without hope. Steel your heart for now. Find your father, and put the portal out of your mind until [pc.name] has defeated the darkness that came from that world to corrupt ours. [pc.HeShe] needs you."
        
        "I..." Cait looks away, fists clenching until you're afraid that she'll draw blood. Finally, she heaves a sigh that makes her[cait.thicknessRange 60| belly and] tits quake beneath her robes. "I can't... I don't even know where dad is, either."
        
        "That, at least, I can help you with."
rows.translation:
凯特抽泣着：“至少告诉我她去了哪里！她安全吗？她还活着吗？”

“哦，我亲爱的小猫咪，”常青女士叹了口气，把手部放在凯特的肩上，“我很抱歉。就连最伟大的学者们也对这些传送门感到困惑；它们究竟是如何将无数个世界连接在一起的，我们仍然一无所知。 但我知道，每一个传送门都是一条通道，当它开启时，总是会在相同的两个点之间进行传送。大多数传送门都能让人们在这些点之间自由移动，但有一个……霍克斯通古庙里的那个传送门……却总是与众不同。你挑了挑眉毛，问道：“有什么不同呢？
        
        [pc.bg arcanist scholar|你肯定读过关于传送门的那为数不多的学术研究资料，其中根本没有提到霍克斯通。当然，在那些历史书籍中，边境地区的相关内容也几乎被忽略不计。那么，常青女士是否掌握了一些贝尔哈尔最杰出的学者们所不知道的信息呢？如果真是这样，或许她真的能够帮助你解决与卡希拉之间的矛盾。|你虽然不是传送门方面的专家，但如果卡希拉所使用的传送门在某些方面有所不同，或许这能帮助你在与她的对抗中取得优势。]
        
        常青女士微微点头，靠在沙发上说道：“霍克斯通传送门每年只开启一次，而且每次只允许进行一次交易。大多数传送门只要你能找到它们，并用正确的仪式将它们打开，就可以自由通行，但这个传送门……无论它通向哪里，它的运作方式似乎都与其他世界不同。每次只有某样东西被传送过去，然后又有另一样东西被传送回来。而且这一切每年也只发生一次。
        
        你提到的那个邪教……”她继续说道，“他们在这个地区活动已经有一段时间了，大概是从神战结束之后就开始的。每年都有人会失踪，通常是些无名流浪者或是来自南方的旅行者。我怀疑鹰棘镇的居民们甚至都没有意识到这一现象。而我真正注意到这个问题的，是因为寺庙里传出了大量的魔法能量。不过，从来没有像你提到的那个恶魔出现时那样，引发如此巨大的以太能量波动……
        
        所以根本没有办法救她……至少要等一年之后才行，”凯特叹了口气，肩膀耷了下来。“你是这个意思吗？”

常青女士紧紧握住了凯特的肩膀。“我熟悉那种肌肉度，可爱的小猫咪。 你不相信我……你想强行打开那个传送门。千万别这么做。你的妹妹肯定还活着，不过我不知道她是否安全无恙。那个传送门连接的世界，无疑是一个暗影而危险的地方……但也许也并非没有希望。 现在，先坚定你的意志。去找你的父亲，先把那个传送门的事抛到脑后，直到 [pc.name] 它已经战胜了来自那个世界的暗影势力，那些势力曾试图腐蚀我们的世界。 [pc.HeShe] 需要你。”

“我……”凯特把目光移开，双手部紧紧握住，仿佛随时都会掐出血来。最终，她长叹一声，那声音让周围的人[cait.thicknessRange 60| 肚子和……] 她的胸脯在长袍下剧烈地起伏着。“我做不到……我甚至也不知道爸爸现在在哪里。”

“至少这一点，我可以帮你。

But I know that every portal is a tunnel, and it always travels between the same two points when it opens. Most allow for free travel between those points, but one... the portal in Hawkstone's ancient temple... has always been different."
        
        You arch an eyebrow. "Different how?"
        
        [pc.bg arcanist scholar|You've read what little scholarship survives from Estelore about portals, and Hawkstone was never mentioned. Of course, nothing in the Marches is mentioned much in the history books. Does Evergreen know something the greatest scholars of Belhar didn't? If so, perhaps she really can help you in your conflict against Kasyrra.|You're no expert on portals, but if the one Kasyrra came out of is different somehow, perhaps that could help you in your conflict against her.]
        
        Evergreen nods, reclining back on her divan. "The Hawkstone portal opens only once a year, and when it does, only one transaction occurs. One thing goes through, and one thing comes back. And only once each year."
        
        "The cult you mentioned..." she continues, "they've operated in this area for some time. Perhaps since the Godswar ended. Once a year, someone always goes missing. Usually a nameless vagrant or a traveler from the south. I doubt the residents of Hawkethorne are even aware of it. I only truly become aware of the phenomenon due to the surge of magical energies from the temple. But it has never caused such as massive aetheric flux as when your demon appeared..."
        
        "So there's no way to save her... not until a year's passed," Cait sighs, shoulders slumping. "Is that what you're saying?"
        
        Evergreen's fingers tighten around Cait's shoulders. "I know that tone of voice, pretty kitty. You don't believe me... you want to try and force the portal open. Don't try it. Your sister is doubtless alive, though I don't know if she is safe and well. The world that portal connects to is a dark and dangerous place, I should think, but perhaps not one without hope. Steel your heart for now. Find your father, and put the portal out of your mind until [pc.name] has defeated the darkness that came from that world to corrupt ours. [pc.HeShe] needs you."
        
        "I..." Cait looks away, fists clenching until you're afraid that she'll draw blood. Finally, she heaves a sigh that makes her[cait.thicknessRange 60| belly and] tits quake beneath her robes. "I can't... I don't even know where dad is, either."
        
        "That, at least, I can help you with."'

rows.original:
The sullen expression that had dominated the cat-girl's features washes away in an instant, replaced by wide eyes and a swishing tail. "You know where he is?"

            Evergreen smiles. "I do. As I said, he came calling some time ago, and I extracted his next destination from him. He's closer than you think, pretty kitty, doubtless waiting for his daughter to find him. And I'll tell you where he's hiding... for a price."
            
            "What price?" Cait scowls, planting her hands on her hips. "I came all this way, and-"
            
            "And have given me nothing but the pleasure of your company. As nice as you are to look at, dear, knowledge is power. A favor for a favor seems fair, doesn't it?"
            
            Cait cuts her glance from the witch to you. "Go on..."
            
            Evergreen gives her that disarming smile again, spreading her hands as if to mollify the priestess's suspicions. "My favorite price to ask for my services is, of course, to have my callers bear me a child... or put one in my belly. But you're decidedly incapable of either, my little Mallachite. Whatever shall I ask for then...?" the witch drawls, eyes wandering over to you instead. Cait blanches, putting a hand on her [cait.belly].
rows.translation:
那个一直笼罩在猫女脸上的阴郁表情瞬间消失了，取而代之的是一双睁得大大的眼睛和摇摆着的尾巴。“你知道他在哪里吗？”

常青女士笑了起来：“我知道。就像我之前说的，他前段时间来找过我，我从他那里得到了他下一个要去的地方。 他比你想象的要接近得多，漂亮的小猫……他肯定在等着他的女儿找到他。而我可以告诉你他藏在哪里……不过得付出代价才行。

“什么代价？”凯特皱着眉头，双手部叉腰问道。 我大老远跑过来，就是为了——”

“而你给我的，仅仅只是与你相处的乐趣而已。亲爱的，你虽然长得漂亮，但知识才是真正的力量。以恩报恩，似乎也是理所应当的，不是吗？
            
            凯特将目光从那位女巫身上移开，转向你：“继续说吧……”

常青女士再次露出了那种让人放松的微笑，摊开双手部，似乎想消除这位女祭司的疑虑：“当然，我提供服务时最喜欢的报酬方式，就是让那些雇佣我的人让我生下一个孩子。……或者把某个东西放进我的肚子里。但显然，你这两样事情都做不了，我的小玛拉基特。那么，我该许什么愿才好呢……？”女巫低声说道，目光却转向了你。凯特脸色一白，把手部放在了自己的身上。 [cait.belly].

rows.original: You glance at Cait, standing at your side. She seems nervous, but you've been traveling with her long enough to know when she's got something to say. A little pat on the shoulder is all it takes to finally get her talking. "E-excuse me, Miss Evergreen? I'm-" "Caitriss Zethra," the sorceress answers with a smirk. "Surprised? Don't be. Your father was very specific about his charming daughter's pretty pink hair, and I'd recognize a Jassiran harlot's choice of attire anywhere." Cait blinks. "M-my father!?" "Oh, very well, be surprised if you must," Evergreen laughs. "Your father came calling a few days before the blizzard. He'd gone ahead of his beloved daughters to investigate the ruins here in the Frostwood, he said, but first wished to confirm the veracity of the rumors of my presence — the fabled witch of the woods that all the common-folk scare their children with. Quite a pleasant man, if a bit nosey. I was almost certain he was going to take charcoal rubbings of my doormat after circling the house half a dozen times. You... [cait.thiccStageRange 0 2 |don't really resemble him overmuch, to be honest. Maybe a few children and a few years will put some weight on you. |have his look about you. Much prettier, of course, but your figure certainly matches his. I'm sure you get plenty of stares when you walk through town, don't you? ]" Cait blushes, but can't help but smile. Lady Evergreen strides up and runs a softly-furred hand over the catgirl's cheeks. "There's the smile he was so proud of. So tell me, kitten, weren't there supposed to be two of you?" Your companion's expression immediately loses its normal cheer, collapsing into a frown with eyes downcast. "There were," she answers slowly. "M-my sister, Calla, she was kidnapped in the blizzard by some strange men in black robes. [pc.name] helped me track them up the mountain, outside Hawkstone Castle, but there was some sort of... of tear in reality there. A portal. And they threw Calla through it before we could save her." "Ah. And you want to know if I can save her?"

凯特抽泣着：“至少告诉我她去了哪里！她安全吗？她还活着吗？”

“哦，我亲爱的小猫咪，”常青女士叹了口气，把手部放在凯特的肩上，“我很抱歉。就连最伟大的学者们也无法理解这些传送门；它们究竟是如何将无数个世界连接在一起的，我们仍然一无所知。 但我知道，每一个传送门都是一条通道，每当它开启时，总是会在相同的两个点之间进行传送。大多数传送门都能让人在这两个点之间自由移动，但有一个……霍克斯通古庙里的那个传送门……却总是与众不同。你挑了挑眉毛，问道：“有什么不同呢？
        
        [pc.bg arcanist scholar
            |你肯定读过关于传送门的那为数不多的学术研究资料，其中根本没有提到霍克斯通。当然，在那些历史书籍中，边境地区的相关内容也几乎被忽略不计。那么，常青女士是否掌握了一些贝尔哈尔最杰出的学者们所不知道的信息呢？如果真是这样，或许她真的能够帮助你解决与卡希拉之间的矛盾。
            |你虽然不是传送门方面的专家，但如果卡希拉所使用的传送门在某些方面有所不同，或许这能帮助你在与她的对抗中取得优势。
        ]
        
        常青女士微微点头，靠在沙发上说道：“霍克斯通传送门每年只开启一次，而且每次只允许进行一次交易。大多数传送门只要你能找到它们，并用正确的仪式将它们打开，就可以自由通行，但这个传送门……无论它通向哪里，它的运作方式似乎都与其他世界不同。每次只有一样东西能够通过，然后又有一样东西会返回来。而且每年也只发生这一次。
        
        你提到的那个邪教……”她继续说道，“他们在这个地区活动已经有一段时间了，大概是从神战结束之后就开始的。每年都会有人失踪，通常是些无名流浪者或是来自南方的旅行者。我怀疑鹰棘镇的居民们甚至都没有意识到这一现象。而我真正注意到这个问题的，是因为寺庙里传来了强烈的魔法能量波动。不过，从来没有像你提到的那个恶魔出现时那样，引发如此巨大的以太能量波动……
        
        所以根本没有办法救她……至少要等一年之后才行，”凯特叹了口气，肩膀耷了下来。“你是这个意思吗？”

常青女士的手部紧紧握住了凯特的肩膀。“我熟悉那种肌肉度，可爱的小猫咪。 你不相信我……你想强行打开那个传送门。千万别这么做。你的妹妹肯定还活着，不过我不知道她是否安全无恙。那个传送门连接的世界，无疑是一个暗影而危险的地方……但也许也并非没有希望。 现在，先坚定你的意志。去找你的父亲，先把那个传送门的事抛到脑后，直到 [pc.name] 它已经战胜了来自那个世界的暗影势力，那些势力曾试图腐蚀我们的世界。 [pc.HeShe] 需要你。”

“我……”凯特把目光移开，双手部紧紧握住，仿佛随时都会掐出血来。最终，她长叹一声，那声音仿佛[cait.thiccStageRange 2| 肚子和……] 她的胸脯在长袍下剧烈地起伏着。“我做不到……我甚至不知道爸爸现在在哪里。”

“至少这一点，我可以帮你。

        Evergreen's fingers tighten around Cait's shoulders. "I know that tone of voice, pretty kitty. You don't believe me... you want to try and force the portal open. Don't try it. Your sister is doubtless alive, though I don't know if she is safe and well. The world that portal connects to is a dark and dangerous place, I should think, but perhaps not one without hope. Steel your heart for now. Find your father, and put the portal out of your mind until [pc.name] has defeated the darkness that came from that world to corrupt ours. [pc.HeShe] needs you."
        
        "I..." Cait looks away, fists clenching until you're afraid that she'll draw blood. Finally, she heaves a sigh that makes her[cait.thiccStageRange 2| belly and] tits quake beneath her robes. "I can't... I don't even know where dad is, either."
        
        "That, at least, I can help you with."
        '

rows.original:
The sullen expression that had dominated the cat-girl's features washes away in an instant, replaced by wide eyes and a swishing tail. "You know where he is?"
            
            Evergreen smiles. "I do. As I said, he came calling some time ago, and I extracted his next destination from him. He's closer than you think, pretty kitty, doubtless waiting for his daughter to find him. And I'll tell you where he's hiding... for a price."
            
            "What price?" Cait scowls, planting her hands on her hips. "I came all this way, and-"
            
            "And have given me nothing but the pleasure of your company. As nice as you are to look at, dear, knowledge is power. A favor for a favor seems fair, doesn't it?"
            
            Cait cuts her glance from the witch to you. "Go on..."
            
            Evergreen gives her that disarming smile again, spreading her hands as if to mollify the priestess's suspicions. "My favorite price to ask for my services is, of course, to have my callers bear me a child... or put one in my belly. But you're decidedly incapable of either, my little Mallachite. Whatever shall I ask for then...?" the witch drawls, eyes wandering over to you instead. Cait blanches, putting a hand on her [cait.belly].
rows.translation:
那个一直笼罩在猫女脸上的阴郁表情瞬间消失了，取而代之的是一双睁得大大的眼睛和摇摆着的尾巴。“你知道他在哪里吗？”

常青女士笑了起来。“我知道。就像我之前说的，他前段时间来找过我，我从他那里得到了他下一个要去的地方。 他比你想象的要接近得多，漂亮的小猫……他肯定在等着他的女儿找到他。而我可以告诉你他藏在哪里……不过得付出代价才行。

“什么代价？”凯特皱着眉头，双手部叉腰问道。 我大老远跑过来，就是为了——”

“而你给我的，仅仅只是与你相处的乐趣而已。亲爱的，你虽然长得很好看，但知识才是真正的力量。以恩报恩，似乎也是理所应当的，不是吗？
            
            凯特将目光从那位女巫身上移开，转向你：“继续说吧……”

常青女士再次露出了那种让人放松的微笑，摊开双手部，似乎想消除那位女祭司的疑虑：“当然，我提供这些服务时最喜欢的报酬方式，就是让那些找我服务的人生下我的孩子。……或者把某个东西放进我的肚子里。但显然，你这两样事情都做不了，我的小玛拉基特。那么，我该许什么愿好呢……？”女巫低声说道，目光却转向了你。凯特脸色一白，把手部放在了自己的身上。 [cait.belly].

rows.original:
You subtly shake your head. This one's on Cait.

    Lady Evergreen sighs and taps a finger to her chin. "Ah, I think I know something a sweet little kitten could do for me instead. Follow me, Caitriss."
    
    She stands and crooks a finger, bidding the cat-girl to follow her towards the stairs. Cait gives you a hesitant glance, but takes a deep breath and follows Evergreen out of the sitting room. You sit back on the couch and watch them go. 
    
    One of the witch's daughters comes to bring you tea and cookies shortly thereafter, but otherwise you're left climbing the walls for what feels like at least an hour. You're sure you've perused every trinket and arcane nick-nack accumulated in the trophy room by the time you finally hear a quartet of feet padding down the stairs. 
    
    Cait looks flustered, cheeks reddened — and it's not the usual lustful rose-hue that you've seen plenty of times in your adventures. Lady Evergreen follows behind her with a self-satisfied smirk on her dark lips, guiding the catgirl with a hand on her shoulders. Evergreen resumes her seat, slapping Cait's plump rear on her way past.
    
    "You're a precious little thing, aren't you?" she laughs. "Now then, for my end of the bargain. Your father has made his camp in an abandoned caravanserai south of Hawkethorne, a short ways down the road into the valley. I believe he's deluded himself into thinking that the merchant caravans that once ran between the barony and Tychris still exist. The building is quite large and was once a symbol of safety and wealth for the barony; I'm sure he's lost himself to studying it and has entirely forgotten about the passage of time."
    
    "He's been right outside town this whole time!?" Cait gasps. "[pc.name]! We have to go — please?"
    
    Evergreen laughs again. "Oh, yes. Don't forget the Waystone key, [pc.name]. It will make your journeys much faster and safer."
    
    You nod and take Cait's hand. Time to go!
rows.translation:
你微微摇了摇头。这次的事情得由凯特来处理了。

常青女士叹了口气，用手指轻敲着下巴说道：“啊，我想我知道有一件可爱的小猫能够为我做的事情。来吧，凯特，跟我来。”

她站起身，伸出一根手指，示意猫女跟她一起走向楼梯。凯特犹豫地看了你一眼，但还是深吸一口气，跟着常青女士走出了客厅。你重新坐在沙发上，目送她们离去。 
    
    不久之后，其中一个女巫的女儿过来给你端来了茶和饼干，但在那之前，你真的觉得仿佛等了至少一个小时才等到这一刻。当你终于听到有足部步声从楼梯上走下来时，你确信自己已经把奖杯室里所有的小饰品和奇怪的小玩意儿都看了个遍。 
    
    凯特看起来有些慌乱，脸颊也红了——但这并不是你在冒险过程中见过的那种充满欲望的红晕。常青女士跟在她身后，那双漆黑的嘴唇上挂着得意的笑容，用手搭在凯特的肩上引导着她。常青女士回到自己的座位上，经过凯特身边时还轻轻拍了一下她那圆润的臀部。
    
    你真是个可爱的小家伙，对吧？”她笑着说，“那么，现在轮到我说我的条件了。你父亲在鹰棘镇南边的一处废弃商队旅馆里安营扎寨，就在通往山谷的路上不远处。我想，他一定以为那些曾经在男爵领地和蒂克里斯之间往返的商队至今仍然存在吧。 这座建筑规模相当庞大，曾经是这个男爵爵府象征安全与富足的标志；我敢肯定，他完全沉浸在对它的研究之中，彻底忘记了时间的流逝。
    
    他整个时间都待在城镇外面吗？！”凯特惊呼道。[pc.name]我们必须现在就走——求你了？”

常青女士又笑了起来。“哦，对了。别忘了那把路石钥匙。 [pc.name]这会让你的旅途变得更快、更安全。”

你点了点头，然后握住了凯特的手。是时候出发了！

rows.original: "Hold on," you tell her. "You can't seriously be holding this kind of information hostage behind trying to get a child out of me." "I'd be happy to work things out with Caitriss in private, if you aren't willing," the witch says with an even, benevolent smile.[var0 | "Though I think you're overreacting a bit, [pc.name]. You've mated with me for less already." ] You shake your head and take Cait's hand. "No way. We'll find her dad on our own. We're out of here." "[pc.name]!" Cait yelps, dragged along behind you as you head for the door. "W-wait. I don't mind, I'll do whatever-" "No," you tell her, firmly. "Cait, you're better than this. [var1 |And there's no way that witch is knocking you up before me, or whatever weird shit she has planned. |We both are. ] We'll find your dad on our own — he can't have gotten far." Cait's ears tuck against her scalp, but she doesn't protest — at least not as much as the huffing, fuming tanuki you leave behind as you exit the manor. When you've cleared the front door, though, Cait throws her arms around you in a hug that nearly bowls the pair of you over. Only a well-placed tree keeps you from pitching back under the surprise embrace. "Thank you. Thank you for always standing up for me," Cait sighs, burying her face in your shoulder. "I would have-" "I know," you say, patting her head. "But we'll just have to search for him ourselves. He'll turn up. I promise." Cait fixes you with a sunny smile, rubbing at her eye. "I... I'm sure he will. And until we find him, I'll be right with you, same as always!"

rows.original: "I have another idea," you say, carefully weighing your words. Crossing a dangerous witch is often the last thing bold adventurers do, but you don't like any of the other options on the table more. "The quest you sent us on was a little more dangerous than you let on. I think we deserve some [silly |danger pay |compensation ]." "Oh?" Evergreen says, leaning back. "You think you're in a position to alter the deal?" You produce the bag from your pack. "If you want this back, tell Cait what she wants to know." The witch frowns, studying you with a dangerous glint in her eye... before she lets out a soft laugh and relaxes. "Oh, my, you are a bold one. And clearly quite capable. I suppose I may have underestimated your resolve... though not your ability. Very well. The bag's contents are quite valuable to me, after all. You clearly sussed that out." She turns to Cait. "Your father has made camp at an old caravanserai south of Hawkethorne, head west at the first junction and look around. The building is quite remarkable so you shouldn't have much trouble finding it. Merchant caravans used to run from there all the way to Tychris, and, from what I could glimpse of your father, I would presume that he has lost himself entirely to studying it." "He was there this whole time!?" Cait exclaims with understandable shock. She barely regains her composure and turns to you. "[pc.name]! We have to get to him! Please." "Tsk! Don't get ahead of yourself, Caitriss," Evergreen says, extending a hand palm-up to you. "My bag." You hand over the pouch and Evergreen unceremoniously flips it upside down and pulls the string holding it closed. A veritable smorgasbord of sex toys of all shapes and sizes spills out onto the floor. Once the cascade slows to a trickle, Evergreen peruses through the heap for a minute, making sure nothing is missing. Seemingly satisfied, the witch snaps her fingers which prompts a few of her daughters to enter the room and begin clearing out the pile. "All seems to be in order, [pc.name]," the witch says as she lays down onto the cushions. With a smirk, she tosses the now-empty bag at you. You snatch it from the air. The witch shifts, accentuating her curves and setting her eyes on yours with a sultry glint. "Think of it as hazard pay. I know firsthand how insufferable those foxes can be." You thank the tanuki for the extra and are about to put the purse in your bag before you remember what was inside it just a minute ago. Noticing your apprehension, the witch chuckles. "It's clean, [pc.name]. It's not a physical space and as such doesn't retain any residue; all that was in it was removed along with the toys." "Right, thank you." With your concerns addressed, you put the bag into your bag. It will likely come in handy, and you're not one to shirk a witch's gift. At least not in her presence.
rows.translation: 我还有一个主意，”你慎重地开口说道。对于勇敢的冒险者来说，挑战危险的巫婆通常是最最后的选择，但目前的这些选项中，你也没有更喜欢的。“你们交给我们的这个任务，其实比你们透露的要危险得多。我认为我们应该得到一些 [silly |危险津贴 |补偿 ]哦？”常青女士向后靠了靠，说道：“你以为自己有资格改变这个交易条件吗？” 你从背包里拿出了那个袋子：“如果你们想要回这个东西，就告诉凯特她想知道的事情。” 女巫皱起了眉头，用一种充满危险意味的目光注视着你……然后突然轻笑了一声，放松了下来。“哦，天哪，你真是个大胆的人。而且显然也很有能力。我想我可能低估了你的决心……不过你的能力倒是没被我看错。好吧，这个袋子里的东西 是 对我来说，这确实是非常有价值的东西。你显然已经察觉到了这一点。” 她转向凯特：“你父亲在鹰棘镇南边的一座旧商队旅馆里安顿了下来。在第一个岔路口向西走，然后仔细寻找那座建筑——它非常显眼，你应该不难找到它。过去的商队都是从那里出发，一路前往蒂克里斯的。从我对你父亲的观察来看，他应该已经完全沉浸在对那座建筑的研究中了。” “他确实是这样 那里 整个这段时间？！”凯特震惊地叫道。她好不容易才恢复镇定，然后转向你说道。[pc.name]我们必须找到他！求你了。” “啧！别急着，Caitriss，”常青女士说着，伸出手掌朝你说道，“把我的包给我。” 你把袋子递过去，常青女士二话不说地把袋子翻了个个儿，然后拉开了系住袋口的绳子。 各式各样、形状大小不一的性玩具散落在地板上，简直就像一场丰富的盛宴。当这些玩具停止掉落后，常青女士仔细地检查了这一堆，确保没有遗漏任何东西。似乎很满意，她打了个响指，几名女儿立刻走进房间，开始清理这些玩具。 一切看起来都正常， [pc.name]就这样，”女巫一边说，一边躺在垫子上。她露出一丝狡黠的笑容，将那个已经空了的袋子扔向你。你迅速从空中接住了它。女巫的身体微微一动，那曲线更加凸显出来，她用一种充满诱惑的眼神注视着你。 可以把这看作是一种‘危险津贴’吧。我亲身体会过，那些狐狸到底有多让人难以忍受。” 你感谢了那只狸猫给了你这笔额外的钱，正准备把钱包放进包里，突然想起来刚才钱包里还装着什么东西。 看到你脸上的担忧，女巫轻声笑了起来：“它是干净的， [pc.name]那并不是一个实体空间，因此也不会留下任何残留物；里面原本有的东西，连同那些玩具一起，都被清走了。” “好的，谢谢。”你的顾虑得到了解答，于是你把那个袋子放进了自己的包里。这个袋子很可能会在以后派上用场，而你也不是那种会拒绝女巫送的礼物的人。至少在她面前，你是不会这么做的。
rows.raw: ' "I have another idea," you say, carefully weighing your words. Crossing a dangerous witch is often the last thing bold adventurers do, but you don't like any of the other options on the table more. "The quest you sent us on was a little more dangerous than you let on. I think we deserve some [silly |danger pay |compensation ]." "Oh?" Evergreen says, leaning back. "You think you're in a position to alter the deal?" You produce the bag from your pack. "If you want this back, tell Cait what she wants to know." The witch frowns, studying you with a dangerous glint in her eye... before she lets out a soft laugh and relaxes. "Oh, my, you are a bold one. And clearly quite capable. I suppose I may have underestimated your resolve... though not your ability. Very well. The bag's contents are quite valuable to me, after all. You clearly sussed that out." She turns to Cait. "Your father has made camp at an old caravanserai south of Hawkethorne, head west at the first junction and look around. The building is quite remarkable so you shouldn't have much trouble finding it. Merchant caravans used to run from there all the way to Tychris, and, from what I could glimpse of your father, I would presume that he has lost himself entirely to studying it." "He was there this whole time!?" Cait exclaims with understandable shock. She barely regains her composure and turns to you. "[pc.name]! We have to get to him! Please." "Tsk! Don't get ahead of yourself, Caitriss," Evergreen says, extending a hand palm-up to you. "My bag." You hand over the pouch and Evergreen unceremoniously flips it upside down and pulls the string holding it closed. A veritable smorgasbord of sex toys of all shapes and sizes spills out onto the floor. Once the cascade slows to a trickle, Evergreen peruses through the heap for a minute, making sure nothing is missing. Seemingly satisfied, the witch snaps her fingers which prompts a few of her daughters to enter the room and begin clearing out the pile. "All seems to be in order, [pc.name]," the witch says as she lays down onto the cushions. With a smirk, she tosses the now-empty bag at you. You snatch it from the air. The witch shifts, accentuating her curves and setting her eyes on yours with a sultry glint. "Think of it as hazard pay. I know firsthand how insufferable those foxes can be." You thank the tanuki for the extra and are about to put the purse in your bag before you remember what was inside it just a minute ago. Noticing your apprehension, the witch chuckles. "It's clean, [pc.name]. It's not a physical space and as such doesn't retain any residue; all that was in it was removed along with the toys." "Right, thank you." With your concerns addressed, you put the bag into your bag. It will likely come in handy, and you're not one to shirk a witch's gift. At least not in her presence. '

rows.original: You weigh the options presented. [var0 |You can't give anything of your own but you're still |You're ] not keen on seeing your [pc.isDK |property |[cait.fucked |lover |friend ] ] put under so much pressure. The anticipation is thick in the air as Cait herself scrutinizes the offer and Evergreen waits for the response. Just as Cait is about to speak you put a hand on the priestess' shoulder and give her a reassuring pat. She gives you a confused look but you nod assuredly before turning to the witch. "[pc.dcb |Yeah, how about no, |I am sorry but we can't accept that, |You're mean! ]" you say [pc.dcb |coldly |diplomatically |huffily ]. Cait puts a hand on your arm. "[pc.name], it's alright. You don't have to worry about me, I've already made up my mind." You lean in closer and whisper to the kitty. "Cait, you're too good for your own good. I'll handle this." [cait.fucked |You put your hand on her head and she purrs as you give her a few scritches between the ears. |You take her hands in yours and lock eyes with her. ] "Just trust me." It's only a moment until she acquiesces and you return your focus to the tanuki witch. The quizzical look is swiftly replaced with one of natural confidence as you resume your bargaining. "Very well, then. If you have nothing to offer I have nothing to give," Evergreen says with finality. "Now, unless you have other business with me or my daughters I trust you can show yourselves out," she finishes with a dismissive wave of her hand. [pc.isBimbo |"What? Wait!" you blurt out before you lose her attention. "Isn't there anything else we can do? Like some stuff you don't want to? Or something? |"I can't make offers without knowing what it is you want," you rebut before you lose her attention. "Surely there is something else we can do for you. [pc.dcb |Something you'd rather not get your hands dirty doing yourself. |You would get a capable set of hands for whatever issue they might be of help with. |There's gotta be a less mean way of dealing with this! There's just gotta! ] ]" Evergreen shuffles on her cushions, undulating her voluptuous curves, as she considers you for a minute. You keep your eyes on hers, refusing to show any sign of weakness. [pc.isBimbo | Well, a peek wouldn't hurt. No! Bad [pc.name]! You will get that later! ] At last she gives you an approving smirk. "I like you, [pc.title]. It's rare people don't just bend over backwards at my word like your friend almost did," she says, directing a furry finger at Cait who looks down embarrassed and clutches her skirt. "But you are right. There is something that has been bugging me for some time now. I haven't been able to find the time to handle it myself, but I have a feeling it would be a perfect fit for your talents." Your swell of pride doesn't go unnoticed, and Evergreen quickly snuffs it with a finger wag, adding, "Don't count your chickens yet, [pc.name]. This will be far from easy. "I've had something stolen from me and would like it retrieved. It's an unassuming linen pouch. I couldn't care less for the pouch itself, you can even keep it if you so wish, but its contents are of great sentimental value to my family." "And where will I find the thief?" "Up in the northwestern part of woods, west of the bend going towards the collapsed bridge, you will find an out-of-place tree. Inside it dwell hundreds of soul-suckers wearing the guise of foxes who would love nothing more than to wrap you up in their fluffy tails and milk you for every drop of energy until you're more raisin than [pc.raceCute]." "And you are sure of this? It's not just some wild guess?" "Quite sure my dear, [pc.title]. Equivalent exchange is a pillar of their religion and way of life. Of course they are the ones who decide how equivalent the exchange is, as they left me with a pile of leaves for a most precious family treasure." She huffs before quickly regaining composure. "I can't go there myself, as I'm not on the best of terms with their matron, and she wouldn't care for any truth I told, but she might have some sympathy for a third party. She is a massive stickler for following religious and societal norms and would no doubt understand the magnitude of such a breach if you brought it up with her." "I'm getting the idea. Anything else I should know?" "Now we discuss the treacherous part. You are not the first adventurers I have sent to deal with this issue for me." Your brow furrows in concern, but Evergreen is quick to soothe it. "But they were not your ilk, [pc.name]. They proved too big for their britches, which is far removed from the flame I see in you. I would not be offering this if I were not confident in your success. Think about it; if you get killed out there who will go after that red demon? So put your mind at ease and close your mouth before you swallow a fly. "Now, I believe that covers everything. All that remains is the directions to the tree. Those foxes are nothing if not crafty and have taken great precautions to hide their home from unwanted guests, so listen closely..." For the next twenty minutes, Evergreen continuously drills into you the directions and misdirections you will need to account for on your way through the forest to the den of foxes. She has you repeat each instruction until she is sure you know them by heart. "That should be all there is to it, [pc.name]. Get in, get the bag through whatever means the situation permits, and get out. If you're not sure you are up to the task, you can take all the time you need testing your mettle against the other residents of the forest. You might even run into some foxes and get a taste of what awaits you in their den." "I'm glad we could work this out," you say. "Quite so," she replies. "Now be off, the bag will not get itself back." She shoos you out of her chambers, and you are left at the doorstep with Cait[comp1.| and [comp1.name]]. You release the breath you had been holding and find yourself unprepared when Cait barrels into you. Her arms wrap around you and hold you tightly as she buries her face in your [pc.hasBreasts|boobs|shoulder]. For your part, you put one hand around her and the other on her head, gently scritching as she purrs in your arms. "Thank you for looking out for me, [pc.name]," comes a muffled voice as she hugs you even harder. "[pc.dcb |Yeah, but you owe me |Any time, Cait |Any time, kitty-Cait. MWAH ]. Now let's go deal with those thieves and find your dad." "Right!" She chirps and the [comp1.|three|two] of you prepare to make your way to your next destination.
rows.translation: 你需要仔细权衡这些被提出的选择。 [var0 |你无法付出任何属于自己的东西，但却依然如此。 |你真是…… ] 不太想见到你 [pc.isDK |财产 |[cait.fucked |恋人 |朋友 ] ] 面临着如此巨大的压力。空气中弥漫着期待的气息，凯特正在仔细考虑这个提议，而常青女士则等待着她的答复。就在凯特即将开口的时候，你伸手部拍了拍这位女祭司的肩膀，给了她一个安慰性的拍击。她显得有些困惑，但你坚定地点了点头，然后转向了那位女巫。[pc.dcb |是啊，还是算了吧。 |很抱歉，我们无法接受这个提议。 |你真坏！ ]你是这么说的吧 [pc.dcb |冷淡地 |以外交方式 |愤怒地 ]凯特把手部放在你的手部臂上。[pc.name]没关系，你不必担心我，我已经下定决心了。” 你凑近一些，轻声对小猫说道：“凯特，你太善良了，这种事让我来处理吧。 [cait.fucked |你把手放在她的头上，轻轻挠了挠她的耳朵，她便发出满足的呼噜声。 |你握住她的手，与她对视着眼睛。 ] 相信我就好。” 不一会儿，她便同意了，你也将注意力重新转向那只狸猫女巫。你那疑惑的表情立刻被自信的神情所取代，继续开始了你的谈判。 “那好吧。如果你没有什么可以提供的，那我也没有什么可以给予的。”常青女士最终说道。“现在，除非你们还有其他事情要和我或我的女儿们谈，否则我希望你们可以离开这里。”她说着，随意地挥了挥手部。 [pc.isBimbo |什么？等等！”你在她失去注意力之前脱口而出，“难道就没有其他我们可以做的事情了吗？比如一些你并不想做的任务，或者什么的？ |在不知道你到底想要什么之前，我无法提出任何建议，”你在她的注意力开始分散之前说道，“肯定还有其他我们可以为你做的事情。 [pc.dcb |有些事情，你肯定不愿意亲自动手去处理。 |无论遇到什么问题，你都会得到一双乐于提供帮助的可靠之手。 |肯定有更温和、更不残忍的方式来处理这件事吧！肯定有的！ ] ]常青女士女子在垫子上翻来覆去，她那诱人的身姿不断起伏，同时她也注视着你，凝视了一分钟之久。你始终紧盯着她的眼睛，拒绝表现出任何软弱的神情。 [pc.isBimbo | 嗯，看看也无妨吧。 不行！ 糟糕 [pc.name]! 这个你稍后就会得到！ ] 终于，她露出了赞许的微笑：“我喜欢你。 [pc.title]很少有人会像你朋友那样，完全不听我的话，”她说着，用手部指指着凯特，后者尴尬地低下头，紧紧抓着自己的裙子。“不过你说得对，确实有件事让我困扰了好一阵子了。 我一直没找到时间亲自处理这件事，但我觉得这个任务非常适合你的能力。” 你那股骄傲的情绪并没有被忽视，常青女士迅速用手部指一摇就扑灭了它，接着说道：“别急着庆祝胜利吧。 [pc.name]这绝对不是一件容易的事。” “有人偷走了我的东西，我希望把它找回来。那只是一个普通的亚麻布袋子，我对这个袋子本身根本不感兴趣，你们如果愿意的话，甚至可以把它留下来，但里面的东西对我的家人来说具有非常重要的纪念意义。那我在哪里能找到那个小偷呢？” “在森林的西北部，朝着那座倒塌的桥梁延伸去的弯道以西，你会看到一棵生长得不合时宜的树。在那棵树里，住着数百只伪装成狐狸的吸魂怪物，它们最想做的就是用它们柔软的尾巴缠住你，然后榨取你身上最后一滴能量，直到你彻底变成干瘪的葡萄干 [pc.raceCute]你确定吗？这并不是随便的猜测吧？” “我非常确定，亲爱的。 [pc.title]等价交换是他们宗教信仰与生活方式的基石，这一点当然毋庸置疑。 他们 正是他们决定了这种交换是否公平合理，因为他们只给了我一堆树叶，却要我交出一份极其珍贵的家庭珍宝。”她气呼呼地说，但很快又恢复了平静。“我自己无法去那里，因为我和他们的女主人关系并不好，她根本不会听我说的任何解释，不过或许第三方的话能让她有所考虑。 她非常严格遵守宗教和社会规范，如果你跟她谈论这种行为所带来的严重后果，她肯定能够理解其中的重要性。 我明白了。还有其他我需要知道的事情吗？现在我们来讨论这个棘手部的部分。你并不是我派去处理这个问题的第一个冒险者。”你担忧地皱起了眉头，但常青女士立刻安慰道：“不过，那些人并不是像你这样的家伙。 [pc.name]他们自视甚高，但实际上能力远远不够，这与我看到的你身上的那份热情与斗志截然不同。如果我对你的成功没有信心，我也不会提出这个建议。好好想想吧——如果你在战斗中牺牲了，谁会去继续追击那个红色恶魔呢？ 所以，你们大可以放心了，先闭上嘴，再把苍蝇咽下去吧。 “现在，我想这些应该已经涵盖了所有该说的内容。剩下的就是去那棵树的路线了。那些狐狸可真是狡猾，它们已经采取了各种措施来隐藏自己的家园，不让不速之客找到，所以请仔细听好了。在接下来的二十分钟里，常青女士不断地向你讲解在穿过森林前往狐狸巢穴的过程中需要注意的各种方向指示和迷惑手部段。她让你反复练习每一条指令，直到确定你已经完全记住了它们。 应该就只有这些了， [pc.name]进去吧，想尽一切办法拿到那个袋子，然后再出来。如果你不确定自己是否有能力完成这个任务，那就花些时间去和森林里的其他生物较量一番吧。说不定还会遇到一些狐狸，从而提前了解在它们的巢穴里会遇到什么。” “我很高兴我们能够解决这个问题，”你说。 “确实如此，”她回答道，“现在快走吧，那个袋子可不会自己跑回来。”她把你赶出了她的房间，于是你只能和凯特一起站在门口。[comp1.| 以及 [comp1.name]]你终于松开了一直憋在体内的呼吸，却没想到凯特会突然冲过来。她将双臂环绕在你身上，紧紧地抱住你，同时把脸埋在你的怀里 [pc.hasBreasts|胸部|肩膀]谢谢你一直照顾我， [pc.name]她紧紧地抱住你，同时传来一个低沉的声音。[pc.dcb |是啊，但你欠我一个人情。 |随时都可以，凯特。 |随时都可以，小凯蒂。 哇哦 ]现在我们去找那些小偷，把你的爸爸找回来吧。” “好哇！”她兴奋地叫道。 [comp1.|三|两个] 是时候你们准备前往下一个目的地了。

几个小时后，你抱着常青女士走下楼，却发现凯特正轻轻地在女巫的沙发上打瞌睡。常青女士以一种经过无数次练习后形成的娴熟动作，轻轻地将凯特的头部抬起来，放在自己的腿上。直到你开始轻轻抚摸它耳朵的后面，这只粉发的小猫才终于醒了过来。

    你真是个可爱的小家伙，对吧？”她笑着说，此时凯特的耳朵不由自主地抽动起来。“你的这位朋友确实很有说服力……所以我想，我必须履行自己的承诺。毕竟，我可是个言出必行的女巫。”

凯特赶紧眨了眨眼睛，试图让自己清醒过来，同时揉了揉眼睛。 然而，她却纹丝不动，仿佛被常青女士那穿梭于她鬃毛间的手指所迷住了。

“你的父亲在鹰棘镇南边的一处废弃商队旅馆里安营扎寨了，就在通往山谷的道路尽头不远处。 我认为他一直在自欺欺人，以为那些曾经在男爵领地和提克里斯之间往返的商队至今仍然存在。那座建筑规模相当庞大，曾经是男爵领地安全和富庶的象征；我敢肯定，他完全沉浸在对它的研究之中，彻底忘记了时间的流逝。他整个时间都待在城镇外面吗？！”凯特惊呼道。[pc.name]我们必须走了——拜托了？”

常青女士又笑了起来。“哦，对了。别忘了那把路石钥匙。 [pc.name]这会让你的旅途变得更快、更安全。”

你点了点头，然后扶起凯特站了起来。是时候出发了！

rows.original:
You're not the only caller in the witch's solar today: her daughter, Senja, is sitting on couch beside her mother with one of the bigger witch's arms wrapped affectionately around her shoulders, held close while an old grimoire rests open over both their laps. 
    
    "Ah, [pc.name]," Evergreen murmurs, idly stroking Senja's dark lockes. "I'm afraid you'll have to wait just a bit, my darling daughter and I are still going through a bit of spellcraft together. We don't want a repeat of the courtyard incident, do we love?"
    
    Senja blushes, squirming. "N-no mother..."
    
    "One day, you'll be an archmage near as powerful as I am. I'd be a poor mother indeed if I didn't make sure you were capable of controlling all that power — not just for your sake, either. So once more, Senja, let's go through the dispelling sigils. These will be your best friend if e'er your magic goes wild in your hands again. Follow along now."
    
    The elder Evergreen puts her hand over her daughter's, guiding her through a series of runic symbols traced in the air, one after the other. You sit by and watch the process, admiring mother and daughter at work until Senja's confident enough to try the process without Oxana's guidance. It's not perfect, but her mother's quick to correct her small errors — and they are small, [pc.isMage
        |so much so that you didn't even notice them until they're pointed out
        |so much so that you can't tell the difference between correct and erroneous performance
    ] — before hefting the grimoire into Senja's arms and telling the younger tanuki "Keep studying, my dear. A little more practice and you'll be able to safeguard yourself from even the direst magics. And now for you, [pc.name]... what can this old witch do for you, hmm?"
rows.translation:
今天，在这位女巫的家中，不止你一个人在通话：她的女儿森雅正坐在母亲的旁边，女巫的一只手部臂亲切地搭在她的肩上，将她紧紧搂在怀里，而一本古老的魔法书则摊开放在她们的腿上。

“啊， [pc.name]常青女士低声说道，轻柔地抚摸着塞尼亚那乌黑的发丝。‘恐怕你还得再等一会儿，我亲爱的女儿，我们还在一起研究一些魔法呢。我们可不想让那种发生在庭院里的事情再次发生，对吧？塞尼亚的脸颊顿时涨红了，她扭动着身体说道：“不、妈妈……”

“总有一天，你会成为一名和我一样强大的大法师。如果我不能确保你能够驾驭那些力量，那我确实算是个不称职的母亲——而且，这不仅仅是为了你好。 所以，森雅，让我们再复习一遍这些驱散符文。如果你的魔法再次失控，这些符文一定会成为你的得力帮手部。现在，请跟着我一起操作吧。”

年长的常青女士将手部放在女儿的手部上，引导她一一描摹那些在空中绘制的符文。 你坐在一旁，观察着这个过程，欣赏着母女俩的协作。直到森雅变得足够自信，能够在没有奥克萨娜指导的情况下尝试这个过程。虽然她的动作还不够熟练，但她的母亲立刻纠正了她那些小错误——而这些错误确实都很微小。 [pc.isMage
        |以至于直到别人指出来，你才注意到它们的存在。
        |以至于你根本无法区分哪些表现是正确的，哪些是错误的。
    ] — 他把那本魔法书交到Senja的手部中，然后对那只年轻的狸猫说道：“继续努力学习吧，我的孩子。再多加练习，你就能保护自己，甚至能够抵御最强大的魔法了。现在，轮到你了…… [pc.name]这个老巫婆能为你做些什么呢，嗯？

I've got many years left, and I teach all my daughters enough magic as they grow up so that any can serve. I'm not in a hurry. Yet. But let's not tarry on the point, it's awfully depressing to think about."
rows.translation: 首先，从你开始。” 常青女士将一缕栗色头发绕在手指上，移开了视线。“如果你坚持的话，那就问吧。我会尽我所能回答你的问题。” 是在防御，还是在戏弄你？对她来说，很难分辨。不管怎样，你还是继续问道：“那么，你来自哪里？我觉得塔努基人并不原生于边境地区。” “观察得很敏锐！”女巫回道，漆黑的嘴唇露出一丝讥讽的笑容，“我也在想，为什么这么难找到一个稳定的伴侣呢 [evergreen.kidsRange 3|直到你的出现|在北方这里]不过，确实如此，狸猫原产于半个地球之外的一片群岛。如果你想知道我具体是在哪里出生的，那就是那边那个房间。” 常青女士指向她客厅外的走廊，指向你们还没有进去过的其中一个侧室。 我的祖先当然是移民。当神战席卷这片土地时，我的一位先祖跟随她的狐族领主来到了这片异国之地，共同抵御来自东方的恶魔入侵。当然，那场战争已经结束两个多世纪了，那么我为什么会在这里呢？ 有时候我也会问自己同样的问题。不过，就在不远处，有一整个由狐妖组成的群体潜伏着……我在想，是否 任何那次鲁莽的远征中，有谁最终回到了家乡吗？我的祖先们显然没有回来，他们的后代也同样如此。” 当然，如今常青女士早已成为了自己族群中的重要人物，但你还是忍不住问道：“那你的父母呢？” 她只是耸了耸肩，仿佛对此并不感兴趣：“我有一个父亲，但我从未见过他。我的大多数女儿们也都不知道自己的父亲是谁，其实这样也好。 [evergreen.kidsRange 3|你是唯一的 [pc.manWoman] 值得向他们介绍。在激情的夜晚，唯一一个能够多次完成这一壮举的人。 ]当然，我并不是在抱怨。我更喜欢按照自己的方式来抚养家庭。不过，我母亲的情况就不同了——在她之前，她的母亲就已经是这片森林里的女巫了。这是一种职业，一种需要广泛的知识和深厚的魔法天赋，这种传承是从母亲传给女儿的。最终，我也将会继承这一传统。 [silly|超越熟女领域|直到老年] 然后退到一边，让我的某个女儿来接替我的位置。” “你已经在为这个职位挑选人选了吗？” 她向你露出一个危险而狡黠的笑容：“我确实留意了一两个人选，但还没有做出决定。我还有很多年的时间，而且我会在我所有女儿成长过程中教会她们足够的魔法，这样她们中的任何一个都可以胜任这个职位。我现在还不着急。不过，我们不要再讨论这个话题了，一想到这些就让人感到非常沮丧。
rows.raw: ' "You, for starters." Evergreen looks away, curling a lock of auburn hair around a dark finger. "If you insist. Ask your questions. I will answer as best I can." Defensive, or toying with you? Hard to tell with her. Either way, you press onwards. "So, where are you from? I don't think tanukis are native to the Marches." "Astute observation!" the witch ripostes, dark lips spreading into a smirk. "I had wondered why it was so difficult to find a steady partner [evergreen.kidsRange 3|until you came along|here in the north]. But yes, tanuki are native to an island archipelago half the world away. If you're wondering where I, specifically, was born, it was right over yonder." Evergreen points down the hallway outside her parlor, towards one of the side rooms you haven't been in yet. "I'm descended from immigrants, though, of course. When the Godswar ravaged this land, an ancestor accompanied her kitsune liege to this foreign land to help stem the tide of demons from the easterlands. Of course, the war ended more than two centuries ago, so why am I here? Sometimes I ask myself the same question. Then again, just up the road, there's an entire den of kitsunes lurking about. I wonder if anyone from that foolhardy expedition ever returned home? My ancestors certainly did not, nor did theirs." Of course, Evergreen's clearly a matron of her own clan now, but you're curious: "What about your parents?" She merely shrugs, as if disinterested. "I had a father, but never knew him. Most of my daughters do not know theirs, either, and just as well. [evergreen.kidsRange 3|You're the only [pc.manWoman] worth introducing to them. The only one to father more than one in a night of passion. ]Not that I'm complaining, of course, I prefer the freedom to raise my family as I see fit. Now, my mother was a different story — she was the witch of the woods before me, and her mother before her. It's an occupation, a breadth of knowledge and depth of magical talent, passed from mother to daughter. Eventually I, too, will pass [silly|beyond milfdom|into old age] and step aside so that one of my daughters will replace me." "Are you already grooming one for the job?" She flashes you a dangerous little smile. "I have my eye on one or two, but I haven't made my decision yet. I've got many years left, and I teach all my daughters enough magic as they grow up so that any can serve. I'm not in a hurry. Yet. But let's not tarry on the point, it's awfully depressing to think about." '

rows.original: You'd like to know a little more about the witch herself.
rows.translation: 你肯定想更多地了解这位女巫本人的一些情况。
rows.raw: "You'd like to know a little more about the witch herself."

rows.original: "So, your daughters..." "Ah, beautiful, aren't they? It's no accident that I have so many, nor that they're all so comely and intelligent. Ever since my ancestors began living here, the Evergreen clan has perfected magic and ritual to ensure that our children grow up quickly — and grow up to be exceptional." [evergreen.kidsRange 1|Yes, you've noticed that. Her clan's pregnancies advance very quickly compared to any normal woman.|Is that so?] She smiles, leaning back into her sofa and steepling her fingers. "It's powerful magic, the stuff of ancient royal courts, but make no mistake, [pc.name]: I am deserving of the respect the village folk speak of me with, and there is no length I will not go to for my family. I am the product of these same spells, of course; I am easily twice your age in years, but I reached adulthood in my first year. You can imagine how many hours I have spent in perfecting my magic — and improving on my mother's." "So your daughters are perfect?" you ask. [evergreen.kidsRange 2|Obviously your kids with her are perfect, but is that really the result of her magic?] Evergreen's dark eyes twinkle. "That's right. As close as we mere mortals can get anyway. They are mortal, though, enhanced as they are. My daughters can be petulant and bitchy and they have their own desires and secrets... I deal with everything that any other mother must." The witch trails off for a moment, and her gaze seems to be going right through you now, off to some thought only she's privy to. When she speaks again, it's with a wistful sigh. "I love them all dearly. Each one is precious to me, no matter how they came into the family." [flags.TANUKI_WITCH_ENCOUNTER |After a moment's consideration, you bring up a particular tanuki you've been seeing in the forest lately — one that expressed an interesting in stealing part of your body after attacking you. Evergreen sighs, "Ah, yes, her. A few of my daughters are rather naughty, and not in the fun way necessarily. Unfortunately I simply have so many that it's impossible to control them all. Still, they don't mean any harm — I at least raised them right enough to know that they'd never really hurt you. Using the other magics I might have taught them, on the other hand... well, I'm sure there's a few of my children out there causing mischief. Probably a few sisters too. "No chance you'll take responsibility for them?" "None!" Evergreen answers cheerily. "Any member of my clan you find outside these walls is an adult, capable of making her own decisions and mistakes. If you seek compensation for damages done, whatever that may be, take it up with the lady in question. But do feel free to remind her that nobody's too old for a spanking." ] [flags.SENJA_MET |"And how about Senja?" you ask, indicating the open courtyard in the middle of the manse. "She certainly stands out from the pack." "Ah, so you noticed." Evergreen snorts softly and crosses her legs, following your gaze towards the door. "Sen is one of my oldest. Fathered by a sweet-talking scoundrel that wanted me to brew a love potion for a certain lady. Insisted that he experience what his would-be paramour would firsthand before he'd accept it." You blink. "So her father made you drug him?" She nods. "It was a lovely night. He was truly a romantic... and when the time came, wanted to explore every inch of our bodies together. And the seed he left behind bloomed into an equally charming, and every bit as adventurous, daughter. Of all my children, Sen wanders farthest abreast — as far as Hawkethorne, even to Khor'minos once or twice. Her wanderlust is insatiable, and she's gotten some sticky fingers, too. I'm sure, if you're bringing her up, she's already tried to sell you something she's dug up in the forest for drinking money." "She's a little moody and rebellious these days, but under that act is a real gentle romantic," Evergreen chuckles. "Give her a little attention and she'll melt in your arms." "Is that encouragement?" Evergreen's eyes just glint with mischief as she sips her drink. ]
rows.translation: 那么，你的女儿们……” “啊，真是漂亮极了，不是吗？我有这么多女儿，而且她们个个都如此美丽聪慧，这绝非偶然。自从我们的祖先开始在这里生活以来，常青女士氏族就不断钻研魔法与仪式，就是为了确保我们的孩子能够快速成长——并且长大后成为 出色的." [evergreen.kidsRange 1|是的，你注意到了这一点。她所在氏族的女性怀孕周期确实有所缩短。 非常 与任何普通女性相比，她都显得格外出众。|真是这样吗？] 她微笑着，靠在沙发上，手指交叉着。“这是强大的魔法，是古代王室才会使用的魔法，但请不要误会 [pc.name]我确实值得村民们对我的尊敬，为了我的家人，我愿意付出任何代价。当然，我也是这些魔法的产物；我的年龄大概是你的两倍，但我在第一年就达到了成年。你可以想象，我花了多少时间来钻研魔法，不断改进我的技艺，也努力继承我母亲的魔法。” “那么你的女儿们就是完美的了？”你问道。 [evergreen.kidsRange 2|显然 你的 和她在一起的孩子们都非常可爱，但这真的都是她的“魔法”在起作用吗？] 常青女士那双深色的眼睛闪烁着光芒。“没错。对于我们这些凡人来说，已经算是非常接近了。不过，他们终究还是凡人，尽管得到了强化。我的女儿们有时会任性、爱抱怨，她们也有自己的欲望和秘密。我必须承担任何一位母亲都应该承担的责任。” 女巫停顿了片刻，她的目光仿佛穿透了你，仿佛在思考一些只有她自己才明白的事情。当她再次开口时，语气中带着一丝怅惘。 我非常爱他们每一个人。对他们来说，每一个成员都是无比珍贵的，无论他们是以什么样的方式加入这个家庭的。 [flags.TANUKI_WITCH_ENCOUNTER |经过片刻思考，你提到了最近在森林里经常看到的那只狸猫——那只在攻击你之后，还表现出想要偷走你身体某部分的兴趣的狸猫。 常青女士叹了口气，说道：“啊，是的 她我的几个女儿有时候挺调皮的，不过这种调皮并不一定是出于恶意。可惜我的女儿太多了，实在没办法一一管教她们。不过，她们并没有恶意——至少我教育得还算不错，她们应该知道自己不会真的伤害到别人。 另一方面，如果我教给了他们其他魔法的话……嗯，我敢肯定，肯定有一些我的孩子们在外面惹麻烦。说不定还有一些姐妹们也在干同样的事。 “你绝对不会为他们的行为负责吧？没有！”常青女士愉快地回答道，“我族中任何一个人，只要他们不在这些围墙之外，都是成年人了，他们有能力自己做出决定，也会自己承担错误带来的后果。如果你们想要为所遭受的损害获得赔偿，无论是什么损害，都应该直接去找相关的人去解决。 但你可以随时提醒她：没有人会因为年纪太大而不能被拍打一下。 ] [flags.SENJA_MET |那Senja呢？”你问道，目光指向宅邸中央那片开阔的庭院，“她确实显得与众不同。” “啊，原来你注意到了。”常青女士轻哼了一声，盘腿而坐，顺着你的视线望向那扇门，“Sen是我最早出生的孩子之一。她的父亲是个嘴甜心坏的家伙，他想要我为一位女士配制爱情魔药，还坚持要自己在接受这份感情之前，先亲身体验那位女士的感受。 你眨了眨眼：“所以是她父亲逼你给他下药的？” 她点了点头：“那个夜晚真的很美好。他真的是个浪漫的人……到了那个时候，他想要一起探索我们身体的每一个角落。而他留下的种子，最终孕育出了一个同样迷人、同样充满冒险精神的女儿。 在我的所有孩子中，Sen走得最远——她甚至去过鹰棘镇，还有一两次去了Khor’minos。她的冒险欲望永远无法满足，而且她还挺喜欢偷东西的。我敢肯定，如果你正在抚养她，她肯定已经试着把在森林里找到的东西卖给你，想赚点钱买东西喝了吧。" 这些天她有点情绪化，也有些叛逆，但在那副外表下，其实是个非常温柔、浪漫的人呢。”常青女士轻笑着说道，“只要多给她一些关心，她一定会在你怀里软化下来的。” “这算是在鼓励我吗？” 常青女士喝了一口饮料，眼中闪着调皮的光芒。 ]

rows.translation: 去了解一下常青女士有多少个孩子吧。

rows.original: "So... do you have any sons?" you venture. Evergreen simply answers "No," and takes a long sip of tea. [flags.EVERGREEN_FUCKED |When you don't take the hint to broach a new line of conversation, Evergreen sighs and shifts her legs around, trying to get comfortable around the size of her endowments. "I have no sons. I'm a woman, and I know how to raise girls. Of course, tanukis are predominantly women-hermaphrodites like myself anyway, but I suppose you're asking about the inevitable outliers. Even the gods don't win at dice as often as I'd need to." She takes a long time in elaborating, staring into her steaming drink. When you lean in, she tsks her tongue and says, "So. Yes. I put my thumb on the scales, if you must know. And no, I don't take my newborn sons out into the woods and leave them for wolves. I am a witch, and a powerful one. I leave you to guess how I've solved the issue." "Magic?" "Magic. Transmutation is the name of my game, [pc.name], and I'm quite good at it. Enough to change my own body to suit my desires. To change my children, too, even when they're nothing but sperm and egg. It's as harmless as any of the other alterations I make to them in the womb, when I bear children. Minor enhancements for a perfect child. You understand." Do you? ]
rows.translation: 那么……你有没有儿子？”你小心翼翼地问道。 常青女士只是简单地回答：“没有”，然后长长地喝了一口茶。 [flags.EVERGREEN_FUCKED |当你没有领会暗示，没有主动开启新的话题时，常青女士会叹了口气，然后调整坐姿，试图让自己在这种尴尬的处境中感到更舒适些。“我没有儿子。我是个女人，我知道如何抚养女儿。 当然，塔努基族成员主要是女性——反正我和他们一样都是雌雄同体，但我想你指的是那些例外情况吧。就连神明在掷骰子时，也不总能如我所愿地获得胜利。 她花了很长时间来详细解释，目光一直盯着自己那杯热气腾腾的饮料。 当你靠近她时，她吐了吐舌头，说道：“那么，没错。如果你非要知道的话，我是把拇指放在天平上的。而且，我并不会把刚出生的儿子们带到森林里，然后丢给狼群。我是个女巫，而且是个强大的女巫。 让我来猜猜我是如何解决这个问题的吧。” “魔法吗？” “没错，魔法。我的游戏就叫做《转化》。 [pc.name]我在这方面相当擅长。甚至能够改变自己的身体，使之符合自己的意愿。能够改变自己的 孩子们也是这样，即使它们还只是精子和卵子而已。这种改变和我怀胎期间对它们进行的任何其他调整一样，都是无害的——这些小小的改进都是为了让孩子更加完美。你明白我的意思吧？ ]

rows.original: Does Evergreen really only have daughters? Because you've certainly seen no men around the estate...
rows.translation: 常青女士庄园里真的只有女性吗？因为在那里你肯定没有看到任何男性……
rows.raw: "Does Evergreen really only have daughters? Because you've certainly seen no men around the estate..."

rows.original: "So, about your magic..." "Ah, my favorite subject!" Evergreen beams. "I know a bit of enchanting and combat magic, a few charms and hexes, but transmutation is my area of expertise: the alteration of objects and mutation of a person's physical properties. Altering bodies is a particular speciality. If you ever find that you wish to be more fecund than you are, enhance or reduce the size of your sexual endowments, bear children more quickly than normal... or even [pc.ra tanuki|return to your superior state as|become] a tanuki like me, I'm always willing to help. For a price, of course." She smirks and [evergreen.isPregnant|runs a hand over her already-pregnant belly. "Don't worry, I'll be able to take more of your... payments... soon enough. Though if you want to mix pleasure instead of business, I'm always eager."|runs a hand over her soft stomach. "My prices are veerrry reasonable, too."] Riiight. "So, how did you learn all of that?" "From my mother, of course," Evergreen answers. "And from her mother before her, etcetera, since my ancestors first came to this land from the Old Country. The first Evergreen was a warrior-mage of some skill, but it's taken all the generations in between to really refine and expand our magic to what it is today. And there's always room for improvement, too. Now then, you've seen my collection out in the main hall, yes? Now imagine three times that volume in magical texts, put to paper by my ancestors during their tenure. And much more than that is orally gifted from mother-to-daughter. That is how I learned, [pc.name]. A great deal of patience and study, and a careful master that taught me all she could." "Tell me more about transmutation." She grins. "My, you're a curious one... but if you insist on plying me on my favorite topic, how can I resist? Transmutation, transformation, is the noble art of making cocks and tits bigger, of filling balls with virile seed and making wombs replete with fertile eggs. Of course, there are other applications: alchemy is a sister-study, hybridizing materials into potions, turning lead into gold. Well, that's on the very advanced side, but you get the point. The whole idea is to use symbolism as a channel for magic, rather than complex rituals or circles. You transpose values from one thing to another, often with a catalyst. Electrum is useful for simple processes like potions, but anything more complex requires more potent reagents." "Usually fun ones," she adds with a wicked smirk.
