rows.original: "So how did you end up with an estate like this?" you ask. "It's certainly unique for the Frostwood." "Many generations of hard work," Evergreen says with a chuckle. "When this estate was first built, it was but a cabin in a woodland clearing. A shelter my first ancestor in this land worked hard to build when it became clear that the divine forces that brought her and her kitsune masters to the Marches would not be returning her. So my ancestor built a home for herself here, and her daughters expanded on it as the brood grew... and then again as their own children were born. Carry on over two hundred years of families coming up here, collecting trinkets and magic, and bearing oh so many children, and you can imagine how many hands have pitched into making this the most comfortable home we could make it." It is a very nice home, easily the equal to any southern manor you passed by on the way to the Marches. Though you have to ask, "Why didn't your family settle in Hawkethorne?" "Oh, honey, when the war was just winding down, there was no Hawkethorne. The castle was crumbling and the village was a smouldering ruin. It wasn't for another hundred years or so that people started returning to the area, and even longer before Hawkethorne resembled a village again. By that point, the Evergreen clan was already well established here. Tearing up my family's roots just for the pleasure of a few dozen peasants' company simply doesn't make sense. Perhaps in another few hundred years, the town will grow so much that we become de facto part of the outskirts. Now that the alraune has been dealt with and the bridge fort is open to occupation again, that might just happen." Laughing, she adds, "it would be a shame to lose my near-mythic status as a witch of the woods only to become the witch by the corner store, though, wouldn't it?"

rows.translation: 你正坐在篝火旁。 [party.solo|独自一人|与……一起 [party.compNames]] 当……的时候 [pc.hasEmoteEars|你的 [pc.ears] 感到振奋起来|你听到了吧] 一种陌生的声音。听起来像是有什么非常大的东西被拖在地上，而你此时正站在那里 [pc.feet] 用你的 [pc.weapon] 当罪魁祸首出现时，画面立刻被吸引住了。 那是一条巨大的娜迦，它那蛇一般的身体从类人形态的部分开始，向后延伸了将近十五英尺。这就是你在树上遇到的那个蛇女！ “嗨……”她打着哈欠，困倦地闭上了眼睛，还用手捂住了嘴。 你还没来得及开口回应，它就已经滑到了你身边，将它的身体缠绕在你的腰上——然后便放松下来，躺在了它真正可能想要的目标旁边——也就是你的篝火旁。 嗯，尽管它不请自来地闯进了你的营地，还把你缠得动弹不得，但它 真的吗 这似乎是一种威胁。你小心翼翼地挣脱了她那无力的抓握，放下了武器，好奇地注视着她。 “那么……你为什么离开你的树呢？”你问道。 “因为太无聊了，”她回答道。 也是，确实挺无聊的。
rows.raw: " You're sitting at the campfire [party.solo|alone|with [party.compNames]] when [pc.hasEmoteEars|your [pc.ears] perk up at|you hear] an unfamiliar noise. It sounds like something very large being dragged across the ground, and you're already standing on your [pc.feet] with your [pc.weapon] drawn when the culprit makes its appearance. A giant naga, her snake-like body extending what must be close to fifteen feet back from her humanoid half. It's the snakewoman you encountered in the tree! "Hellooooo," she yawns at length, sleepily closing her eyes and putting a hand over her mouth. Before you can even open your mouth to reply she's slithering up to you and wrapping her coils around your waist — only to relax and lie prone next to what might have been her true goal — your campfire. Well, despite waltzing into your camp unannounced and leaving you mired in a layer of coils she doesn't really seem like a threat. Carefully extricating yourself from her languid grasp, you put your weapon down and regard her with curiosity. "So... why'd you leave your tree?" you ask. "It's boring," comes the reply. Fair enough. "

rows.original:
[flags.FLUFFSNEK_CAMP_MET
        |[rand
            |You sit down near Vatia and she shifts her coils to plant her head in your lap, smiling up at you.
            |Vatia's all nice and reclined next to the fire — perfect for lounging. You sit down against her massive, snake-like body and lean against her like a couch, putting your arms around her before she coils around you to put her head in your lap.
            |Sitting down near Vatia for a chat proves to be too much of a temptation for her — she wraps her coils around you until you're almost coated in them, then lays her upper body across them like a bed. She gives you a smile.
        ]
        |"I don't think I ever got your name," you say to the busty — and noticeably naked — snakewoman, taking a seat beside her. "I'm [pc.name]."
        
        She sits up a little — just enough to slide forward and put her head down in your lap, a small breath escaping her lips as she sighs happily. "It's Vatia."
        
        It seems totally natural to take her head in your hands and stroke her long, raven-black hair, brushing strands of it out of her face while she rests. Vatia seems to appreciate the attention.
        
        She cracks an eye open and glances up at you. "[var0
            |Thanks for keeping me warm that one time.
            |Thank you for keeping me warm all those times.
            |Thank you for keeping me warm so often. It was nice.
        ]"
    ]

rows.original:
"What's your story? How'd you end up napping in a tree?" you ask.

    "Hmm... I traveled a long way and lost track of the seasons," Vatia says. "The last time I didn't hibernate was awful. So I just laid down where I was and took a nap."
rows.translation:
你的故事是什么？你怎么会跑到树上睡觉的呢？”你问道。

“嗯……我旅行了很长的路，结果完全忘记了季节的变化，”瓦蒂亚回答说，“上次没有进入冬眠状态，情况简直糟透了。所以我就找了个地方躺下，小睡了一会儿。

rows.original:
"You lost track of the seasons?" you echo. "Isn't that kind of important for a naga?"
    
    "Depends where I end up," she says. "Worst case, I make my own magical fire and rest until I can move again."
    
    [flags.FLUFFSNEK_TALK_MAGICK
        |"Good point. With skills like yours, I can't imagine making a fire is too much of a challenge," you say.
        
        "True, but sleeping next to an unattended fire has its own problems," Vatia points out.
        |"Oh, you can use magic? That's handy," you say.
        
        Vatia just smiles.
    ]

你都忘记季节的变化了？”你问道，“对于一条娜迦来说，这难道不很重要吗？”

“那得看我会出现在什么地方，”她回答，“最坏的情况下，我就自己制造魔法火焰，休息一段时间，等身体恢复后再继续前进。
    
    [flags.FLUFFSNEK_TALK_MAGICK
        |说得有道理。以你的能力，生火应该不是什么困难的事吧，”你说。

“确实如此，但如果在无人看管的火堆旁边睡觉，也会带来一些问题，”瓦蒂亚指出。
        |哦，你会使用魔法？那可真方便啊，”你说道。

瓦蒂亚只是微笑着。
    ]

rows.original:
"What was not hibernating like?" you ask.
    
    "Ugh," Vatia moans. "I was tired and grumpy all the time. No energy. Felt like death the whole way through. There wasn't a single good thing about it."
    
    "Why did you do it, then?" you say. "Were you in danger?"
    
    "Oh, no," she says, waving a hand. "I just wanted to finish a spell I'd been working on."
    
    [silly
        |So she was a student pulling an extended all-nighter to finish an assignment. 
    ]"You need to take better care of yourself," you say, gently reprimanding her. "Sleep is healthy[pc.bg scholar
        |, but... I get it. I've gone without sleep when I'm knee-deep in research myself."
        
        "Oh, a kindred spirit,"
        |, especially for a race that hibernates."
        
        "Thank you for your concern,"
    ] Vatia says, smiling. "You're right, of course. I don't pay enough attention to my surroundings."
    
    "So I gather," you say, and the snakewoman giggles.
rows.translation:
那不像是冬眠该有的状态吧？”你问道。

“唉，”瓦蒂亚叹了口气，“我整天都感到疲惫不堪，脾气也很差。完全没有精力，整个人都像死了一样。这种状态一点好处都没有。”

“那你当初为什么要这么做呢？”你继续问道，“是遇到了什么危险吗？”

“哦，不是的，”她摆了摆手，“我只是想完成一个我一直在研究的法术而已。
    
    [silly

“哦，原来还有同感的人啊。

“感谢你的关心。

“所以，我是这么理解的……”你说道，而那位蛇女则轻声笑了起来。

rows.original: "You might not know this, but the Marches are dangerous right now. And they're getting worse by the day," you say. "It's a good thing you've joined up with us. I never felt quite right about leaving you there alone with all the things going on in this land." "My hero," Vatia murmurs, shifting just enough to give you a kiss on the cheek. Her soft pink lips feel like silk brushing against your [pc.skinFurScales]. "You don't have to worry about me, [pc.name]. I can take care of myself." Well... she is an exceptionally large naga. It looks like she would tower over [party.has brint |Brint |[party.has brienne |Brienne |you ] ] were she to pull herself up to her full height, and you can imagine there's some power to a body that heavy. It's possible she could crush the life from an invader but, well... You look over the naked naga, staring at the puffy fluff adorning her wrists and chest. Vatia smiles modestly. "Appearances can be deceiving," she reminds you. "True," you say.

A long howl reaches your ears and sends a shiver down your spine. You draw your [pc.weapon] and stay on guard; whatever beast let out that noise isn't far, not far at all. 
    
        As if trying to prove you right, some growling comes from behind the trees, and it's followed by the dry sound of snow getting crushed under some mighty paw. Damn, the beast is now getting even closer, and it's moving fast. Its dark silhouette doesn't take long to appear from behind some bushes, and as soon as you spot its shape, the creature jumps in front of you.
        
        The huge figure lands just a couple of steps away from your reach. It's a familiar wolf-like creature, and the woman straddling the warg is even easier to recognize: she's none other than Gytha, the rider that guarded the city gates.
        
        "Halt, outsider!" she says while pulling the reins on her mount. "And sheathe your weapons."
        
        You chose not to do that and hold your [pc.weapon] tighter instead; with that massive, growling warg in front of you, you're not willing to take any chances.
        
        "I've been waiting for you to appear, but it's not blood that I seek, only words."
        
        "Speak, then."
        
        She swallows, breathes in deeply, tightens the grip around the reins, and then voices a question.
        
        "Where did Queen Alissa go? I know that you alone may know the answer."
        
        "I hope you're not thinking about following her," you say.

rows.original:
The woman is a boreal elf with a long, aureate ponytail that flows up to her lower back and wiggles every time she moves her head. A single lock of hair has escaped her bun; a golden river that springs over her eyebrows and runs down her face to tickle one of her cheeks before falling gently over her shoulder. Just as if she was trying to hide that lock, Gytha runs her fingers over the fringe and pushes it behind her pointy ear, only for the hairs to mock her attempts and return to their original position.

        The girl averts her gaze and a faint blush appears over her pale face. One thing is clear: Gytha gets excited easily. She bites her lip and her breathing turns heavy. Her chest rises every time she inhales and you swear her tits are just about to pop out from the leather vest that poorly conceals her bust. Around her waist she wears a split kilt that leaves her legs almost entirely bare all the way up to a leather thong shielding her sex.
        
        "Don't you have a trace of shame in you, outsider?" she asks, while turning her face away from you. Still, she can't hide her blush. "Stop staring at my body as if you wanted to make it yours to play with."

女孩移开了视线，她那苍白的脸上浮现出一丝淡淡的红晕。 有一点是显而易见的：Gytha很容易变得兴奋起来。她会咬住嘴唇，呼吸也会变得急促而重型。每次吸气时，她的胸部都会明显地上升，你甚至会觉得她的胸部几乎要从那件遮盖得并不好的皮背心中凸出来来了。 她腰间系着一条开衩短裙，这条裙子几乎将她的双腿完全暴露在外，只有那条皮革束带遮住了她的私处。

rows.original: "I thought you were in charge of defending the gates," you ask. Her gaze meets yours as she ponders if there's some kind of mockery behind your words. She frowns, and Demon's Shadow barks at you, stiffening his body. It seems like the beast is just about to jump on you, but before your hand can reach your [pc.weapon], Gytha speaks up, and Demon's Shadow lowers his head, a little bit calmer. "I was. The Queen herself trusted me with that duty, but —as it may be of your knowledge— I failed her, and because of that, she's been forced to temporarily abandon her royal duties." "So after being defeated, you no longer feel fit for the role..." you say. "You jest?" Gytha retorts, lifting her face all dignified. "Not even the cold breeze would go past the gates if they still let me guard them. It's not my aptitude that's a concern in the matter; it's my loyalty that they at the city guard consider a bother." "Loyalty to Alissa?" you ask, dragging the words as if you weren't sure if this was a question you wanted to voice. "Who else? Isn't she the Queen?" Gytha answers, way faster than you thought. It seems like the mere question offends her, but after noticing her reaction she sighs and takes a moment for the calm to come back to her. "Don't mistake my words. I would fight to protect this new regent if any danger threatened her or the city, but she's no queen. When the time comes, and Alissa returns, I will follow her orders without a doubt even if they go against Etheryn's wishes. It's our duty to serve the Queen and not the regent." [party.has etheryn |[etheryn.highConfidence |"Even a queen who has turned against her own people?" Ryn says with a frown. |"But she's done so much wrong to our people..." Ryn says. ] "It's not my place to judge if she's a good queen or a bad one; she's still the Queen nonetheless," Gytha replies. Ryn's brows draw tight across the top of her face. "The whole city judged her." "Nevertheless." ] Her gray eyes meet yours, and the stalwart shine that comes out of her firm gaze tells you that she's adamant about her choice. "And I take it that the city guard doesn't share your view," you say. "Uh... no, they... they don't," she suddenly lowers her stare until it reaches the ground. It seems like you've hit a weak spot. "But they're wrong. They..." Her voice softens, turning into a whisper you can barely hear. "They don't know the Queen..." [party.has etheryn |[etheryn.highConfidence |"I would say that I do know my sister quite a bit. Too well, even," Ryn says. In the same soft voice as before, Gytha says, "Only the worst side of her." ] ]

rows.original:
"What do you think of Alissa?" you ask. 

        "I'm in no position to judge the Queen, but I can tell you that I'm honored to serve her, and I've had that honor since we were both of young age," Gytha says, her chest puffing out with pride. 
        
        "How come? Did you work at the palace?
        
        "No I didn't. Alissa loved hunting, yet hated doing so alongside the adults back then, since they would often belittle her and treat her more like a child than a fellow hunter. That's why she wanted to go by herself, but Queen Alraince was scared of letting her reckless daughter alone in the wild and that's why she made Alissa choose at least one hunting partner. Out of all the people, she chose me."
        
        "You seem pretty proud of that, indeed."
        
        "I sure am," she says. "But I still fail to understand why I was chosen; we had only met once before that. It was during one of those hunting parties where she grew tired of the adults there and escaped to face the wilderness alone. I was also alone, training with Demon's Shadow for the day I could finally apply to be a city guard, and I saw her coming out of the blue. I didn't know who she was, and she didn't introduce herself either, she only asked me if I wanted to go hunting, and I said I did. It took the guards a whole day to find her. The noblemen who had been with her at the hunting party were terrified of what Queen Alraince would do to them if Alissa didn't appear, and Alissa took great pleasure in that. She couldn't stop laughing when she saw the panicked faces of all those adults who had belittled her."
        
        "That sure sounds like Alissa..."
        
        [party.has ryn
            |[etheryn.highConfidence
                |"And she must've been in a good mood," Ryn says. "I've seen her doing much worse for far less."
                |"It... it does," Ryn says.
            ]
        ]
        
        "You seem to hold a pretty poor opinion on the Queen," Gytha says, and you can't quite deny that. Her gaze pierces you during a long silence before she resumes her words. "By the time Queen Alraince died, Alissa had accustomed to me being around her whenever she wanted to go hunting. Still, not every time she wanted to go hunting she was seeking the thrill, sometimes all she wanted was an excuse to escape the palace, her royal duties or her grief. And I've been by her side each time. I've seen the Ice Queen melt in tears before my eyes."
        
        You hold the silence. It's not that she's done talking, it's just that she's having a hard time choosing her next words.
        
        "I can't say I support what she's done to her sister. I can't say I support all the debauchery she recently brought to the palace. I can't say I support everything she's done. But I can say I support my Queen with my honor and my very soul."
        
        [party.has ryn
            |[etheryn.highConfidence
                |Etheryn steps forward while a frown of disapproval appears on her face.
                |Gytha's fierce stare searches for Etheryn, who just lowers her head and hugs her bow to put some distance between the former gatekeeper and herself.
            ]
        ]
        
        "Are you aware that Alissa bankrupted the city and handed it over to a demon?[party.has ryn
            |," [etheryn.highConfidence
                |she says, unable to believe what she's hearing
                |you say, bringing Gytha's attention to yourself
            ]. "
        | ]Hell, are you aware that she's become a demon herself?"
        
        "Aaah...I-I am now," Gytha stutters.
        
        "Does it change anything?"
        
        "No, it doesn't!" she says, taking back her prideful stance. "If what you say is true, she needs me by her side more than ever."
        
        "Okay then."

你对艾莉莎有什么看法？”你问道。

“我根本没有资格评判女王，但我可以告诉您，能够为她服务是我的荣幸，而且这种荣幸从我们还是年轻的时候就开始了，”吉莎骄傲地说道，胸膛因自豪而微微起伏。

“为什么呢？你是在宫殿里工作的吗？
        
        不，并没有。艾丽莎非常喜欢狩猎，但那时候她讨厌和成年人一起行动，因为他们经常会贬低她，把她当作孩子而不是同行的猎人来对待。因此，她想独自去狩猎。不过艾尔兰斯女王担心让这个任性的女儿独自在野外冒险，所以要求她至少选一个狩猎伙伴。在所有人中，她选择了我。
        
        你似乎对此感到非常自豪，确实如此。”

“我当然是啊，”她说道，“但我还是不明白为什么会被选中；在那之前我们只见过一次面。那是在一次狩猎活动中，她对那里的成年人感到厌烦，于是独自逃到了野外。 那天，我也是独自一人，正在用“恶魔之影”进行训练，为有朝一日能够申请成为城卫而努力。突然，我看见她出现了。我不知道她是谁，她也没有自我介绍，只是问我是否想去打猎，我回答说想去。 守卫们花了一整天的时间才找到她。那些在狩猎活动中与她在一起的贵族们，都害怕如果艾丽莎没有出现，阿尔兰斯女王会对他们做出什么报复，而艾丽莎对此感到非常开心。每当看到那些曾经轻视过她的成年人们惊慌失措的表情，她就忍不住大笑起来。"
        
        那声音听起来确实像艾丽莎……
        
        [party.has ryn
            |[etheryn.highConfidence
                |她当时肯定心情很好，”瑞恩说道，“我见过她因为一些小事而情绪变得非常糟糕。
                |它……确实如此，”瑞恩说道。
            ]
        ]
        
        你似乎对那位女王评价很低啊，”吉莎说道，你确实无法否认这一点。在她长时间的沉默之后，她的目光紧紧地盯着你，然后继续说道：“等到阿尔兰斯女王去世的时候，艾莉莎已经习惯了每次想要去打猎的时候，我都会陪在她身边。 然而，并非每次她想要去狩猎时，都是为了追求刺激；有时候，她只是需要一个借口来逃离宫殿、远离王室的职责，或是暂时忘却自己的悲伤。而每一次，我都在她身边陪伴着她。我亲眼见过冰霜女王在泪水中崩溃的那一刻。这片沉默由你保持着。并不是说她已经不再说话了，只是她还在努力思考接下来该说些什么。

        “我必须承认，我并不支持她对妹妹所做的事情。我也无法认同她最近在宫廷里引发的那些混乱与堕落行为。 我并不能说她所做的每一件事我都支持。但我可以肯定的是，我会以我的荣誉和全部真心来支持我的女王。
        
        [party.has ryn
            |[etheryn.highConfidence
                |伊瑟琳向前迈了一步，她的脸上浮现出不赞同的神情。
                |吉莎那凶狠的目光在寻找伊瑟琳，而伊瑟琳只是低下头，紧紧抱住自己的弓，试图与这位前守门人保持一定的距离。
            ]
        ]
        
        你知道吗，艾莉莎让这座城市陷入了破产，然后把它交给了一个恶魔。[party.has ryn
            |," [etheryn.highConfidence
                |她说，简直不敢相信自己所听到的一切。
                |你说得对，这样就能吸引Gytha的注意了。
            ]. "
        | ]天啊，你难道没意识到她自己也已经变成一个恶魔了吗？”

“啊……现在我确实成了。”吉莎结结巴巴地回答。

“那这会改变什么吗？”

“不会，没有任何改变！”她重新摆出了骄傲的神情，“如果你说的是真的，那么她现在比任何时候都更需要我站在她身边。”

“那好吧。

        "Okay then."'

rows.original: What does Gytha think of her?

"I enjoyed fighting you," you tell her. "What do you say about a rematch? She grabs her spear tightly and lifts her face, taking some time to consider her answer while Demon's Shadow awaits patiently. The beast can't hide his eagerness to fight you as he stares at her owner with his eyes full of hope. "I accept your request," Gytha says, finally. Then, her prideful expression is broken by the initial spark of a blush. "But will it be with...with everything at stake? It would be needed to further recreate the fight that we had at the gates." "What do you mean with everything?" you say, even if you know perfectly well what she means. "Our... our bodies. I meant with our bodies at stake," she says, gathering all her strength to meet your gaze. "The desire to avoid being used as plaything gives me a special kind of strength that I wouldn't like giving up. That's the only reason I have for demanding these rules. Trust my words." Not only has her face abandoned her pale tone in favor of a pinkish blush, but also her breathing has become heavier. It's very hard to trust her words. "If that's what it takes to fight you again, then sure," you say with a shrug. "I appreciate your consideration," Gytha says, respectfully lowering her head, but her cheeks still can't stop blushing. "May the best fighter win."
rows.translation: 我很享受与你战斗，”你对她说，“怎么样，再战一局吧？” 她紧紧握住手中的长矛，抬起头，花了一些时间考虑该如何回答。而“恶魔之影”则耐心地等待着她的决定。那只野兽眼中充满渴望，紧紧注视着它的主人，显然也非常期待能与你再次交战。 我接受了你的请求，”吉莎终于说道。然而，她那骄傲的表情立刻被一丝红晕打破了。“但是，这真的需要……需要付出所有的代价吗？要重现我们在城门前的那场战斗，确实需要这样的代价。你这么说是什么意思？ 一切你是这个意思吧？”你说，尽管你心里非常清楚她真正想表达的是什么。 “我们的……我们的身体。我的意思是，当我们的身体处于危险之中时，”她说道，鼓起全部勇气去直视你的眼睛，“那种不想被当作玩物来利用的愿望，给了我一种特殊的力量，而我并不想放弃这种力量。 这就是我要求制定这些规则的唯一原因。相信我吧。” 她的脸色已经不再苍白，而是带着淡淡的红晕，呼吸也变得急促起来。实在很难相信她所说的话。 如果必须这样才能再次与你战斗，那么当然可以，”你耸了耸肩说道。 “我很感激你的考虑，”吉莎恭敬地低下头说道，但她的脸颊依然忍不住泛红。“愿最强大的战士能够获胜。"

rows.original:
There you are, standing near the road with Gytha staring at you from atop her black warg, their huge figure silhouetted against the [dayNight|gray skies|night sky]. 
    
    "Are you set?" Gytha asks as she aims her great lance at you and pulls the reins on Demon's Shadow. The beast is eager to run at you, and even if he obeys his owner and stands still, his growling still reaches your ears.
    
    You nod while pulling your [pc.weapon] out.
    
    "Then prepare yourself to face Gytha Myrrada Odain," she announces. "Demon's Shadow, charge them down!"

你就在那里，站在路边，而Gytha则站在她那匹黑色的战马背上，凝视着你，他们庞大的身影在背景下显得格外醒目。 [dayNight|灰蒙蒙的天空|夜空]准备好了吗？”吉莎一边说着，一边将她那支巨大的长矛对准你，同时拉紧了“恶魔之影”的缰绳。这只野兽迫不及待地想要冲向你，即使它听从主人的命令停了下来，它的低吼声依然传到了你的耳边。

rows.original: A growl sends a shiver down your spine. It's a noise you're familiar with, and you can already tell that it belongs to a certain angry warg, so you ready your [pc.weapon] just in case the owner decides against holding its leash this time. There's no time to do anything else before the growl reaches your ears again. New notes have joined in to create a threatening melody: the sound of a beast panting and that of the road being crushed beneath some mighty paws. The black blur is rushing towards you from behind, and it's not a surprise to see that an elven girl is riding the wolflike creature, with her golden ponytail whipping in the wind behind her. It looks like they're gonna run over you, but just when you're about to accept this as a declaration of war, Gytha pulls the reins and forces her warg to a halt. "Fate must really love making us meet on the road, outsider," Gytha says. Her mount drools, tired from the run, but with a deadly stare that tells you that it's ready to jump at your throat. "Unfortunately I don't have time to spare, so just step aside and I'll resume my way." "To Alissa?" you ask. "I told you I would find her myself." [party.has ryn |[etheryn.highConfidence |"Loyalty won't protect you," Ryn says. "She's been corrupted to the core, and going after her will only lead you down the same path. It's dangerous." "No danger can stop me from going. Even if trying to help her is all I can do, I'll give my best. That's what I've chosen to do." Gytha breathes in heavily. "And I'm willing to fight to defend my choice." |"Why...why would you go so far for her?" Ryn says with a delicate voice. She's not asking her to change her mind, she genuinely wants to know why someone would do that for the same person that did so wrong to her. "Because it's my duty," Gytha answers with pride, almost automatically. But then her face changes to a softer expression, and so does her voice. "No, that's not completely true, I also want to. I once promised her that I would be by her side no matter what, and I want to fulfill that promise. I want to try to guide her to the right path, and if I fail, I want to know that I at least tried my best." "Even if it's impossible that you'll succeed?" "I've made my choice," Gytha says firmly as she wraps her hand around her great lance. "And I'm willing to fight for it." ] |"I suggest you reconsider what you're doing," you say. "She's barely even Alissa anymore. You'll only be dooming yourself." "I'll doom myself to the guilt if I don't even try," Gytha says. "I've chosen my way, outsider, and my lance won't hesitate nor will my hand tremble if I were to fight to defend my choice." ]
rows.translation: 一声低吼会让你不寒而栗。这种声音你很熟悉，立刻就能判断出它来自某只愤怒的野兽，于是你立刻做好了准备 [pc.weapon] 只是为了防止主人这次不再牵住它的皮带。 在那种低吼声再次传入你的耳中之前，已经没有时间做其他事情了。新的声音加入了进来，共同构成了一首充满威胁的旋律：那是野兽喘息的声音，也是道路在强有力的爪子下被碾碎的声音。 那道黑色的身影正从背后朝你冲来，你很快就会发现，有一个精灵女孩正骑在那只类似狼的生物背上，她金色的马尾在风中飘扬。 看起来他们是要撞上你的，但就在你准备将这视为一种战争宣言的时候，吉莎突然拉住了缰绳，让她的坐骑停了下来。 命运似乎真的喜欢让我们在路上相遇，外地人。”吉莎说道。她的坐骑因为奔跑而显得疲惫，但它那凶狠的目光却让人明白：它随时准备扑向你的喉咙。“可惜我没什么时间可以浪费，所以你最好让开道路，让我继续前行吧。给艾丽莎吗？”你问道。 “我就说过，我会亲自找到她。 [party.has ryn |[etheryn.highConfidence |忠诚并不能保护你，”莱恩说道，“她已经彻底堕落了，追她只会让你也走上同样的道路。那是很危险的。” “没有任何危险能够阻止我前往。即使我所能做的只是尝试帮助她，我也会全力以赴。这就是我的使命。 被选中 我必须这么做。”吉莎沉重地叹了口气，“而且我愿意为捍卫自己的选择而抗争。 |为什么……为什么你要为她做到这种地步？”蕾恩用温柔的声音问道。她并不是在要求对方改变主意，她真心想知道，为什么有人会为那个曾经对自己做过那么坏事的人做出这样的举动。 因为这是我的责任，”吉莎自豪地回答，几乎是不假思索地说出了这句话。但随后，她的表情变得柔和起来，声音也变得轻柔了一些。“不，其实并不完全是责任，我也是真的想要这么做。我曾经向她承诺过，无论发生什么，我都会陪在她身边，现在我想兑现这个承诺。 我想尽力引导她走上正确的道路，如果我失败了，我也希望自己至少已经尽了最大努力。” “即使你根本不可能成功呢？” “我已经做出了选择，”吉莎坚定地说道，同时将手握在她那柄巨大的长矛上。 而我愿意为此而奋斗。 ] |我建议你重新考虑自己的所作所为，”你说，“她已经不再是以前的阿丽莎了。这样做只会害了自己。” “如果不尝试一下，我就会永远活在愧疚之中，”吉莎回答，“外人，我已经选择了自己的道路。如果需要为这个选择而战，我的长矛不会犹豫，我的手也不会颤抖。 ]

You draw your [pc.weapon] and assume a fighting stance. "I won't let you go."

        [party.has ryn
            |[etheryn.highConfidence
                |"I refuse to lose another elf to Alissa's madness," Ryn says, standing by your side with [ryn.weapon] in hand. "Please, Gytha. Stay. Don't make us hurt you."
                |"P-please, Gytha," Ryn squeaks behind you. "Don't make [pc.name] hurt you. It-it's for your own good!"

            Gytha snarls, drawing her lance. "So be it. I'm willing to die for my beliefs. Can you say the same, princess? Demon's Shadow! Charge them down!"
            |Gytha snarls, drawing her lance and aiming it at your heart. "So be it! I won't let you stand between me and my liege, southerner. Demon's Shadow! Charge [pc.himHer] down!"
        ]

rows.original:
[lastStanding.is DemonsShadow
        |After receiving the last hit, Demon's Shadow falls backward, taking the rider with it to the ground. 
    
        The beast is too wounded to move, and Gytha can only crawl from beneath the enormous wolf-like body before her muscles refuse to move another inch.
        |Gytha falls backward, too wounded to keep fighting, but not wounded enough that she can't try to crawl away from you... A couple of inches at least. After those last efforts, her limbs give up, and only her mouth is left to convey her fading resistance.
    ]
    
    "Alissa..." is all she can mumble before falling unconscious. 
    
    You've managed to defeat her, but it will be an empty victory if she runs to Alissa the second she wakes up. Only one clear solution appears in your mind: throwing her into a cell in the Wayfort until you've dealt with her Queen. For her own sake. 
    
    You scoop Gytha up over your shoulder and turn back south. Her warg will follow along soon enough of its own accord, you're sure. It's a long walk, but Gytha barely stirs all the while until you [wayfort.hasBailiff
        |hand the rebellious warg-rider off to her loyalist counterpart. 
        
        Daliza gives you a sharp nod when you explain what's happened. "I see. Thank you for your actions, [pc.mf
            |Baron
            |Baroness
        ]. Gytha is one of the finest hunters in the kingdom; losing her to Alissa, too, would have been a terrible blow for us all. I'm sure that, when it's all said and done, she'll thank you for saving her from herself."
        
        Daliza snaps her fingers, and a couple of her rangers grab Gytha and drag her down to the dungeons below. "Don't worry, m'[pc.mf
            |lord
            |lady
        ], we'll take good care of her until the Dracia mission is resolved."
        |return home and toss the elf into one of the cells beneath the fort. You'll see that some of the maids stop in and take care of her until the business on Dracia is resolved. Perhaps, when it's all said and done, she'll realize this is for the best. Perhaps not.
    ]
    
    [party.has ryn
        |Etheryn favors you with a smile. "We did good, [pc.name]."
    ]
rows.translation:
[lastStanding.is DemonsShadow
        |在受到最后一击之后，恶魔之影向后倒下，将骑在它身上的骑士也一同摔到了地上。

这只野兽伤得太重，已经无法动弹了，吉莎只能从它那巨大的、形似狼的身体下面爬出来，直到她的肌肉再也无法承受任何动作时，她才停止了移动。
        |吉莎向后倒下，伤得太重，已经无法继续战斗，但伤势还不至于严重到让她无法试图爬开你的身边……至少还能爬几英寸。在做了那些最后的努力之后，她的四肢终于失去了力量，只有她的嘴巴还在试图表达她那逐渐减弱的抗争意志。
    ]
    
    艾丽莎……”她只能挤出这几个字，随后便失去了意识。

你虽然成功地击败了她，但如果她一醒来就去找艾丽莎，那么这场胜利就毫无意义了。此时，你只有一个明确的解决办法：把她关进荒废驿堡的牢房里，直到你解决了她的女王问题。 为了她好。

你把吉莎扛在肩上，然后向南方向走去。你相信，她的战兽很快也会自动跟上来。虽然路途很长，但吉莎一路上几乎都没有动弹过，直到你们 [wayfort.hasBailiff
        |将这个叛乱的战骑交交给她的忠诚派同僚。

当你向达丽莎解释发生了什么时，她点了点头表示理解。“我明白了。感谢你的行动。 [pc.mf
            |男爵
            |女男爵
        ]吉莎是这个王国中最出色的猎手之一；如果她也被阿丽莎夺走，对我们所有人来说都将是一个巨大的打击。我相信，等一切尘埃落定之后，她一定会感谢你救了她，让她摆脱了自我毁灭的命运。

达丽莎打了个响指，她的几名护林员立刻抓住了吉莎，将她拖到了地下的地牢里。“别担心，小姐[pc.mf
            |领主
            |女士
        ]我们会好好照顾她，直到Dracia的任务完成为止。
        |回到家后，把那个精灵关进堡垒下面的某个牢房里。你会看到，有些女仆会偶尔去照顾她，直到德拉西亚的事情得到解决。也许，等到一切结束之后，她会意识到这样做才是最好的选择。当然，也有可能不会。
    ]
    
    [party.has ryn
        |伊瑟琳微笑着对你说道：“我们做得很好。 [pc.name]."
    ]

rows.original:
Now that you've been given 'permission' to see through Hatsumomo's glamor, it's staggering to imagine this cabin has been here for so long; a series of neatly carved and stacked, vertically-placed wooden logs rise from floor-to-ceiling, and those logs have had their exteriors shaved into a level wooden wall that's so flat it looks like a series of flat planks that you can run a hand up-and-down the breadth of.
    
    Maybe it's been accomplished with magic, but the lumberjack has spared no effort on the construction of her cabin, with every inch giving off a rich warmth and well-oiled against the coldest and wettest seasons. The roof carries a lot more of the traditional 'Old-Country' style that those foxes are more well-known for, reaching out far in excess of the building before turning up steeply at the corners.
    
    Beside her cabin is a very large outhouse, a well-used saw-horse, a planing table that looks large enough to heave out an inch-per-pass out of every plank you run across it, and a very neat stack of firewood. The whole space smells like fresh pines and maples, and the familiar notes of a wintery forest.
    
    A very lovely cabin.

现在你已经被允许看穿初桃那华丽的伪装，真难以想象这个小木屋竟然已经存在了这么久；一排排整齐切割、垂直堆放的木原木从地面一直延伸到天花板，这些木原木的外表面被削平，形成了整整齐齐的木墙，墙面如此平整，看起来就像是一块块平坦的木板，你可以用手在上面从上到下滑动。
    
    也许这是通过魔法才得以实现的，但这位伐木工在建造她的小屋时确实付出了巨大的努力——每一个细节都散发着浓厚的温暖气息，能够有效抵御最寒冷潮湿的季节。屋顶采用了那种极具“乡土风格”的传统设计，这种设计正是那些狐狸们最为熟悉的风格；屋顶的边缘远远超出了建筑物的主体部分，然后在转角处急剧向上倾斜。
    
    她的小屋旁边有一间非常大的户外储藏室，有一把使用频率很高的锯子，还有一张刨花板切割台——那张台子看起来大得足以让你在用它切割任何木板时，每切一下都能去掉一英寸的木屑。此外，那里还整齐地堆放着一些柴火。整个空间弥漫着新鲜松木和枫木的气息，充满了那种典型的冬日森林特有的气息。
    
    一座非常可爱的小木屋。

rows.translation: 虽然并非如此 热门的 这些泉水天生就具有流动的特性，因此它们带来的水总是清冽、凉爽而新鲜。人们还花了一些心思，让这个天然的沐浴场所变得更加温馨舒适——那里配备了毛巾架，还有一篮子来自狐狸窝里的花瓣，以及一面印有她家族徽章的乳白色旗帜，这一切都让这个地方显得更加富有生活气息……那就是柴山。 有一块大石头盖在炭火炉上，只留下了一条小小的缝隙，让炭火能够继续燃烧。到了春天，可以把这个炭火炉放在平坦的地方，用来加热水。不断流淌的淡水会不断搅动这些热水，这样就可以快速泡个澡了；唯一的缺点就是热水不会永远持续下去，如果想长时间泡澡，就需要经常补充炭火。

Some effort has gone into making the natural bathing area a little more homely, with a towel rack, a basket of blossom petals from the fox den, and a creamy white flag showing off her family crest; Shibayama. There's a large stone covering a charcoal burner, leaving only a small crack to allow it to keep breathing. That same charcoal burner can be placed on a level spot in the spring in order to heat the water up, with the constant trickling freshwater stirring that warmth in for a quick dip; the only downside is that the heat isn't endless, and the burner needs topping up regularly if you want a long soak. "

rows.original: [var0 |Hatsumomo is perched up on a lovingly-carved armchair, smiling as you enter and sipping from a china teacup. |She may have given you permission to visit any time, but it's strange being here with nobody inside. ] Old country china rests on local-style shelves, cupboards, and tables. A scrubbed and re-polished stove of brick and brass dominates the wall on the right, with a refillable sink, and a cooking space. On the back wall is a bookcase with a couple of books, and the deep armchair [var0 |she's currently sitting in |she's usually sitting in ]. Last of all, the left wall features an elegant four-poster bed with a tightly-woven and triple-folded linen mattress, and a huge puffy blanket.
rows.translation: [var0 |初美坐在一把雕刻精美的扶手椅上，当你走进来时，她正微笑着，手里还端着一杯瓷茶。 |她或许允许你随时来访，但这里空无一人，确实有点奇怪。 ] 传统的中国瓷器被摆放在具有地方特色的架子、橱柜和桌子上。右侧的墙上，一座经过清洗和重新打磨的砖制黄铜炉子占据了显眼的位置，旁边还有一个可重复使用的水槽以及烹饪区域。后墙处有一个书架，上面放着几本书，还有一把深色的扶手椅。 [var0 |她现在正坐在那里。 |她通常坐在那里。 ]最后，左侧墙壁上还设有 优雅的 一张四柱床，配备着紧密编织、可三折的亚麻床垫，以及一条巨大的蓬松毯子。

rows.original: Hatsu may be absent, but absence is hardly going to turn charcoal cold. You'll just have to be sure to return the burner to its stone-lidded dry spot once you're finished, or the poor lumberfox is going to experience a very nippy bath later. You carefully lift and lower the gently-smoldering charcoal burner, settling the heated base of the brass device down until it's hissing and bubbling merrily. You're quick to get undressed, desperate to escape the bracing chill in order to get nicely submerged. [party.som |[companion1.name] is just as fast, plucking up one of Hatsu's scrubbing brushes as [companion1.mf |he |she ] goes. |Your companions are just as fast, plucking up a couple of Hatsu's scrubbing brushes as they go. ] You've hardly got all the time in the world, but it is wonderful to sit and soak, let your bones drink the heat, and the grime of your encounters soften [pc.hasFur |in your fur |against your skin ]; ready to be brushed away. [party.som |You |The two of you |The three of you ] make quick, but casual work of getting nice and fresh. The natural flow of the spring carries away any dirt, thankfully, although the constant trickle of fresh, cold water gradually brings the temperature down to something a little less relaxing. Drying off is a lot less fun; the gentle breeze picks up all that fresh moisture and threatens to chill you to the core; any sexy posing you had planned is quickly dashed when [pc.hasCock |your prick threatens to turn into an 'innie'. |your nipples turn to painful diamonds. ]
rows.translation: 虽然Hatsu不在场，但它的缺席并不会让这个炭火炉变得冷冰冰的。你只需要在用完之后把炉子放回那个有石盖的干燥地方就行了，否则那个可怜的木狐以后就会洗上一个非常冰冷的澡了。你小心翼翼地抬起又放下那还在微微冒烟的炭火炉，将那个黄铜炉子的加热部分放好，直到它开始欢快地发出嘶嘶声和气泡声。 你迅速脱掉衣服，迫切地想要摆脱那刺骨的寒冷，以便能够好好地泡在热水里。 [party.som |[companion1.name] 速度也一样快，他立刻拿起了Hatsu的一把清洁刷开始行动。 [companion1.mf |他 |她 ] 进行。 |你的同伴也同样行动迅速，一边前进一边拿起了几把哈茨用的清洁刷子。 ] 你其实并没有那么多时间，但无论如何 是 坐下来尽情享受这种感觉真是太美妙了，让身体吸收这份温暖，让那些在冒险中积累的疲惫与污垢慢慢消散吧。 [pc.hasFur |恼羞成怒 |让人感到非常不适 ]; 随时可能被风吹走。 [party.som |你 |你们两个 |你们三个 ] 动作要快，但也要注意保持轻松。幸运的是，春天的自然水流会带走所有的污垢，不过那源源不断的新鲜冷水也会逐渐降低水温，使得环境不再那么舒适了。 不过，晾干身体可就没那么有趣了——微风会带走身上所有的水分，让你感到阵阵寒意；那些你原本打算做的性感姿势，也会因此立刻破灭掉 [pc.hasCock |你的那个家伙可能会变成一个“内向的人”。 |你的乳头会变得像痛苦的钻石一样坚硬。 ]

rows.original: While you're walking along, there's an abrupt sense of... something in the area. Are you being watched? Moments before you have a chance to even reach for a weapon, a familiar voice calls out. "Hey there, what d'we have here?" Hatsumomo, the lumber-fox steps out from— actually where did Hatsu step out from? The fox's ears twitch a few times, and she peers over her own shoulder, before looking back to you. "Ah! Of course... sorry I forget it's even there, you can't see it, can ya?" You spread your hands helplessly; if it looks like a fox, and chops wood like a fox, you assume you're looking at a lumberfox. She props her axe down against... a rock that wasn't there a moment ago, but it's posed perfectly for the role. "Heh, I'm no summoner or spook! It's a glamor, made t'look like an empty clearing. It kinda... makes you assume what you're looking at is something else? What do you see now?" "A rock." "It's actually a wall," Hatsu explains. "Here, stare at this empty space really hard, don't blink!" She slaps her hand against open air, and this time — even though you're watching for it — you jolt in alarm as her hand strikes something wooden. And then you blink, and the rock her axe is resting on is now tall enough to support contact. "That's pretty incredible, and this is just an illusion then?" "Sort'a, I aint a wizard I don't know how it works. A little gift from th'Old Country. Uh... considerin' I'm [wayfort.controlled |squatting on yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship's land! And, hey, how about a discount on wood? Neighbors get a discount of five 'Lecs, sound good? |so intimately familiar with such an upstanding gentle[pc.mf |man |lady ]. ]" Hatsu smiles and steps behind a non-existent bush, disappearing completely for a moment, before returning a few seconds later with an old jade token. She tosses the token to you, which you catch. "Just snap it, and [party.yall] should be able to see m'lovely abode."
rows.translation: 就在你行走的过程中，突然间会有一种……的感觉。 某个东西 在那个区域…… 有人在监视你吗？ 就在你还没来得及拿起武器的瞬间，一个熟悉的声音响起：“嘿，这里发生了什么？”柴本狐从……实际上是从哪里走出来的呢？ 做了 哈茨是从哪里走出来的呢？ 狐狸的耳朵动了几下，它先回头看了看自己的肩膀，然后才再次看向你。“啊！当然了……抱歉，我都忘了还有这个东西的存在，你应该看不见它吧？” 你无奈地摊开了双手部；如果它长得像狐狸，而且也像狐狸一样砍木头，那你就应该认为它是一只伐木狐狸吧。 她把斧头靠在一块岩石上……这块岩石刚才还不存在，但现在却正好处于这个位置，简直再合适不过了。“呵呵，我可不是什么召唤师或巫师！这只是个幻术，让这个地方看起来像是一片空地而已。这种效果嘛……确实会让人误以为自己看到的是别的东西。 你现在看到了什么？” “一块石头。” “其实那是一面墙，”Hatsu解释道，“看，紧紧地盯着这个空旷的地方，千万不要眨眼！”她将手部掌拍在空气中，而这一次——尽管你 观看 因为她的手部碰到了什么东西，你吓得猛地一惊。但当你眨眼再看时，她斧头倚着的那块石头已经高到足以支撑她的体重了。 “真是太不可思议了，那么这一切其实都只是个幻觉吗？” “算是吧……我又不是巫师，也不明白这是怎么发生的。这只是来自‘古老国度’的一个小礼物罢了……嗯……考虑到我现在的处境，这个礼物还算挺有用的吧。 [wayfort.controlled |占着你的位置不放 [pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]船坞用地啊！对了，木材能不能打折呢？邻居们可以享受五“莱克”的折扣，怎么样，听起来不错吧？ |对这样一位正直而温和的人如此熟悉[pc.mf |男人 |女士 ]. ]八ツ微笑着走到一株并不存在的灌木后面，瞬间消失不见了，几秒钟后才拿着一枚古老的玉制令牌重新出现。 她将那枚令牌扔给你，你接住了它。“把它折断就行了 [party.yall] 应该就能看到我那可爱的居所了。

rows.original: The world before your very eyes doesn't so much shift as it does suddenly make sense. Now that you've been given 'permission' to see through Hatsumomo's glamor, it's staggering to imagine this cabin has been here for so long; a series of neatly carved and stacked, vertically-placed wooden logs rise from floor-to-ceiling, and those logs have had their exteriors shaved into a level wooden wall that's so flat it looks like a series of flat planks that you can run a hand up-and-down the breadth of. Maybe it's been accomplished with magic, but the lumberjack has spared no effort on the construction of her cabin, with every inch giving off a rich warmth and well-oiled against the coldest and wettest seasons. The roof carries a lot more of the traditional 'Old-Country' style that those foxes are more well-known for, reaching out far in excess of the building before turning up steeply at the corners. Beside her cabin is a very large outhouse, a well-used saw-horse, a planing table that looks large enough to heave out an inch-per-pass out of every plank you run across it, and a very neat stack of firewood. The whole space smells like fresh pines and maples, and the familiar notes of a wintery forest. A very lovely cabin. "You like?" Hatsu beams proudly, folding muscular arms beneath her hefty chest. "Very nice." [flags.HATSUMOMO_SPRING |"Oh, come on in if you want, any time. Same with the spring; did you ever wonder why y'couldn't find it without me?" You were next to her house the whole time? ]
rows.translation: 你眼前的这个世界，与其说是在发生变化，不如说是一种持续的状态转变。 突然变得合情合理了现在，既然你已经被允许看穿初桃那华丽的伪装，那么想到这个小木屋竟然已经存在了这么久，实在令人震惊。一排排整齐地切割、堆放起来的木原木从地面一直延伸到天花板，这些木原木的外表面被削平，形成了一面极其平整的木墙，看起来就像是一块块平坦的木板，你可以用手在上面从上到下滑动。 或许这是通过魔法才得以实现的，但这位伐木工在建造她的小屋时确实付出了巨大的努力——每一个细节都散发着浓厚的温暖气息，能够有效抵御最寒冷潮湿的季节。屋顶采用了那种极具“乡土风格”的传统设计，这种设计正是那些狐狸们最为擅长的；屋檐远远地延伸出建筑物之外，然后在转角处急剧向上倾斜。 她的小屋旁边有一间非常大的户外储藏室，有一把使用频率很高的锯子，还有一张刨花板切割台——那张台子看起来大得足以让你在用它切割任何木板时，每切一下都能削去一英寸的木料。此外，那里还堆放着一堆整理得整整齐齐的柴火。整个区域弥漫着新鲜松木和枫木的气息，充满了那种典型的冬日森林特有的气息。 一座非常可爱的小木屋。 “你喜欢吗？”哈ツ骄傲地笑着，将结实的双臂交叉在宽大的胸前。 “非常不错。 [flags.HATSUMOMO_SPRING |哦，如果你想来的话，随时都可以进来。春天的情况也是一样；你有没有想过，为什么没有我的帮助你就找不到它呢？” 原来你一直都在她家附近啊？ ]

rows.original: You follow Hatsu into her home, and the theme of an Old Country affectation applied to solid cold-weather hearthlands is continued. Old country porcelain rests on local-style shelves, cupboards, and tables. A scrubbed and re-polished stove of brick and brass dominates the wall on the right, with a refillable sink, and a cooking space. On the back wall is a bookcase with a couple of books, and the deep armchair [var0 |she's currently sitting in |she's usually sitting in ]. Last of all, the left wall features an elegant four-poster bed with a tightly-woven and triple-folded linen mattress, and a huge puffy blanket. "There, now y'can come and relax any time you catch me hangin' around. Or, you know, if you'd like to feed a hungry fox in style..." Hatsu gestures pointedly at the bed, a wicked smile on her handsome face while you're placing the shattered halves of the jade token on her kitchen counter.

rows.original: With a warm, plush cat on either arm, the three of you begin your shopping date; much to the jealous gaze of a few onlookers at seeing you travel with beautiful curvy women once again. ...If they knew how barely-dressed the cats were beneath their cloaks, that jealousy would be intensified threefold, you're sure. "So, what does Vari actually like?" You ask, sinking a hand into Liresh's hair and gently rubbing her scalp as you walk leisurely. The white-furred snow-cat purrs and ponders, nuzzling into your hand. "Hmm... that's the thing; We came all the way out here to try and figure something new out." Syrish continues, stealing your other hand so that she can get similar scritching-treatment. "Yeah, we get her something new every year. Jewelry, clothes — she never wears those, although I bet she's worn the sexy underwear at least once — books, weapons, crafts..." [pc.dcb |"She doesn't appreciate any of it? What a waste." |"And none of these have been of interest to her?" |"Awww... and she doesn't like, like any of it?" ] you respond, pinching both of their ears until they giggle and snuggle up again. "Well, it's not quite like that. Vari says she loves anything that we give her, but mostly she complains that we go out adventuring to do it." Syrish mumbles, leaning in to nibble your ear when you're distracted by Ogrish's stall. "So no roaming for fancy rare things, insteeaad, here we are! Perhaps hoping that you'd be able to finally help us get that real winner of a gift..." Liresh looks to you hopefully, tail creeping around until she can nibble on it coquettishly. No ideas strike you immediately, and so the three of you wander from shop-to-shop — with an excited pause on Liresh's part to explore the alchemy goods — that sure results in the girls getting a bunch of fancy adventurer's kits and herbalism supplies for themselves, but nothing strikes you as particularly huge-cat-milf-y. "I'm having a wonderful time you know! Buuuut... we haven't gotten anything for Vari yet!" Syrish pouts. By this point they've been grinding up on you so much that you're feeling flushed, [pc.hasCock |having to navigate a [pc.cock] |thighs a little slick and sticky when they rub together ]. The wheels slowly turn in your head, [pc.isBimbo |struggling to churn under the weight of bimbo lust |tumbling towards the inevitable ]... "I have an idea! rows.original:
Her big brown eyes are the first thing to grab your attention, standing out in a beautiful human face: long, thin, pale like the moonlight and framed by her dark wavy hair, which flows like a waterfall to one of her copper pauldrons. She combs her black locks using her hand as a claw, her white slender fingers dancing between the contrast of colors. Only when seen from up close you notice the small, red scratches covering her knuckles, seemingly never able to heal, or maybe always replaced by new ones.

    The recent fight must have been tough, since the grazes are not the only mark it has left on the woman. As you gaze at her mouth, you see how she bites a crimson wound that bulges out of her thin, dry lips, her gesture then turning into one of pain while she curses to the air, damning the mother of the opponent who inflicted the bruise. 
    
    You try to check the rest of her petite body, but you can only appreciate the battered armor that hides it. rows.original:
While walking down the road, your eye catches some distant lights. You can tell it’s not the pale glow from the moon but a warmer one, reaching you from deep inside the forest, their glister managing to dodge the thick trunks of trees to tear through the dark cloak of the night.

    You decide to[party.hasCompanions | tell your companions to wait while you] go get a closer look, choosing your path carefully to avoid bushes and branches, aware of how easily they would crack beneath your [pc.shoes] and how, with the same ease, the faint sound could call for unwanted attention. You check every shadow before moving forward, your hand resting near your [pc.weapon], ready to draw at any sign of danger. Since, for all you know, it could be a trap.
    
    It’s not long before you find the source of the light. You see a small campfire burning atop some well ordered stones, making company to a woman who sits just in the outer circle of light and warmth, resting her back against a tree while sharpening a sword. Her brown eyes focus on the weapon as she runs the stone across the blade, freeing a metallic sound that resonates through the camp. She then licks her thumb and rubs it against a tiny dirtied spot, too absorbed by her task to notice you.

A step forward leaves the shadows of the forest at your back. You deeply inhale as your mouth opens, your vocal cords already vibrating, just about to call the attention of the woman when a branch suddenly cracks under your weight. 

        It takes you by surprise, making you waste only a second looking down to understand what has just happened, but she reacts quickly, leaping towards you, sword in hand. Next thing you know, you have the recently sharpened sword pointed at you, the tip so close to your neck you can almost feel the cold metal against your skin, just a flick of the wrist away from cutting into you. Behind the threatening weapon you find a girl with brown eyes, observing you with both confidence and concern shining in her gaze.
        
        [pc.dcb |"If I wanted to fight, you would already know by now," |"I’m not here to fight," | "I come here in peace, jeez, why the meansies?"] you say, raising your arms to show your intentions. "My name is [pc.name]."
        
        She keeps the sword up for a moment, studying you from your [pc.feet] to your head, her white teeth starting to gently bite her thin, dry, lower lip. 
        
        "Fine, [pc.name]," she says, finally lowering the weapon. "I’ll believe you. You don’t look like a demon. But what are you doing out here in the middle of the night?"
        
        "I could be asking you the same question," you point out.
        
        "Checkmate, I guess," she says, lifting her shoulders while approaching the campfire, where a fallen log awaits, ready for her to sit on and enjoy the nearby flames. An opportunity she doesn’t hesitate to take while letting out a sigh. "Well, the fact is we’re both here, and what kind of knight would I be if I didn’t offer you a place near the fire?"
        
        You gladly take the invitation, sitting next to her, close enough to the fire for the cold to start fleeing from your body.
        
        "Still," she continues, "If you don’t want to tell me what you’re doing out here, tell me at least what you were doing searching around my camp."

"Not much I can say about myself," she says. "And even less than I want to say."

    "For whatever little you may be willing to say, I want to listen," you say.
    
    She sighs, looking at you first and then into the fire which dances atop the scorched branches, stealing reddish shades from the girl's pale face. 
    
    "Name is Lyla. And in case you didn't notice, I'm not from around here." 
    
    "Well, I didn't notice. Where are you from then?" you say.
    
    "From afar."
    
    [pc.dcb|"And that is?" |"And that is?"|"I haven't heard of that place! Is it far? It sounds like it is,"] you say, staring at her.
    
    "Far enough. That's all I'm gonna tell you. I don't like talking about it. Not now that I'm a shame for my people."
    
    Lyla tears a branch off the fallen log and throws it into flames, who welcome the new addition with a crackling sound as they feed on the wood. You let Lyla watch how it burns in silence. A silence that appears to be a never ending one, its heavy weight pressing down on you. She scratches one of her eyebrows, hiding her brown eyes from your sight for a brief moment, after which you hear her clearing her throat. Then she starts talking again. 
    
    "I was meant to go back with honors, you know?" she says with a sad smile. "I came here with a quest. I just had to catch this one guy and bring him home, to the same justice he tried to flee. I would be the hero my family always wanted, and I was on the right track, me and the rest of the squad. We could feel we were getting close. But, as you can probably tell, we failed." 
    
    "So the [pc.dcb|fugitive|fugitive|bad guy] put up a good fight..." you say.
    
    "No, it wasn't him. We didn't get to reach him, those damned demons attacked before we could. A fucking lot of them appeared out of nowhere. We tried fighting, but we weren't prepared for their numbers and one by one we all fell under their claws. I still remember how they laughed, those hoarse voices echoing through my head as unconsciousness took me. I thought it was the end, but they weren't done with us. No, those assholes wouldn't kill us. They wanted to keep us there, as prisoners — to service them, I imagine."
    
    "[pc.dcb |It's likely that your imagination is not too far off, |It's likely that your imagination is not too far off, |Maybe, but, like, who knows?]" you say.

rows.translation: 莉拉，”你问道，抬起眼睛望向她，“你其实来自哪里？” 她沉默了好一会儿，只是静静地凝视着那片被篝火微轻型所掩盖的暗影森林。 然后她吐了吐舌头，叹了口气。 “好吧，”她说，仍然没有抬头看你。“我其实不太喜欢谈论自己，但我想我还是可以告诉你的。我来自贝尔哈尔——那座神圣之城。不过，这里的人们根本不把那里当作世界的瑰宝，所以你可能也听不到过它的名字。" [pc.bg soldier courtesan scholar slumrat noblescion acolyte minstrel |你能听出来那是当地的口音——所以她并不是为了显得自己更有学识而故意装出来的。而且她说话时带着那种典型的、略带势利的口吻，这种口吻正是当地某些贵族阶层常常会使用的。 嗯，确实如此。你指出，‘在边境地区，还有其他一些和我们一样的Heartlanders。’也许他们并不居住在Ridell这么远的地方，但鹰棘镇的大多数居民在某个时候都来自南方。” “然而，他们却依然选择忽视这一事实。 然而，即便过了这么久，你仍然可以在河对岸看到帝国的遗迹。”直到这时，她才转过头来看着你。 |哈，一个来自心脏之地的人。你知道，很少有人能来到这么北的地方。这里没有军队，也没有商队往来，消息也相当稀少。自从我们之前那个时代之后，帝国就基本上不再存在了[pc.ora wyldelf | | 祖父母的 ] 祖父母辈的人都已经出生了，我们为什么还要讨论首都的问题呢？” “你难道没有看到周围这些帝国的残骸吗？”她厉声说道，终于转向了你。 ] 那些由帝国工程师建造的废弃引水渠、供奉神明的寺庙、宏伟的市政建筑以及皇宫……它们都在提醒我们：如果我们仍然能够团结在同一个旗帜下，我们本可以取得更大的成就。然而，这一切都在逐渐走向衰败，因为没有了帝国，世界上有一半的人已经忘记了如何将一块石头稳稳地堆放在另一块石头之上，否则它们就会立刻倒塌。人们应该共同努力，重新点燃文明的火种。 我们的 文明。那是我们共同拥有的文明，也是让我们得以繁荣发展的文明。然而，他们非但不去维护它，反而选择视而不见，仿佛这与他们毫无关系。 而如今，情况已经好多了。 [pc.bg hunter barbarian arcanist |在南方 |在家 ]目前吗？完全不是这样。但是，”她激动地继续说道，“他们在这里的表现也并不怎么样。曾经，我们所有人都遵循着同样的规则，共同分享着繁荣与幸福。我们曾经是—— 是 他们依然是贝尔哈兰人。那些幽灵摧毁了太多，但他们已经被击败了！我们本可以重建一切……然而我们并没有这样做。至少在南方，军阀们仍在为帝位争斗，仿佛这个头衔真的有什么意义似的。而在这里，统治者们虽然保留着帝制的象征，却没有任何头衔，也没有任何统一国家的意愿，更没有重获繁荣与强盛的决心。试想一下，如果能再次在古老的浴场中沐浴，能看到那些充满生机与欢笑的古老宫殿与城镇，能目睹那些训练有素的专业战士列队行进该有多好 [silly |现在，所有那些时刻都将随着时间的流逝而消失……就像雨中的泪水一样。 |如今，只剩下废墟，而那些真正关心这些废墟的人，却远在这之外。他们在遥远的南方，生活在那些争吵不休、琐碎无意义的小国家里，而这些小国家在萨瓦拉的地图上，只不过是微不足道的、像酒渍一样的小点罢了。 ]"
rows.raw: ' "Lyla," you ask, lifting your eyes toward hers, "where are you actually from?" For several moments, she doesn't answer, staring in silence at the dark veil that covers the forest out of range of the campfire's flickering light. Then she clicks her tongue and lets out a sigh. "Fine," she says, still not returning your gaze. "I don't really like talking about myself, but I guess I can tell you. I'm from Belhar — the Holy City itself. Not that you'd know it was the jewel of the world by the way people up here ignore its existence." [pc.bg soldier courtesan scholar slumrat noblescion acolyte minstrel |You recognize the accent — so she's not just putting on a show of it to make herself seem more learned. And she has that classic, somewhat snobbish tone about the capital that certain parts of the aristocracy there often adopt. Well, well. "There are a few other Heartlanders like us up here in the Marches," you point out. "Maybe not this far beyond the Ridell, but most of Hawkethorne came from down south at one point or another." "And somehow, they still choose to ignore it. Yet even after all this time, you can still see remnants of the Empire just over the river." Only now does she turn to look at you. |Huh. A Heartlander. "Not a whole lot of you get this far north, you know. No armies, no caravans. Not that much news, either. The Empire just hasn't really been around since before our[pc.ora wyldelf | | grandparents' ] grandparents were born; why should we talk about the capital?" "Don't you see the wreckage of empire all around you?" she barks, finally turning to you. ] "Fallen aqueducts built by imperial engineers, temples to the gods, great municipal buildings, imperial palaces... they remind us how much more we could be if we were still united under one banner. But they're all gradually falling into decay, because without the Empire, half of the world doesn't remember how to stack one block of stone on another without them both falling over. People should be working together to rekindle the embers of civilization. Our civilization. The one we shared; the one that let us thrive. But instead of doing that they'd rather just look the other way like it has nothing to do with them." "And things are so much better [pc.bg hunter barbarian arcanist |down south |back home ]?" "Currently? Not at all. But," she continues hotly, "it's not like they're doing great around here, either. Once upon a time, all of us lived under one rule and shared in its prosperity. We were — we are all still Belharans. The Wraiths destroyed so much, but they've been defeated! We can rebuild! And we haven't. At least in the south warlords still vie for the imperial title like it means something. Here, the rulers keep the symbols of imperial rule, but no title. No unifying urge. No destiny. And no return to its wealth, prosperity, or power. Imagine being able to rest in the ancient baths, see the old palace towns full of life and laughter, watch the serried ranks of true professional warriors march by. [silly |Now all those moments will be lost in time... like tears in the rain. |Now, ruins are all that remains, and the only ones who care are far away from here. Way down south, in their squabbling petty states that are little more than a tiny wine stain on the map of Savarra. ]" '

rows.original:
"A lot of blood was spilled on the Empire's account," you muse. "And from the way[pc.bg arcanist barbarian hunter
            | it sounds like
        ] things are going [pc.bg arcanist barbarian hunter
            |down south
            |back home
        ], people aren't done doing it, either. Maybe it's more complicated than just talking about the magical marvels and great cities."
        
        "I'm not saying it was perfect," Lyla replies, her words sounding coached, as if a mantra she's repeated many times before. "But as far as I'm concerned, the benefits of it outweighed the downsides. Outweighed what we're living through right now, at least."

rows.original: The violent, conquering Empire wasn't good for everybody, and maybe wanting it back isn't entirely a good idea.
rows.translation: 这个充满暴力、热衷于扩张的帝国并非对所有人都有好处，或许，试图将其夺回来也并非一个明智的选择。
rows.raw: "The violent, conquering Empire wasn't good for everybody, and maybe wanting it back isn't entirely a good idea."

rows.original:
"People in the Marches [flags.WC_CLEAR|— we, now, I guess — we're|are] doing the best [var0|we|they] can." You shrug. "Whatever the Empire was, nobody's come close to reuniting it in a long time. Nobody's even managed to keep up trade between north and south to more than a few caravans a year. If somebody ever unites the Heartlands, maybe how we feel about the Empire will matter, but until then, Marchers will just have to make do with the language and the ruins and some of the culture, and not the rest."
        
        "I don't know," she says dubiously, still refusing to meet your eyes. "It's not that simple. Especially not in the Heartlands. The past means something, [pc.name]."

rows.original:
"What about your family?" you ask.
    
    "Family? Well, yeah, I guess I do have a family back home." There's a pause, just barely longer than there would be for a normal sentence. "Or something similar. It's complicated."
    
    Complicated, hmm? Time for another tack. "[pc.bg noblescion scholar acolyte
        |You talk like you've been educated in proper southern style. Would I know your family?"
        
        "You might."
        |The reason I ask is that you sound like somebody... well, important. You've got that accent."
        
        "I may have been raised like one, at least."
    ] Before she elaborates, she looks up at the night sky. "I'm a bastard, you know? No shame in it. It is what it is. My father was a nobleman; my dear mother, a servant who used to work for him. When I was young, she passed away, and I very quickly found out the truth. He took me in, anyway. Bastard children are good for a nobleman — we have nowhere else to go. Most of us are very, very loyal. But they don't have to include us in the succession or the inheritance or anything. So I learned elocution and war alongside his sons, but whenever someone visited, I stopped being his daughter. No family name. Just some commoner. Just Lyla."

    "So that starry pond from last time caught your eye," Lyla says."The place is beautiful... too beautiful even. We can go there, of course, but we'll need to take our old enemy with us."
    
    She pulled the golden bottle of liqueur from her belongings and shrugged. Oh gods, it's that damned bottle.
    
    "Don't look at me like that," she says. "We gotta finish what we started."
    
    [pc.isBimbo|"But it seems like the bottle is infinite!|"Yet somehow it looks like no matter how much we drink, the bottle doesn't go down below halfway full."]
    
    "That's the magic of it," she says with a crooked smile. "Besides, I'm sure it wasn't that bad. I didn't have any complaints about the taste after we reached the pond."
    
    Well, she does have a point there. You may have been exaggerating how bad your tongue burned during the first sips. It probably wasn't that bad. Probably.|
    
    "Today was a good day, you know?" she says cheerily. "I found a carriage near the road, not too far from here. I couldn't see any trace of violence, but there were no signs of any merchants around either, so I deemed it abandoned. The owners probably had to flee or were taken away by some demons. Well... now that I think about it, I guess it wasn't a good day for them."

    She pressed her lips together and caressed her neck in silence for a couple of seconds, then she resumed talking.
    
    "The thing is, I found some boxes still untouched," she said, after what she leaned towards her belongings and started looking for something. "Most of them were dresses and rags for which I have no use, but I also found this beauty."
    
    A golden bottle appeared in her hands. Your sight didn't reach the label, but it was clear that it was some kind of liqueur. 
    
    "I was thinking we could give it a try. Take a walk, take some sips... just hang out like friends do, what do you say?"]

“我在想，我们不妨试一试。边散步边小酌几口……就像朋友一样一起享受这个时光，你觉得怎么样？"]

It's difficult to walk around the forest at night, when the only light helping you is granted by the moon and she's acting like a miser. It's even more difficult to do so when a quarter of the golden liqueur has already traveled your gullet.

            "Aaaand here we are," Lyla says. She leans on a rock and points forward, to the nothingness your eyes don't reach.
            
            Then you get closer and notice that there are no trees in front of you. The forest opens into a clearing where the still surface of a pond mirrors the night sky. The black canvas, the small droplets of light that are the stars and the pale queen of the night, they're all there, copied with such detail that you start to wonder if it wasn't actually the sky reflecting this place every night. [lyla.isWayfort|No matter how many times you come here, the sights never fail to amaze you.]
            
            "Beautiful isn't it?" Lyla says. 
            
            Her words make you look at her and you see her armor is already on the ground, leaving no barriers left between her naked body and your gaze. She then tries to stand on one foot to remove her boot, but the liqueur is merciless and you two have already guzzled a quarter of the whole bottle. Her balance starts to slowly drift away and she is forced to lean on you not to fall. Unfortunately, you're not better off and need to take a couple of backsteps and grab a nearby branch to not fall yourself.
            
            "Oops," she says as an apology. 
            
            Your answer isn't a word, it's only laughter. You don't really know why you're laughing, but you laugh nonetheless, and soon Lyla joins you. Both of you keep laughing until you have no air left and your abdomen hurts.
            
            "I'll...I'll wait for you in the water," she says, dragging the words. 
            
            She then throws her boots near her armor and walks toward the waters. The mirrored night sky trembles and breaks under the waves when Lyla dives headfirst into the pond and disappears under the dark waters.
            
            You remove your [pc.gear]—which proves to be a harder task than you expected— and let the pale moon shower your body with her light. 
            
            "Are you coming?" Lyla says from the pond.
rows.translation:
在夜晚的森林里行走确实很困难，因为唯一能帮助你的轻型源就是月亮，而它似乎格外吝啬，只洒下微弱的轻型芒。更何况，当你已经喝下了四分之一的金色利口酒之后，这种困难就更大了。

            就这样，我们到了。”莱拉说道。她靠在一块岩石上，指向前方——那片你肉眼无法触及的虚无之地。

当你靠近一些后，才会发现前方根本没有树木。森林在这里豁然开朗，形成了一片空地，而池塘平静的水面倒映着夜空。 那片黑色的画布，那些点点星轻型，还有那夜空中的淡雅女王——这一切都被如此细致地再现了出来，以至于你开始怀疑：难道每晚真正反射出这些景象的，其实是天空本身吗？ [lyla.isWayfort|无论你来到这里多少次，这里的景色总是能让你感到惊叹。]
            
            真美，不是吗？”莉拉说道。

她的这句话让你不由得看向她——此时她的盔甲早已掉落在地上，她的裸露身体再没有任何遮挡，完全暴露在你的视线之中。她试图单脚站立来脱掉靴子，但那杯利口酒实在太过诱人，你们俩已经喝掉了整瓶酒的四分之一。 她的平衡感逐渐丧失，不得不依靠你才能避免摔倒。不幸的是，你的情况也好不到哪里去——你也需要后退几步，抓住附近的一根树枝才能自己保持平衡。
            
            哎呀，”她说道，以此作为道歉。

你的回答根本不是什么有意义的话，只是一阵笑声。你其实并不知道自己为什么在笑，但就是忍不住笑了起来，不久之后，莉拉也加入了你的笑声。你们俩一直笑个不停，直到喘不过气来，肚子也疼得厉害。
            
            我……我会在水里等你，”她缓缓地说道。

随后，她把靴子扔在靠近盔甲的地方，然后朝着水边走去。当莉拉纵身跳进池塘，消失在暗影的水面下时，那反射着星轻型的天幕仿佛也随之颤动、破碎了。
            
            你取下了它。 [pc.gear]——这证明是一项比你想象中更艰巨的任务——让那淡薄的月轻型洒满你的身体。

“你要来吗？”莉拉在池塘边问道。

rows.original: Despite being the younger of the sisters, Meira is a little taller than Senja and more slender to boot. All of Evergreen's daughters are curvaceous, voluptuous creatures, but Meira's hourglass figure isn't as blatantly pronounced as that of her sister's or mother's, being more... well, without another frame of reference, you don't really have that much of an idea as to what %"reasonable" entails for a 'nuki, or even half-'nuki like her. Still, maybe it stands to reason. Meira falls more on the side of girl when it comes to monster-girl, seeming mostly human in appearance. Her round 'nuki ears, thick-ringed tail, and hint of a mask about her purple-hued eyes, which could easily be mistaken for some kind of eyeshadow — if not for those, she'd be no different from any human. Evergreen's daughters do run the gamut from nearly human to full-blooded tanuki, and you wonder if this isn't intentional, given the kinds of powers the mistress of the manor wields. Soft ginger hair, the color of 'nuki fur, falls all the way down to Meira's butt and base of her tail in a lush waterfall — how she keeps that luster while making regular trips out into the wild is beyond you. Seeing you eyeing her, Meira sticks her tongue out at you and poses, one hand on her cheek and pointed chin while the other rests on her hips. Her high-cut dress is fashionably white with red underskirts that hide her ringed tail most of the time, and its long sleeves with frilly cuffs keep her warm in the chill of the Marches. She's got a little cape-like thing about her neck, held together with a garnet clasp, and it's clear from the way her nipples push against the curve of her perky, rounded breasts that she doesn't bother with underclothes in the slightest. It makes sense — they'd only get in the way of her job... "Well then," Meira says with a giggle. "I'm much more interesting than Senja is, aren't I?" She certainly comports herself differently, if nothing else. "Right, but I wasn't asking that question. Well, no matter; I know you want to keep in Senja's good graces. Mom won't stand for us fighting around the house, after all. Now then, as much as I like to be admired, we don't have all day — anything else I can do for you?"

If you'd wanted to cook up a better story to impress her, certainly you wouldn't have come up with something this pedestrian. Meira scratches her chin and rolls her big purple eyes. "Yeah, I can see how that might make sense. On the other hand... I still don't know. Still a four out of ten." You don't think you're supposed to be rated on the entertainment value of your task here... |"You're odd," Meira states flatly. Sidling in close, the tanuki-girl witch runs her fingers up and down your arm, feeling your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] and sensing the muscles underneath tense. rows.translation: [rand |妈妈对你印象深刻，这本身就已经是很了不起的事情了。她本来差不多已经放弃了与那些狐狸们对抗，但你却成功地让他们知道了自己的态度，并且拿回了被抢走的东西。这是那些曾经来到这座宅邸的雇佣兵和冒险者们从来都没有做到过的——那些曾经与他们作对的人，没有一个能够成功回来。现在，我们所有人都在关注你。 [pc.name]." 嗯，考虑到常青女士家族的存在，你真的不知道自己是该感到荣幸，还是应该感到恐惧。 梅拉微笑着凑过来，用指尖轻轻划过你的脸颊。 只要不惹妈妈生气，就没什么好害怕的。如果你不怕妈妈，那么也就不用怕我。我们是一个非常友好的家庭。 |说实话，我们大家都觉得你是一个非常有趣的人。妈妈已经很久没有遇到过像你这样的人了——你会主动跟她讨论一些发人深省的话题。那些来到这座庄园的人，大多要么是来找工作的冒险者，要么是那些想要治愈身上的疾病、获得爱情魔药，或者想要除掉商业竞争对手的人……都是些充斥在普通人平凡生活中那些无聊琐事的人。 但是你！你就像是一个巨大的、会移动的魔法奇观一样出现了，送给妈妈一颗奇怪的能量水晶，然后还超出了她的所有期望，帮她找回了那些她以为永远丢失的东西！你是多年来出现在我们家门口的最大机遇，而妈妈甚至都不用费什么力气就能让你来到这里！ 一个机会而已？对梅拉和她的家人来说，你就只值这个吗？不过说真的，这样的评价也算挺高的了。 妈妈肯定会想办法哄你多在庄园里待一段时间的。天啊，我知道我也会这么做的——和你聊天确实比和这个地方的其他人聊天有趣多了。 她真的确定自己并没有参与到她母亲那个诱使你永远留在这里的阴险计划中吗？ 嗯！就算我是这样，我也不会后悔的！妈妈有她自己的办法，所以她能够为我们姐妹买到几乎任何我们想要的东西，但真正意义上的、纯粹的人际互动却很难通过这种方式获得。你真的很好奇，所以才会一次又一次地回来——大多数人都害怕妈妈，拿到他们想要的东西后就不会再来了。但是你……嗯，能有这样一个不排斥奇怪事物的人在身边，感觉真是挺好的，对吧？ |那么，呃，你到底是从哪里来的呢？你看起来并不像是我们这附近的人。 确实，你并没有。你花了一些时间向梅拉讲述了自己生活中的一些事情。 [a] [pc.background] 在这一切开始之前。那个有着狸猫外形的少女巫师全神贯注地聆听着，她那紫色的眼睛瞪得大大的，嘴巴也张成了一个小小的“O”字形。 嗯，这听起来确实比我的生活有趣多了。我不是说我至今以来的生活很糟糕或很不舒服——妈妈确实把我们所有人都照顾得很好——但你的经历确实比我丰富得多，毕竟我成年后拥有的时间也更长。说实话，我有点羡慕你。 她不应该这样。外面的世界太残酷了。 梅拉靠在附近的柱子上，缓缓坐下。 是啊，我知道。我想大概十年后，当我独自生活的时候，回想起和妈妈在一起的那些日子，就会想起在这里我有多么舒适，也会后悔当初没有珍惜那些美好的时光。但现在…… 总以为别人的草更绿，不是吗？ 呃。 |所以，妈妈告诉我，你正在进行这次冒险，目的是阻止某个女恶魔统治世界之类的。 没错。 听起来倒也不算太离谱，就给它打四分吧， creativity方面还算不错。 什么？ 所有那些来到这座宅邸的雇佣兵和冒险者，通常都会编造一些关于自己即将完成的大事迹的故事：屠龙、击败黑暗之心、恢复力量的平衡，诸如此类的夸张言论。但大多数情况下，他们最终只是去追捕了几只鸡，然后觉得这根本不值得，便转身回家了。说实话，那些关于恶魔女妖想要征服一切的传说，听起来实在没什么波澜壮阔之处……更像是一些人自己编造出来的故事罢了。 会 虽然看起来很宏伟，但实际上并不如此。 这就是她之所以相信那是真的原因。如果你想编一个更精彩的故事来打动她，肯定不会想出这么老套的内容。 梅拉挠了挠下巴，然后翻了个大大的紫色眼睛。 嗯，我明白这样想确实有道理。但另一方面……我还是不太确定。给个四分吧。 你难道不觉得，你的任务应该根据其娱乐性来来评价吗…… |你真奇怪。 梅拉直截了当地说道。那个皮肤黝黑、打扮像女巫的狸猫女孩凑近你，用手指沿着你的手臂上下滑动，仔细感受你的身体。 [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] 同时也能感受到下面的肌肉正在变得紧张。 奇怪’其实就是‘有趣’的另一种说法。我想我明白妈妈为什么看中你，虽然我也很难用语言表达出来。你拥有某种连我都无法企及的潜力，甚至敢说连妈妈也不例外……正因为如此，妈妈才想学会如何做到这一点，这样她自己也能做到。在这些问题上，妈妈一直都是有点羡慕你的。 嗯，你并不确定是否还会出现那些通往只有神明才知道的地方的传送门，所以你也不完全确定她的母亲是否有可能找到这样的途径。就你而言，你真的不希望这种事情再次发生。 不过，这并不会阻止妈妈一有机会就催你做事。我也一样，只不过我的原因跟她的完全不同…… 那么，如果是你先主动接近她，那么她这样的行为还能算得上是在逼迫你吗？ ]
