rows.original: [rand |"Mom... has been around for as long as any of my sisters can remember. Maybe some of my older sisters who've left might've known our grandma — presumably the Lady Evergreen before her — but we grow up quickly enough that no one really knows. She's just always been... there." Meira looks a little uneasy and hugs herself. "I don't know. Life without her seems impossible at times, until I get a grip on myself and remember that I'll be gone from this place someday. I think I'd manage fine, but several of my sisters are utterly dependent on her for practically everything, especially her potential heirs to the title of Lady Evergreen. Those sisters of mine are always around her; she never lets them stray too far away." Was she always that much of a looker, though? Meira thinks. "When I was — uh, younger, she was shapelier and slimmer, I guess. She's still pretty ritzy, but Mom's starting to show her age a little — she was talking about passing the title down in the next five to ten years before her body truly starts wearing itself out. Before that happens, though... all of us half-'nuki daughters will have to leave. The next Lady Evergreen won't take kindly to having her sisters still running around the place when she'll be having daughters of her own to fill the manor with, Mom says." And what of the old Lady Evergreen? "Mom didn't say. Like I said, I don't know what happened to our grandma. Maybe she hung on for long enough for her to expire? No, that's not right, there's always only been one Lady Evergreen at a time." She shrugs. "I might be inclined to find out, if it ever comes to that." |"You've seen Mom's trophy room on the way in, right?" It is quite impressive. "They're all trophies Mom and all the previous Lady Evergreens have collected. There's no end of do-gooders who hear of a witch in the woods, decide she must be up to no good and decide to have a good old time of 'burn the witch' when all Mom and the lot of us want to do is be left alone in peace. "Then there're those who thought they were really smart and could get away with double-crossing Mom, or get away with breaking the deals they struck with her. Mom can't let that sort of thing stand — her reputation is really all she has when it comes to the outside world. If they're lucky, she has them turn over everything they own and kicks them out with a stern word to never come back." And if they're unlucky...? "Well, it hasn't happened in the time I've been alive, so there's a small mercy at least. I'm sure Mom would be able to do some very nasty things to them, though." Judging by the items Evergreen openly has on display, you presume there're other more powerful spoils she's got hidden away. And if she was able to take those from their owners, she's no doubt a witch of some renown and power. But then again these are things you already knew. "Yeah. It's a good thing Mom is so nice and reasonable to most people. She could be really mean if she chose to be; I'm glad she's such a good person to keep on helping people out, even if it does come at a very reasonable price. It's got to cost something, after all, or else we'd be swamped with guests all day." |"Mom is a really great sorceress," Meira declares proudly. "I know a bit of this and that, but I learned it all from her to begin with. All of us daughters know a bit of her magic, but it's only the favored sisters — those who might be Lady Evergreen after her — who're allowed to learn the really good stuff. While I can see why that's the case, I can't help but be a little jealous." Well, you would be too. Still, she's gained in some ways that they don't — she's got the ability to forge her own path when she finally leaves her mother's house. The ability to grow independently can't be understated — there is the chance that she might eventually manage to outdo her mother under her own strength instead of forever being tied to Evergreen's level. "I guess, even if it's not that good of a chance, aha. Still, what I do know is more than what most who call themselves wizards in the outside world actually do. I went into the town down south some time ago, and there was a badly-dressed fat cat who claimed to be some kind of big-shot wizard. Didn't do much actual magic, most of it was smoke and mirrors; even I could've easily outdone him, let alone Mom. She's great that way." |"You know those ringtail peaches Senja always has in stock at that little so-called shop of hers? Mom loves those — apparently all the old Lady Evergreens have had a soft spot for them. They're not native to this part of the world, but the first Lady Evergreen brought them over from... uh, wherever it is she came from and planted them here in the Frostwood. Mom says they bring back good memories for her. "I don't care for them much myself — they're okay eating, I guess — but it's always a good idea to have some on hand lest I catch Mom in a bad mood. It wouldn't get me out of any actual trouble, but at least it'll cheer her up a bit. Nothing's worse than being snapped at by Mom just because you caught her on a bad fur day." |"Mom has always told me that if I go out, I shouldn't wander near the big cherry blossom tree in the northwest part of the forest, nor should I get too close to the old castle should I head into town. I'm not sure what kind of beef those two have with the Evergreen line, but they've been at loggerheads with each other since forever, it seems." What caused it all? Meira shrugs. "Beats me. But if a witch as powerful as Mom is careful around them, then it doesn't sound like anything I might want to get caught up in with. Let the next Lady Evergreen deal with it, I say; once I'm out of this manor and on my own, presumably they'll have no reason to bother with me any more." ]
rows.translation: [rand |妈妈……从我姐妹们记事起，她就一直都在我们身边。也许那些已经嫁出去的姐姐们曾经认识我们的奶奶——也就是那位被称为‘常青女士’的人——但我们都长得太快了，所以其实没人真正了解她。她就是一直……在那里。 梅拉看起来有些不安，她抱住了自己。 我不知道。有时候，没有她的生活似乎根本无法继续下去，直到我重新振作起来，提醒自己总有一天会离开这个地方。我想我自己应该能应付得来，但我的几个姐妹在几乎所有事情上都完全依赖她，尤其是那些有望继承‘常青女士’头衔的姐妹们。她们总是围在她身边，她从不允许她们离开太远。 不过，她本来就那么漂亮吗？ 梅拉这样想着。 当我还比较年轻的时候，她应该看起来更苗条、更漂亮一些。她现在依然很时髦，不过妈妈也开始显老了——她说她打算在接下来的五到十年里把这个头衔传下去，等她的身体真正开始衰老之前。不过在那之前……我们这些‘半尼基’家族的女儿们都得离开这里。妈妈说，下一任‘常青女士’可不会乐意看到自己的姐妹们还在这里晃来晃去，而她自己却有女儿们来填补这个庄园。 那么，老夫人常青女士又怎么样呢？ 妈妈没有说。就像我说的，我不知道我们奶奶发生了什么。也许她坚持了太久，最终去世了吧？不，那样说不对，因为‘常青女士’这个称号一次只能属于一个人。 她耸了耸肩。 如果真到了那一步，我或许会想要弄清楚真相。 |在来这里的路上，你应该已经看到妈妈设立的奖杯陈列室了吧？ 确实令人印象深刻。 这些都是妈妈和之前的各位‘常青女士’收集来的战利品。总有一些好事之徒，一听说森林里有女巫，就认定她肯定在干坏事，然后就兴冲冲地去‘烧死女巫’。而妈妈和我们所有人，其实只是想安静地过自己的日子罢了。 还有那些自以为非常聪明，以为可以欺骗妈妈或者违背与她达成的协议而逍遥法外的人。妈妈绝不能容忍这种行为——对于外界而言，她的声誉就是她所拥有的一切。如果那些人运气好的话，她只会让他们交出自己拥有的一切，然后严厉地赶他们走，让他们永远不要再回来。 而如果他们运气不好呢……？ 嗯，在我有生之年，这种事还没发生过，所以至少还有这点幸运。不过，我敢肯定妈妈肯定能对他们做出一些非常残忍的事情来。 从常青女士公开展示的那些物品来看，可以推测她肯定还藏有一些更强大的战利品。如果她能够将这些物品从原主手中夺走，那么她无疑是一位声名显赫、实力强大的女巫。不过，这些其实都是你们早已知道的事情罢了。 是啊。幸好妈妈对大多数人都这么友善、通情达理。如果她愿意的话，也可以变得很刻薄；不过我很高兴她是个这么好的人，总是愿意帮助别人，而且她所要求的代价也相当合理。毕竟，帮助别人总要付出一些代价的，否则我们整天都会被客人挤得水泄不通。 |妈妈真的是一位非常出色的女巫。 梅拉自豪地宣称道。 我对这些知识也略知一二，但最初都是她教给我的。我们这些女儿们都知道她的一些魔法，但只有那些受她偏爱的姐妹们——那些将来有可能继承她位置的人——才能学习那些真正的、高深的魔法。虽然我能理解为什么会是这样，但我还是忍不住会感到有点嫉妒。 嗯，你也是吧。不过，她在某些方面确实比他们更强——当她最终离开母亲的家时，她有能力自己开辟道路。这种独立成长的能力非常重要，因为这样她就有机会依靠自己的力量取得比她母亲更高的成就，而不会永远受限于“常青女士”的水平。 我想，即使这个机会并不是那么大，啊哈。不过，我所掌握的知识确实比那些在外界自称为巫师的人要多得多。不久前我去过南边的那个小镇，那里有只穿着破旧、体型肥胖的猫，它自称是什么了不起的巫师。但实际上它并没有施展什么真正的魔法，大部分都是些花招和骗人的把戏；就连我，也能轻松地胜过它，更不用说妈妈了。她在这方面确实非常厉害。 |你知道Senja她那家小店里总是有那些环尾桃吧？妈妈非常喜欢它们——显然，所有的常青女士老太太们也都对它们情有独钟。这些水果其实并不是原产于这个地区的，但第一位常青女士老太太把它们从……呃，她来自的地方带到了这里，然后种在了霜林。妈妈说，这些水果能让她回想起许多美好的回忆。 我自己其实不太喜欢吃这些——我觉得吃起来还行吧——但备着总没坏处，这样万一妈妈心情不好，我就可以用这些来让她开心一点。虽然这并不能真正帮我摆脱麻烦，但至少能让她的情绪好一些。没有什么比在妈妈心情不好的时候惹她生气更糟糕的了。 |妈妈总是告诉我，如果我出门的话，千万不要在森林西北部那棵大樱花树附近闲逛，如果我去镇上的话，也千万不要靠近那座古老的城堡。我不太清楚这两者和常青女士线有什么矛盾，但看起来他们之间长期以来一直存在着争执。 这一切究竟是为什么造成的呢？ 梅拉耸了耸肩。 真难办。不过，像妈妈这么强大的女巫在处理这些事情时都会格外小心，所以我觉得这些事情应该不会让我陷入麻烦。还是让下一任常青女士来处理吧；等我离开了这座庄园，开始独立生活后，他们应该就没有理由再来打扰我了。 ]
rows.raw: " [rand |"Mom... has been around for as long as any of my sisters can remember. Maybe some of my older sisters who've left might've known our grandma — presumably the Lady Evergreen before her — but we grow up quickly enough that no one really knows. She's just always been... there." Meira looks a little uneasy and hugs herself. "I don't know. Life without her seems impossible at times, until I get a grip on myself and remember that I'll be gone from this place someday. I think I'd manage fine, but several of my sisters are utterly dependent on her for practically everything, especially her potential heirs to the title of Lady Evergreen. Those sisters of mine are always around her; she never lets them stray too far away." Was she always that much of a looker, though? Meira thinks. "When I was — uh, younger, she was shapelier and slimmer, I guess. She's still pretty ritzy, but Mom's starting to show her age a little — she was talking about passing the title down in the next five to ten years before her body truly starts wearing itself out. Before that happens, though... all of us half-'nuki daughters will have to leave. The next Lady Evergreen won't take kindly to having her sisters still running around the place when she'll be having daughters of her own to fill the manor with, Mom says." And what of the old Lady Evergreen? "Mom didn't say. Like I said, I don't know what happened to our grandma. Maybe she hung on for long enough for her to expire? No, that's not right, there's always only been one Lady Evergreen at a time." She shrugs. "I might be inclined to find out, if it ever comes to that." |"You've seen Mom's trophy room on the way in, right?" It is quite impressive. "They're all trophies Mom and all the previous Lady Evergreens have collected. There's no end of do-gooders who hear of a witch in the woods, decide she must be up to no good and decide to have a good old time of 'burn the witch' when all Mom and the lot of us want to do is be left alone in peace. "Then there're those who thought they were really smart and could get away with double-crossing Mom, or get away with breaking the deals they struck with her. Mom can't let that sort of thing stand — her reputation is really all she has when it comes to the outside world. If they're lucky, she has them turn over everything they own and kicks them out with a stern word to never come back." And if they're unlucky...? "Well, it hasn't happened in the time I've been alive, so there's a small mercy at least. I'm sure Mom would be able to do some very nasty things to them, though." Judging by the items Evergreen openly has on display, you presume there're other more powerful spoils she's got hidden away. And if she was able to take those from their owners, she's no doubt a witch of some renown and power. But then again these are things you already knew. "Yeah. It's a good thing Mom is so nice and reasonable to most people. She could be really mean if she chose to be; I'm glad she's such a good person to keep on helping people out, even if it does come at a very reasonable price. It's got to cost something, after all, or else we'd be swamped with guests all day." |"Mom is a really great sorceress," Meira declares proudly. "I know a bit of this and that, but I learned it all from her to begin with. All of us daughters know a bit of her magic, but it's only the favored sisters — those who might be Lady Evergreen after her — who're allowed to learn the really good stuff. While I can see why that's the case, I can't help but be a little jealous." Well, you would be too. Still, she's gained in some ways that they don't — she's got the ability to forge her own path when she finally leaves her mother's house. The ability to grow independently can't be understated — there is the chance that she might eventually manage to outdo her mother under her own strength instead of forever being tied to Evergreen's level. "I guess, even if it's not that good of a chance, aha. Still, what I do know is more than what most who call themselves wizards in the outside world actually do. I went into the town down south some time ago, and there was a badly-dressed fat cat who claimed to be some kind of big-shot wizard. Didn't do much actual magic, most of it was smoke and mirrors; even I could've easily outdone him, let alone Mom. She's great that way." |"You know those ringtail peaches Senja always has in stock at that little so-called shop of hers? Mom loves those — apparently all the old Lady Evergreens have had a soft spot for them. They're not native to this part of the world, but the first Lady Evergreen brought them over from... uh, wherever it is she came from and planted them here in the Frostwood. Mom says they bring back good memories for her. "I don't care for them much myself — they're okay eating, I guess — but it's always a good idea to have some on hand lest I catch Mom in a bad mood. It wouldn't get me out of any actual trouble, but at least it'll cheer her up a bit. Nothing's worse than being snapped at by Mom just because you caught her on a bad fur day." |"Mom has always told me that if I go out, I shouldn't wander near the big cherry blossom tree in the northwest part of the forest, nor should I get too close to the old castle should I head into town. I'm not sure what kind of beef those two have with the Evergreen line, but they've been at loggerheads with each other since forever, it seems." What caused it all? Meira shrugs. "Beats me. But if a witch as powerful as Mom is careful around them, then it doesn't sound like anything I might want to get caught up in with. Let the next Lady Evergreen deal with it, I say; once I'm out of this manor and on my own, presumably they'll have no reason to bother with me any more." ] "

rows.original: [rand |"Senja is old enough to strike out on her own, but she doesn't want to take the initiative and butt out. Instead, she wants some knight in shining armor to come up to Mom's doorstep and sweep her off her feet!" Meira purses her lips and folds her arms under her chest. "Can you believe it? First off, do-gooders aren't the kind to come riding up to Mom's doorstep with any regularity. Second off, she's got such a flat personality that no one would ever be interested in her like that; she's got to liven things up a little, be more energetic and unpredictable! Finally, good things don't happen to people who wait; you have to take the initiative and make your own luck. Sitting around and waiting for things to happen to you isn't any way to go about your future!" Uh-huh. "Those of my sisters competing to be Mom's heir aside, she's the oldest of us still hanging around the manor. I wonder which it's going to be first, me eventually leaving this place or Mom finally kicking her out the door." |"Senja's always been a bit of a pack rat, that's how she's got so much stuff on her hands to try and push onto people. She doesn't even really have a good idea of properly theming a shop — it's all just stuff she finds out in the woods! Then, instead of the town she so loves to visit, she decides to hawk here stuff right here on Mom's doorstep! Where is she going to find customers?" Um... well, she seems to be doing all right, if nothing else. Certainly she seems satisfied with the money she's able to take in to be able to afford pretty dresses and nice drinks down in Hawkethorne. "That's what I don't understand about it all!" Meira exclaims, throwing her hands up in the air. "She's going against everything a sane merchant would do, but somehow the money's coming in against all reason! She's not getting it from Mom — the only reason Mom keeps money around is to pay off mercenaries, and that's off-limits! So just who is buying her junk out in the middle of nowhere? I haven't been able to figure it out no matter how hard I try!" Has she tried asking Senja? Meira glares dark daggers at you and makes the most sour pouty face you've seen in quite a while. Well, there's your answer. |As far as you can tell, Meira doesn't like Senja a lot. Shouldn't they get along better as sisters? Meira grumps. "Well, given how many sisters I have, blood really isn't worth that much, is it? She's just so... straight-laced and schoolmarmish. She's smart and pretty enough to be an interesting person if she so chose, but she doesn't want to be. There's nothing sorrier in the world than wasted potential." Hmm... "Doesn't even have a dick, I tell you. I keep on telling her, it's not as if you have to have it out at all if you don't want it out and about, but it's better to have it and not need it than need it and not have it. Of course, everything's fallen on deaf ears. I guess it saves me the trouble of going around to collect dick length for her, but..." Rolling her eyes, Meira flops against a nearby pillar and sighs, visibly deflating. "She just makes me so mad." You get the feeling here that the problem's more on Meira's side than it is on Senja's, but telling it to her face as-is is probably just going to make matters worse. |"Senja is more properly tanuki than I am, I guess. I'm on the pretty low end of the scale, just the ears and tail, and maybe a bit of what might be eyeshadow. Mom's as full-blooded as they get. Senja on the other hand, she's nearly stuck in between. Not enough to be counted as mostly human, but not really enough to be thought of as a 'nuki, either. Maybe that in-between state is why she's so wishy-washy and indecisive all the time; it's hard for me to get a straight answer out of her because she really doesn't like making decisions." You give Meira a hard look. Sometimes it's not easy to tell whether she's just simply being spiteful towards her eldest sister, or if there's a grain of truth in all of that. |"Senja is such a goody-two-shoes, I sometimes wonder if she's Mom's kid at all. I meant that in spirit, if not in body. Did she get that from her dad, whoever he was? There's not a single mischievous bone in her body, I swear. I guess Mom isn't picky about who fathers us daughters, but even so...! When I become as great a witch and sorceress as Mom is, I'm going to demand some standards for all the suitors who'll be lining up to impregnate me, that's for sure!" Well, she'd better get started on that, then. "I already have!" Closing her eyes, Meira puffs out her chest in her proudest and most stately pose. "Watch out, world, I'm coming to take you by storm! I'm sure not going to be content with sitting in a little house in the woods like Mom and Senja are, and waiting for people to come to me!" ]
rows.translation: [rand |Senja已经长大了，应该能够独立生活了，但她却不愿意主动迈出第一步。相反，她希望有位白马王子出现在妈妈家门口，然后将她抱走！ 梅拉抿紧嘴唇，双臂交叉抱在胸前。 你能相信吗？首先，那些总爱做好事的人根本不会经常上门来帮助妈妈。其次，她的性格太过平淡无奇，根本不会有人对她产生那种兴趣；她必须让自己变得更活跃一些，更充满活力、更难以预测才行！最后，好事从来不会主动找上那些只会等待的人——你必须主动出击才行。 制作 靠自己的运气吧。坐以待毙，等待事情主动发生在自己身上，这种态度根本无法帮助你规划未来！ 嗯，好的。 除了那些争着成为母亲继承人的姐妹们之外，她是我们当中还在这个庄园里生活的最年长的人。我在想，究竟会先发生什么：是我最终离开这个地方，还是母亲终于把她赶出去。 |Senja一直都是个喜欢囤积东西的人，正因为如此，她手里才会有那么多东西，总是想把这些东西推销给别人。她甚至都不太清楚该如何为自己的店铺营造一个统一的主题风格——所有这些东西都是她在森林里找到的！然后，她没有选择去她那么喜欢去的镇子上售卖，反而决定就在妈妈家门口摆摊卖这些东西！她到底在哪里能找到顾客呢？ 嗯……至少她现在看起来过得还不错。她似乎对自己赚到的钱很满意，这些钱让她能够在鹰棘镇买到漂亮的衣服和美味的饮品。 这就是我完全无法理解的地方！ 梅拉惊呼着，双手朝天举起。 她的行为完全违背了一个理智商人应该采取的方式，但奇怪的是，钱却源源不断地进账！这些钱肯定不是妈妈给的——妈妈留钱本来就是用来支付雇佣兵的费用的，这笔钱根本不可能被用到别的地方！那么，到底是谁在这么偏远的地方买她那些东西呢？我费了九牛二虎之力，还是想不明白！ 她有没有试过去问Senja呢？ Meira用充满敌意的目光盯着你，做出了你很久以来见过的最生气的表情……好吧。 有…… 你的答案。 |从你观察来看，梅拉似乎并不太喜欢塞尼亚。作为姐妹，她们不应该相处得更好一些吗？ 梅拉哼了一声。 嗯，考虑到我有那么多姐妹，血缘关系其实并没有那么重要，对吧？她就是太……古板、太守旧了。她虽然聪明又漂亮，如果她愿意的话，完全可以成为一个有趣的人，但她并不想这样做。世界上没有比浪费潜力更可悲的事情了。 嗯…… 我跟她说了，那东西根本就没有必要非得有。我一直跟她说，如果不想让别人知道，那就没必要非得露出来；但有了而不用总比需要了却没有要好吧。当然，她根本没听进去……至少这样我就不用再费心去搜集关于那个东西长度的资料了，不过…… 梅拉翻了个白眼，靠在附近的柱子上叹了口气，明显显得有些沮丧。 她真的让我非常生气。 在这里，你会觉得问题更多出在梅拉身上，而不是森雅身上，但如果直接把这种想法告诉她，情况反而可能会变得更糟。 |我想，比起我来说，Senja才更像真正的狸猫。我的特征还算比较不明显，只有耳朵和尾巴有点像狸猫的特征，或许还有那么一点点类似眼影的颜色。而妈妈则是纯粹的狸猫血统。至于Senja，她的特征则介于两者之间。 她的特性既不足以被归类为“人类”，也不足以被定义为“努基”。也许正是这种介于两者之间的状态，导致她总是优柔寡断、难以做出决定；我很难从她那里得到一个明确的答案，因为她实在不喜欢做决定。" 你仔细地打量着梅拉。有时候，很难判断她对姐姐的这种行为究竟只是出于恶意，还是其中确实有些真相。 |森雅真是个太乖太正经的人了，有时候我甚至会怀疑她到底是不是妈妈亲生的孩子。我的意思是，就算不是亲生，至少在性格上也是吧。这种性格是遗传自她父亲吗？我发誓，她身上根本没有一点调皮捣蛋的基因。我想妈妈应该并不在意为我们女儿们挑选父亲吧，但即便如此……！等我将来也成为像妈妈那样伟大的女巫和魔法师时，我一定会要求一些 标准 对于所有那些排队想要让她们怀孕的追求者来说 我那肯定是这样！ 那么，她最好马上开始行动吧。 我已经有了！ 梅拉闭上眼睛，挺起胸膛，摆出了她最骄傲、最庄严的姿势。 小心了，全世界的人们，我就要来震撼你们了！我可不会像妈妈和Senja那样，坐在森林里的小房子里，等待别人来找我！ ]

rows.original: [rand |Just how many sisters does she have, anyway? "You know, I'm not entirely sure." That's interesting. Could she elaborate? "Uh, okay. So Mom's been about this for a while now, and there're sisters who flew the nest before I was ever born, either of their own free will, or they were married off by Mom or something. Then, well... I've never actually bothered to tally up all of those still hanging around the mansion. I know Senja, I know a few more, but frankly Mom keeps on getting pregnant all the time and popping them out with such speed that I don't bother keeping count any more. "Sometimes, it can get really hard to tell them apart, especially the full-blooded 'nukis amongst my sisters. As far as I'm concerned, they're practically identical to each other, peas in a pod — I don't know if they're born that way, or if Mom makes them that way in the same fashion that she makes any boys born to her into girls, but if I don't know one from the other I can't keep count. Assuming that I would even care to begin with, anyway." Well, it makes sense from a strange point of view. If the next Lady Evergreen is supposed to be as close to the previous as possible, it wouldn't be a surprise that they look like her. Are they all called 'Oxana', too? Meira scratches her chin at that and purses her lips in thought. "I... I dunno. Come to think of it, I've never heard Mom refer to any of them by name. I guess you're right — if they're going to be her heirs, whoever it is who wins out will have to be used to being called Lady Evergreen, won't she?" |"You may not think it, but Mom's the mother-in-law to several important families in the Belharan Heartlands. Not that she has any claim or connection to the head families, but the branch families... well, all of us daughters are very pretty, and if Mom's any measure our beauty is slow to fade with age. While I've never met them, I supposedly have plenty of sisters who were married off into advantageous positions for Mom. That's one of the reasons she was able to have such a luxurious, well-supplied mansion in the middle of nowhere, or so she tells me. Connections and contacts." |Does the mansion ever get crowded with her ever-growing number of sisters? Evergreen is a bit of a pregophile, after all, and her daughters grow up fast. Sure, she has plenty of children around all the time, but it's never gotten to the point where her mansion feels crowded. Maybe Meira would have a different point of view, especially since she lives here and all. "Hmmmm. I..." It looks to you as if this is the first time Meira's given the subject any serious thought. "I'm not entirely sure, really. Mom does like getting kids from people as part of payment for services rendered, but things have never gotten to the point where it's cramped. Neither has any of us left the manor in the last couple of years or so... you know what?" Yes? "I don't know, and thinking about it just makes me confused. That makes me not really care very much about it... I have a room, if it's not a very big one, and I know Senja has one, and sometimes I'm walking on the balcony for quite a while to cross a small distance, and —" she catches herself — "I don't want to think about it too closely. There's just enough space for everyone, no matter how many of us there are, and while I'd like to learn whatever shenanigans Mom pulls to keep it that way she's not likely to be slipping those secrets to me anytime soon." |"Like me, my sisters are assigned tasks to do," Meira informs you. "It's mostly getting things in order around the house, though. Mom could make everything spick and span with a snap of her fingers, but she doesn't do it and instead wants us to get things sorted out. Says that it builds character. I don't know, I'm kind of glad I got a job that I actually like instead of being in their place — I know I'd die of boredom if I were to push a broom about all day!" Well that makes sense. rows.raw: " For some reason, Meira's extra perky and excited to see you today — no sooner have you entered the tanuki witch's sight that the little round ears atop her head stiffen and she sashays towards you with a dramatic sweep of her skirts. [pc.bg minstrel |Little lady knows how to make a dramatic entrance, that's for sure — enough to your professionally experienced eyes that one wonders if she's been coached. ] "Hey, [pc.name]!" Meira says, greeting you with a cheeky grin and pinching her own cheek. "Just the [pc.raceCute] I was thinking of seeing today! Were you thinking of seeing me, too, that you came all the way here and walked up right to me? Because that makes two of us!" She's laying it on pretty thickly today, isn't she? Meira gasps in melodramatic mock surprise and shrinks back, setting the frilly hem of her skirts aflutter. "Oh no, oh no! Do you mean that I'm not usually this cheeky and energetic, that something must be up with me for a poor girl to be friendly with the rare visitor to her home?" Oh sure, Meira's plenty cheeky all the time. Thing is, she's usually impish cheeky, while this little act is ingratiating cheeky. Well, she's a forward girl who knows what she wants and isn't afraid to say it, so out with it already instead of this little charade. A huff. "Well, it's not like I have anyone other than my sisters to practice on..." C'mon, what does she want already? "Spoilsport." Meira sticks her tongue out at you. "All right, so I'm getting to the age when I should be thinking of leaving the mansion, okay? It won't be for a couple more years, but even so, I should start thinking about it — I can't be here forever tending to my sisters, [evergreen.dealtWith |even Mom isn't... around anymore and Senja's taken her place, I think I owe it to my poor sis to move out and lighten her burden a bit. Not so far away that I can't be easily reached if need be, but also not so close that I'm dragging on her style. There's a lot changing in this house from how Mom used to run things, and it's got everyone on edge; the more feeble-minded of my sisters are still asking where Mom is and Senja's got her hands full wrangling them." Fair enough. Looking at it from Meira's point of view, you can see why she'd think that this would be the appropriate time to strike out on her own. Meira gives you a smile, although it's a lot less impish than the one she greeted you with. "...Yeah. Like I said, far enough to be out of Senja's hair, close enough to be around if I'm needed. Not that I do anything useful around the house these days; since Mom is no longer around, there's really no need for someone to go out and get dick inches for everyone. Now that I look back on it, the whole matter really feels like a lot of busywork to keep me away from the house and out of trouble... "Anyways! Mom's not around to settle my future for me, and Senja's going to be busy with her own things for, I don't know, forever. That leaves me to figure out what I'm going to be doing for the rest of my life. I think I speak for all of my sisters that we always imagined that Mom was going to be around forever, and I guess that was closer to the truth than anyone imagined, huh?" Credit's where credit's due — Senja's too nice a person to kick her own sister out from under her roof, so Meira could have just been a moocher forever. That she's proactively taking this step shows that she has more forethought than most of her sisters, even if that's not a high bar to clear. |Mom won't allow it for anyone who isn't a full 'nuki." Sounds sensible, she can't live under her mother's roof forever. You take it that she has a plan, then? "Yeah, about that. My older sisters who eventually moved out — Mom was more than happy to make arrangements for them, sending one off to apprentice to her old friend, marrying another off to so and so, that kind of thing. By all accounts that've come back to the mansion, my sisters are doing pretty well for themselves, especially since they were content to let Mom handle their future for them. But..." She wants more? "Nah, those sisters of mine which Mom handled have more than I could ever achieve by myself, I know as much. But see, if I'm able to visit different places for myself and figure out some kind of plan, I'll be able to put forward a plan that Mom might actually find sensible. The woods and manor are nice and all, but they're not really conducive to a girl thinking about what she's going to be doing with the rest of her life, right?" Well, by giving more thought to what comes after she leaves her mother's house, she's demonstrated more forethought than most of her sisters, even if that's not a high bar to clear. Credit's where credit's due. ] Meira beams at your praise. "Okay, then! [pc.name], you're not just anyone — you're the only person who comes by the manor these days, and you're our fancy new neighbor down by the fort a stone's throw away to the south. rows.original: Well, I'd love to, but it's a little late to be going out about the town. I'd get too sleepy and forget important details — as much as going out with you is fun, it's supposed to be a working trip, hmm?" Now, now. At this point, are the dates really an excuse to scout for future locations to set up shop, or is it the other way around? Meira sticks her tongue out at you; maybe you struck closer to the truth than intended. "Nice try. Really, it's too late. [evergreen.dealtWith |Sure, Senja is the new Lady Evergreen, not me, but it's not like she's doing everything on her own. I'm trying to teach the more sensible of our sisters to care better for the more airheaded ones, but it's an uphill battle. The worst of the worst... they're probably going to be able to do little more than just eat, sleep and fuck. It got to the point where even Senja got to the point where she asked me if we shouldn't just, uh, arrange a proper future for them that caters to their proclivities." ...You have no idea what that euphemism is intended to mean, but it doesn't sound good. Meira rubs her eyes and sighs. "Sorry, I didn't mean to take things for a grim turn. Point being that a lot's changed in so short a time — we really thought that Mom was going to be with us forever, and it shows. Sure, I need to move out, but right here and now, I need my rest. If it's getting to Senja that badly, it's getting to me whether I know it or not." |Mom'll have a few choice words for me keeping all kinds of ungodly hours if I go out onto the town right now — another reason I should be moving out, but there's a time and place for everything. I need to wake up on time in the morning to help prepare breakfast for everyone, after all — there's a lot of responsibility in being the most gifted at transmutation amongst all your sisters. When swapping around dick inches and ball size comes to you as easily as breathing, turning leaves into a ten-course meal is child's play." ] All right, then. You'll ask again at a better time. Meira gives you an apologetic smile and does her best to appear nonplussed and appropriately impish. "There are still things I could do for you, [pc.name], things that don't involve leaving the house at this hour. Maybe you would want to avail yourself of them as a way for me to make it up to you?"

rows.original:
Well, I won't say no to more chances to explore the world beyond this little forest. I'm doing it on my own, of course, but it's nice to have someone who knows the territory to cut the chaff and show you the important sights, as opposed to you wandering around aimlessly and hoping to come across something important or relevant."

    Now, now. At this point, are the dates really an excuse to scout for future locations to set up shop, or is it the other way around?
    
    "As the old saying goes, why not both? Why do you think Mom had me traipsing about the forest swapping around inches of cock and balls? If you enjoy your work, you'll never work a day in your life."
    
    You smile and muss Meira's hair, and she huffs in a mixture of indignance and pride. All right, then, you'll pick the location?
    [evergreen.dealtWith|Senja|Mom] catches us and decides to make me stay and wash the dishes or something!"
rows.translation:
嗯，对于更多探索这片小森林之外世界的机会，我当然不会拒绝。当然，这些探索都是我独自进行的，但如果有一个人熟悉这片地区，能够为我指明方向、介绍重要的景点，那就再好不过了。这样我就不用漫无目的地四处游荡，而是能更有针对性地寻找有价值的东西了。现在，现在。在这个阶段，这些日期真的是为了寻找未来的经营地点而设定的借口，还是反过来呢？

    “正如那句老话所说，为什么不两者兼而有之呢？你觉得妈妈为什么让我在森林里跑来跑去，不断地更换那些阴茎和睾丸的尺寸呢？ 如果你喜欢自己的工作，那么你这辈子就永远不会有一天是真正在工作。”

你微笑着揉了揉梅拉的头发，而她则带着既愤慨又自豪的情绪哼了一声。好吧，那么由你来选择地点吧？

rows.original: How about heading down to the Wayfort? It fits the bill of what she needs, but also is but a stone's throw from the Evergreen manor. That means she can stay out just a bit longer before having to head home... Meira laughs. "I like the way you think, [pc.name]. Lead the way, then." And so you do, with Meira attaching herself to your arm as you leave the manor and start down the forest path heading south. The both of you make idle talk on the way, and soon enough the roar of the River Ridell draws close, followed by the trees parting and the Wayfort rolling right up. [wayfort.renovated |"It's quite something you've done with the Wayfort," Meira says as you reach the riverbank. "I remember seeing it from across the river ever since I was much younger — I thought it was going to remain a ruin for the rest of my life, given that it'd been that way for as long as I can remember. It must've lain like that for decades, centuries, and then you come along and fix it right up in the blink of an eye. I don't even recognize it anymore, so good job on that." Well, you may have organized the people and provided some of the funding, but it wasn't just you who went and restored the Wayfort alone. Plenty of people were involved, too, and without them this wouldn't have been possible either. "Yeah. Well, you should be proud that you've got a pretty nice place, nice enough that an Evergreen is considering setting up shop here, even if it isn't the Evergreen. That should be good enough for anyone!" That's quite the compliment, coming from her. Meira chuckles. "Well... maybe I'm just buttering you up so you'll let me stay if it comes to that. Or maybe if I flatter you enough, you won't make me pay for my share of this date..." |"To be completely honest, I thought that old Wayfort was going to remain a ruin for the rest of my life, given that it'd been that way for as long as I can remember. Then again, these old ruins are perfectly serviceable homes for plenty of people in these parts. You ought to have seen the kinds of squatters I'd find in the elven ruins that dot the northern forest." She doesn't have to mince her words about it, either — the Wayfort still is something of a ruin. Meira shrugs. "It's more than most. Certainly enough for me to consider it a candidate for moving in someday, so it's not that bad..." ] As you step in from the Wayforth's northern entrance, [daliza.around |several of Daliza's subordinates pause what they're doing to salute you. Daliza herself half-turns to you, one finger raised, then tuts and shakes her head when she catches sight of Meira at your side. "Oh. You. I thought I'd never have to see you ever again after Alissa stopped the outrider patrols into the southern woods, but here we are. And you haven't aged so much as a day since I last laid eyes on you. I'd ask how you do it, but given whose daughter you are I know better." She folds her arms and stares Meira down. "I'm sure that you'll make no trouble given that [pc.mf |Lord [pc.name] himself |Lady [pc.name] herself ] is bringing you into the Wayfort, right?" Meira just blows Daliza a raspberry. Well, it looks like the both of them are acquainted with each other, which saves you the trouble of introductions. As for Meira's behavior... you'll keep an eye on her. "I don't know why you're bringing one of the witch's more mischievous daughters into the Wayfort, [pc.mf |sir |ma'am ], but I truly hope I never have to find out. If anything else, she can't be worse than some of the people who outright live here." Daliza sighs and waves the both of you on. "Welcome home, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]." Once the elves are behind you, Meira elbows you lightly. "Coming up in the world, huh? I thought it had to be the case, given that you own the fort, but seeing that bitch have to suck up to you made my day." Hey, you can't say that you didn't earn it. "You'll have to tell me that story sometime, then. Most of the self-styled adventurers who pass through the mansion don't ever amount to anything." All in good time. But the both of them know each other? "I maaaay have taken several inches of dick off the forest outriders in the past." She shrugs. "Hey, they wagered and lost. I won completely fair and square." Yeah, that'd do it. Somehow, you don't think the outriders' consent meant anything to Daliza, but that's all in the past. She'll be behaving herself while in your home, yes? |several passers-by stop to take in your arrival, but if the de facto [pc.mf |lord |lady ] of the fort passing by is anything notable, people don't seem to take it to heart. "I kind of like it," Meira says, looking around her. "You own this place, and yet people are plenty relaxed around you. That's a good start." Oh, so she's saying that she'd like to put down roots already? "There's no need to be hasty! But... yes, it's a point towards things that no one actually feels like bowing or scraping to you. Makes it feel like you're building something from scratch, even if you're living in a place that someone else built." Meira thinks a little, then smiles apologetically. "Sorry if that hit a little too close to home." No, you get what she's saying. Everything you have here, you and the people who helped you earned, instead of being given it in name only by some bigwig and being expected to fix the place up. Given the entire bent of Meira's reason for being here, you figure she'd like it. Meira sniggers and elbows you lightly. "Coming up in the world, huh? Of all the people to restore this dump, I wouldn't have figured you'd be the one to do the job, but I'm pleasantly wrong this time." Hey, you can't say that you didn't earn it. ] "Yeah! So, um, like, can you show me around? I don't mean as in the public places, but like, the nice bits that're off-limits to the riff-raff." As you understand it, the entire pretext of this date was to let her look for prospective places to settle. Is she so sure she deserves a nice spot in your keep right from the outset? Meira does her best Senja impression, all innocence and baby-doll eyes. "We-ll... we're friends, aren't we? It's not like I'm asking you to make any promises right now, and besides, you get to show off your stuff!" There is that, you suppose. [pc.dcb |What's the point of having all this stuff if there's no one to fawn over it appropriately and be overawed by your magnificence? |You wouldn't call it showing off, but private collections should be perused from time to time instead of simply gathering dust, given that their whole point is to look nice. |Like, she totally has a point in that someone should really take the time to see what you've done with the interior decor! ] "Well then, let's take a gander, shall we?" Meira [wayfort.hasMaids |blows a kiss to a couple of your maids who're bowing to you, sending the duo scampering off in a fit of giggles |ruffles her skirts in an appropriately smug fashion and nuzzles herself against your side ]. "The people I've seen so far are okay, but I'd really like the opportunity to soak in the atmosphere! Let's be about it!" Pushy, pushy...
rows.translation: 去荒废驿堡怎么样？那里正好符合她的需求，而且距离常青女士庄园也只有一步之遥。这样她就可以多待一会儿再回家了…… 梅拉笑了：“我喜欢你的这种思维方式。 [pc.name]那你就带路吧。” 于是你便带着梅拉离开了庄园，沿着通往南方的森林小路开始前行。一路上你们闲聊着，不久之后，里德尔河的咆哮声便越来越近了，紧接着，树木也分开了，荒废驿堡庄园就出现在了眼前。 [wayfort.renovated |你对荒废驿堡遗址所做的这些确实令人赞叹，”当你来到河岸边时，梅拉说道。“我记得自己还很小的时候，就从河对岸看到过它——当时我就想，既然它已经变成这样的废墟那么久了，那它应该会永远保持这种状态吧。 它肯定已经那样摆放了几十年、几个世纪了，而你却在一瞬间就把它修复好了。我现在甚至都认不出它来了，真是干得太棒了。 嗯，虽然是你组织了相关人员并提供了部分资金，但真正负责修复荒废驿堡的人并不只是你一个人。 也有很多人参与了进来，如果没有他们，这一切也是不可能实现的。 “是啊。不过，你应该为自己拥有这样一个这么好的地方而感到骄傲——好到连‘常青女士集团’都考虑在这里设立分支机构呢，尽管他们最终并没有这么做。 那个 常青女士。这对任何人来说都应该足够好了吧！” 这样的赞美，竟然出自她之口…… 梅拉轻笑了一声：“嗯……也许我只是想讨好你，这样如果真到了需要我留下来的时候，你才会同意让我留下。又或者，如果我恭维你得够厉害，你就不会让我为这次约会支付我的那份费用了…… |说实话，我原本以为那座古老的荒废驿堡会永远成为一片废墟，因为从我记事起，它就是那样的。不过，对于这些地区的许多人来说，这些古老的废墟其实完全可以作为居住场所使用。 你真该看看我在北方森林里那些精灵遗迹里发现的那些占便宜的人。” 她其实也没必要拐弯抹角——荒废驿堡现在毕竟也差不多算是一片废墟了。 梅拉耸了耸肩：“这个地方比大多数地方都要好。至少对我来说，它已经足够让我考虑有朝一日搬进去住，所以其实也没那么糟糕…… ] 当你从韦弗思北侧入口走进来时， [daliza.around |达丽莎的几名下属都暂停了手头的工作，向你行礼。达丽莎本人也转过身来，举起一根手指向你致意，但当她看到你身边有梅拉时，她发出“啧”的一声，摇了摇头。 “哦。是你啊。 在艾丽莎阻止了那些前往南部森林的巡逻队之后，我原以为再也不会见到你了，但没想到我们还是在这里重逢了。而且，自从我上次见到你以来，你似乎一点都没有变老。我本来想问你是怎么做到的，但考虑到你是谁的女儿，我就不再追问了。她双臂交叉，直视着梅拉说道：“我相信，既然如此，你肯定不会惹麻烦的。 [pc.mf |大人 [pc.name] 他自己 |女士 [pc.name] 她自己 ] 这是要带你去荒废驿堡，对吧？” 梅拉直接对达丽莎吐了口唾沫。 看来她们俩互相认识，这样就省去了介绍的麻烦了。至于梅拉的行为……你得好好留意她。 “我不明白为什么你要把那个巫女最调皮的女儿带到荒废驿堡去 [pc.mf |先生 |女士 ]但我真心希望永远不必知道真相。至少，她总不会比那些真正住在这里的人更糟糕吧。”达丽莎叹了口气，然后招呼着你们俩说：“欢迎回家，孩子们。[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]当精灵们都站在你身后时，梅拉轻轻用肘子碰了碰你：“看来你是越来越有地位了啊？既然你拥有那座堡垒，我就觉得肯定会是这样，不过看到那个贱人不得不对你阿谀奉承，真是让我开心极了。嘿，你总不能说这是你白赚来的吧。” “那你总得有天把这件事讲给我听。那些自称冒险家的家伙，大多数经过这座宅邸后，最终都什么成就也没有。一切都会在适当的时候发生。不过他们俩之前应该已经认识了吧？” “嗯，也许我以前从那些森林里的冒险者那里‘赢’来过一些东西吧。”她耸了耸肩，“嘿，他们是打赌输掉了，而我完全是公平竞争赢来的。嗯，那样就可以了。不知为什么，你似乎认为那些外围人物的同意对达丽莎来说根本没有任何意义，但这一切都已经过去了。她在你家里的时候肯定会守规矩的，对吧？ |几位路人都停下来观察你的到来，但实际情况却是 [pc.mf |领主 |女士 ] 经过的那座堡垒并没有什么特别之处，人们似乎并没有太在意它。 “我还挺喜欢这里的，”梅拉环顾四周说道，“你拥有这个地方，但人们在你身边依然能够放松下来。这已经是一个很好的开始了。哦，所以她是想说她已经想要安定下来生活了？ “没必要急着做决定！不过……没错，这确实表明了她并不愿意为了讨好你而委屈自己。 这会让人觉得自己仿佛是在从零开始创造某些东西，即使实际上你生活在一个别人早已建造好的环境中。”梅拉思考了一会儿，然后带着歉意笑了笑：“如果我的话让你感到有些不适，实在抱歉。 不，你明白她的意思。你在这里拥有的一切，都是你和那些帮助你的人通过努力赚来的，而不是别人赐予你的。 鉴于 只是有某个大人物名义上支持了这个项目，人们也期望你能把这个地方整顿好。考虑到梅拉来到这里的真正目的，你应该会乐意接受这个任务的。 梅拉轻声笑了起来，然后用肘子轻轻碰了碰你：“想出人头地，是吧？在所有应该来整顿这个破地方的人当中，我真没想到会是你来干这个活，不过这次我倒是猜对了。” 嘿，你总不能说这是你应得的吧。 ] 对！所以，嗯，你能带我四处看看吗？我不是指那些公共场所，而是那些普通人都无法进入的、比较不错的地方。” 你应该明白，这次约会的真正目的就是让她寻找适合定居的地方。 她真的这么确信自己从一开始就值得在你身边获得一个好的位置吗？ 梅拉尽力模仿塞尼亚的样子，表现得天真无邪，眼神也像小孩子一样无辜。“我们……我们是朋友吧？我又没有要求你现在做出任何承诺，而且，这样你也可以展示自己的能力了！在那里 是 你是这么认为的吧。 [pc.dcb |拥有这一切究竟有什么意义呢？ 东西 如果没有人能够恰到好处地赞美它，没有人能够为你的伟大而感到敬畏呢？ |你或许不会称之为炫耀，但私人收藏品毕竟存在的意义就是让人赏心悦目，因此应该定期拿出来欣赏，而不是让它们被尘土覆盖。 |她的观点确实很有道理。 有人 真的应该花些时间去看看你把室内装饰布置得怎么样了！ ] 那么，我们就去看看吧，怎么样？”梅拉 [wayfort.hasMaids |你向那两个向你鞠躬的女仆们飞了一个吻，结果她们笑着跑开了。 |她得意地撩动着自己的裙摆，然后依偎在你的身旁。 ]到目前为止，我遇到的那些人都还不错，但我真的很希望能有机会彻底融入这种氛围中！那就这么定了吧！” 真是个固执的人……

Being a slum rat was never the easiest life, and to hear her brush it off like that... "Well, I didn't mean to. I just — I" Meira tries to find a way out of this faux pas that doesn't involve her capitulating, and gives up. "Sorry." |That she's in a position to be able to make this decision in the first place says that she has things to give up, and doubting one's importance in the scheme of things... yeah. "Hey, you put it in words better than I could!" Meira pipes up, her expression brightening. "Yeah, that's exactly how it is!" You may not have come from the wealthiest of backgrounds, to be true, but after arriving in the Marches and embarking on this crazy little adventure you can say your priorities have shifted a little. A chuckle as Meira elbows you. "I guess that's one way to put it!" ] |She says that one of the reasons she wants to get out from under her [evergreen.dealtWith |sister's |mother's ] roof is because of all her sisters, right? Meira gives you a weak grin. "It can get a bit overwhelming, yes. I guess I never had the opportunity to get used to it, given that I was out of the house most of the time until really recently... [evergreen.dealtWith |even if Mom isn't around any more to make more of them, having two dozen relatives running around under the same roof really drives home the point, and that's when they're not all trying to get your attention as one of the few people with the brains to get anything done...phew." That's not to mention that Senja will eventually be looking to make some of her own, though probably at a considerably slower rate than Oxana was. "Yes. There's... that. To her credit, she wants most of our sisters out of the house before she really gets into making me a whole bunch of nieces, though. |having two dozen relatives running around under the same roof really drives home the point, especially when Mom's always eager to make more with anyone who's willing. Even if Mom does most of the minding, especially when it comes to the full 'nukis amongst my sisters, the constant clamoring for attention... phew. ]" That's a reasonable stance to take, but has she considered that no matter where she ends up, if she's going to move to anywhere populated like your Wayfort or Hawkethorne there're going to be much, much more than two dozen people all crammed in a relatively small space, day in, day out? It's not going to be less crowded, it's going to be more. Meira sips her drink as she mulls that over. "That is true. Physically, anyway. But it's not that way up in my head — all the people that we passed by on the way in?[daliza.around | The elves garrisoned here? ][wayfort.hasMaids | The maids you have cleaning up the place? ] Everyone else sitting around in this bar? They don't register in my mind the same way that my sisters do, I'm not expected to care for, care about them. For all the people who're here... they may as well be faceless, nameless. Functionally speaking, there're actually less people in your Wayfort than back home at the manor." "That..." "I guess I'm not making very much sense, am I?" Meira gives you an apologetic smile. "I must sound silly, contradicting myself with each and every word I say." [pc.bg slumrat |Actually, no, you know exactly what she means. Sure, there're a lot more people in a city than there are in a place like Hawkethorne, but if you were still in the business of your old life, disappearing in Hawkethorne would be far more difficult than disappearing in, say, one of the major Belharan city-states down south, or even somewhere like Tychris. After a certain point, people just become a crowd, and hiding in one is far, far easier. You've done it a fair few times, after all[silly | — everyone knows that once you surround yourself with four or more people, you're as good as invisible to anyone looking for you ]. "I-I'm surprised you actually get it." Just a fact of life as a guttersnipe. By necessity, you didn't see most people as people — there were dangers, marks, and a good chunk of the rest were simply meat, warm bodies. For all the people crammed into so tight a space, a low existence in a city meant all of them were abstracted away; there was no better place to simply be alone than in a border village like Hawkethorne with only a couple hundred of people living there. Meira frowns and purses her lips at your words. "When you put it that way... well, you're not wrong." [pc.isDK |That's just the truth of it, as unsavory as it is. And honestly? You'd rather not having to keep up appearances of caring for everyone on the street, instead of being in Meira's shoes of having to keep two dozen sisters in mind all the time. |Harsh as they may be, seeing the city from the bottom-up taught you some truths. Thoroughly unpalatable ones to most people, to be sure, but... ] |No, you kind of understand what she means. Even with a village like Hawkethorne, learning everyone's names and faces would be too much for one person to handle — you know Garth and his family, you know the people whom you have relations with, but everyone else just kind of fades into the background. [pc.bg barbarian hunter arcanist | |You've been to a few cities in your time, and disappearing in a small village or even Hawkethorne would be far more difficult than doing so in one of the Belharan city-states down south or even just Tychris. ] After a while, people just become a crowd, and unless one devotes an inordinate amount of effort to making it otherwise it's just hard to care. Meira's eyes light up. "Yes! Yes, that's it!" Good to see that you understand her, at least. ] "I just need a little space between me and my sisters, to be honest," Meira sighs, settling back with drink in hand. "Mom's busywork never let me have a chance to actually get used to the constant bustle, and I'm actually glad for that. The constant whining, demanding, infantile behavior...[evergreen.dealtWith | and worst of all, knowing that they're that way because Mom made them so, ] it's just... tiring. I don't want to feel like I'm dumping it all on Senja's shoulders and running away, but at the same time this can't go on for too much longer. I can help my more impressionable sisters get a good home... from an arm's length away." You see. |"Do you like my dress? I went and made it myself." It's very flashy and in some circles might even be considered fashionable. Not the kind of thing you'd expect someone to be frolicking in the woods to be wearing, though — you should've been more surprised at that. This kind of stuff's made for twirling about in, not traipsing through mud and leaves. "Well, with your help, I plan to put that at an end! Maybe get some eyes on me, eyes who'll appreciate someone who puts in the effort to look good! It's very Borderland Marches style, just with a bit of white and not too old-fashioned. It's best paired with dark and gloomy, like how Mom [evergreen.dealtWith |used to keep |keeps ] the manor, but the white helps me fit in even in good lighting where all black and red would just be awful." She's put a lot of thought into her outfit, hasn't she? Meira gives you a thin smile. "You don't think Senja puts on all that makeup until she's practically got a mask about her eyes just because she likes looking that way, do you?" Actually, yes. "I... actually..." Meira sets down her mug and rubs her chin. "That's a thought." She just never considered it? Well, if she's going to be heading out of the forest and into somewhere more populated, then at least her dress will be more appropriate. Right, because a surprising number of people — "Half of my wardrobe is this exact dress, and the other half is identical nightgowns for sleeping. "I've got to stay in both style and character, you know. That's a fine line to tread." ]
rows.translation: 片刻之后，你便坐在了鲁米安排的桌位上。这位热情的女服务生不仅为你免费提供了几杯饮料，还承诺还会再给你带来更多——“毕竟，对于这么一位优雅的年轻女士来说，这是理所应当的。”而当梅拉对这样的赞美和免费酒水感到欣喜若狂时，你却有机会看到她装出一副傲慢不屑的样子，而鲁米显然非常欣赏这种表现。 要不是有你在身边，她肯定会直接欺负那个可怜人的…… 不管怎样，她这次旅行到现在感觉怎么样？ 梅拉喝了一口杯子里的东西，然后陷入了思考。 "[wayfort.renovated |我必须说，所有的这些步行都是值得的。了解到这个地方过去的样子，然后现在看到它现在的样子——这种变化对于那些想要自己努力取得成就、而不是依赖母亲给予一切的人来说，确实充满了鼓舞意义。所以，没错，我想你可以说，我玩得很开心。 |真是很有意思。我去了森雅有时候会去的那个村子，当时就在想：“人们怎么能够忍受住在这样的破地方里呢？”嗯，现在我终于明白了。 仍然 虽然还不完全明白，但我觉得自己已经离弄清楚真相更近了一步。对于那些生活在废墟中的人们来说，你们做得相当不错了——至少比那些仍居住在他们曾经拥有的一切残余之中、过着原始生活的德鲁伊们要好得多。 ][daliza.around | 另外，能够四处走动，同时知道你那个可爱的小精灵因为我自己被允许来到这里而气得直冒烟，这种感觉真是太棒了。这种人实在太容易成为别人嘲笑的对象了，这种诱惑简直让人难以抵抗。” 嘿，如果她真的决定搬过来住，你敢肯定，她的存在肯定会不断惹恼你那个循规蹈矩的管家，更何况她还会和其他一些名声不太好的居民一起共享这个家。 |嗯，她的赞美确实让我感到非常荣幸。 ] 梅拉微微一笑：“很高兴能帮上忙。” 那么，她为什么不介绍一下自己呢？ [pc.bgMulti minstrel courtesan noblescion |回想起来，要想让观众愿意接受你的内容，最简单的方法就是了解他们的兴趣所在，然后围绕这些兴趣来进行创作。所以，关键就在于这一点吧。 是 米拉对什么感兴趣？ |你回想起自己曾经是如何说服那些害羞的客户敞开心扉的——通常，人们都非常乐意滔滔不绝地谈论自己。他们希望自己能够感受到自己很重要，希望在某种程度上能够发挥作用，而有一个愿意倾听的人，甚至愿意关注他们生活中那些最琐碎、最平常的事情，这对他们来说意义重大。 |所有那些社交活动以及那些无聊的闲聊——但至少你明白了，无论地位高低，每个人都喜欢谈论自己，尤其是当他们感受到别人是真心关心他们的时候。无论是最高贵的贵族还是最卑微的仆从，每个人都希望别人能认为他们 重要的事情而善于倾听，哪怕是那些最琐碎、最平淡无奇的事情，也同样有助于实现这一目标。 |这确实是一种能让人们敞开心扉的好方法——这种方式体现了人们的重要性，表明他们足够值得他人关注。这样的做法应该会吸引梅拉的注意，不是吗？ ] 你 — 嗯，在荒废驿堡，每个人要么对你有所了解，要么都在猜测你的情况。但梅拉呢？她又知道些什么呢？ 她一个充满神秘色彩的狸猫？ “那你就尽管问吧。我们就当你在试探我，看我是否适合留在你的小堡垒里吧。这样不是很有趣吗？我感觉自己就像被推上了舞台一样。 [rand |那么，她有没有考虑过将来应该从事什么职业呢？虽然为人们处理那些“私密部位”的问题确实很受欢迎，但如果她不想像某些人那样完全与世隔绝的话，这种工作最好还是作为副业来做，而不是主业。 [evergreen.dealtWith |姐姐 |母亲 ] 我可没那个兴趣。” 梅拉听到这话，轻笑出声，有些饮料溅到了桌子上。“嗯……要是我说，其实我对摆弄别人的私处根本不感兴趣，你们会相信我吗？” 不过，她做起来还挺熟练的。几乎和她妈妈一样在行。 [evergreen.dealtWith |过去常常做 |做 ]嗯，没错，这确实是一种很好的做法。将人们的身体进行转化——用母亲的话来说，就是将活生生的肉体进行改变——可以说是所有转化方式中最困难的一种了，而且出现问题的可能性也很多。 如果你能把这件事做得这么好，那么几乎什么事情你都能做到。我真正想成为的，就是一位‘魔法厨师’。” |现在既然Senja代替妈妈负责安排用餐时间，这个任务就落到了我的身上——其实她以前也没怎么做过这个工作，因为那时她总是把所有时间都花在她的小店铺生意上。不过，我觉得如果不用一直纠正姐妹们犯下的错误，避免有人食物中毒或遇到更糟糕的情况，我应该能够把这项工作做得更好。 ]我……嗯，仔细想想，普通的厨师总是受到手头食材、可用工具以及烹饪流程的限制。而我呢，唯一的限制就是我的想象力；要想做出一顿精美的饭菜，我所需要准备的其实非常简单。想象一下，我能够收取多高的利润吧！” 嗯，人们对于食用这种经过转化处理的食物确实存在一些顾虑，但如果时间证明她的餐厅既安全又美味的话…… [pc.isMage |你 做 在几乎所有东西中都加入那么一点点“杂质”，才能让它们变得可口：边缘稍微烤焦一点，带一点筋膜，叶子有点发黄，或者烹饪得稍微不够熟，再加点盐…… 嗯，你还没有机会在常青女士餐厅吃晚餐吧，不过 [pc.isBimbo |比如说，你完全可以说，这个世界将会 超级的 如果每个人身上都没有那么一点点调皮捣蛋的成分，那就太无趣了。 |可以说，如果不是这样的话，这个世界将会变得相当无聊。 Even if Mom does most of the minding, especially when it comes to the full 'nukis amongst my sisters, the constant clamoring for attention... phew. ]" That's a reasonable stance to take, but has she considered that no matter where she ends up, if she's going to move to anywhere populated like your Wayfort or Hawkethorne there're going to be much, much more than two dozen people all crammed in a relatively small space, day in, day out? It's not going to be less crowded, it's going to be more. Meira sips her drink as she mulls that over. "That is true. Physically, anyway. But it's not that way up in my head — all the people that we passed by on the way in?[daliza.around | The elves garrisoned here? ][wayfort.hasMaids | The maids you have cleaning up the place? ] Everyone else sitting around in this bar? They don't register in my mind the same way that my sisters do, I'm not expected to care for, care about them. For all the people who're here... they may as well be faceless, nameless. Functionally speaking, there're actually less people in your Wayfort than back home at the manor." "That..." "I guess I'm not making very much sense, am I?" Meira gives you an apologetic smile. "I must sound silly, contradicting myself with each and every word I say." [pc.bg slumrat |Actually, no, you know exactly what she means. Sure, there're a lot more people in a city than there are in a place like Hawkethorne, but if you were still in the business of your old life, disappearing in Hawkethorne would be far more difficult than disappearing in, say, one of the major Belharan city-states down south, or even somewhere like Tychris. After a certain point, people just become a crowd, and hiding in one is far, far easier. You've done it a fair few times, after all[silly | — everyone knows that once you surround yourself with four or more people, you're as good as invisible to anyone looking for you ]. "I-I'm surprised you actually get it." Just a fact of life as a guttersnipe. By necessity, you didn't see most people as people — there were dangers, marks, and a good chunk of the rest were simply meat, warm bodies. For all the people crammed into so tight a space, a low existence in a city meant all of them were abstracted away; there was no better place to simply be alone than in a border village like Hawkethorne with only a couple hundred of people living there. Meira frowns and purses her lips at your words. "When you put it that way... well, you're not wrong." [pc.isDK |That's just the truth of it, as unsavory as it is. And honestly? You'd rather not having to keep up appearances of caring for everyone on the street, instead of being in Meira's shoes of having to keep two dozen sisters in mind all the time. |Harsh as they may be, seeing the city from the bottom-up taught you some truths. Thoroughly unpalatable ones to most people, to be sure, but... ] |No, you kind of understand what she means. Even with a village like Hawkethorne, learning everyone's names and faces would be too much for one person to handle — you know Garth and his family, you know the people whom you have relations with, but everyone else just kind of fades into the background. [pc.bg barbarian hunter arcanist | |You've been to a few cities in your time, and disappearing in a small village or even Hawkethorne would be far more difficult than doing so in one of the Belharan city-states down south or even just Tychris. ] After a while, people just become a crowd, and unless one devotes an inordinate amount of effort to making it otherwise it's just hard to care. Meira's eyes light up. "Yes! Yes, that's it!" Good to see that you understand her, at least. ] "I just need a little space between me and my sisters, to be honest," Meira sighs, settling back with drink in hand. "Mom's busywork never let me have a chance to actually get used to the constant bustle, and I'm actually glad for that. The constant whining, demanding, infantile behavior...[evergreen.dealtWith | and worst of all, knowing that they're that way because Mom made them so, ] it's just... tiring. I don't want to feel like I'm dumping it all on Senja's shoulders and running away, but at the same time this can't go on for too much longer. I can help my more impressionable sisters get a good home... from an arm's length away." You see. |"Do you like my dress? I went and made it myself." It's very flashy and in some circles might even be considered fashionable. Not the kind of thing you'd expect someone to be frolicking in the woods to be wearing, though — you should've been more surprised at that. This kind of stuff's made for twirling about in, not traipsing through mud and leaves. "Well, with your help, I plan to put that at an end! Maybe get some eyes on me, eyes who'll appreciate someone who puts in the effort to look good! It's very Borderland Marches style, just with a bit of white and not too old-fashioned. It's best paired with dark and gloomy, like how Mom [evergreen.dealtWith |used to keep |keeps ] the manor, but the white helps me fit in even in good lighting where all black and red would just be awful." She's put a lot of thought into her outfit, hasn't she? Meira gives you a thin smile. "You don't think Senja puts on all that makeup until she's practically got a mask about her eyes just because she likes looking that way, do you?" Actually, yes. "I... actually..." Meira sets down her mug and rubs her chin. "That's a thought." She just never considered it? Well, if she's going to be heading out of the forest and into somewhere more populated, then at least her dress will be more appropriate. You don't see her changing her look anytime soon... come to think of it, there's something you need to ask her. "Yes?" Does she have an entire wardrobe of the same exact outfit? Like, a dozen of this exact dress down to the seams? "What? No! That's outrageous! To think I'd wear the same thing all the time, regardless of where I was, who I'm with or what I'm doing?" Right, because a surprising number of people — "Half of my wardrobe is this exact dress, and the other half is identical nightgowns for sleeping. Oh, I also have a couple of aprons for when I'm helping with preparing meals." ...Well, that's an improvement over some others. Meira gives you a wink. "I've got to stay in both style and character, you know. That's a fine line to tread." ]"

rows.original: Eventually, you drain your mugs, and Meira grins and claps her hands. "Well, if today wasn't just fine, [pc.name]. I've got to thank you again for showing me around your place. You hope she'll give some serious consideration to putting down roots in the Wayfort, given its advantageous location. "Mmmm..." Meira raises a finger to her lips. [daliza.around |"It might just be worth it to see the scowl on your sourpuss elf's face day in, day out. |"It is close enough that Senja can't just accuse me of tossing responsibility for our sisters onto her and running away." Is that Senja accusing her, or her own conscience speaking? "Hush, you. ]" Well, you're glad that someone as energetic as Meira had a bunch of fun just seeing the sights of your pad. Perhaps you should've taken the chance to introduce her to some of the people here, but you get the feeling that she was more interested in the infrastructure. "That, yes. Don't worry about introductions — I've discovered that stuff like that tends to fall into place once I've got the fundamentals down." If she says so. Walk her to her door? "Sure!" It's a short walk out of the bar, across the bridge and to Evergreen manor. As you return to the foyer, Meira clears her throat and raises a hand to her cheek. "So, yeah... I know that this was meant to be a date, and we haven't actually done any touchy-feely stuff like what someone might expect out of a date..." Showing her around was worth it. You get the feeling that Meira has her own style, anyway. "Yeah. I just don't want you to feel like you got shortchanged, or that I was using you or something. It's just that — well, Senja was always the one more for hugs and pets with lots of love, that kind of stuff." ...Goodness, if you just wanted to have sex with her you wouldn't have to take her out in the first place. What does she take you for? Meira's cheeks flush a little. "I didn't mean it that way! I just, well, hmph. Well then, it's good that you enjoyed showing off your place! I bet you got a lot out of it, too!" Before you can reply, Meira [pc.heightRange 72 |stands on tiptoe |swoops in ] to give you a quick kiss on the cheek, then runs off into the manor, her 'nuki tail swishing behind her. You consider calling after her, but shake your head and smile. She's going to have to be a bit less childish if she's going to be taking this whole moving out on her own thing seriously... but for now, it is quite endearing, isn't it?
rows.translation: 最终，你们把杯子里的酒都喝光了，梅拉笑着拍手部说道：“嗯，如果今天不是这么美好的一天的话 [pc.name]我真得再次感谢你带我参观你的家。 你希望她能认真考虑在荒废驿堡定居，毕竟那里的位置非常优越。 “嗯……”梅拉用手部指轻轻按住嘴唇。 [daliza.around |它 可能 仅仅为了每天都能看到你那个脾气坏的精灵脸上那副阴沉的表情，这一切也就值得了。 |它 是 距离已经近到足以让Senja无法指责我只是把照顾姐妹们的责任推给她然后逃之夭夭了。” 那么，这是Senja在指责她，还是她自己的良心在在提醒她呢？ “闭嘴吧。 ]嗯，你肯定很高兴像梅拉这样充满活力的人，仅仅是因为参观了你的住处就玩得这么开心。也许你当初应该机会把她介绍给这里的一些人认识，不过感觉她对这里的基础设施更感兴趣一些。 那个，嗯。别担心介绍的事情——我发现，只要把基础掌握了，这些细节通常都会自然而然地解决。” 如果她这么说的话，那就送她到门口吧？ “当然可以！ 从酒吧出来，穿过桥，就能到达常青女士庄园。当你回到门厅时，梅拉清了清嗓子，然后用手部捂住了脸颊。 “所以，嗯……我知道这本应该是一场约会，但实际上我们并没有做那些人们通常认为会在约会中发生的事情…… 带她四处逛确实值得。总之，你能感觉到梅拉有着自己独特的风格。 “是啊。我只是不想让你觉得被亏待了，或者觉得我在利用你之类的。只是……嗯，森雅一直都是那种喜欢拥抱、喜欢抚摸别人，充满爱心的人。 天啊，如果你只是想和她发生关系，一开始就根本不需要带她出去吧。她到底把你当成了什么人啊？” 梅拉的脸颊微微涨红了。“我并不是那个意思！我只是，嗯，哼。那好吧，很高兴你喜欢展示自己的家！我敢打赌，你肯定也从中得到了很多乐趣吧！ 在你能够回复之前，梅拉 [pc.heightRange 72 |踮起脚来 |突然出现 ] 她快速地在你的脸颊上亲了一下，然后跑进了庄园，她那条“小尾巴”在身后摇来摇去。你考虑着要不要叫她回来，但最终只是摇了摇头，笑了笑。如果她真的想认真对待这次独自搬出去住的事情，她还是得少一点孩子气才行……不过，现在看来，这也挺可爱的，不是吗？

rows.original: You have an idea — how about heading down to Hawkethorne and seeing what her sister sees in that place that she chooses to visit so often? "I don't need to figure that one out, because I already have. Senja really loves her —" Meira begins, then shuts up when she realizes what you're about. Hint, hint. "Oh, uh, well, I suppose," she replies with a smile, quickly changing tack and pretending that nothing had just happened. "It would be close enough that Senja could come see me whenever she dropped by, wouldn't it? I've had hopes of becoming a chef someday, since it wouldn't be that much different from what I'm doing at home right now, really... and while there's a tavern I don't think they're in the business of serving food food." Food food, eh? And how's that different from regular food? Meira claps her hands. "Oh, you'll see." You'll see indeed. Actually, if she wants someone who knows a thing or two about good food, Garth's just the person to ask. Why doesn't she ask him to weigh in on something that she can make? A raised eyebrow. "You think he'd agree?" Well, he owes you in some ways, and you owe him in some ways, but all in all you don't think he'd mind if you vouched for her. So long as she brings her own ingredients and doesn't make a mess of the Frost Hound's kitchen, you don't see why he should have any reason to refuse. "Oh, I can think of plenty," Meira snickers. "That being said, I don't need anything more than the simplest ingredients, and I know how annoying having to clean up can be. If you really think your friend would be willing to judge it professionally... well, it'll be interesting to hear the opinion of someone who isn't obligated to eat what I make. Certainly more interesting as a date than just walking up and down in search of knick-knacks like Senja does." She sounds confident in her skills. A huff. "Part of the point is that I can produce something exquisite from ingredients that people wouldn't even take a second look at, [pc.name]. How do you think [evergreen.dealtWith|my sisters|Mom and my sisters] all stay so plump?" Her hard work for which no one ever thanks her and everyone takes for granted? "Well, Senja and my hard work. Wouldn't be right for me to take all the credit. So, are we going to go or what?"
rows.translation: 你有个主意——何不去鹰棘镇看看，看看她的姐姐为什么那么频繁地去那个地方呢？ “这个我其实已经想明白了，因为Senja真的很喜欢那个地方……”Meira刚开口，就意识到你在暗示什么，于是立刻住了口。 提示一下吧…… “哦，嗯，好吧，我想也是吧……”她笑着回答，迅速改变了话题，装作什么都没发生一样。 会 距离足够近，所以Senja每次路过都可以来看我，对吧？我一直希望能有朝一日成为一名厨师，因为这其实和我现在在家里做的事情并没有太大区别……而且，虽然附近有一家酒馆，但我猜他们并不提供餐饮服务。 食物 食物。” “食物啊，嗯？它和普通的食物有什么不同呢？” 梅拉拍了拍手部：“哦，你等着瞧吧。” 你确实会看到的。其实，如果她想找一个对美食有所了解的人，加思正是合适的人选。 她为什么不让他对一些她自己能够决定的事情发表意见呢？ “挑了挑眉毛，说道：‘你觉得他会同意吗？’” 嗯，从某种程度上来说，他确实欠你人情，而你也欠他人情，但总的来说，你应该不认为他会介意你为她担保吧。 只要她自带食材，而且不会把霜犬酒馆的厨房弄得一团糟，我想他没有任何理由会拒绝吧。 “哦，我还能想出很多理由来呢，”梅拉嘲笑道，“不过说实话，我只需要最简单的食材而已，而且我也知道事后清理卫生有多麻烦。 如果你真的认为你的朋友会愿意专业地评价它……那么，听听一个没有义务吃我做的东西的人的意见，肯定会很有意思。比起像Senja那样东翻西找一些小玩意儿，这样的约会方式肯定更有趣得多。她听起来对自己的能力充满信心。 “哼，这也算是 要点 关键在于，我能够用那些人们根本不会多看一眼的材料，制作出一些精美的东西来。 [pc.name]你认为呢？ [evergreen.dealtWith|我的姐妹们|妈妈和我的姐妹们] 为什么大家都还能保持那么苗条呢？” 她那些无人感谢、反而被所有人视为理所当然的辛勤付出，又该如何呢？ “嗯， 塞尼亚 还有我的辛勤努力。如果我把所有的功劳都揽到自己身上，那就不对了。那么，我们到底去不去呢？

rows.original: It's a little while later that both of you are standing at the doorway to the Frost Hound — while Meira's taken a passing interest in the market while you plod down the streets of Hawkethorne, what she appears most interested in is the people. Several times, you have to elbow the mischievous little creature and remind her not to stare so openly, even if she's considering putting down her roots in the village. Wouldn't do to antagonize potential neighbors. Garth looks up blearily as you enter, setting down the mug he's polishing. "Oh, it's you, [pc.name]. Who — one of Evergreen's, huh? Haven't seen you before." She's Meira, and she's with you. "I can see that," Garth grunts. "She's going to be trouble, isn't she? I can tell just by that shit-eating grin on her face." Depends on his definition of trouble, but he's likely to be right. Say, the bar's looking pretty slow at this time of day — does he have a moment? A sigh. "What kind of trouble are the both of you going to get up in here, and does this mean you'll be breaking any of my beds? It's not that often that the witch's get drop by in town, but they're usually well-behaved while around other people. Can't say the same for this one." Actually, nothing of the sort. After buying a huffy Meira a drink to calm her down, you quickly explain to Garth Meira's aspirations of being a magical chef, and her experience in helping with her family's meals. The Marches may not be rich enough to warrant a local gourmet with refined tastes, but Garth knows something about whipping up a meal or two. Yes, you know he runs a tavern and not an establishment, but he's been doing this long enough that if anyone's going to be comparing Meira's methods to more conventional cooking, it's going to be him. "Hmm." Garth taps his muzzle thoughtfully — if nothing else, his eyes have lost their dull glaze as he turns his gaze between Meira and you. "She cooks for her family every day, does she?" "That's right," Meira replies, downing the last of her cheap drink. "For years now, and no one's complained or wound up sick, which is more than I can say for some of my sisters." "And you turn lesser ingredients into gourmet meals?" "Mom taught me how to do a few good ones, but then I cooked up — heh — the rest on my own from things I'd seen. I suppose it can be a bit weird because some of them I've only seen in Mom's books and never actually tasted for myself, but that's why [pc.name] brought me here to ask you to judge. Then again, no one's ever complained, like I said." Garth's gaze grows distant, the grizzled old wolf clearly reminiscing, then he nods slowly. "And this would be towards the ends of..." She's hoping to open some kind of establishment, or at least work for someone who does. Perhaps even here in Hawkethorne. There's a lot involved in having her own place, but getting the skill that she intends to peddle down pat is a strong start. "Can't argue with that. I've been to your mother's, so I know something of what you're talking about. You'll want to use my kitchen, I take it — did you bring your own ingredients?" "Actually, no," Meira replies. "I thought it over and figured I'd make more of a point using what scraps you've left over." Garth looks at you, clearly considering once more as to whether this is a good idea. You give him an encouraging nod, and he sighs. "All right, all right. So long as I don't have to eat it all. I also wouldn't mind seeing how the cake's made, to borrow the saying, and you don't mind if I invite someone else for the ride, do you?" If it'll reassure him that he won't keel over after eating Meira's cooking, sure. "Good." Setting down both mug and cloth, Garth roars over his shoulder at the back door. "Pup! Hey, pup! Watch the bar for a moment for me, will you? I've got some business in town... and get your sister to clean up the kitchen while I'm out. We'll need to be using it soon! "Well then, don't mind an old dog. I have someone in mind for taste-testing the kind of stuff that you want to make — I'll be back shortly."
rows.translation: 过了一会儿，你们俩站在了通往“霜猎犬”的门口——当时梅拉对市场产生了一丝兴趣，而你则漫步在鹰棘镇的街道上，她似乎更感兴趣的是那些人。 有几次，你不得不推搡那个调皮的小家伙，提醒她不要这么公然地盯着别人看，即使她看起来已经打算在村里安家落户了。惹恼潜在的邻居可不太好。 当你走进来时，加思眯着眼睛抬起头，放下了他正在擦拭的杯子。 哦，原来是你啊， [pc.name]你是谁……是常青女士组织的人吧？我以前没见过你。” 她叫梅拉，现在和你在一起。 “我看出来了，”加思低声说道，“她肯定会惹麻烦的，对吧？从她脸上那副得意的笑容就能看出来。 这得看他怎么定义“麻烦”了，但他的想法很可能是对的。比如说，这个时候酒吧里的人挺少的——他有空吗？ “唉……你们俩这次又要惹什么麻烦呢？难道还要弄坏我的床吗？女巫们平时很少会来到镇上，而且在其他人的面前通常也会表现得很有礼貌。不过这个女巫就不一定了。 其实并没有这样的事情。在给生气的梅拉买了一杯饮料让她冷静下来之后，你迅速向加思解释了梅拉想要成为一名魔法厨师的志向，以及她之前帮助家人准备饭菜的经验。虽然这些边远地区可能并不富裕，不足以培养出品味高雅的美食家，但加思在烹饪方面还是挺在行的。 没错，你知道他开的是一家酒馆，而不是什么高级餐厅，但他从事这个行业已经很久了。所以，如果有人想将梅拉的烹饪方法与更传统的烹饪方式进行比较的话，那个人肯定会是他。 嗯。”加思若有所思地轻敲着枪口——至少，他的眼神已经不再那么呆滞了，他的目光在梅拉和你之间来回移动。“她每天都会为家人做饭，对吧？” “是的，”梅拉回答道，喝完了杯中剩下的廉价饮料。“已经很多年了，而且从来没有人抱怨过，也没有人因此生病，这一点我可不敢说我那些姐妹们也能做到。 你能把普通的食材做出美味可口的菜肴来？” “妈妈教了我一些简单的做法，但之后我就开始自己尝试创新了——呵呵——都是根据自己看到的东西来摸索出来的。我想，这大概就是烹饪的乐趣所在吧。 可以 有点奇怪，因为其中一些食物我只在妈妈的书中见过，从来没有亲自尝过，但正因为如此 [pc.name] 所以我才来找你，请你帮忙做这个判断。不过，就像我说的，从来没有人抱怨过。” 加斯的目光变得恍惚起来，这只灰白的老狼显然在回忆着什么，然后他缓缓点了点头：“这件事应该发生在……的末期吧。” 她希望能够开一家自己的店，或者至少为拥有这样的店铺的人工作。也许就在鹰棘镇这里。要想拥有自己的事业，需要考虑很多因素，但首先掌握她打算用来创业的技能，确实是一个很好的开始。 这点确实无可争议。我曾经去过你妈妈家，所以对你说的这些还是有所了解的。我想你肯定会想用我的厨房吧——你带了自己的食材吗？” “其实没有，”梅拉回答道，“我仔细考虑过了，觉得利用你剩下的食材反而会更有意义。 加思看着你，显然又在考虑这是否真的是个好主意。你给了他一个鼓励的点头，他这才叹了口气。 “好吧，好吧。只要我不必把所有东西都吃掉就行。而且，借用一句俗话来说，我也挺想看看这个蛋糕是怎么做的。另外，你应该不介意我再邀请其他人一起走吧？ 如果这样能让他放心，相信他吃了梅拉做的饭之后肯定不会出什么事，那当然可以。 “好。”加斯放下杯子和布巾，回头对后门喊道：“小狗！喂，小狗！帮我看一会儿门，好吗？我得去镇上办点事……还有，让我出去的时候让你妹妹把厨房收拾干净，我们很快就要用它了！ 那么，就请放心吧。我已经有一个人选了，他会帮忙品尝你们想要制作的那类东西——我马上就回来。
rows.raw: " It's a little while later that both of you are standing at the doorway to the Frost Hound — while Meira's taken a passing interest in the market while you plod down the streets of Hawkethorne, what she appears most interested in is the people. Several times, you have to elbow the mischievous little creature and remind her not to stare so openly, even if she's considering putting down her roots in the village. Wouldn't do to antagonize potential neighbors. Garth looks up blearily as you enter, setting down the mug he's polishing. "Oh, it's you, [pc.name]. Who — one of Evergreen's, huh? Haven't seen you before." She's Meira, and she's with you. "I can see that," Garth grunts. "She's going to be trouble, isn't she? I can tell just by that shit-eating grin on her face." Depends on his definition of trouble, but he's likely to be right. Say, the bar's looking pretty slow at this time of day — does he have a moment? A sigh. "What kind of trouble are the both of you going to get up in here, and does this mean you'll be breaking any of my beds? It's not that often that the witch's get drop by in town, but they're usually well-behaved while around other people. Can't say the same for this one." Actually, nothing of the sort. After buying a huffy Meira a drink to calm her down, you quickly explain to Garth Meira's aspirations of being a magical chef, and her experience in helping with her family's meals. The Marches may not be rich enough to warrant a local gourmet with refined tastes, but Garth knows something about whipping up a meal or two. Yes, you know he runs a tavern and not an establishment, but he's been doing this long enough that if anyone's going to be comparing Meira's methods to more conventional cooking, it's going to be him. "Hmm." Garth taps his muzzle thoughtfully — if nothing else, his eyes have lost their dull glaze as he turns his gaze between Meira and you. "She cooks for her family every day, does she?" "That's right," Meira replies, downing the last of her cheap drink. "For years now, and no one's complained or wound up sick, which is more than I can say for some of my sisters." "And you turn lesser ingredients into gourmet meals?" "Mom taught me how to do a few good ones, but then I cooked up — heh — the rest on my own from things I'd seen. I suppose it can be a bit weird because some of them I've only seen in Mom's books and never actually tasted for myself, but that's why [pc.name] brought me here to ask you to judge. Then again, no one's ever complained, like I said." Garth's gaze grows distant, the grizzled old wolf clearly reminiscing, then he nods slowly. "And this would be towards the ends of..." She's hoping to open some kind of establishment, or at least work for someone who does. Perhaps even here in Hawkethorne. There's a lot involved in having her own place, but getting the skill that she intends to peddle down pat is a strong start. "Can't argue with that. I've been to your mother's, so I know something of what you're talking about. You'll want to use my kitchen, I take it — did you bring your own ingredients?" "Actually, no," Meira replies. "I thought it over and figured I'd make more of a point using what scraps you've left over." Garth looks at you, clearly considering once more as to whether this is a good idea. You give him an encouraging nod, and he sighs. "All right, all right. So long as I don't have to eat it all. I also wouldn't mind seeing how the cake's made, to borrow the saying, and you don't mind if I invite someone else for the ride, do you?" If it'll reassure him that he won't keel over after eating Meira's cooking, sure. "Good." Setting down both mug and cloth, Garth roars over his shoulder at the back door. "Pup! Hey, pup! Watch the bar for a moment for me, will you? I've got some business in town... and get your sister to clean up the kitchen while I'm out. We'll need to be using it soon! "Well then, don't mind an old dog. I have someone in mind for taste-testing the kind of stuff that you want to make — I'll be back shortly.""

rows.original: Garth is good to his word — you don't think fifteen minutes have passed before he's back through the door of the Frost Hound, a familiar antlered shape in tow. You shouldn't be surprised, given that Ivris is the local authority on all things magical, but to see the elf so outright enthusiastic about it all to the point where she's downright bubbly is a sight to see. "Heeey!" Noticing your gaze, Garth shrugs. "I was originally going to get Old Man Sanders, but Mistress Ivris overheard us and wouldn't let up with the idea after it'd gotten into her head. To be honest, she'd be the better judge of magical food than Sanders would be." "That, and a less-oft application of transmutation — I really couldn't pass up the chance once I heard what was going on!" Ivris chirps. "Most people associate it with transforming one's body, but even making a gourmet meal out of table scraps and kitchen refuse is even harder than that! Well, in some ways, in other's it's a whole lot easier! You don't encounter it a lot, if at all — it would invalidate a lot of agriculture and logistics even in the limited fashion which you intend to use it." Garth grimaces. "Please don't put it that way. We're going to have to eat it, you know." Well, another judge wouldn't be bad, especially one who's magically inclined, given that this is going to be magic food. "That, and Mistress Ivris' blindness has resulted in her other senses becoming much stronger to compensate. She'll be able to pick out details that even an old dog like me can't." "I just had to come after hearing who it was, too!" Ivris is so abuzz with energy that she's all but bouncing on the spot. "Your mother's quite the legend about these parts, and not just for transmutation, um... oh, I forgot to ask your name!" "Meira." "Yes, Miss Meira! Show us what you're capable of, okay?" "Kitchen's over there, girl. I'm heading in with you to make sure you don't make a mess of things." "I'm going to watch how the pudding's made!" Ivris says. "Well, not watch watch. But there are other ways to observe something that's going on, especially with the kind of magic our girl's going to be working!" "You okay with waiting out here, [pc.name], or you want to head in with us?" Garth jerks a thumb over his shoulder at the kitchen doorway. "Some people aren't interested in knowing how cooking's done, only in eating the results. After more than twenty years of doing it for me and the pups, can't blame them."
rows.translation: 加思确实说到做到了——你几乎感觉不到十五分钟的时间流逝，他就带着那个熟悉的、长着鹿角的生物重新回到了“霜犬酒馆”旅馆的门口。考虑到伊夫里斯是当地所有与魔法相关事务的权威人物，你本不应该感到惊讶，但看到这位精灵对这一切表现得如此热情高涨，甚至到了这种程度 活泼开朗的 真是一幅值得一看的景象。 “嘿！” 注意到你的目光，加斯耸了耸肩：“我本来打算买桑德斯老头的东西，但伊夫里斯小姐听到了我们的谈话，这个想法一旦在她脑子里扎根，她就再也不会放过了。 说实话，比起桑德斯，她才更适合评判那些具有魔力的食物。 另外，由于她使用变形术的频率较低，所以当我听说发生了这样的事情后，我真的无法错过这个机会！伊夫里斯发出鸣叫声。”大多数人认为这种能力是用来改变自己外形的，但实际上，用剩菜剩饭和厨房垃圾做出一顿美味佳肴，这个难度反而比改变外形还要高！不过，从某些角度来看，这也确实容易得多吧！ 你很少会遇到这种情况，甚至几乎不会遇到——因为即使按照你打算使用的那种有限的方式，这种情况也会使许多农业和物流活动变得无效。 加思皱起了眉头：“请别这么说吧。 我们总得吃掉它，你知道的。” “嗯，再找一个法官也不错，尤其是那些对魔法有一定了解的人，毕竟这毕竟是一种魔法食物。” “而且，伊夫里斯女士因为失明，她的其他感官反而变得异常敏锐，以此来弥补视力的缺失。 她甚至能够发现连我这样的老家伙都忽略的细节。” “我只是 曾经有过 等我知道是谁之后，我也一定要去拜访他！”伊夫里斯充满了活力，几乎在原地跳来跳去。“你母亲在这些地方可是出了名的，不仅仅是因为她的转化能力……哦，我忘了问你的名字呢！梅拉。” “是的，梅拉小姐！让我们看看你到底有什么本事吧，好吗？” “厨房在那边，姑娘。我会跟你一起进去，确保你不会把事情弄得一团糟。我要看看这布丁是怎么做的！”伊夫里斯说，“嗯，其实不用看了。 观看 看着吧。不过，观察正在发生的事情其实还有其他方法，尤其是对于我们女孩将要使用的那种魔法来说！” “你愿意在这里等着吗？ [pc.name]还是想和我们一起进去吗？”加思用拇指朝厨房的门方向一指。“有些人根本不想了解烹饪的过程，他们只关心最终的食物。毕竟，为我和我的孩子们做了二十多年的饭，我也不能责怪他们吧。
