rows.original: From out of nowhere three glinting blades strike down from the frozen boughs above, ripping through the foliage and icy wind. [party.Ya'll] jump back on a wave of adrenaline, dodging an attack that, upon rapid inspection, wasn't aimed for you at all. In the ground, three arrowhead-shaped knives are impaled to the hilt, their circular pommels vibrating from sheer force of impact. [party.CombatNames] strain your eyes to the [dayNight|sunlight|moonlight]-riddled overhangs in search of your hidden aggressor. Cracks of ice and frigid wood alert your [pc.ears] to shifting developments behind criss-crossed spears of deadly thickets. The faintest of grunts can be heard behind the thresh if you still your breathing. An ethereal giggle carves through the numbed air to tickle your chest with, triggering your natural fear of the unknown. Something is jumping around up there, bending like a reed through places small game could not. Distracting clamors assault you from every direction; brushing snow and shattering bramble are accompanied by the endless laughter of an unseen trickster. A shadow blacker than a starless night blurs past your vision almost too quick to see. It's amazing you even noticed it through sensory lassitude. A heavy landing alerts [party.som|you|you and your ally|you and your companions] to the presence of a born provocateur, whose every movement is as tailored as the flowing dress she wears. "I saw that!" her smooth voice passes through a masking veil. The covering hugs her jawline up to the lower lids of her eyes, both narrow and sharp — blue like strangled dreams. Wispy glows and azure flames hover around her head of black hair, illuminating the slender woman and her tall, fuzzy ears. "You were able to see me just then, did you not?" She doesn't wait for an answer, merely spreads into an attack stance. Only now do you see what she is behind the fancy clothing. One, two... five tails spread out behind her as if she were a flower in bloom, gloving her graceful form in an intricate, sight-swallowing web of fur. "Well well well," she softly chimes, "I finally have a target. Let us play together! I promise it'll be fun, no matter the outcome!" The kitsune levels her twin daggers, the blades consisting of a midnight-dark metal. You have to defend yourself!
rows.translation: 突然间，三把闪亮的刀刃从上方冰冻的树枝上飞射而下，划破了树叶和冰冷的空气。 [party.Ya'll] 你再次被肾上腺素的激增所驱使，迅速躲过了那次攻击——仔细观察后，你才发现那次攻击其实根本不是针对你的。地面上，三把箭头形状的刀深深地插在地面中，它们的圆形刀柄因为巨大的冲击力而不断震动。 [party.CombatNames] 费力地注视着 [dayNight|阳光|兼职工作]那些布满裂痕的悬垂物，正在暗中潜伏着，等待着露出你隐藏起来的攻击者……冰层上的裂缝，以及冰冷坚硬的木头，都在向你发出警告 [pc.ears] 在那些密布着致命荆棘的地带，一切都在不断变化。如果你屏住呼吸，就能听到那些荆棘背后传来的微弱声响。一阵清脆的笑声划破沉闷的空气，触碰到你的心弦，唤醒了你对于未知事物的恐惧。 某个东西 有东西在上面跳来跳去，它的身躯柔软得像芦苇，能够穿过那些小型猎物根本无法通过的狭窄空间。各种嘈杂的声音从四面八方袭来；扫落的积雪、折断的荆棘，伴随着那个看不见的捣蛋鬼无尽的笑声…… 一道比无星之夜还要暗影的影子，几乎快得让人无法看清，就从你的视线中掠过。在感官已经变得迟钝的情况下，你居然还能注意到它，实在令人惊讶。而它那重型的落地声，更是提醒着你它的存在 [party.som|你|你和你的盟友|你和你的同伴们] 在一个天生的挑衅者面前，她的每一个动作都像她身上那条流畅飘逸的裙子一样精心设计。 “我看到了！”她那柔和的声音仿佛透过了某种掩饰的面纱。那层面纱紧紧贴合着她的下颌线，一直延伸到她那狭长而锐利的双眼——那双眼睛如同被扼杀的梦境一般，呈现出湛蓝色的色彩。 淡蓝色的光芒与蔚蓝色的火焰在她那黑色的头发周围缭绕，照亮了这位身材纤细的女性以及她那高高的、毛茸茸的耳朵。“刚才你确实看到了我，对吧？” 她没有等待回答，而是立刻摆出了攻击的姿态。 直到现在你才明白。 什么 她穿着那些华丽的衣服。一、二…… 五 她的尾巴在身后摇曳，仿佛一朵盛开的鲜花，那复杂的、令人目不暇接的毛皮覆盖着她那优雅的身姿。“好了好了好了，”她轻声说道，“我终于有了一个目标。让我们一起玩吧！我保证一定会很有趣，无论结果如何！” 那只狐妖将她的双匕首调整到合适的位置，那些刀刃是由深沉如午夜的金属制成的。 你必须保护自己！

rows.original:
A sharp whistle shatters the frigid monotony, prompting [party.yall] to whip around. It's none other than Kura, the five-tailed kitsune who keeps watch on the Frostwood. "Greetings, [pc.name]," she politely introduces, approaching on a gentle wind. Her mask is already lowered. [rand|"Are you doing well [dayNight|today|tonight]?"|"How go your journeys?"|"Are you in good health?"]

    She stops within arm's reach, fingers knitting at her waist.
    
    [pc.dcb|"Kura," you mutter. "What does it look like?"|"All is well, Kura," you reply.|"Yep!" you exclaim.]
        
    [rand
    |"Good. Perhaps I could borrow some of your time?" she asks coyly, but coming from a kitsune that's a grim bit of humor. 
    
    "Aww! That's not what I meant, and you know better!" she cries, feigning offense. "Nonetheless," she focuses again, "You need only ask, [pc.name], and I will be glad to warm your side."
    
    |"I've grown attached to seeing you hale and hearty, [pc.name]," she says. "Perhaps I could improve your mood this [dayNight|day|evening]?" A curving finger strokes down her clothed bosom, hooking into the sash holding her elegant attire.
    
    Perhaps she could...
    
    |"I'm pleased to see you are yourself, [pc.name]." Her ears swivel. "I am intruding on your time, but I wish to make myself available for your use. Any way you see fit," she winks. "If, of course, you are willing to provide for me, too."
    
    You just might.
    ]

Kurako, or Kura, is a black-furred, five-tailed kitsune, and like all of her race she possesses the large, triangular ears of a fox. An obscene amount of inner fluff feathers out from the interiors, bristling in the boreal wind. Beneath the sharp fringe of her rich black hair is the immaculate, olive-skinned face of elegance and refinement often hidden behind the mask of a professional agent. Her nose is small, her cheeks are curved and devoid of excess fat, and her eyebrows are finely plucked. A tattoo resembling a flowing script is drawn under her right eye, practically substituting for it when she blinks. For a kitsune, Kura has a well-sculpted body. Long, toned arms and a lithe, agile figure lend the foxen kunoichi an attractive silhouette — even if you hadn't fought her, her appearance describes the nonpareil constitution of a life lived for strife. From neck to fingers and feet she wears a transparent bodysuit that wraps around her heels, leaving her toes exposed. Over the suit — and over her womanly features — she wears a lotus-colored tabard trimmed by dim gold and fancy embroidery indicating a modest place in the status quo. It's tied to her abdomen by a beautifully patterned scarlet sash. From bicep to knuckle and thigh to ankle she wears a pair of silk gloves and stockings that form the other half of the jointless gap between her waist and shoulders. rows.original: "[pc.dcb|What's your story?|So... who are you? Who is 'Kura'?|Since we're friends, tell me about yourself!]" Kura's steady breathing carries her up an inch and down another. She regards your question with confusion, bewilderment... it's like the inquiry has left her spellbound. You bend forward and snap your fingers which startles her. "Oh. Me?" she simpers. "I was gathering my thoughts, [pc.name]. It's not... well, I will be blunt. You are the first person to ever ask me that question. [pc.ra kitsune|I am deeply honored by your interest, my [pc.mf|lord|lady], but it certainly came as a surprise.|I was not expecting to be flattered by your interest in me, [pc.name], so it came as a surprise.] I'm afraid there is not much to tell, so I hope you will not be offended by a short story." Not much to tell? She is a kitsune, is she not? A long-lived race foreign to this continent. Surely she's lived a life that would stand out among what most Savarran cultures would consider interesting. A slight blush tints her light chocolate cheeks with a strawberry-pink shade. "You give me too much credit, but before we digress, I will start from the top." Inhaling through her nose, she swallows and halts the swaying of her tails and ears. "My name is, as you know, Kurako Tsukimi. In our language, names have other meanings, and..." she bites her lip. "I'm afraid it's..." Embarrassing? "Yes!- N-No!" she stammers, clearly flustered. Kura's putting thought to something she's taken for granted her entire life, and it's rather adorable in a way. "In your language it would loosely mean 'child of the moon.' Loosely," she repeats, clearly holding the rest back. What she gave you is fine enough considering her line of work, but... pressing her is more fun. "You left something out." "W-What? Oh, please! It's silly!" You fold your arms. "Dreaming child of the moon," she finishes, blushing. Both ears fold to her head. Was that so bad? She huffs, waiting a few seconds before continuing in her smooth tone. "I won't make any presumptions with how you view us[pc.ra kitsune|, especially considering that you've become one of us], but despite the artistic flair of my name I am still a commoner — a soldier in service." Whom was she born to, then? Surely she has a family somewhere. "Oh, my family has returned to Keros, along with my twin brother," she says flatly, not a hint of emotion in her speech. "As I understand it, the den, our home, has been standing for over two-hundred years. I am among the third generation of kitsune to have been born here, never to see our country. My mother and father were also soldiers, but not like me. Early in their lives, and in my grandparent's lives, they were devoted to the pursuit of knowledge and beauty. My family line was one of skilled crafters, and my mother was an exceptional jeweler. The one memento I have of her I keep in my room, which... mm, it's been some time since I've slept in my own bed..." [pc.dcb|"I see," you reply quietly.|"My sympathies," you answer.|"I'm so sorry!" you half-shout.] "Once again, you show me too much kindness." Kura's posture droops on her next exhalation, but then she's back to normal. "It's been a long time since I thought of that. If you're wondering, it was not a tragedy that took them, merely the hard won and easily lost movements of time. But to finish my train of thought... I said early in their lives they were artisans, and later on they pursued martial studies. There was some deeper motivation that I wasn't privy to, one that I didn't have a chance to be in the training I sought. In your language I am a spy, an agent, but in ours I am a kunoichi, loyal..." her ears tilt forward and she gives a silly smirk, "...if often bored. To be honest, I would have died of tedium had I chosen a softer vocation! And what a tragedy that would have been, truly!" She slinks forward, bending so as to expose the vast topsides of her bosom. "For I would not have been able to meet someone like you," she purrs, standing back up before you muster a response. Now how, exactly, did that training go? Any insights? 她停顿了一下，随意地抽出一把投掷匕首。“纪律不仅仅是一种情感上的驱动力，更是一种心态。至少，我是这么认为的。”她将匕首抛向空中，那把刀在空气中旋转着，形成了一道致命的旋转轨迹，而她却轻松地将它接了回来。 那个藏身处不再让我有家的感觉，而‘家’，”她特意强调了这个词，“反而变成了我的工作、我的职责、我的领域、我的外部世界。通过一系列仪式，我学会了如何使用那些卷轴；凭借坚定的决心，我忍受了大自然带来的一切考验。 通过纪律的约束，我明白了自己在我们这个平凡的社会中应该扮演什么样的角色。我不知道是否还有其他人和我一样，所以有时候我会认为自己是独一无二的！”她眨了眨眼，然后开始整理自己的装备。 |我无权透露那一信息。 [pc.name]这些规矩和方法外人是无法理解的，就连你，我也无法违背自己的忠诚。请原谅我。 ] 所以，归根结底，她的生活确实相当有趣，不是吗？ “嗯……你所说的‘有趣’，定义范围实在太广了，”她一边说，一边用手指轻轻划过自己的脸庞，“但事实就是如此。对别人来说，我们或许确实很有趣，但在我自己看来，我只不过是个平凡的人罢了。不过！”她的眼中突然闪过一丝轻型芒，“我很庆幸自己现在在这里，而不是在那个古老的国家。如果在那里，我的自由肯定会被严重限制。我想，他们绝对不会给予像我这样的人这样的尊重 [silly|石田大人|浅见小姐] 就是这些小事，对吧？” 确实如此。 “还有其他你想谈的事情吗？ [pc.name]?"
rows.raw: ' "[pc.dcb|What's your story?|So... who are you? Who is 'Kura'?|Since we're friends, tell me about yourself!]" Kura's steady breathing carries her up an inch and down another. She regards your question with confusion, bewilderment... it's like the inquiry has left her spellbound. You bend forward and snap your fingers which startles her. "Oh. Me?" she simpers. "I was gathering my thoughts, [pc.name]. It's not... well, I will be blunt. You are the first person to ever ask me that question. [pc.ra kitsune|I am deeply honored by your interest, my [pc.mf|lord|lady], but it certainly came as a surprise.|I was not expecting to be flattered by your interest in me, [pc.name], so it came as a surprise.] I'm afraid there is not much to tell, so I hope you will not be offended by a short story." Not much to tell? She is a kitsune, is she not? A long-lived race foreign to this continent. Surely she's lived a life that would stand out among what most Savarran cultures would consider interesting. A slight blush tints her light chocolate cheeks with a strawberry-pink shade. "You give me too much credit, but before we digress, I will start from the top." Inhaling through her nose, she swallows and halts the swaying of her tails and ears. "My name is, as you know, Kurako Tsukimi. In our language, names have other meanings, and..." she bites her lip. "I'm afraid it's..." Embarrassing? "Yes!- N-No!" she stammers, clearly flustered. Kura's putting thought to something she's taken for granted her entire life, and it's rather adorable in a way. "In your language it would loosely mean 'child of the moon.' Loosely," she repeats, clearly holding the rest back. What she gave you is fine enough considering her line of work, but... pressing her is more fun. "You left something out." "W-What? Oh, please! It's silly!" You fold your arms. "Dreaming child of the moon," she finishes, blushing. Both ears fold to her head. Was that so bad? She huffs, waiting a few seconds before continuing in her smooth tone. "I won't make any presumptions with how you view us[pc.ra kitsune|, especially considering that you've become one of us], but despite the artistic flair of my name I am still a commoner — a soldier in service." Whom was she born to, then? Surely she has a family somewhere. "Oh, my family has returned to Keros, along with my twin brother," she says flatly, not a hint of emotion in her speech. "As I understand it, the den, our home, has been standing for over two-hundred years. I am among the third generation of kitsune to have been born here, never to see our country. My mother and father were also soldiers, but not like me. Early in their lives, and in my grandparent's lives, they were devoted to the pursuit of knowledge and beauty. My family line was one of skilled crafters, and my mother was an exceptional jeweler. The one memento I have of her I keep in my room, which... mm, it's been some time since I've slept in my own bed..." [pc.dcb|"I see," you reply quietly.|"My sympathies," you answer.|"I'm so sorry!" you half-shout.] "Once again, you show me too much kindness." Kura's posture droops on her next exhalation, but then she's back to normal. "It's been a long time since I thought of that. If you're wondering, it was not a tragedy that took them, merely the hard won and easily lost movements of time. But to finish my train of thought... I said early in their lives they were artisans, and later on they pursued martial studies. There was some deeper motivation that I wasn't privy to, one that I didn't have a chance to be in the training I sought. In your language I am a spy, an agent, but in ours I am a kunoichi, loyal..." her ears tilt forward and she gives a silly smirk, "...if often bored. To be honest, I would have died of tedium had I chosen a softer vocation! And what a tragedy that would have been, truly!" She slinks forward, bending so as to expose the vast topsides of her bosom. "For I would not have been able to meet someone like you," she purrs, standing back up before you muster a response. Now how, exactly, did that training go? Any insights? [pc.ra kitsune |Humming to herself, Kura smiles encouragingly. "Were you not a kitsune, this is a part of myself I would not share." Her mouth opens, and words flow as easily as a calm river. "When I submitted myself to the training that's made me into the woman I am today, I reported to one person: Azami. In pursuit of the Discipline of Subterfuge, I was made to endure very harsh exercises often unsupervised. Azami oversaw my training, but strategy, tactics, and espionage were for me to study and apply on my own on frequent tasks. In places like this forest I lived alone, acted alone, would not see home for months at a time. It was grueling, but not without reward, not without... how shall I say... an inner peace. It was a role that I had to fill. It is a station that I believe I belong in, and that were I not in it, my life should have ended early." She pauses, casually producing one of her throwing daggers. "Discipline isn't just an emotional motivation, but also a state of mind. At least, that's what I believe," she lobs it straight into the air, the knife becoming a deadly pinwheel she effortlessly catches. "The den stopped feeling like home, and 'home'," she lingers on that word, "became the job, the work, the field, the outside. Through rituals I gained the use of my scrolls. Through determination I endured all that nature had to offer. Through discipline, I learned what my role in our modest society was. If there are anymore like me, I do not know, so I like to think I'm the only one sometimes!" she winks, storing her gear. |"I am not at liberty to divulge that information, [pc.name]. The manners and the methods are not for outsiders to know, and not even for you can I break my loyalty. Forgive me." ] So in the end, she does have a rather interesting life, huh? "W-Well... your definition of 'interesting' is... broad," she says, running a finger down her face. "But that's all there is to it. Really. To the rest of the world we must certainly be interesting, but to my own I am of low-birth. However!" There's a glint in her eye. "I am thankful to be here, and not in the Old Country. Were I there, my freedom would be sharply limited. I don't think they would have allowed someone like me the honor that [silly|Ishida-dono|Mistress Azami] has. It's the little things, right?" It is. "Is there anything else you wish to speak of, [pc.name]?"'

rows.original: "How crude!" she cries, play-acting an impugned professional. "'Just' guarding makes it sound as if it's an unimportant job..." she pouts, quickly softening. "...Not that it doesn't get boring, which is why I have to get a little amusement from time to time. [silly|Ishida-dono|Mistress Azami] would have one of my tails if she found out — the woman is about as far removed from fun as one can get — but as they say in the Old Country, heaven is high and the emperor is far away. The trees may have eyes and ears, but even they get tired from time to time." [pc.bgMulti soldier hunter |She doesn't have to make excuses for herself. You were a soldier, after all, and guard duty is something you're all too familiar with. The mind-numbing boredom that comes with being on watch for long periods of time that inevitably breeds complacency — you know it all too well. "It's good that you understand, then." |That's something you can sympathize with as someone who lived the life of a hunter. Overcoming impatience and tedium to put food in your belly was the most important part of growing up. What she's doing is hardly any different from what you learned the hardest way. Sure, watching over a frigid forest like this is tiresome... but like you, she sought out what she needed to succeed in her goal. "I knew there was something unique about you. It looks like we have more in common than I thought!" she claps her hands, brushing a tail against your thigh. "Patient hunters, guardians of our domain! It's no wonder that you proved yourself my superior." |Well, you would have thought that mere guard duty would be assigned to someone more... uh, commonplace? "It's very flattering of you to say that I'm something special, but that's not going to get you anywhere." ] What else does she do, then? "Spotting, for one. Those lovely elves from the city of ice to the north send patrols into this forest all the time. They're all so big and brash and bold; giantesses, every single one of them. Getting them off their wargs and convincing them to take on the mantle of benefactor is child's play." She blinks, every word thus far full of fond appreciation. "They're such easy, willing meals." [party.has etheryn |At that, Ryn crosses her arms and pouts. "Hey!" "Hmm? Is it not true?" Slinking well into Ryn's personal space, Kura fixes her gaze into Ryn's. "The warrior women of your kind have robust bodies and appetites for desire... it is a compliment, not a jibe. Unless there's some deeper meaning I have yet to perceive? You look like you'd be a tasty little morsel, not that I would take anything that's not willingly given." ] [party.has einin |Kura looks towards the wary mecian in your group, bending low with a slight frown on her face. "I have been performing my role since I was myself a child, and now that we're on the subject, you deserve some credit." Einin steps back, saying nothing. "You have a way of moving that I haven't seen before. Trying to keep track of you is..." she grins, "...challenging." "Thanks. I guess?" the mousegirl folds her arms. "In time, you'll be better than me. I don't say this lightly," she continues. "Though I would advise you not to spend all your time in the shadows." Kura straightens her posture, sharpening her last words to a sentimental edge. "You may forget what it's like to live in the light." ] You see. "Of course, there're other reasons I'm out here... but that treads into the realm of prying. Now, is there something else you'd like to discuss?"

rows.original: Kura makes a show of pondering the question, tapping her chin theatrically while humming to herself. "Far from it being upon me to speak ill of my superior behind her back, even if it is to one such as you..." One such as you — what's that supposed to mean? "[pc.ra kitsune|Oh, um, nothing|You're not one of us]." Ah... it makes sense in a way that, incidentally, raises more questions, but one thing at a time. "[silly|Ishida-dono|Mistress Azami Ishida] is a humorless scold. She's as fun as a bag of rocks and has all the charm of a dull knife," Kura blurts out. "I've never seen a greater neat freak who simply can't stand to have even so much as a scroll painting hanging crooked on the wall; but that must be why she holds her office. It's almost as if someone distilled all the mischief and trickery out of a fox and what's left is but an unappetising slice of meat that's been left out in the sun too long. It's unnatural!" That's quite the castigation for someone like Kura, but you suppose she's been holding it in for a long, long time. From what you've gathered by how this vigilant fox approached the subject, complaining, let alone about one's superiors, is something that's simply not done in kitsune society. "Eehh... mmm. I suppose it's what comes with being a [silly|先達|sendatsu]." A what, now? Kura's ears swivel contemplatively. "Ah, forgive me. I'm not sure if there's a word in your language to adequately exemplify such a title. A 'wildling' comes close, but is severely lacking in the spiritual aspect of things. A 'druid' would encompass the spiritual and religious connotations, but fail to communicate the martial aspect. Perhaps 'scout' would be closest, although the real meaning is something more akin to 'spiritual mountain guide'." Language is funny that way. "Just so. Now, I think I've said enough — these trees have ears, after all. Maybe another topic of conversation, if you please?"
rows.translation: 库拉故作沉思地敲着下巴，一边自言自语地哼着小曲，把这一幕演绎得淋漓尽致。 我绝对没有资格在背后说我上司的坏话，即使是对你这样的一个人来说也是如此…… 像你这样的人——这到底是什么意思？ "[pc.ra kitsune|哦，嗯，没什么。|你根本不是我们中的一员。]." 啊……从某种角度来看，这确实说得通，不过这样一来，反而引出了更多的问题。不过，我们还是先解决一个问题再说吧。 "[silly|石田大人|石田亚美里女士] 她就是一个毫无幽默感的人，严肃得就像一袋石头，完全没有一点吸引力，简直就像一把毫无魅力的钝刀。 库拉脱口而出。 我从未见过有人比她更讲究整洁了，她简直无法忍受哪怕是一幅卷轴画挂在墙上而有点歪；但也许正是因为这样，她才能担任现在的职位。她简直就像是一只狐妖，所有的狡猾和诡计都被抽离掉了，最后剩下的，就只是一块在阳光下晒得太久而变得索然无味的肉罢了。 太不自然了！" 对于像库拉这样的人来说，这样的惩罚确实相当严厉了。但想来，她肯定已经忍耐了很长时间很久。从这只警惕的狐妖谈论这个话题的方式来看，她竟然会抱怨自己的上级，这种行为在狐族社会中绝对是不可接受的。 呃……嗯，我想这就是身为……所必须面对的事情吧。 [silly|先達|sendatsu]." 什么？现在？” 库拉转动着耳朵，若有所思地听着。 啊，请原谅我。我不确定你们的语言中是否有合适的词汇能够准确表达这样的含义。‘野人’这个词还算接近，但明显缺乏其中所蕴含的精神层面的意义；‘德鲁伊’虽然包含了精神与宗教方面的含义，却又无法体现其战斗方面的特质；或许‘侦察员’这个词最为接近，但实际上它的含义更类似于‘精神上的向导’吧。 语言就是这么奇妙的东西。 就这样吧。现在，我想我已经说得够多了——毕竟，这些树可是有耳朵的。或许我们可以换个话题来聊，好吗？

rows.translation: 虽然庄园里的大多数狸猫要么对你视而不见，要么太害羞而不愿与你交谈，但这个女孩似乎相当容易接近。你慢悠悠地走过去， [pc.dcb|简短地向她点了点头。|打个招呼吧。|兴奋地挥了挥手，说道：“嗨！] 嘿呀，”那个半只狸猫说道，露出满口獠牙的笑容，“原来你是 [pc.name]哈？妈妈真的很高兴你能来。我们这样的机会其实并不多。 [a] [pc.title] 就在这一带。” 不过听起来不太像 她 那个女孩挑了挑眉毛：“嗯？哦，不，别误会……见到新朋友确实挺开心的。只是，和妈妈不一样，我偶尔会去城里逛逛。而多亏了你帮忙照顾阿尔劳内，我才能再次去城里了。 我只是不想像妈妈和姐妹们那样成为隐士而已。所以，换个新面貌对我来说并不是什么重大的改变或启示。不过，我并不是想因此显得无礼，抱歉。我叫Senja，很高兴认识你。 她伸出了手——那双手上覆盖着深棕色的毛发，一直延伸到肘部，就像长手套一样包裹着她的手臂。 每根手指的指尖都长着小小的爪子，当你与她握手时，那些小爪子会轻轻触碰到你的手。 [pc.skinFurScales]所以我的那些同父异母的姐妹们大概都会避开你，不会来打扰你的，”她继续说道，背靠着柱子，目光投向院子里那些其他棕熊幼崽正在玩球的地方。“妈妈说过不要去打扰你。 不过我想，如果你自己过来找我，应该不会打扰到你吧？” “没错。” Senja笑了笑：“太好了。那么，听着，妈妈和其他女孩们其实不太需要钱，但我需要。我喜欢去镇上喝点东西或者买些新衣服，你懂的吧？ 所以，也许我们可以一起做点生意吧！我在森林里捡到了很多有趣的东西，那些东西可能会和你身上散发出的那种……呃，非常奇怪的气场产生反应。应该是些具有变形能力的物品吧。如果你也想变成像我们这样的狸猫，但又不想让妈妈再生更多的小宝宝；或者反过来，如果你有这样的需求，我这里有一些桃子，应该能解决你的问题。 还有很多其他的东西呢。想看看吗？
rows.raw: ' While most of the tanuki around the manor have either ignored you or are too shy to talk with, this daughter seems fairly approachable. You saunter up and [pc.dcb|give her a curt nod.|say hello.|wave excitedly. "Hi!"] "Heyya," the half-tanuki says, giving you a fang-filled grin. "So you're [pc.name], huh? Mom's real excited to have you around. Not often we get [a] [pc.title] around here." Doesn't sound like she is. The girl arches an eyebrow. "Hm? Oh, no, don't get me wrong... it's nice to see new people. Just, unlike mom, I actually go into town once in a while. And thanks to you taking care of the Alraune, I can get back to doing so. I try not to be a hermit like mom and my sisters, that's all. So a new face isn't some divine revelation or anything. I don't mean to be rude about it though, sorry. The name's Senja. Nice to meet you." She extends a hand — one covered in rich brown fur up to the elbows, sleeving her arm like a long glove. Little claws peek out at the tip of each finger, and as you shake her hand, they gently brush across your [pc.skinFurScales]. "So most of my half-sisters will probably leave you with a wide berth," she continues, leaning back against the pillar and casting her gaze out to the courtyard where the other tanukis are playing ball. "Mom said not to bother you. But I figure I'm not bothering you if you come over here on your own, right?" "Right." Senja grins. "Great. So, hey, listen. Mom and the other girls don't have much use for money, but I do. I like to go into town for drinks or new clothes, you know? So maybe you and I could do some business! I pick up a lot of fun things out in the forest, things that might react well with that, uh, really weird aura bleeding off you. Transformatives probably. If you ever wanna be a tanuki like us but don't wanna shove more babies in mom, or vice versa, I got some peaches that ought to do the trick. Lots of other stuff too. Wanna see?"'

rows.original: "So, anything special for me?" you ask, leaning up against the pillar with Senja. "After all I went through for your mom..." The half-nuki flashes you a little smile, sidling closer. "Well, now that you mention it... now that mom's got her bottomless bag back, she gave me one of her earlier iterations and said I should find a use for it. My definition of 'use' is 'sell for beer and dresses money,' soooo... wanna have a look?" You nod, and Senja ducks into a side room, returning with a small chest about the size of Brint's bicep. She sets it down and pops the top, urging you to look inside. You do so, and see... a chest, with a polished wood interior. "What gives?" Senja shrugs. "I dunno. It's a box that holds stuff. It's not actually bottomless, cuz you can see the bottom, but look!" The nuki-girl takes a knee and thrusts her arm into the chest, all the way up to the elbow... and then the shoulder... in a straight line down. You peer in as the bottom seems to expand down and down well past where the floor must be, and yet you saw solid stone there a moment ago! Senja grins, tail swishing. "See? A lot bigger on the inside. Magical artifact like this is pretty pricey, of course," she adds, standing up so fast that her rack nearly bounces free of her dress. She quickly puts a hand around the fabric, giggling. The chest at her feet snaps closed of its own volition the moment her arm's free. "If I went down south, I could easily sell it off to some noble for a thousand Belharan Hawks, but for you, the victorious hero, I'll let it go for the low, low price of a kiss. How about it?"
rows.translation: 那么，有没有什么特别的东西给我吗？”你一边倚着柱子，一边问Senja，“毕竟我为你妈妈付出了那么多……” 半裸的Senja对你露出了一个微笑，然后慢慢靠近你：“嗯，既然你提到了……既然妈妈把她的那个无底袋拿回来了，她就把早期制作的一个版本给了我，让我想想该怎么利用它。而我对‘利用’的定义就是‘把它卖掉，换来啤酒和衣服的钱’，所以……你想看看吗？ 你点了点头，Senja便走进了一侧的小房间，回来时拿着一个大小与Brint的二头肌差不多的小箱子。她把箱子放在地上，打开盖子，示意你往里面看。你照做了，里面……竟然也是一个箱子，只不过内部是用光滑的木头制成的。“这是什么意思呢？” Senja耸了耸肩：“我也不知道。这就是一个用来装东西的箱子而已。其实它并不是无底的，因为你能看到下装，但是看啊！ 那个NUKI女孩单膝跪地，将手臂一直伸向胸前，手臂一直延伸到肘部……然后是肩膀……整个动作都呈直线进行。你仔细观察，发现她的手臂似乎一直向下延伸，甚至超出了地面的位置……但就在刚才，你明明看到那里是坚硬的石头啊！ 塞尼亚咧嘴一笑，尾巴摇来摇去：“看到了吧？里面其实要大得多。这样的魔法神器，价格当然也很高。”她说着迅速站了起来，动作如此之快，以至于她的胸罩差点从连衣裙上脱落下来。她赶紧用手按住布料，咯咯地笑了起来。当她的手松开的瞬间，足部边的那个“胸罩”竟然自动合上了。“要是我去南方的话，肯定能以一千贝拉兰鹰币的价格把它卖给某个贵族……不过 你这位胜利的英雄啊，我愿意以一个吻这个极低的价格将它让给你。怎么样？

rows.original:
You reach into your purse and withdraw a fat bar of electrum. Easily worth a thousand hawks. "Will this do?"

        Senja blinks, staring at the bullion. "I, uh, I mean okay... if you'd rather pay me a fortune than give me a kiss... I'd be insulted if I hadn't just become independently wealthy. Thanks!"
        
        She takes the bar and shoves it down between her breasts before any of her siblings have a chance to glimpse it. One of her paws scoots the chest over to you. "Use it in good health, [pc.name]! I'm gonna work to destroy mine as fast as I can now. Ale for days!"
        
        Maybe you'll see her at the Frost Hound sometime, then.
        
        You heft up the chest and head on your way.

你从钱包里拿出一根厚实的电银条，它的价值绝对超过一千只鹰。“这样够吗？”

森雅眨了眨眼，盯着那根电银条说道：“呃，好吧……如果你宁愿付给我一大笔钱也不愿吻我……那我反而会觉得被侮辱呢。反正我现在也已经独立致富了，所以不客气啦！谢谢！”

她接过电银条，迅速把它塞到胸前，趁她的兄弟姐妹们还没来得及看清楚，她用一只爪子把胸前的衣服拉拢过来。“希望你能好好使用它。 [pc.name]我现在就要尽快着手毁掉我的东西了。真的，要花好几天的时间呢！”

“也许到时候你会在霜犬酒馆那里见到她吧。”

你背起背包，踏上了旅途。

rows.original: If this is worth a thousand hawks to Senja, the least you can do is make it count. You take a confident step forward, pressing the chesty tanuki between yourself and the sandstone pillar. She gasps, biting her lip as you take her cheek in one hand and her waist in the other, holding her against your [pc.chest] as you lean in and press your [pc.lips] to hers, playing across the slender black mounds until they part with a gasp, permitting your [pc.tongue] to slip between them. She goes stiff a second, surprised, and then a little moan escapes her mouth as you play your wandering tongue across her own, entwining them [pc.dcb|while your hand moves down her hip and grabs onto her plush ass through her skirt, groping until you feel her pressing back against your hand. Dirty girl, she likes it!|while your hand gently strokes her hip.|while you push your body forward, feeling the way her big tits squish up against your [pc.boobs]. That's nice!] When you finally break the kiss nearly a minute later, Senja is panting like a pup in heat, tail beating furiously behind her. You hadn't even noticed her own hands grabbing your hips, but they stay attached until you gently brush them away, giving her your most seductive smile. "Are you only charging a kiss?" you wonder. "I-I, uh..." she murmurs, touching her lip. "You certainly made the first one amazing. I should charge you another — just to be sure." Several of her sisters let out a concerted "Ohhhhhhh!" from the courtyard, which seems to finally break the spell and leave Senja blushing furiously, realizing what she's just said. She whirls around to the younger tanukis and shouts "Shut up, brats! You're all just jealous!" While she's busy chastising her siblings, you heft up your new chest and sling it on your back. Best get this back to the Frost Hound. "I'll, uh, see you around, [pc.name]!" she giggles, tail still swinging. "Buy me a drink sometime, maybe?" Maybe this chest isn't the only thing that's going to the inn.

rows.translation: 你向后靠了靠，摇了摇头。其实现在看了这个盒子之后，你并不真的需要它。不过还是谢谢了。 那只半狸猫冲你撅了撅嘴，然后把一只爪子放在盒子上，把盒子盖住了。“好吧……那就算了！我就把里面塞满化妆品之类的东西，直到你改变主意为止。你肯定会改变主意的。外面肯定找不到比我的盒子更好的了！ [pc.cunningRange 66|你有一种感觉，她 真的会 既然她提到了，我就希望你能帮她拿那个盒子。]
rows.raw: " You lean back and shake your head. You don't actually need the box, now that you've seen it. But thanks anyway. The half-tanuki makes a pouty huff at you and puts a paw atop the box, holding it closed. "Well... fine then! I'll just, I dunno, stuff it full of makeup or something till you change your mind. And you will. You won't find a lot of better boxes out there than mine!" [pc.cunningRange 66|You have a feeling she really would like you to take her box, now that she mentions it.] "

rows.original: You don't actually need a bottomless box right now, but thanks.
rows.translation: 其实你现在并不需要一个“无底洞”式的箱子，不过还是谢谢了。
rows.raw: "You don't actually need a bottomless box right now, but thanks."

rows.original:
[flags.SENJA_TLK
        |Leaning against one of the pillars in the courtyard, you ask the young lady Evergreen if she has a moment to chat.
        
        "Well, there's a dearth of other customers at the moment, so I suppose I can make some time," she teases. "Chat away!"
        |Leaning against one of the pillars in the courtyard, you ask the young lady Evergreen if she has a moment to chat.
        
        "Me?" Senja squeaks, glancing at the wall behind her as if expecting another, more interesting 'nuki to have been stood in her shadow. "I don't know that I'll have all that much to say — I don't get out like my sister Meira, and I certainly don't have the kind of experience Mother has accumulated. But i-if you need something, I'm happy to help. Mom's so busy and all..."
        
        No, no, you don't need anything in particular. You just want to talk.
        
        "Oh, I mean, that's fine too. I'm not busy or anything... w-what do you want to talk about?"
    ]

        |你靠在庭院中的一根柱子上，询问那位名叫常青女士的年轻姑娘是否有时间聊聊天。

“我吗？”森雅惊呼道，她瞥了一眼身后的墙壁，似乎在期待着还有另一个更有趣的“家伙”藏在她的阴影里。 我不知道自己是否有那么多话要说——我并不像我的姐姐梅拉那样经常外出，而且我也完全没有母亲所积累的那种经验。但是，如果你们需要什么帮助，我非常乐意伸出援手。妈妈现在实在太忙了……不，不，你并不需要准备什么特别的东西。你只是想聊聊天而已。”

rows.original: Ask Senja about her mother, Oxana Evergreen.
rows.translation: 去问森雅关于她母亲奥克萨娜·常青女士的事。
rows.raw: "Ask Senja about her mother, Oxana Evergreen."

rows.original: So where does Senja get all these knicknacks anyway?
rows.translation: 那么，Senja到底是从哪里得到这些小饰品的呢？
rows.raw: "So where does Senja get all these knicknacks anyway?"

rows.original: What can Senja tell you about the rest of the Evergreen family?
rows.translation: 关于常青女士家族的其他成员，森雅能告诉你些什么呢？
rows.raw: "What can Senja tell you about the rest of the Evergreen family?"

rows.original: What's the story with this mansion out in the middle of nowhere? It certainly clashes with the boreal elf aesthetic of the region.
rows.translation: 这座坐落在偏远地区的豪宅究竟有什么来历呢？它的风格显然与这一地区极北精灵的传统审美完全不符。
rows.raw: "What's the story with this mansion out in the middle of nowhere? It certainly clashes with the boreal elf aesthetic of the region."

rows.original: "About my mother?" Senja echoes, trying to laugh it off. "I mean, she's just in the other room. If you have any questions, you can just ask her yourself. It's not like she ever leaves anymore, at least not for more than a couple hours. Really, you can't miss her." Well that's a good point right there — why doesn't Lady Evergreen have more contact with the outside world? A witch of her wealth and standing could really be someone important if she had a mind to. [var0 |"People don't trust wizards the way they used to in the old days, not after the Godswar and all the dark magic that came pouring out of that... at least, according to mother. And no offense," Senja says, looking over your coal-dark scales, "but you should know better than anybody why mages like us can be worried about getting noticed. You Astrida were the bogeymen in mother's stories growing up — that big bad blackscale salamanders would crawl out of the shadows and eat up all my magic if I misbehaved. Even now if I stray far from the house, she tells me not to use more than the occasional cantrip or else somebody will take notice. I'd like to think a god's servants aren't so bored as to bother with me, but if mom's so concerned..." Senja, at least, has shown no reason why she should be afraid. Though her mother is rather... dangerous. You can see why she'd have problems if a more zealous member of the order became interested. "R-right," Senja nods. "We're not afraid, but there's every reason to be cautious. I don't want to come back from town someday to find the house burned down because some paladin decided they didn't like the cut of mom's jib." ... That probably would not be why Evergreen would draw a mage hunter's ire, but you get the point. |"M-maybe," Senja shrugs, "but mother always says it's best not to draw too much attention to ourselves. People don't trust wizards the way they used to in the old days, not after the Godswar and all the dark magic that came pouring out of that... at least, according to mother. And besides, any mage that gets too powerful risks earning the ire of Nareva's mage hunters. There's wards and counter-spells woven into the very foundation of this old place, so it's a safe haven from prying eyes where we don't have to worry about persecution just because magic flows so strong in our bloodline." Is her mother really that worried about mage hunters? Senja shrugs. "Most minor magicians don't have to worry about such things, but mother's an archmage descended from archmages. One day... one day I'll be in her shoes, too, and the idea of having Narevan paladins breathing down my neck at all hours, watching every cantrip I cast... no thank you! Considering how, um, intimate mother's magic tends to be I'd think she likes the idea even less than me!" These Narevans the family Evergreen's so worried about can't be that bad, can they? "I don't know. I've never met one, but they were the bogeymen in mother's stories growing up — that big bad blackscale salamanders would crawl out of the shadows and eat up all my magic if I misbehaved. Even now if I stray far from the house, she tells me not to use more than the occasional cantrip or else somebody will take notice. I'd like to think a god's servants aren't so bored as to bother with me, but if mom's so concerned..." Better safe than sorry, you suppose. ]
rows.translation: 关于我妈妈的事？”森雅重复道，试图用笑声来化解这个话题。“其实她就在隔壁房间。如果你有什么问题，可以直接去问她。她现在几乎从不离开房间，至少也不会离开超过几个小时。真的，你根本不会想念她的。” 嗯，这倒是个不错的观点——为什么 不 绿叶女士与外界的接触是否更为频繁呢？像她这样的富有且地位显赫的女巫，如果她真的有意的话，完全有可能成为某个重要人物。 [var0 |人们已经不再像过去那样信任巫师了，尤其是在经历了神战以及那些从中涌现出来的黑暗魔法之后……至少母亲是这么说的。无意冒犯，”森雅看着你那煤黑色的鳞片说道，“但你应该比任何人都更清楚，为什么像我们这样的法师会担心被人注意到。 在你小时候，阿斯特丽达就是妈妈故事里那些可怕的怪物——那些巨大的、长着黑色鳞片的蝾螈会从阴影中爬出来，要是我表现不好，它们就会吃掉我所有的魔法。直到现在，每当我要离开家太远时，妈妈还是会提醒我，不要使用太多的魔法，否则别人就会注意到。 我愿意相信，神的仆从们应该不会无聊到要去理会我，但既然妈妈这么担心…… 至少，Senja并没有表现出任何应该害怕的理由。虽然她的母亲确实有点……危险。 你可以理解，如果这个组织里有更狂热的人对此感兴趣，她肯定会遇到麻烦的。 “对，对，”森雅点点头说，“我们并不害怕，但确实有理由保持谨慎。我可不想有一天回到城里，却发现房子被烧毁了，只因为某个圣骑士觉得妈妈说话的方式让他们不满意。……那样做可能不太合适。 为什么 常青女士会惹恼那些法师猎手，但你应该明白我的意思。 |也……也许吧，”森雅耸了耸肩，“但妈妈总是说，最好不要太引人注意。人们现在不再像过去那样信任巫师了，尤其是在经历了神战以及那些随之而来的黑暗魔法之后。至少，母亲是这么说的。而且，任何实力过于强大的法师都可能会招致纳雷瓦那些猎魔者的追杀。这个古老的地方的基础中布满了防护结界和反制法术，因此这里是一个安全的避风港——我们不必因为自己的血脉中流淌着强大的魔法力量而担心会遭到迫害。她母亲真的那么担心那些法师猎手吗？” Senja耸了耸肩：“大多数普通法师并不需要担心这种事情，但母亲可是出身于法师高阶世家的首席法师啊。总有一天……总有一天，我也会处在她的位置上。而一想到那些纳雷万的圣骑士会时刻监视着我，关注我使出的每一个小技巧……我真的不想这样！考虑到这种情况……嗯， 亲密的 我觉得母亲的魔法……她应该比我更不喜欢这个想法吧！” 那些让常青女士家族如此担心的纳雷万人，应该不会真的那么可怕吧？ “我不知道。我从未见过他们，但在我成长过程中，母亲的故事里他们总是被描绘成可怕的怪物——那些巨大的、长着黑色鳞片的蝾螈会从阴影中爬出来，如果我表现不好，它们就会吞噬我所有的魔法。 即使现在，当我离开家走得太远时，她也会提醒我不要频繁使用那些小技巧，否则会有人注意到我的。我本来以为神明的仆从们应该不会无聊到去关注我这种人，但既然妈妈这么担心，那我也就只好遵从她的建议了。宁可谨慎一些，也不要后悔吧。”你应该是这么想的。 ]

rows.original: "A girl's gotta have some secrets, [pc.name]," Senja giggles, puffy tail swaying so hard she nearly knocks a basket of ring-peaches over. "But really, it's not that exciting. My sisters and I all wander around the forest — some, like Meira, are a little more vigorous than others — and we all collect things we find. I just have a keener eye than any of them, so I end up finding all the best stuff. Sometimes I even do a little digging — poking around in old boer'alvar ruins can yield all sorts of interesting things. Sometimes even old spellbooks and scrolls, if you look through druidic ruins, but those are the most dangerous ones too. I try and leave those to Mother unless I can be sure the spirits aren't going to be too angry at me." She draws a small, old copper knife from one of her boxes, running a finger over faint rune-etchings. "I've always had an interest in the old bones of the world. I figured, why not try and make a little money off what I turn up? Mother's rarely interested, after all. Not because what I find isn't good, but she just... just knows everything already, it feels like. Plus, since I actually leave the house sometimes, I can charge people reasonable prices compared to mom — I'm not gonna be asking ten thousand hawks just to make it worth my while! A-and of course, I'm not going to ask someone to pay the, um, other price she asks for things." And what, pray tell, does a girl like her do with money that her mother won't? A hint of red creeps onto the merchant-tanuki's cheeks. "Remember what I said about secrets? I mean, what do you think a young lady w-would spend money on? From time to time I go down to Hawkethorne and buy clothing or get a few drinks, of course!" Right, right. Whatever she says. "Y-yes," she coughs, looking bashful about... something. "So anyway..."
rows.translation: 女孩子总得有些秘密， [pc.name]塞尼亚咯咯笑着，她那蓬松的尾巴摇得厉害，差点把一篮子环桃弄翻。不过说真的，也没那么有趣。我和我的姐妹们都会在森林里四处逛逛——有些姐妹，比如梅拉，会比我们更活跃一些——然后我们会把找到的东西收集起来。 我只是比他们任何人都更有敏锐的观察力，因此总能找到最棒的东西。有时候我甚至会深入挖掘——在那些古老的布尔人遗迹中翻找，总能发现各种各样有趣的东西。有时候，在德鲁伊的遗迹里还能找到古老的法术书和卷轴，不过这些地方也是最危险的。 除非我确定那些灵魂不会对我太生气，否则我总是会把这些事情留给母亲来处理。” 她从其中一个箱子里拿出一把小巧而古老的铜刀，用手指轻轻触摸上面那些模糊的符文。“我一直对这个世界上的古老遗迹充满了兴趣。 我想，既然我找到了这些东西，为什么不试着从中赚点钱呢？毕竟妈妈通常对这些并不感兴趣。并不是因为我找到的东西不好，而是因为她似乎已经什么都知道了。另外，由于我偶尔会离开家，所以我可以比妈妈收取更合理的价格——我总不可能为了让自己不亏本而索要高达一万霍克斯的费用吧！ 当然，我也不会要求别人来支付这笔费用 其他 她要的东西可真贵啊……” 那么，像她这样的姑娘，用那些她妈妈不肯给她的钱来做什么呢？ 商人的脸颊上浮现出一丝红晕。“还记得我之前说过关于秘密的事吗？我想，一个年轻姑娘会把钱花在什么上面呢？偶尔我会去鹰棘镇买些衣服，或者喝上几杯酒，当然啦！” 对，对……随便她怎么说吧。 “嗯……”她轻咳了一声，似乎有些害羞，“总之……

rows.original: "I've got a looooooot of sisters," Senja giggles, gesturing around the courtyard at the gaggle of 'nuki-girls at play. "I don't know how the estate has enough room for us all! And there're new girls joining the family constantly. I have to admit, more than once I've grabbed one of my furry-faced sisters to help me only to realize I've no idea who she actually is!" That sounds a bit disconcerting — not knowing who her sisters even are. Senja just waves you off like it's nothing. "It's the price of having such a large family. New girls are born and raised in the blink of an eye, coming and going with lifespans enhanced by mother's magic. And for every girl that leaves with a handsome southern husband or goes off to found her own wizard's tower, it seems like mother's birthed two more!" Well, alright, how about the sisters that she does know, then? She has to be close to some of them. "Of course I am. Meira is the closest to me in age, at least among the half-tanukis. She's much more like mother than me in almost every respect — she's a master of transmutation magic, changing her body and her lovers' too, but the similarity doesn't end there. Meira has the same mischievous streak as mother does, that same playful cattiness that drives me up the wall sometimes! It's kind of hard to believe mother's not training her to be the future Lady Evergreen... I really never will understand why she insists it'll be one of the airheads. I really don't get it." The airheads? Senja flicks her tail towards a gathering of tanukis, all of them fully swathed in fur from head to toe — a contrast to your conversation partner, who's hardly got much more than little ears and a tail to set her apart from human stock. That, and her little black mask around her eyes. "I don't know why it is, but any of mother's full-blooded tanuki children just are always... a little dim? They're sweet-natured and loving, but all they really have going for them is sky-high libidos that make them plenty popular with the guests. But they can barely cast a cantrip between them, to say nothing of their conversational abilities..." But her mother's still set on making one of them her heir? "Right! Couldn't tell you why, except that it's always been a tanuki that's been the lady of the house. We half-breeds always get kicked out eventually, to make room for the fluffy girls. I don't want to sound bitter or anything, but I just don't understand why my mother does some of the things she does — her doting on them most of all!" Senja sighs, shoulders deflating. "I suppose I should just try and be happy that I have a mother that loves me, and is willing to let me stay around until I'm confident enough to strike out on my own. Someday... but not someday too soon. I still have so much to learn..."
rows.translation: 我有好多好多姐妹呢，”森雅咯咯笑着，一边指着院子里那些正在玩耍的“毛茸茸脸的姐妹们”一边说，“真不知道这个庄园怎么会有足够的空间容纳我们所有人！而且还有新的女孩不断加入这个大家庭。我得承认，有几次我叫某个姐妹来帮我，结果却发现自己根本不知道她到底是谁！ 这听起来确实有点让人不安——连她的姐妹们都是谁都不清楚。 不过Senja只是淡淡地耸了耸肩，仿佛这没什么大不了的。“这就是拥有这样一个大家庭的代价吧。新女孩们出生、长大，转眼间就离开了家，而她们的寿命也因为母亲的魔法而得到了延长。每当有一个女孩嫁给了南方某个英俊的男子，或者独自去建立自己的巫师塔时，母亲似乎又会再生下两个新的女孩！ 嗯，好吧，那她认识的那些姐妹们怎么样呢？她肯定和其中一些人关系比较亲密吧。 “我当然认识。在那些半坦努基族人中，梅拉在年龄上与我最为接近。几乎在所有方面，她都更像我的母亲——她精通变形魔法，能够改变自己的外貌，也能改变她所爱之人的外貌。不过，相似之处还不止这些。 梅拉和她母亲一样，也有一副调皮捣蛋的脾气，那种爱闹着玩的坏脾气有时真的会让我抓狂！真很难相信她母亲并没有在训练梅拉，让她成为未来的常青女士小姐……我实在想不通，为什么她坚持认为梅拉会成为那些愚蠢的人之一。 我真的不明白。 那些傻瓜们？ Senja用尾巴轻轻一甩，指向了一群全身都被毛皮覆盖的tanukis——与她的对话对象形成了鲜明的对比：那个对话对象几乎没有什么区别于人类的特征，只有小小的耳朵和一条尾巴而已。 还有她眼睛周围戴的那块小黑面具。“我不知道为什么，但母亲那些纯种狸猫生的孩子，总是……有点迟钝吧？他们性格温顺、充满爱心，不过他们最大的特点就是性欲极其旺盛，因此很受客人们的欢迎。 但他们彼此之间连一个简单的法术都难以施展，更别提他们的交谈能力了…… 但她的母亲还是坚持要让其中一个人成为自己的继承人？ “没错！我也说不清楚为什么，只是一直以来，家里的女主人一直都是那些狸猫。我们这些混血儿最终总是会被赶出去，好给那些毛茸茸的猫咪们腾出空间。我并不是想表现得怨恨什么，只是真的不明白我的母亲为什么会做出一些那样的事情——她对那些猫咪的宠爱简直到了极点 他们 最重要的是这个！” Senja叹了口气，肩膀耷了下来。“我想，我应该庆幸自己有一个爱我的母亲，她愿意让我留在她身边，直到我有足够的信心去独立生活。总有一天……但不是现在。 太 很快。我还有很多东西需要学习……
rows.raw: " "I've got a looooooot of sisters," Senja giggles, gesturing around the courtyard at the gaggle of 'nuki-girls at play. "I don't know how the estate has enough room for us all! And there're new girls joining the family constantly. I have to admit, more than once I've grabbed one of my furry-faced sisters to help me only to realize I've no idea who she actually is!" That sounds a bit disconcerting — not knowing who her sisters even are. Senja just waves you off like it's nothing. "It's the price of having such a large family. New girls are born and raised in the blink of an eye, coming and going with lifespans enhanced by mother's magic. And for every girl that leaves with a handsome southern husband or goes off to found her own wizard's tower, it seems like mother's birthed two more!" Well, alright, how about the sisters that she does know, then? She has to be close to some of them. "Of course I am. Meira is the closest to me in age, at least among the half-tanukis. She's much more like mother than me in almost every respect — she's a master of transmutation magic, changing her body and her lovers' too, but the similarity doesn't end there. Meira has the same mischievous streak as mother does, that same playful cattiness that drives me up the wall sometimes! It's kind of hard to believe mother's not training her to be the future Lady Evergreen... I really never will understand why she insists it'll be one of the airheads. I really don't get it." The airheads? Senja flicks her tail towards a gathering of tanukis, all of them fully swathed in fur from head to toe — a contrast to your conversation partner, who's hardly got much more than little ears and a tail to set her apart from human stock. That, and her little black mask around her eyes. "I don't know why it is, but any of mother's full-blooded tanuki children just are always... a little dim? They're sweet-natured and loving, but all they really have going for them is sky-high libidos that make them plenty popular with the guests. But they can barely cast a cantrip between them, to say nothing of their conversational abilities..." But her mother's still set on making one of them her heir? "Right! Couldn't tell you why, except that it's always been a tanuki that's been the lady of the house. We half-breeds always get kicked out eventually, to make room for the fluffy girls. I don't want to sound bitter or anything, but I just don't understand why my mother does some of the things she does — her doting on them most of all!" Senja sighs, shoulders deflating. "I suppose I should just try and be happy that I have a mother that loves me, and is willing to let me stay around until I'm confident enough to strike out on my own. Someday... but not someday too soon. I still have so much to learn..." "

rows.original:
"Ah, Mother's manor has been here for centuries!" Senja chuckles. "I know enough about old architecture and digging up ruins to say that with some certainty. There's nothing underneath the manor that isn't part of its construction, and no trace of disparate building materials... it was all built at once, on open ground. I imagine when the first Lady Evergreen set the foundation stones, the Wayfort down the road was still occupied by boer'alvar roadwardens, making it an important tradeway between the Winter City and the south. It would have been a good place for a mage like her to set up shop."
    
    But then...
    
    "... And then the keep fell, the Winter City isolated itself, and the town south of here was wiped out in the Godswar. We Evergreens have been pretty isolated since then. Sometimes a boreal elf scout would come by, or some particularly rebellious kitsune... but I'm the first child fathered by someone from south of the River Ridell in more than two centuries." Senja smiles proudly, puffing out her chest and wagging her tail in a distinctly canine fashion. "More came after me, of course, but the important thing is that we've only have contact with southerners for a few generations of tanukis — maybe twenty years, at the most."
    
    That's about when Hawkethorne was refounded, from what you've gathered. Hard to imagine the manor sustaining itself up here all by its lonesome with so little contact for so long.
    
    "Oh, you'd be surprised," she laughs. "Whether through magic or by the sweat of our own hands, our family can produce nearly everything we need. You only saw a tiny part of the gardens we keep on your way in, and mother has this amazing spell that transmutes normal plant-matter like grass and tree leaves into lettuce and cabbage. It's not the best tasting food on its own, but it's essential to keep so many hungry 'nukis from all starving to death by the sheer number of us eating the landscape barren!"
    
    [var0
        |Oh yeah, that probably explains why your horde hasn't stripped the Marches clean too. At least not yet. Komari must have the same spell in her arsenal, too.
        |That sounds mighty convenient. Shame such spells aren't widely circulated — [pc.bg slumrat
            |being able to turn grass into cabbage would have saved you a lot of hungry nights once upon a time
            |they could save a lot of people from starving
        ].
    ]
    
    "It's pretty advanced magic," Senja hastens to add. "Meira and I are pretty decent wizards ourselves, the best in the family besides mother, but all we can do even working together is keep old vegetables from spoiling for a bit. Creating them out of plant matter is... far beyond us. I'm not sure how far as spell like that would go to curing world hunger when even mother is stressed by it. But it serves us, at least."
    
    You can't help but wonder what other helpful surprises might be lurking around Evergreen's estate.
    
    [var1
        |"Well, I'm sure you'd like to know, but... I've probably said too much already. No offense, [pc.name], but mother would probably flay me if she knew I'd said as much as I have!"
        
        Ah yes. You can only guess why a coven of witches might be a little nervous around one of Nareva's chosen.
        
        "Sorry."
        |"There's all sorts of amazing things around here, it's true! We Evergreens have been around this part of the world for centuries, picking things up and trading with outsiders when we can. There's things from all over the world in mother's show room — Belharan armor and Tronarii bronze and Kitsuhon talismans to name just a few. And the spellbooks she has! Oh, I know outsiders aren't really allowed in the library, but just imagine four walls all laden with grimoires, and then there's chests under the floor boards with the really esoteric things..."
        
        Senja chuckles. "Really, that's the story of this place. There's magic in every nook and cranny. Every stone has its own enchantment, or at least, that's what it feels like most of the time. The good news is, so much ambient magic floating around in the air here, clinging to everything... mother can really pull off some amazing feats of spellcraft! Things it would take a whole cabal of Belharan magisters to perform could be done single-handedly thanks to all the aetheric buildup in the manor. At least, that's my theory. Mother's understandably tight lipped about such things — only for her final heir, she says."
    ]
rows.translation:
啊，母亲的庄园已经存在几个世纪了！”森雅轻笑道，“我对古建筑以及挖掘遗迹颇有研究，因此可以肯定地说，庄园地下没有任何不属于其建筑结构的物质，也找不到任何使用过其他建筑材料的痕迹。…这一切都是在一块开阔的土地上一次性建成的。我想，当第一位“常青女士夫人”铺设奠基石的时候，路途尽头的荒废驿堡地区还居住着那些负责维护道路的布尔人，因此这条道路在当时成为了连接冬城与南部地区的重要通道。 对于像她这样的法师来说，这里本该是建立自己的事业基地的理想之地。
    
    但是后来……

“……然后那座堡垒陷落了，冬城被孤立了起来，而这里南边的小镇也在神战中被彻底摧毁。从那以后，我们常青女士族就一直处于与世隔绝的状态。偶尔会有极北精灵的侦察兵路过，或者是一些特别叛逆的狐妖也会出现。但是，我是两个多世纪以来，第一个由里德尔河以南地区的人所生的孩子。”森贾骄傲地笑着，挺起胸膛，还用一种典型的犬类方式摇着尾巴。“当然，后来还有更多的孩子出生了，但重要的是，我们的坦努基家族与南方地区的人建立联系，也才仅仅经历了几代人——最多也就二十年的时间而已。"
    
    根据你收集到的信息，大约就是在那个时候，鹰棘镇庄园才得以重建的。很难想象，在与外界几乎没有任何联系的情况下，这座庄园是如何独自在这里存活这么长时间的。

“哦，你可能会感到惊讶的，”她笑着说。 无论是通过魔法，还是依靠我们自己的辛勤劳动，我们家几乎能够生产出我们所需的一切。你在来这里的路上，只看到了我们种植的花园中的一小部分而已。而妈妈掌握了一种神奇的魔法，她能够将普通的植物——比如草和树叶——变成生菜和卷心菜。 单凭它的味道来说，它并不是最美味的食品，但如果没有它，那么众多饥饿的“核子生物”们肯定会因为我们太多人而把整个地区吃得一片荒芜，最终导致它们全部饿死！因此，它确实是必不可少的。
    
    [var0
        |哦，对了，这大概就能解释为什么你的军队还没有把那些边境地区洗劫一空吧。至少现在还没有。科玛丽肯定也掌握了同样的法术。
        |那听起来确实非常方便。可惜这样的法术并没有得到广泛的传播…… [pc.bg slumrat
            |如果当初能将草变成卷心菜，那你肯定可以避免很多次挨饿的夜晚了。
            |他们本可以拯救许多人免于挨饿。
        ].
    ]
    
    这是相当高深的魔法，”森雅急忙补充道，“我和梅拉本身也是相当不错的巫师，除了母亲之外，我们是家里最出色的。但即便我们齐心协力，所能做的也不过是让那些旧蔬菜暂时不会变质而已。 用植物物质制造出这些东西……确实超出了我们的能力范围。我不确定这样的咒语在解决世界饥饿问题上能起到多大的作用，毕竟就连“母亲”这样的存在也为此感到困扰。但至少，这些咒语对我们来说是很有用的。

你不禁会想，在常青女士庄园里，或许还藏着哪些其他有用的惊喜呢。
    
    [var1
        |嗯，我猜你肯定想知道，但是……我可能已经说得太多了。无意冒犯， [pc.name]但是要是妈妈知道我说了这些，她肯定会把我骂得狗血淋头的！”

啊，没错。你肯定也能猜到，为什么一群女巫会对于纳雷瓦挑选出来的人感到有些紧张吧。

“对不起。
        |这里确实有各种各样令人惊叹的东西！我们这些常青女士族几个世纪以来一直生活在这个地区，会尽可能地收集各种物品并与外界进行交易。妈妈的展示厅里陈列着来自世界各地的珍品——比如贝尔哈兰的盔甲、特罗纳里族的青铜器，还有基苏洪族的护身符，等等。 还有她拥有的那些魔法书啊！哦，我知道外人其实是不被允许进入这个图书馆的，但试想一下：四面墙上都摆满了各种魔法书，而地板下面还藏着一些极其珍稀的物品……塞尼亚轻笑起来：“真的，这个地方的故事就是这样的。每一个角落都充满了魔力。每一块石头似乎都拥有自己的魔法，至少大多数时候都是这样感觉的。好消息是，这里空气中弥漫着大量的魔法，它们附着在每一样东西上。…这位母亲在魔法方面确实能够创造出一些令人惊叹的奇迹！那些通常需要一整个贝拉兰法师团才能完成的事情，仅仅依靠这座庄园里积累的以太能量，她就能独自完成。至少，我是这么认为的。 母亲对于这类事情自然会保持沉默——她说，这只是为了她的最后一个继承人。
    ]

rows.original:
You take a confident step forward, cupping Senja's cheek and guiding the young witch to face you full-on. Her red-gold eyes go wide as you draw closer, wrapping one arm around her willowy waist and holding her tight. Feeling her heart fluttering, you lean in and press your lips to hers, playing across the slender black mounds until they part with a gasp, permitting your tongue to slip between them. She all but melts into your arms, a little moan escaping her mouth as you play your wandering tongue across her own. You entwine them and push your body forward, enjoying the way her big tits squish up against your [pc.chest]. That's nice!
    
    When you finally break the kiss nearly a minute later, Senja is panting like a pup in heat, tail beating furiously behind her. You hadn't even noticed her own hands grabbing your [pc.butt]. 
    
    "You looked like you needed that," you say simply.
    
    Senja bites her lip, tail wagging. "I really, really did. In fact, I could use another... just to tide me over until the next one."
    
    Well, if she asks so nicely. You give the little 'nuki a gentle push back against one of the sandstone pillars, both hands on her cheeks now, and give her another long, deep kiss.
    
    Several of her sisters let out a concerted "Ohhhhhhh!" from all around the courtyard, which seems to finally break the spell and leave Senja blushing furiously, realizing that she's still very much in full view of the family.
    
    She whirls around to the younger tanukis and shouts "Shut up, brats! You're all just jealous!"
    
    "They should be," you tell her, giving her plump rear a playful grope. 
    
    Senja just blushes all the harder, but her tail wags like a puppy's.
rows.translation:
你自信地向前迈出一步，托起塞尼亚的脸颊，将这位年轻的女巫引向自己，让她完全面对自己。当你逐渐靠近时，她那红金色的眼睛瞪得大大的，你将一只手部臂环绕在她纤细的腰间，紧紧地将她抱在怀里。感受到她的心跳加速，你俯身将嘴唇贴在了她的唇上，轻轻触碰着她那柔软的黑色双唇，直到她轻轻喘息着将嘴唇分开，这时你的舌头便滑入了她的口中。 她几乎整个人都融进了你的怀抱中，当你用舌头轻轻触碰她的嘴唇时，她轻轻发出一声呻吟。你们紧紧相拥，你将身体向前倾，尽情享受着她那丰满的胸部紧贴着你的感觉 [pc.chest]太好了！”

将近一分钟后，当你们终于分开时，Senja已经像一只发情的小狗一样气喘吁吁，尾巴在身后拼命地摇动。你甚至都没有注意到她自己的手部一直在抓着你的手部。 [pc.butt]你看起来确实需要这个，”你简单地说道。

Senja咬了咬嘴唇，尾巴摇个不停：“我真的非常需要。事实上，我再要一个的话……应该能帮我撑到下一个东西到来吧。”

嗯，既然她这么诚恳地请求…… 你轻轻地将那个小女孩推到其中一根砂岩柱子上，此时你的双手部已经放在她的脸颊上，然后再次给了她一个漫长而深情的吻。

她的几个姐妹们从院子的各个角落同时发出了“哦哦哦哦哦！”的叫声，这一声似乎终于打破了这种尴尬的气氛，让Senja的脸颊变得通红，她这才意识到自己仍然完全处于家人的视线范围内。
    
    她转过身，对那些年纪较小的狸猫们大喊：“闭嘴，小鬼们！你们都是嫉妒而已！”

“他们确实应该嫉妒，”你对她说，同时调皮地摸了摸她圆润的臀部。

Senja的脸色变得更加红润了，但她的尾巴却像小狗一样欢快地摇动着。

The matron of the coven has surrounded herself with a magic circle drawn in chalk on the sandstone tiles, and just outside it has placed a pedestal on which a black leather-bound grimoire is laid open. The witch is in the middle of incanting a spell, taking great pains to speak slowly and clearly so that her myriad apprentices can follow along. She sweeps her black-clad hands around in exaggerated somatic gestures, tracing sigils in their air that each burn with residual magic for brief moments before she begins the next. Some of the girls are writing the symbols down in little journals or spellbooks of their own, but most of them — her fully-furred wards especially — just watch with slack-jawed awe as the spell comes together. With a final invocation, Evergreen thrusts her hands into the air and spreads them apart. When she brings them parallel with the ground, the witch strikes a pose and flexes, and where once there was a body voluptuous and chubby, you now see iron-hard muscle and bulging biceps. Just for a moment, the witch even has a six-pack visible under her fur! But it lasts just a moment before she dismisses it with a snap of her fingers, filling right back out to the shame pudgy shape you're familiar with. "Never be afraid to change yourself, girls," she says to the crowd. "Add a little muscle to defend yourself if someone tries to hurt you. Squeeze yourself into a smaller body if you need to hide or escape where a bigger hunter can't reach you. And of course, I'm sure you can all think of ways to use a little body-sculpting just for fun." The raccoon-girls all laugh — all save Senja, who's so busy scribbling in her one little spellbook she doesn't even notice her mother looming over her. "Ah, Senja, darling. You seem so focused on your work — let's stand you up and see a practical demonstration, shall we?" "W-what? Me?" Senja squeaks, glancing around like she expects to find another Senja sitting behind her. "But I've never-" Evergreen reaches down and hefts the younger 'nuki up, giving her a little push towards the circle. "Just do as I did, dear. Step into the circle, and repeat the invocation. Mind your gestures. Just as I taught you." The younger tanuki gets into position with a nervous whine, mimicking her mother's gestures and reading aloud from the open grimoire. After a few moment's hesitation, green lines of fire begin to follow her claws through the air as she forms the same sigils, incanting the same phrases as her mother had... ... until she sees you in the crowd watching her, anyway. Senja squeaks out a gasp of surprise between arcane syllables, and instantly the spell twists out of her control, sparks of wild magic flying around her. The very air seems to shimmer and vibrate with untapped, uncontrolled power. Some of her younger sisters scream and scamper back, terrified, but Lady Evergreen's already moving. She faster than she looks, breaching the magic circle before you've fully realized what's happening, and grabs Senja's around the waist — a much wider waist, now, replete with the same exaggerated thickness as her mother. In the blink of an eye, Senja's breasts have grown even larger than the elder Evergreen's, curves all overflowing through her fingers as she tries patting down her body — like she can stop the changes by squeezing herself back into shape. The voice telling you everything's going to be okay. Stop crying." Even as she's speaking, Evergreen's free hand is making a rapid-fire series of gestures, unraveling whatever it is that her daughter's done to herself. Her eyes glow too — just for a second, but the sight's seared into your mind all the same. The magic breaks under the witch's forceful counterspelling, snapping out of existence with an audible tear that leaves all your hairs standing on end — yours, and all the other electrified tanukis. Evergreen releases her daughter, eyes slowly fading back to their normal colors, if totally bloodshot. For her part, Senja collapses onto hands and knees, gasping as her body slowly retracts to its normal proportions. Her mother takes a knee beside her, gently stroking the younger witch's hair. "Polymorphing is very powerful magic, Senja, but it's also the most dangerous. Letting your focus wander when you're reshaping your own body can very well turn you to misshapen slush on the floor — and my daughter is much too precious to end up a stain, you understand me?" "Y-yes mother..." "And she's most certainly too pretty to be thinking she needs to look like an old, worn-out hag to catch a [pc.mf |man |woman ]. You're beautiful the way you are, love, inside and out. Far moreso than I've ever been. Anyone with eyes can see it." Senja's cheeks were already flushed with embarrassment, and now her eyes are starting to glisten. Evergreen tuts and picks her up, pulling her daughter into a uncharacteristically chaste embrace. "Now then, my dear. Your dress is all torn up. Go to your room and get cleaned and changed. Shout if you feel anything off." She pats Senja's head and sends her off towards the stairs, looking every bit both the proud mistress and concerned mother at once.

[evergreen.dealtWith
        |"Weeeellll... today's been a slow day, I've got to admit. There've been more people of late than there used to be when my mother was Lady Evergreen, but word has yet still to get out that there's a new mistress of this house — and that she's far more approachable than the previous one was."
        
        It takes a while for news to spread, so she doesn't have to worry about it. All Senja needs to do is keep on being the nice person that she is, and eventually she'll be able to drag herself out of her mother's shadow.
        
        "Aanyway. If you want to get up to something, it's not as if I've got anything better to do at the moment," Senja says, giving you a wink that's clearly meant to be sultry but ends up being more cute than anything. "Come on, let's show each other what we're made of."
        |"Weeeelll... not that many people have dropped by today for me to try selling anything. More and more people have been coming of late to ask for Mother's help given the local troubles out there, but today's been in a bit of a dry spell for some reason. Oh well, so long as I don't have to go out there by myself — Meira keeps on telling me that it's getting more and more dangerous despite the wall of thorns Mother's put up to protect us."
        
        So, you take it all of the above was just a roundabout way of saying that she's free?
        
        Senja huffs a little and crosses her arms over her bosom, but can't hold the pouty face and breaks into a smile after a couple of moments. "Yes, yes, I'm free indeed. Let me close up the little shop and we can show each other what we're made of, okay?"
    ]
    
    Mm-hm... 
    
    "Now then, let's get ourselves a little more private and away from my nosy sisters." [party.hasCompanions
        | Smiling her best smile, Senja turns to [party.compNames]. "If you don't mind giving us a moment, please? I'll return [pc.name] to you in one piece — in the meantime, why don't you let my sisters entertain [party.manyCompanions
            |the two of 
        ]you?"
    ]
    
    Numerous giggles and excited exclamations burst out from the floor as Senja's sisters gather to watch the two of you go; you take her hand in yours and lead her up the steps to a multitude of cheers and catcalls alike. Following your lead, Senja lets you bring her up to her old room amongst the many that branch off from the second story corridor. Pushing open one of the finely carved doors, you sweep her in and kick the door shut, gently brushing away several stray strands of hair from her eyes with your fingers.
    
    [evergreen.dealtWith
        |Ah, even though she's Lady Evergreen now, she's never going to move into her mother's old quarters, is she?
        
        Senja bites her lip and shakes her head. "No. Even though she's... she's no longer the Lady Evergreen of this house, there's still too much of Mom left in her chambers for me to ever dream of filling her shoes that way. I don't want them, not ever. Besides, I like this place — it's where I had my first time with you, right?
        
        Ah... you'd had her pegged for a romantic, but this is truly taking it out of you.
    ]
    
    "Well then... shall we begin?"
    
    Of course. You lean in close and get a good whiff of Senja's dark hair, then reach over to peel her strapless black dress off her body. The softness of your 'nuki paramour's form spills out as you free it from its constraints, rolling out into its more pear-y natural shape once the corset isn't there to hold the hourglass together. Senja sighs appreciatively as she plops down on the bed and watches you undress, eyes roving hungrily over your body as you strip out of your [pc.armor] and let your gear fall to the carpeted floor with her slinky black dress.
    
    Ah, the entire room smells of Senja... not just the makeup and perfume, but other, warmer scents that stoke one's appetite. Feeling your gaze fall upon her, Senja turns her eyes away from you and bites her lip, clearly waiting for you to make the first move.
    
    Well then, it's up to you to take the initiative here...

rows.original: Sometimes, the simple is the best. The river just south of her place is nice and pleasant, and it's safe and not too far from her home to boot. The point of going out is to be with each other, after all.
rows.translation: 有时候，简单才是最好的选择。她住处南边的那条河非常优美，环境宜人，而且离她家也不远，很安全。毕竟，外出的目的就是为了陪伴彼此啊。
rows.raw: "Sometimes, the simple is the best. The river just south of her place is nice and pleasant, and it's safe and not too far from her home to boot. The point of going out is to be with each other, after all."

rows.original: Take Senja out to the Wayfort for a spin and show it off to her.
rows.translation: 带森雅去荒废驿堡赛道试驾一番，让她看看你的车技吧。
rows.raw: "Take Senja out to the Wayfort for a spin and show it off to her."

rows.original: The wayfort's a bit of a dump at the moment, and taking Senja there wouldn't give her the best impression of you as its owner.
rows.translation: 目前，这个据点有点破败不堪，如果带森雅去那里，她肯定不会对你作为这个据点的主人留下好印象。
rows.raw: "The wayfort's a bit of a dump at the moment, and taking Senja there wouldn't give her the best impression of you as its owner."

rows.original: "O-oh!" Senja pipes up all of a sudden. "I'd like to show you the river just down from our house! You've probably crossed the old stone bridge many a time... but you don't wander along the banks much, do you?" You were just thinking the same thing, but it's interesting to see her be assertive and proactive for a change. "Well, you did the hard bit of actually asking me out, so I might as well take your mind off the matter of where we should go. Do you mind if I get some things ready?" Of course not. Senja closes up her little shop and wanders off further into the mansion, and you spend the next handful of moments [party.hasCompanions |letting [party.compNames] know that you'll be out with Senja for a while, and to expect your return by sundown; you're sure that the Evergreens will be more than happy to play host while you tend to Senja |enduring the attentions of the gaggle of Senja's sisters who've come to gawk and giggle at her predicament. You pat one on the head, tug at another's tail, then shoo them off; they scatter, giggling all the while ]. Soon enough, Senja returns from the mansion's halls with a large covered basket in one arm and a case in the other; without waiting, she hooks her arm into the crook of yours and gives you an impatient tug. "Let's be off, shall we?" Alas, you don't manage to leave the mansion unimpeded — waiting at the door is the [evergreen.dealtWith |Grinning, hang-wringing form of Meira herself, standing in the doorway with a cheeky smirk on her face. She doesn't even bother to disguise her impishness as you approach, giving the both of you a pleasant little wave. "Ooooh. Senja's going on a date." "Well, if you weren't such a pest I'm sure you'd actually be able to have someone to take you out too, Meira." "Mmmmmh. I'm working on it. But you should really get out more, what with being the big and important Lady Evergreen and all. Have a lovely little roll in the flowers with [pc.name] here — you need to let people know you're the new Lady Evergreen, after all. We're going to need to marry off all our sisters eventually, you know; they can't live with us forever." Is there a point to this entire conversation, or are the sisters just going to needle each other all the way to the bank? Meira tsks. "All I'm asking is for you two lovebirds to take care of each other and keep yourselves safe. It'd be terrible if something happened to you, big sis, and I was left in charge of all these cottonheads for the rest of their lives." "Tch." A shrug. "And remember, come home by sundown and in time for dinner, or it'll get cold." "You're starting to sound like Mom did, Meira." "Just buzz off already and go make out in the bushes. Someday I'll be the one walking out the door with a date." |chubby, motherly form of Oxana herself, standing by the doorway with her arms folded. She eyes the both of you with he usual pleasant smile, then gives you an upnod as you draw near. "My, my, if it isn't [pc.name] and my little Senja. Off to have a little private romp, aren't you?" "Mom!" "No, no, it's good for you to get out more." Oxana's smile widens. "Many of my daughters just hang around the house all day and don't get to meet people besides the occasional adventurer who comes looking for work or the poor souls who fall upon my doorstep seeking solutions to their myriad problems. Poor things often don't know what to do after I marry them off. "All I'm asking is for you two to take care of each other while you're out of my sight... and remember your poor loveless mother once in a while when you're out there, hmm?" "Yes, Mom." Oxana waggles a finger at Senja's petulant tone. "And remember, come home by sundown and in time for dinner. You know what happens to naughty daughters who stay out in the woods for too long." "Yes, Mom." "Good, good. Off with you, then, and enjoy yourselves." ]
