rows.original: The trip out of the mansion's yard and to the riverbank pathways is uneventful. Senja does look a little out of place in the wilderness with her little black dress on — isn't she worried it'll get torn or dirty in the thick underbrush? — but sticks close to you as you forge your way forward, her body always pressed to your side, warm and reassuring. Eventually, the trees thin and the riverbank draws into view with the old stone bridge off to one side in the distance, and you lead Senja along the forest trail and into a clearing by the stony riverbank. The place's been peaceful ever since you dealt with the Alraune, the air full of floral scents and clean smells; hugging her case and basket close to her, Senja takes deep lungfuls of the blossoms' fragrance, sighing in satisfaction each time she exhales, her impressive bosom rising and falling with an undeniably alluring curvature to it. Senja's in her usual good mood today, humming a little ditty in the back of her throat as you find a fallen log and she spreads out a cloth nearby. Unpacking the basket with one hand and setting down the case with the other, there's a definite spring in Senja's step as she puts out the spread. What is up with her? "Oh, nothing," she replies airily. "I just feel particularly inspired this day." You wonder if there's more to it than that, but her cheery demeanor is infectious, and it's hard to stay moody at her for long, if at all. The area by the water's edge is muted, the Frostwood's thick canopy blocking out much of the light, save for a few shafts which illuminate the undergrowth; there's a smell in the air — not sweet, but not unpleasant, either, the smell of clean water and green growing things. All in all, it's a peaceful place. Senja senses it, too, dusting off a spot on the log and gathering her skirts before sitting down and opening up the little case to draw out a violin and bow. Brushing back her messy black hair, Senja stares into the rushing water of the river as she begins to play. "Ah, blessed solitude. With just you and me..." Settling down on the grass yourself, you rest your back against a nearby tree and enjoy the music for a little bit. At a glance, one wouldn't have figured Senja for the kind to play classical music like this, but now that she's doing it the act fits her so completely and naturally. "Come on, don't be shy. These are just leftovers from breakfast — I was going to tell my sisters to recycle them for dinner, but since you came around..." You look at the spread laid out on the cloth and shake your head. A stack of lightly fried flatbreads, a little cold mincemeat and some apple preserve mixed with wild honey in a tiny jar. It looks like the sort of thing someone reasonably wealthy would eat for breakfast — someone like a witch of the woods, that is. A couple of simple clay cups complete the ensemble, which you fill with clear, fresh water from a canteen. "[evergreen.dealtWith |Well, whatever else Mom did, she took good care of my sisters. Now that she's not capable of doing so, I feel like I should do the same, and part of that is serving the same kinds of meals she used to do before... before I became Lady Evergreen in her stead |Well, Mom likes to have good, rich food, and all of us do as well. Except Meira — she's a little weird that way, which is why she's so thin and underfed. Strange girl, but I'm not going to about to force her. It's one of the perks of living with Mom, which is why so many are loathe to leave ]. Besides, you don't think I got this kind of body by eating porridge and boiled turnips all day, do you? Even after all this, there're a lot of leftovers..." Well, she should have some herself; a big girl like her needs to keep her strength up, of course. Senja blushes as you tear off bits off the morsels and feed her even as she plays — you can tell she's missing a note here and there, going off-key while you distract her — but the food is quite decent. It's certainly of the savoury kind a secretly wealthy witch of the woods would conjure for herself, if nothing else... Senja squirms a bit as you cozy up to her on the log, resting your head on her thigh and gathering her thigh tail about your [pc.chest] and [pc.belly] staring up into her face as she plays. [rand |[evergreen.dealtWith |So, now that she's Lady Evergreen... "No, no children yet as much as I may want any. Not for a little while until I've gotten my sisters sorted out. They'll be good practice for when I actually do have some of my own." Oh? Senja nods and continues playing. "What Mother did to many of them is unforgivable; they may have fully-grown bodies, but many of them have impaired minds that were prepared as vessels. I... think I can fix them. Not fully, but enough that they can live semi-independent lives with someone else. Once that's done, then I can think about my own needs." |So, does she think she'll leave her mother's household someday? "The if isn't really a question," comes the reply. "The only problems lie with the when and how." Oh? Many would consider Oxana's place an idyllic haven that no one would ever want to leave. Room, board, the ability to do mostly what you please all day... beautiful surroundings at the height of decadence... "Ah... but she is the only one who is to have children under that roof. I have sisters, but no nieces. That, and what she does to... never mind. Suffice to say that I would like to have some in the future. "I know it's expected that mothers and daughters will argue, as will fathers and sons, but our disagreements have been going on for a very long time, [pc.name]. I have always sought to give Mom all the respect due her station, but I cannot help but get the impression that she resents me after a fashion. Worst of all, I don't know why, and can't even prove it. I don't have anything concrete, and it's awful to suspect Mom on just a gut feeling." ] |Has she ever thought about what she wants to achieve in the future? "[evergreen.dealtWith |Everything's just changed so quickly, it's hard to tell. I guess I'm still getting used to all this; it feels like yesterday that Mom was around running the show, and now..." She's not her mother. "I guess that's the important thing, that and letting everyone know about it. It can't be too hard to let people know that there's a new witch of the woods... never mind about the last one. It feel trite to say that she's gone to a better place... but that's technically true, isn't it? I guess I just need to repair the reputation that Mom had; people in the area know me more thanks to me getting around, I just need to get them to associate as much. Guess that's my goal, if you can call it one." |I... I don't know, really. Run some kind of shop, I suppose? I know there's a lot more to running an actual business than what I'm doing right now — securing stock, keeping inventory, doing things beyond hawking stuff I find in the forest to people. I know something of basic alchemy and spells, so I could do around peddling those for a small fee... that is, if Mom doesn't decide to marry me off to someone first." She does that? "Oh yes. All my sisters who've been married off have had reasonable lives... people who mistreat my sisters aren't long for this world, as Mom puts it herself. Put the fear of the gods in them or somesuch... it's not a bad life, but... I don't know. I need to count my blessings, I guess; some people out there don't even have food to eat and a warm place to sleep at night. Right now, I just need to think about getting capital to stock a shop or something." ] |Hmm, a question, if she doesn't think it's too intrusive... Senja doesn't miss a beat while playing. "If I thought that poorly of you, [pc.name], I wouldn't have agreed to go on a date in the first place, would I?" Well, there's some truth to that, but even so. She rolls her eyes, but smile as she does so. "Go on, ask. I won't bite." What does she think of you? "Ah, I see why you think I might be bothered by that. Well, you're decent company, otherwise like I just said, I wouldn't have agreed to take off with you into the forest, would I?" Well, that's true. "Relax, [pc.name]. Once you know you're decent enough, there's no need to constantly worry about what other people think of you. I used to see things the same way... and then Meira cured me of that right quick. If you must have flattery — you're rather pleasant company, and are possessed of an appreciation for the finer things, which is important. Here by the riverside, eating simple yet sincere food and listening to an amateur musician dabble with her violin — how could one say otherwise? And what does it tell her about you? "That you're someone I don't mind accompanying on a day trip into the forest." That's the third time she's saying that. Senja hums a few notes along with her violin and smiles. "Maybe. Perhaps. Could be." Oh great, now she's being cheeky. |Not really wanting to spoil the mood by saying anything, you settle down and listen to Senja play. The river's constant roar is clearly having an effect on your date's choice of music, the notes that rise from her fingers are quick and fluid on the surface, but possessed of a deep, slow undercurrent that tugs gently at your mind, shifting it along a dark riverbed to parts unknown... Clear and vital, like the river itself. Energetic and brilliant all around, yet with its own depths for the discerning. Oxana doesn't look like the kind to have dabbled in music of this sort, so one can only wonder who taught Senja to play, and when. You come to some moments later with Senja closing the tune with a series of chords — with the music being as flowing as it was, you must've been carried away and dozed off sometime in all of that. Senja herself either hasn't noticed or doesn't care, for she closes her music with a finishing flourish, the last notes lingering in the air before they fade into the roar of the river. ] "I think that's enough for now. Why don't we finish off the rest of this food, and we can head back home?"
rows.translation: 从宅邸的庭院出发，沿着河岸的小路前行，一路上并没有发生任何意外。不过，Senja穿着那条黑色的小裙子，在荒野中确实显得有些格格不入——她难道不担心裙子会在茂密的灌木丛中被撕破或弄脏吗？ ——但在你前行的道路上，它始终紧贴着你，它的身体始终紧贴在你的身旁，温暖而令人安心。最终，树木逐渐稀疏，河岸也出现在视线中，远处那座古老的石桥隐约可见。你带着森雅沿着森林小径前行，最终来到河岸边的一片空地上。 自从你解决了阿尔劳恩的问题之后，这个地方就恢复了宁静，空气中弥漫着花香与清新的气息。森贾紧紧抱着她的包裹和篮子，深深地吸着那些花朵散发出的芬芳，每次呼气时都会满意地叹息一声，她那令人瞩目的胸部随之起伏，展现出一种无可否认的诱惑力。 今天，森雅的心情一如既往地好，她轻声哼着小曲。你找到一根倒下的原木，而她则在旁边铺开一块布。她一只手打开篮子，另一只手放下那个箱子，动作里充满了活力，随后她开始摆放那些食物。 什么？ 是 她怎么了？ “哦，没什么，”她轻松地回答道，“只是今天觉得特别有灵感而已。” 你怀疑其中肯定还有别的原因，但她的开朗态度实在很有感染力，很难长时间保持坏心情，甚至根本无法保持坏心情。 水边的区域显得昏暗朦胧，霜林茂密的树冠遮挡了大部分轻型线，只有几道轻型线穿透树叶，照亮了下面的灌木丛；空气中弥漫着一种气味——既不甜美，也不难闻，那是清水的味道，还有绿色植物散发出的气息。 总的来说，这是一个宁静的地方。Senja也感受到了这一点。她擦去木头上的一层灰尘，整理好裙摆，然后坐下来，打开那个小盒子，取出了小提琴和琴弓。她把凌乱的黑色头发拨到后面，凝视着河中湍急的水流，开始演奏起来。 啊，多么美好的独处时轻型。只有你和我……” 你自己也坐在草地上，背靠着附近的树木，静静地聆听这段音乐。乍一看，人们很难想到Senja会喜欢演奏这样的古典音乐，但此刻，她这样做显得如此自然、得体。 来吧，别害羞。这些不过是早餐剩下的食物而已——我本来打算让姐妹们把它们重新利用来做晚餐，但既然你来了……” 你看着铺在布上的那些食物，摇了摇头。 一堆轻轻煎过的薄饼，少许已经变凉的肉末，还有装在一个小罐子里、用野生蜂蜜调味的苹果酱。看起来这种早餐应该是那些相当富有的人会吃的——比如森林里的女巫之类的。 几个简单的陶制杯子就组成了这套用具，你可以用从水壶里取来的清澈新鲜的水来装满它们。 "[evergreen.dealtWith |嗯，不管妈妈还做了些什么，她确实把我的姐妹们照顾得很好。现在她已经无法再这么做了，我觉得自己也应该承担起这个责任，其中一部分就是继续准备那些她以前经常做的饭菜……在我就取代她成为“常青女士”之前。 |嗯，妈妈总是喜欢吃那些美味丰盛的食物，我们其他人也是这样。不过梅拉除外——她在这一点上有点与众不同，正因为如此，她才会那么瘦，营养也严重不足。真是个奇怪的女孩……但我也不会强迫她改变。能和妈妈一起生活，就是这种便利之一，也正因如此，才会有那么多人不愿意离开她。 ]再说，你难道认为我整天吃粥和煮萝卜就能拥有这样的身材吗？即便吃了这么多，还是会有很多剩菜……” “嗯，她自己也应该吃点吧；像她这样的年轻女孩，当然需要保持体力啊。 当你一边撕下那些小块食物喂她，一边让她继续玩耍时，Senja的脸颊微微泛红——你可以看出，有时候她的动作会不太协调，发音也会走调，但当你转移她的注意力时，她还是能够顺利地进食。这些食物确实相当不错，如果是某个隐秘富有的森林女巫为自己准备的食物，那肯定属于美味可口的那一类。当你依偎在木头上，把头靠在她的腿上，同时把她的大腿围在自己身上时，Senja有些不自在地扭动了一下。 [pc.chest] 以及 [pc.belly] 在她玩游戏的时候，我抬头凝视着她的脸。 [rand |[evergreen.dealtWith |所以，现在她已经成为常青女士夫人了…… “不，虽然我很想要孩子，但现在还不行。在我把我的姐妹们安排妥当之前，暂时还不适合要孩子。等我把她们的问题都解决了，再要孩子也会更容易一些。哦？” Senja点了点头，继续玩游戏。“母亲对他们的所作所为确实不可原谅；虽然他们的身体已经发育完全，但他们的智力却受到了损害，他们只不过是被当作容器而已。 我想……我能够修复它们。虽然不能完全修复，但至少能让它们能够在与他人共同生活的过程中保持一定的独立性。等这些都解决了，我再考虑自己的需求吧。 |那么，她是不是认为自己有朝一日会离开母亲的家呢？ 如果 其实这并不是一个真正的问题，”得到的回答是，“唯一需要考虑的只是时间和方式而已。” 哦？对很多人来说，奥克萨娜提供的这个地方简直就是个理想的避风港，没有人会想要离开那里。有吃有住，而且一整天都可以做自己想做的事情。……处于衰落巅峰时期的美丽环境…… “啊……但只有她才能在那栋房子里生孩子。我虽然有姐妹，但没有侄女。再加上她所做的那些事……我知道人们都认为母女之间、父子之间会经常发生争执，但我们的矛盾其实已经持续了很长时间了 [pc.name]我一直努力给予母亲应有的尊重，符合她的身份地位，但我总觉得，她在某种程度上对我怀有怨恨。最糟糕的是，我不知道原因，也无法证明这一点。我没有任何确凿的证据，仅仅凭直觉就怀疑母亲，这种感觉实在令人难受。 ] |她有没有想过自己未来想要实现什么目标？[evergreen.dealtWith |一切都变化得太快了，简直让人难以适应。我想我还在努力适应这一切吧；感觉就像昨天妈妈还在这里掌管一切，而现在……” 她已经不再是原来的妈妈了。 “我想这才是最重要的，还有要让所有人都知道这一点。这件事绝对不能被忽视。 太 真的很难让人们知道，又有一位新的森林女巫出现了……至于上一位女巫，就更不用说了。说她去了一个更好的地方，这种话听起来有点老套……但从技术上讲，这话确实是事实，不是吗？我想我只需要恢复妈妈以前的声誉罢了；多走动一下，这个地区的人们已经开始认识我了，现在只需要让他们更多地把我和妈妈联系起来就可以了。我想，如果可以称之为目标的话，这就是我的目标吧。 |我……其实我也不太清楚。大概就是经营某种店铺吧？我知道，真正经营一家企业所需要的东西，远比我现在所做的这些要多得多——比如确保有足够的库存、管理货物数量，还有许多其他需要处理的事情，而不仅仅是在森林里找到东西然后卖给别人而已。 我对基础炼金术和法术略知一二，所以我可以靠这些东西来赚取一些小收入……当然，前提是妈妈不会先把我嫁给别人。 哦，没错。我那些已经出嫁的姐妹们都过上了不错的生活……用妈妈自己的话来说，那些虐待我姐妹们的人都不会有好下场。就是让他们害怕神明之类的……虽然生活不算差，但…….. 我也不知道。我想，我应该珍惜自己所拥有的一切；因为世界上还有很多人连食物都没有，晚上也没有地方取暖睡觉。现在，我只需要考虑如何筹集资金来开一家店之类的了。" ] |嗯，有个问题……如果她不觉得这太过分的话…… 森雅玩游戏时丝毫不拖沓：“如果我真那么看待你的话 [pc.name]要不是这样，我一开始就不会同意去约会的，对吧？” 嗯，这话也有点道理，不过即便如此…… 她翻了个白眼，但嘴角还是带着笑：“快问吧。 我不会咬人的。” 那么，她对你有什么看法呢？ “啊，现在我明白你为什么觉得我会因此感到困扰了。嗯，你确实是个不错的伴儿，否则就像我刚才说的，我也不会同意和你一起进入森林的，对吧？嗯，确实是这样。 “放松点， [pc.name]一旦你确信自己的能力已经足够好了，就无需再过分在意别人对你的看法。我曾经也是这么想的……直到梅拉很快改变了我的这种想法。 如果你非得听些奉承话的话——那你确实是个很不错的伴侣，而且你懂得欣赏那些美好的事物，这一点非常重要。 就坐在这河畔，品尝着简单而真挚的食物，听着一位业余音乐家用小提琴演奏着动听的旋律——还有什么理由不感到满足呢？ 那么，这究竟说明了你是什么样的人呢？ “这说明你是一个我愿意陪着一起去森林里度过一天的人。这已经是她第三次这么说啦。 Senja一边拉小提琴，一边轻哼着几声曲调，然后笑了起来：“也许吧。有可能……也说不定。” 哦，太好了，现在她又开始调皮捣蛋了。 |你并不想说些什么破坏这种氛围，于是便安静地坐下来，聆听Senja的演奏。河流持续的咆哮声显然影响了她选择的音乐风格——她指尖弹奏出的音符表面听起来轻快流畅，但却蕴含着一种深沉而缓慢的韵律，这种韵律轻轻牵引着你的思绪，将它们引向那条未知的暗影河床。清澈而充满活力，就像这条河流本身一样。整体上充满能量与轻型彩，同时又隐藏着只有细心观察才能发现的深度。奥克萨娜看起来并不像是会涉足这类音乐的人，因此人们不禁会好奇，究竟是谁在什么时候教会了谢尼亚如何演奏这种音乐。 过了一会儿，Senja用一连串的和弦为这首曲子画上了句号。由于音乐本身就非常流畅，你在聆听的过程中肯定不知不觉地陷入了沉思，甚至打起了瞌睡。Senja本人要么没有注意到这一点，要么根本不在意，因为她以一段华丽的结尾乐段结束了演奏，最后的音符在空气中回荡片刻，随后便被河流的咆哮声所淹没。 ] 我想现在这样就够了。我们把剩下的食物吃完，然后就可以回家了吧？
rows.raw: " The trip out of the mansion's yard and to the riverbank pathways is uneventful. Senja does look a little out of place in the wilderness with her little black dress on — isn't she worried it'll get torn or dirty in the thick underbrush? — but sticks close to you as you forge your way forward, her body always pressed to your side, warm and reassuring. Eventually, the trees thin and the riverbank draws into view with the old stone bridge off to one side in the distance, and you lead Senja along the forest trail and into a clearing by the stony riverbank. The place's been peaceful ever since you dealt with the Alraune, the air full of floral scents and clean smells; hugging her case and basket close to her, Senja takes deep lungfuls of the blossoms' fragrance, sighing in satisfaction each time she exhales, her impressive bosom rising and falling with an undeniably alluring curvature to it. Senja's in her usual good mood today, humming a little ditty in the back of her throat as you find a fallen log and she spreads out a cloth nearby. Unpacking the basket with one hand and setting down the case with the other, there's a definite spring in Senja's step as she puts out the spread. What is up with her? "Oh, nothing," she replies airily. "I just feel particularly inspired this day." You wonder if there's more to it than that, but her cheery demeanor is infectious, and it's hard to stay moody at her for long, if at all. The area by the water's edge is muted, the Frostwood's thick canopy blocking out much of the light, save for a few shafts which illuminate the undergrowth; there's a smell in the air — not sweet, but not unpleasant, either, the smell of clean water and green growing things. All in all, it's a peaceful place. Senja senses it, too, dusting off a spot on the log and gathering her skirts before sitting down and opening up the little case to draw out a violin and bow. Brushing back her messy black hair, Senja stares into the rushing water of the river as she begins to play. "Ah, blessed solitude. With just you and me..." Settling down on the grass yourself, you rest your back against a nearby tree and enjoy the music for a little bit. At a glance, one wouldn't have figured Senja for the kind to play classical music like this, but now that she's doing it the act fits her so completely and naturally. "Come on, don't be shy. These are just leftovers from breakfast — I was going to tell my sisters to recycle them for dinner, but since you came around..." You look at the spread laid out on the cloth and shake your head. A stack of lightly fried flatbreads, a little cold mincemeat and some apple preserve mixed with wild honey in a tiny jar. It looks like the sort of thing someone reasonably wealthy would eat for breakfast — someone like a witch of the woods, that is. A couple of simple clay cups complete the ensemble, which you fill with clear, fresh water from a canteen. "[evergreen.dealtWith |Well, whatever else Mom did, she took good care of my sisters. Now that she's not capable of doing so, I feel like I should do the same, and part of that is serving the same kinds of meals she used to do before... before I became Lady Evergreen in her stead |Well, Mom likes to have good, rich food, and all of us do as well. Except Meira — she's a little weird that way, which is why she's so thin and underfed. Strange girl, but I'm not going to about to force her. It's one of the perks of living with Mom, which is why so many are loathe to leave ]. Besides, you don't think I got this kind of body by eating porridge and boiled turnips all day, do you? Even after all this, there're a lot of leftovers..." Well, she should have some herself; a big girl like her needs to keep her strength up, of course. Senja blushes as you tear off bits off the morsels and feed her even as she plays — you can tell she's missing a note here and there, going off-key while you distract her — but the food is quite decent. It's certainly of the savoury kind a secretly wealthy witch of the woods would conjure for herself, if nothing else... Senja squirms a bit as you cozy up to her on the log, resting your head on her thigh and gathering her thigh tail about your [pc.chest] and [pc.belly] staring up into her face as she plays. [rand |[evergreen.dealtWith |So, now that she's Lady Evergreen... "No, no children yet as much as I may want any. Not for a little while until I've gotten my sisters sorted out. They'll be good practice for when I actually do have some of my own." Oh? Senja nods and continues playing. "What Mother did to many of them is unforgivable; they may have fully-grown bodies, but many of them have impaired minds that were prepared as vessels. I... think I can fix them. Not fully, but enough that they can live semi-independent lives with someone else. Once that's done, then I can think about my own needs." |So, does she think she'll leave her mother's household someday? "The if isn't really a question," comes the reply. "The only problems lie with the when and how." Oh? Many would consider Oxana's place an idyllic haven that no one would ever want to leave. Room, board, the ability to do mostly what you please all day... beautiful surroundings at the height of decadence... "Ah... but she is the only one who is to have children under that roof. I have sisters, but no nieces. That, and what she does to... never mind. Suffice to say that I would like to have some in the future. "I know it's expected that mothers and daughters will argue, as will fathers and sons, but our disagreements have been going on for a very long time, [pc.name]. I have always sought to give Mom all the respect due her station, but I cannot help but get the impression that she resents me after a fashion. Worst of all, I don't know why, and can't even prove it. I don't have anything concrete, and it's awful to suspect Mom on just a gut feeling." ] |Has she ever thought about what she wants to achieve in the future? "[evergreen.dealtWith |Everything's just changed so quickly, it's hard to tell. I guess I'm still getting used to all this; it feels like yesterday that Mom was around running the show, and now..." She's not her mother. "I guess that's the important thing, that and letting everyone know about it. It can't be too hard to let people know that there's a new witch of the woods... never mind about the last one. It feel trite to say that she's gone to a better place... but that's technically true, isn't it? I guess I just need to repair the reputation that Mom had; people in the area know me more thanks to me getting around, I just need to get them to associate as much. Guess that's my goal, if you can call it one." |I... I don't know, really. Run some kind of shop, I suppose? I know there's a lot more to running an actual business than what I'm doing right now — securing stock, keeping inventory, doing things beyond hawking stuff I find in the forest to people. I know something of basic alchemy and spells, so I could do around peddling those for a small fee... that is, if Mom doesn't decide to marry me off to someone first." She does that? "Oh yes. All my sisters who've been married off have had reasonable lives... people who mistreat my sisters aren't long for this world, as Mom puts it herself. Put the fear of the gods in them or somesuch... it's not a bad life, but... I don't know. I need to count my blessings, I guess; some people out there don't even have food to eat and a warm place to sleep at night. Right now, I just need to think about getting capital to stock a shop or something." ] |Hmm, a question, if she doesn't think it's too intrusive... Senja doesn't miss a beat while playing. "If I thought that poorly of you, [pc.name], I wouldn't have agreed to go on a date in the first place, would I?" Well, there's some truth to that, but even so. She rolls her eyes, but smile as she does so. "Go on, ask. I won't bite." What does she think of you? "Ah, I see why you think I might be bothered by that. Well, you're decent company, otherwise like I just said, I wouldn't have agreed to take off with you into the forest, would I?" Well, that's true. "Relax, [pc.name]. Once you know you're decent enough, there's no need to constantly worry about what other people think of you. I used to see things the same way... and then Meira cured me of that right quick. If you must have flattery — you're rather pleasant company, and are possessed of an appreciation for the finer things, which is important. Here by the riverside, eating simple yet sincere food and listening to an amateur musician dabble with her violin — how could one say otherwise? And what does it tell her about you? "That you're someone I don't mind accompanying on a day trip into the forest." That's the third time she's saying that. Senja hums a few notes along with her violin and smiles. "Maybe. Perhaps. Could be." Oh great, now she's being cheeky. |Not really wanting to spoil the mood by saying anything, you settle down and listen to Senja play. The river's constant roar is clearly having an effect on your date's choice of music, the notes that rise from her fingers are quick and fluid on the surface, but possessed of a deep, slow undercurrent that tugs gently at your mind, shifting it along a dark riverbed to parts unknown... Clear and vital, like the river itself. Energetic and brilliant all around, yet with its own depths for the discerning. Oxana doesn't look like the kind to have dabbled in music of this sort, so one can only wonder who taught Senja to play, and when. You come to some moments later with Senja closing the tune with a series of chords — with the music being as flowing as it was, you must've been carried away and dozed off sometime in all of that. Senja herself either hasn't noticed or doesn't care, for she closes her music with a finishing flourish, the last notes lingering in the air before they fade into the roar of the river. ] "I think that's enough for now. Why don't we finish off the rest of this food, and we can head back home?" "

rows.original: Ah, yes. Despite the two of you having pecked at the contents of Senja's hamper throughout all this, there's still a little left over — you may have had something while listening to Senja play, but your date's appetite is always good. This has to be different from how she has meals at home, right? Eating with so many sisters at the table has to be a bit of a hassle. Senja blushes a bit. "[evergreen.dealtWith |Well, it's one of Mom's habits that I've seen fit to preserve. Everyone about the long table... it gives us a bit of our old normality back, and everyone needs that, even me. Turning up for mealtimes gives us structure to our day, and more importantly, it keeps us sisters together until we've righted ourselves from Mom's... loss. "Still, it feels weird to be the one at the head of the table in her place... I can't bear to seat myself in her old chair, we've put that away and instead replaced it with my old one. The important thing is that everyone eats together, everyone knows where they're supposed to be, and everyone's there for each other. I — ah |Well, that's not wrong... we've got this long table in the dining hall, you see, long enough to seat everyone, and everyone's expected to head in for mealtimes." Everyone? A nod. "Everyone, Mom included — no, Mom especially. No acceptable excuses save for being deathly sick, or something like that; if Mom can make time to be at the table, so can you. She always sits at the head of the table, then with the oldest sisters down, all the way to the foot... everyone knows where they're supposed to be, and Mom says the important thing is that everyone eats together. If someone's missing, their empty seat sticks out like a sore thumb, and — ah ]!" Senja's face falls as she realizes what she's just done — speaking to you means she wasn't paying that much attention to where she was dipping her flatbread, and went ahead and stained her fingers with the jam. "Oh, bother..." Hmm, does this give you any ideas?
rows.translation: 啊，没错。虽然你们俩在整个过程中一直在吃Senja带来的食物，但应该还剩下一些吧——也许在听Senja演奏的时候你们也吃了一点，不过你的约会对象向来食欲很好。这肯定和她在家里吃饭的情况不一样吧？和这么多姐妹一起坐在桌前吃饭，肯定会有点麻烦吧。 Senja的脸微微红了。[evergreen.dealtWith |嗯，这是妈妈的一些习惯，我认为这些习惯值得保留。围坐在长桌旁的大家……这种氛围让我们重新找回了一些昔日的平常感，而每个人都需要这样的感觉，包括我。按时吃饭为我们的日常生活带来了规律性，更重要的是，它能让我们姐妹们团结在一起，直到我们摆脱妈妈带来的那些影响…… 损失不过，坐在她原来的位置上主持这个聚会，还是感觉有点奇怪……我实在不忍心坐到她以前的那把椅子上，我们把那把椅子收起来了，换成了我的旧椅子。最重要的是，大家能够一起吃饭，每个人都知道自己应该坐在哪里，而且大家都能相互陪伴。我——啊 |嗯，这么说也没错……我们餐厅里有一张很长的桌子，足够让所有人坐下吃饭，而且大家都应该在吃饭时间来吃饭。 所有人？ 他点了点头：“所有人，包括妈妈——不，除了妈妈。 尤其是除了病得重得无法动弹之外，没有什么借口是能被接受的；如果妈妈都能抽时间坐到餐桌旁，你当然也可以。她总是坐在餐桌的首席位置，然后长姐们依次坐在她的两侧，直到餐桌的尽头……每个人都知道自己应该坐在哪里，妈妈也总是强调，最重要的是大家能一起吃饭。如果有人缺席，他们空着的座位就会像一根突兀的指头一样，显得格外显眼——啊，真是让人心里不好受。 ]当森雅意识到自己刚刚做了什么时，她的脸色立刻沉了下来——原来她和你说话的时候，根本没有注意自己把平底面包蘸到什么地方，结果手指上沾满了果酱。 “哦，真麻烦……” 嗯，这个情况会不会让你想到什么呢？
rows.raw: " Ah, yes. Despite the two of you having pecked at the contents of Senja's hamper throughout all this, there's still a little left over — you may have had something while listening to Senja play, but your date's appetite is always good. This has to be different from how she has meals at home, right? Eating with so many sisters at the table has to be a bit of a hassle. Senja blushes a bit. "[evergreen.dealtWith |Well, it's one of Mom's habits that I've seen fit to preserve. Everyone about the long table... it gives us a bit of our old normality back, and everyone needs that, even me. Turning up for mealtimes gives us structure to our day, and more importantly, it keeps us sisters together until we've righted ourselves from Mom's... loss. "Still, it feels weird to be the one at the head of the table in her place... I can't bear to seat myself in her old chair, we've put that away and instead replaced it with my old one. The important thing is that everyone eats together, everyone knows where they're supposed to be, and everyone's there for each other. I — ah |Well, that's not wrong... we've got this long table in the dining hall, you see, long enough to seat everyone, and everyone's expected to head in for mealtimes." Everyone? A nod. "Everyone, Mom included — no, Mom especially. No acceptable excuses save for being deathly sick, or something like that; if Mom can make time to be at the table, so can you. She always sits at the head of the table, then with the oldest sisters down, all the way to the foot... everyone knows where they're supposed to be, and Mom says the important thing is that everyone eats together. If someone's missing, their empty seat sticks out like a sore thumb, and — ah ]!" Senja's face falls as she realizes what she's just done — speaking to you means she wasn't paying that much attention to where she was dipping her flatbread, and went ahead and stained her fingers with the jam. "Oh, bother..." Hmm, does this give you any ideas? "

rows.original:
The rest of the meal passes quickly, with Senja wiping her mouth with a small handkerchief and starting to pack everything up. The sun hasn't quite started to dip below the horizon yet, but it's not long in coming, either. Best to get her home before it's too late. You help her pack up hamper and case alike, then take her hand and slowly lead her back along the forest trails to the Evergreen mansion. Her sisters peer in from the hallways as you approach, and she turns and gives you a little curtsey as you reach the courtyard.
                
                "Thanks for seeing me home, [pc.name]."
                
                It was your pleasure. Taking her out was no trouble at all, and besides, she fed you. That ought to make the two of you even.
                
                "I needed to get out for a bit — being able to play my violin alone for a while was welcome, and I needed a change of scenery. Maybe we should do this again sometime, but for now — " she waggles a hand at the not-so-well-hidden ears and tails about every conceivable piece of furniture in the courtyard — "I've got to deal with my sisters. I'll see you around, okay?"
rows.translation:
剩下的饭菜很快就吃完了，Senja用一块小手帕擦了擦嘴，然后开始收拾东西。太阳还没有完全沉到地平线下，但也不远了。 最好在为时已晚之前把她送回家。你帮她把各种物品收拾好，然后牵着她的手，沿着森林小路慢慢地带她回到常青女士庄园。当你们接近时，她的姐妹们从走廊里探出头来，而当你们来到庭院时，她转过身来，向你微微鞠了一躬。
                
                谢谢你们送我回家， [pc.name]那真是你的荣幸。带她出去根本不是什么麻烦事，而且，她还请你吃了饭。这样你们俩就扯平了。”

“我确实需要出去走走——能够独自弹一会儿小提琴对我来说真是件乐事，而且我也需要换个环境。 也许我们以后应该再找个机会一起做这件事，但现在——她朝院子里那些几乎被完全遮住的耳朵和尾巴挥了挥手，那些耳朵和尾巴似乎附着在每一件家具上——“我得去处理一些事情，跟姐妹们谈谈。回头见，好吗？"

rows.original:
Senja is a little surprised when you stand and head to the riverbank, but soon relaxes as she realizes what you're about to do. You fill your cup in the river, head back, then take her hand in yours and pour out your cup over the offending stain, scrubbing as best as you can. You're not sure when or how it really happens, but soon enough the cup and stain are but mere afterthoughts, and her fingers are lacing together with yours — 
                
                "Oh! Excuse me." Snatching back her hand, Senja looks all flustered as she examines her fingers and flicks off the water onto the grass. "Ah, I was careless back there. Thanks for helping me out."
                
                No problems. If anything, you're glad for the little mishap — it's brought the two of you a little closer together, hasn't it?
                
                Senja pouts a bit. "You're not supposed to say it out loud and spoil the moment, silly!"
                
                Ah, whatever will you do.
rows.translation:
当你站起身走向河岸时，Senja显得有些惊讶，但很快她就明白了你打算做什么，于是放松了下来。你在河里取了些水，回到原地，然后握住她的手，将水倒在那个有污渍的地方，用尽全力进行清洗。 你并不清楚这一切究竟会在何时、以何种方式发生，但很快，那个杯子以及留下的水渍就变得无关紧要了，她的手指也与你紧紧地交织在了一起——

“哦！对不起。”森贾猛地抽回自己的手，显得有些慌乱，她仔细检查着自己的手指，然后将手上的水珠弹到了草地上。 啊，我刚才确实太粗心了。谢谢你的帮助。”

“没关系。其实，这次小插曲反而让你们俩的关系更加亲密了，不是吗？
                
                Senja微微撅起了嘴：“你不应该把这话说出来，破坏这个美好的时刻的，傻瓜！”

“唉，随你便吧。

rows.original: Get some water from the river and help Senja wash off the sweet, sticky mess.
rows.translation: 从河里取些水来，帮Senja洗掉那些甜腻粘糊的东西吧。
rows.raw: "Get some water from the river and help Senja wash off the sweet, sticky mess."

rows.original:
Senja looks a surprised when you take her hand in your own, and is even more so when you give the stain a gentle lick. the honey and jam taste pretty much as you'd expect, sweet and delicious, and there's the taste of Senja herself which makes it all the better, bringing the flavors together in wonderful harmons. Your date's eyes widen as you engulf the entire fingertip in your mouth, suckling gently; she squirms, clearly flustered, but the resistance is no more than token.
                
                Thoroughly bathing her digit in your spit, you work away at the stain with the tip of your tongue, licking and sucking alternately. Come to think of it... she must have pretty sensitive fingers, what with her playing her violin and all. Satisfied that all the sweetness has been cleaned from her skin, you withdraw, wiping away a small trail of sticky drool from your lips.
                
                There, that should do it — the jam shouldn't stain now.
                
                "Um... yes." Slowly, Senja upends her cup's contents on her finger and gives it a good scrubbing; sure enough, what's left of the blotch after your tender ministrations is gone.
rows.translation:
当你握住Senja的手时，她看起来显得非常惊讶，而当你轻轻舔了一下那种果酱时，她的惊讶更是达到了顶点。这种果酱的味道确实如你所料，甜而不腻，令人回味无穷；而其中还蕴含着Senja本身的味道，这使得这种果酱更加美味，各种味道相互融合，营造出了美妙的和谐感。 当你将她的整个指尖含在口中，轻轻吮吸时，她的双眼瞪得大大的；她扭动身体，显然有些慌乱，但她的抗性只不过是象征性的而已。

你用唾液彻底湿润她的指尖，然后用舌尖反复舔拭、吮吸，努力清除那些污渍。 仔细想来……她弹小提琴的时候，手指肯定非常灵敏吧。确认她皮肤上的甜味已经被彻底清除后，你收回手，同时擦去了嘴唇上那一丝黏腻的口水痕迹。
                
                好了，应该这样就没事了——果酱应该不会再留下污渍了。

“嗯……是的。”森雅慢慢地把杯子里剩下的果酱倒在手指上，然后仔细地擦洗起来；果然，在她细心处理之后，那些污渍已经完全消失了。

rows.original: Shouldn't let good jam go to waste — [silly|it's finger-licking good|that, and Senja tastes just divine].
rows.translation: 好东西可不能浪费啊—— [silly|简直美味极了|而且，Senja的味道简直棒极了。].
rows.raw: "Shouldn't let good jam go to waste — [silly|it's finger-licking good|that, and Senja tastes just divine]."

rows.original:
Grumbling to herself, Senja pours the contents of her cup over the offending stain on her finger, then another when it refuses to wash out. You watch her with a faint smile — given her chubby and curvaceous frame, being sulky and angry really doesn't suit her.
                
                "Ah, cranberry. At least it's a small mercy it didn't get on my clothes..."
                
                A small mercy indeed, that doesn't look like it's going to wash out anytime soon.
                
                "Sorry about that, [pc.name]. We shouldn't let a bit of silliness from me ruin the mood of our date — why don't you let me make it up to you?"
rows.translation:
塞尼娅边抱怨边把杯子里的水倒在手指上那个难洗的污渍上，可污渍还是没有消失，于是她又倒了一次。你看着她，脸上带着一丝微笑——考虑到她那圆润、曲线优美的身材，生闷气实在不太适合她。
                
                啊，蔓越莓……至少它没有弄到我的衣服上，这也算是个小幸事吧……”

确实是个小幸事，看来这种污渍短期内是洗不掉的。

“真为这件事感到抱歉 [pc.name]我们不应该因为我的一些愚蠢行为而破坏我们约会的氛围——你为什么不让我来弥补这个过失呢？

                "

rows.original: Senja can handle a stain by herself, she's a capable girl.
rows.translation: Senja完全有能力自己处理这种麻烦，她是个很能干的女孩。
rows.raw: "Senja can handle a stain by herself, she's a capable girl."

rows.original: Living out in the woods can get a little boring, you'd like to show her the Wayfort and what you've been doing to restore at least some of that old place as your pad. Surely that should get her interested, given how close it is to the Evergreens — practically speaking, you're now her nearest neighbour. Why don't you take her for a look-see, show her just how well you're reclaiming the place and making it presentable once more? Senja looks a little uncertain at the idea. "Hmm..." Is something the matter? She shakes her head. "No, old habits die hard. Mom always told us the Wayfort wasn't somewhere for us to play in or linger, old masonry being dangerous and all, but if you're fixing up the place and making it livable then I don't have a problem. Besides... it's going to be with you, [pc.name]." You can't help but smile at that. Of course it'll be, and you can promise her a wonderful time. "The only actual settlement I've been in is Hawkethorne. There's that city of elves up north... but it's a long walk, I'd stick out like a sore thumb, and I certainly haven't been given leave to go in since the wall of thorns went up. But enough of that — why don't we get going?" Indeed. Senja closes up her little shop and wanders off further into the mansion, and you spend the next handful of moments [party.hasCompanions |letting [party.compNames] know that you'll be out with Senja for a while, and to expect your return by sundown; you're sure that the Evergreens will be more than happy to play host while you tend to Senja |enduring the attentions of the gaggle of Senja's sisters who've come to gawk and giggle at her predicament. You pat one on the head, tug at another's tail, then shoo them off; they scatter, giggling all the while ]. Soon enough, Senja returns from the mansion's halls all gussied up; she's made an effort to get her eternally messy hair under control and has donned a pair of white, elbow-length gloves. Your date's still wearing her little black dress — it is very fancy to begin with — and eases a hand into the crook of your arm, allowing you to lead the way. "Come on, let's go before someone notices us, okay?" Alas, you don't manage to leave the mansion unimpeded — waiting at the door is the [evergreen.dealtWith |grinning, hang-wringing form of Meira herself, standing in the doorway with a cheeky smirk on her face. She doesn't even bother to disguise her impishness as you approach, giving the both of you a pleasant little wave. "Ooooh. Senja's going on a date." "Well, if you weren't such a pest I'm sure you'd actually be able to have someone to take you out too, Meira." "Mmmmmh. I'm working on it. But you should really get out more, what with being the big and important Lady Evergreen and all. Have a lovely little roll in the flowers with [pc.name] here — you need to let people know you're the new Lady Evergreen, after all. We're going to need to marry off all our sisters eventually, you know; they can't live with us forever." Is there a point to this entire conversation, or are the sisters just going to needle each other all the way to the bank? Meira tsks. "All I'm asking is for you two lovebirds to take care of each other and keep yourselves safe. It'd be terrible if something happened to you, big sis, and I was left in charge of all these cottonheads for the rest of their lives." "Tch. Meira, we're just going to the old Wayfort next door. Looks like [pc.names] our next-door neighbor now." "Oh, so you're going for the [pc.mf |boy |girl ]-next-door thing, aren't you? Well, it suits your type, sis." Meira's impish grin widens. "And remember, come home by sundown and in time for dinner, or it'll get cold." "You're starting to sound like Mom did, Meira." "Just buzz off already and go make out in the bushes. Someday I'll be the one walking out the door with a date." |chubby, motherly form of Oxana herself, standing by the doorway with her arms folded. She eyes the both of you with he usual pleasant smile, then gives you an upnod as you draw near. "My, my, if it isn't [pc.name] and my little Senja. Off to have a little private romp, aren't you?" "Mom!" "No, no, it's good for you to get out more." Oxana's smile widens. "Our lovely [pc.name] has been fixing up the Wayfort for a little while now, and I'd like to have you tell me all about what a marvelous job [pc.heShe]'s been doing. After all, there's room for a little neighborly concern to go around, hmm? "All I'm asking is for you two to take care of each other while you're out of my sight... and remember your poor loveless mother once in a while when you're out there, hmm?" "Yes, Mom." Oxana waggles a finger at Senja's petulant tone. "And remember, come home by sundown and in time for dinner. You know what happens to naughty daughters who stay out of the house for too long." "Yes, Mom." "Good, good. Off with you, then, and enjoy yourselves." As you leave, something niggles at your mind: you never did quite tell Oxana where you were going and why, did you? Senja shakes her head at that. "Neither did I." How did she know, then? "Mom has her ways; it's best not to think too deeply about it. Come on, [pc.name], we're wasting daylight. Take me away, won't you?" ]
rows.translation: 住在树林里确实会有点无聊吧？你不妨带她去看看荒废驿堡，以及你为修复那个古老的地方、把它改造成自己的居所所做的一切。考虑到那里距离常青女士林如此之近——事实上，你现在已经是她最近的邻居了——这些肯定会引起她的兴趣吧。 你为什么不带她去看看呢？让她亲眼看看你是怎么把这个地方重新整理得井井有条的。 Senja听后显得有些犹豫：“嗯……” 是不是有什么问题呢？ 她摇了摇头：“不行，老习惯很难改。妈妈总是告诉我们，荒废驿堡不是我们可以去玩耍或逗留的地方，因为那些古老的砖石结构很危险，但如果你正在修缮这个地方，让它变得适合居住，那我没有任何意见。 另外……它会一直陪伴在你身边。 [pc.name]听到这里，你不禁会露出微笑。当然会这样，你可以向她保证，她会度过一段美好的时光。 “我真正去过的人类聚居地只有鹰棘镇。北方还有那座精灵城市……但那里距离太远了，我去的话肯定会显得格格不入。而且自从荆棘墙建起来之后，我也没被允许去那里。 不过，这些就说到这里吧——我们还是继续吧。” 的确如此。Senja关上了她的小店，继续向宅邸的深处走去，而你在接下来的几分钟里 [party.hasCompanions |出租 [party.compNames] 你知道自己会和Senja一起离开一段时间，也预计会在日落之前回来；你相信，在你照顾Senja的这段时间里，Evergreens家族一定会非常乐意招待你。 |一群塞尼亚的姐妹们围过来，围观她的窘境，还咯咯地笑个不停。你轻轻拍了拍其中一个的脑袋，拉了拉另一个的尾巴，然后把她们赶走了；她们一边笑着，一边四散而去。 ]不久之后，Senja从宅邸的大厅里走出来，整个人都打扮得漂漂亮亮的；她费了些功夫把那头总是乱糟糟的头发整理得井井有条，还戴上了一副白色、及肘长的手套。而你的约会对象仍然穿着那条黑色的小裙子——她 是 一开始就显得非常精致美观——而且它的设计使得你可以轻松地将它握在手臂的弯曲处，这样你就可以带着它前行了。 “快点，趁还没人注意到我们，我们赶紧走吧，好吗？” 可惜，你并没有能够顺利地离开那座宅邸——在门口等着你的 [evergreen.dealtWith |梅拉本人正站在门口，脸上挂着调皮的笑容，那笑容中带着一丝狡黠。当你靠近时，她甚至都不费心去掩饰自己的顽皮劲，只是朝你们俩愉快地挥了挥手。 “哦哦哦，森贾要出门去了 日期嗯，要是你不是这么烦人的话，我肯定你能找到人陪你出去玩的，梅拉。” “嗯……我正在努力中。不过你真的应该多出去走走啊，毕竟你可是重要的‘常青女士’嘛。去花丛中好好享受一下大自然吧。 [pc.name] 在这里——你需要让人们知道你就是那个人。 新的 毕竟，我们都是常青女士家族的一员。迟早我们还是得把所有姐妹都嫁出去，她们总不能永远和我们住在一起吧。 这场谈话到底有什么意义呢？还是说，这些姐妹们只是打算一直互相挖苦、互相调侃下去罢了？ 梅拉轻哼了一声：“我只不过是希望你们这两对恩爱夫妻能够互相照顾，注意自己的安全。要是你们出了什么事，姐姐可就麻烦了 我 从那以后，他就一直负责照看这些家伙，直到他们去世。” “切。梅拉，我们只是去隔壁的老荒废驿堡家而已。看起来 [pc.names] 我们的隔壁邻居现在就是了。” “哦，所以你是想说 [pc.mf |男孩 |女孩 ]这不是很平常的事吗？嗯，挺适合你的风格的，姐。”梅拉调皮地笑了起来，“记得哦，必须在日落前回家，才能吃上晚饭，否则饭菜会凉掉的。” “你说话越来越像妈妈了，梅拉。” “快走吧，去灌木丛里亲热去吧。总有一天 我会的。 成为那个带着约会对象走出门的人吧。 |胖乎乎的，有着奥克萨娜那种母亲般的体态，她双臂交叉站在门口。她用那惯常的亲切笑容看着你们俩，当你们靠近时，她还点了点头表示欢迎。 “哎呀，真是没想到 [pc.name] 还有我的小森雅，是不是要去偷偷地玩一会儿呢？“ “妈妈！” “不，不，多出去走走对你有好处。”奥克萨娜的笑容更加灿烂了，“我们可爱的 [pc.name] 他一直在修理荒废驿堡号，现在已经有一段时间了。我真的很想听听你对他所做的工作有什么评价——他的工作确实非常出色！ [pc.heShe]我只不过是希望你们两个在我看不见的时候能够互相照顾……而且在外面的时候，偶尔也想想你们那位可怜的、没有伴侣的母亲吧，嗯？好的，妈妈。” 奥克萨娜看到森雅那任性的肌肉度，摇摇手指提醒她：“还有，一定要在日落之前回家，按时吃晚饭。你知道那些在外面待太久的淘气女儿会遇到什么后果的。好的，妈妈。” “很好，那你就去吧，玩得开心点。” 当你离开的时候，突然有个念头萦绕在脑海中：你其实并没有告诉奥克萨娜你要去哪里，为什么要去，对吧？ 塞尼娅听了后摇了摇头：“我也不知道。” 那么，她是怎么知道的呢？ “妈妈有她自己的办法；最好不要想得太复杂。来吧， [pc.name]我们正在浪费时间，带我走吧，好吗？ ]
rows.raw: " Living out in the woods can get a little boring, you'd like to show her the Wayfort and what you've been doing to restore at least some of that old place as your pad. Surely that should get her interested, given how close it is to the Evergreens — practically speaking, you're now her nearest neighbour. Why don't you take her for a look-see, show her just how well you're reclaiming the place and making it presentable once more? Senja looks a little uncertain at the idea. "Hmm..." Is something the matter? She shakes her head. "No, old habits die hard. Mom always told us the Wayfort wasn't somewhere for us to play in or linger, old masonry being dangerous and all, but if you're fixing up the place and making it livable then I don't have a problem. Besides... it's going to be with you, [pc.name]." You can't help but smile at that. Of course it'll be, and you can promise her a wonderful time. "The only actual settlement I've been in is Hawkethorne. There's that city of elves up north... but it's a long walk, I'd stick out like a sore thumb, and I certainly haven't been given leave to go in since the wall of thorns went up. But enough of that — why don't we get going?" Indeed. Senja closes up her little shop and wanders off further into the mansion, and you spend the next handful of moments [party.hasCompanions |letting [party.compNames] know that you'll be out with Senja for a while, and to expect your return by sundown; you're sure that the Evergreens will be more than happy to play host while you tend to Senja |enduring the attentions of the gaggle of Senja's sisters who've come to gawk and giggle at her predicament. You pat one on the head, tug at another's tail, then shoo them off; they scatter, giggling all the while ]. Soon enough, Senja returns from the mansion's halls all gussied up; she's made an effort to get her eternally messy hair under control and has donned a pair of white, elbow-length gloves. Your date's still wearing her little black dress — it is very fancy to begin with — and eases a hand into the crook of your arm, allowing you to lead the way. "Come on, let's go before someone notices us, okay?" Alas, you don't manage to leave the mansion unimpeded — waiting at the door is the [evergreen.dealtWith |grinning, hang-wringing form of Meira herself, standing in the doorway with a cheeky smirk on her face. She doesn't even bother to disguise her impishness as you approach, giving the both of you a pleasant little wave. "Ooooh. Senja's going on a date." "Well, if you weren't such a pest I'm sure you'd actually be able to have someone to take you out too, Meira." "Mmmmmh. I'm working on it. But you should really get out more, what with being the big and important Lady Evergreen and all. Have a lovely little roll in the flowers with [pc.name] here — you need to let people know you're the new Lady Evergreen, after all. We're going to need to marry off all our sisters eventually, you know; they can't live with us forever." Is there a point to this entire conversation, or are the sisters just going to needle each other all the way to the bank? Meira tsks. "All I'm asking is for you two lovebirds to take care of each other and keep yourselves safe. It'd be terrible if something happened to you, big sis, and I was left in charge of all these cottonheads for the rest of their lives." "Tch. Meira, we're just going to the old Wayfort next door. Looks like [pc.names] our next-door neighbor now." "Oh, so you're going for the [pc.mf |boy |girl ]-next-door thing, aren't you? Well, it suits your type, sis." Meira's impish grin widens. "And remember, come home by sundown and in time for dinner, or it'll get cold." "You're starting to sound like Mom did, Meira." "Just buzz off already and go make out in the bushes. Someday I'll be the one walking out the door with a date." |chubby, motherly form of Oxana herself, standing by the doorway with her arms folded. She eyes the both of you with he usual pleasant smile, then gives you an upnod as you draw near. "My, my, if it isn't [pc.name] and my little Senja. Off to have a little private romp, aren't you?" "Mom!" "No, no, it's good for you to get out more." Oxana's smile widens. "Our lovely [pc.name] has been fixing up the Wayfort for a little while now, and I'd like to have you tell me all about what a marvelous job [pc.heShe]'s been doing. After all, there's room for a little neighborly concern to go around, hmm? "All I'm asking is for you two to take care of each other while you're out of my sight... and remember your poor loveless mother once in a while when you're out there, hmm?" "Yes, Mom." Oxana waggles a finger at Senja's petulant tone. "And remember, come home by sundown and in time for dinner. You know what happens to naughty daughters who stay out of the house for too long." "Yes, Mom." "Good, good. Off with you, then, and enjoy yourselves." As you leave, something niggles at your mind: you never did quite tell Oxana where you were going and why, did you? Senja shakes her head at that. "Neither did I." How did she know, then? "Mom has her ways; it's best not to think too deeply about it. Come on, [pc.name], we're wasting daylight. Take me away, won't you?" ] "

rows.original: The trip to the Wayfort is short and uneventful — it's literally just down the road, after all. Senja hangs close to you all the time, perhaps a little too close, but eventually the trees part and you're faced with the old but stolid Wayfort in all its standing glory. Several of the denizens give you looks as you pass by with Senja on your arm, but no one bothers you as you make your way through with Senja on your arm. "It's nice to have a place that's all yours, isn't it?" There is something to be said for restoring an old ruin like this into something functional; a certain sense of satisfaction that breathing new, genuine life into what previously may as well have been a corpse. Come on, you'll show her a place that you can be truly proud of. Feeling a bit hungry, you decide to call this a dinner date and lead Senja on to the Wayfort bar. She gives the interior an appraising look as the two of you slip through the doors, but makes no comment; the place is open and busy at this time of day, serving those who desire [var0 |a late breakfast, an early lunch |a late lunch, an early dinner ], or to just stuff their faces regardless of time of day. Happily, it isn't that crowded — while most of the best tables have been taken, there are still a few empty ones at the sides and corners of the bar's common room. It's at one of these that both of you seat yourselves until Rumi comes up to take your order. "I know my experience of other people has been limited to Hawkethorne, but don't people usually go up to the bar, instead of the bartender coming down to you?" Rumi eyes Senja and smiles. "Usually not, but we all owe [pc.name] here for giving us a place to live and make ourselves useful; it's the least I can do to come out to you. Anything you want for you and your date today, boss?" Well, this place doesn't rightly have menus yet for proper food, so you'll just leave it to her to make some recommendations... "There's always the [rand |steamed peas |baked rice |chicken breast ]. We obviously can't get very fancy food here, but it'll be a sincere meal, if nothing else. And for a date — " Rumi winks down at Senja — "I think that's more important than trying to be ritzy." That sounds perfectly fine. And give Senja a bigger serving, she's a big girl. "Hey..." "Nothing wrong with having a bit of meat on you, especially for your kind. I've seen your sisters running around the edge of the woods, and they're obviously well-fed. All right, just hang on a bit — I'll have your orders up pretty soon, and on the house. Not every day you bring a date back home, after all!" Blowing you a kiss, Rumi wanders back into the hubbub of the Wayfort bar, leaving Senja looking a little embarrassed as she turns her gaze back to you. How's she finding the place so far? "It's certainly a different atmosphere than in Hawkethorne. There aren't as many people... yet." Yet. "Not just that, it's something else. But you've clearly worked hard to at least make it more than the crumbling ruin that I remember from when I was younger." Enough about you, though. Let's talk about her. "..." [rand |Since you're treating her to a meal right now, does she have any foods that she doesn't really like? Senja chuckles. "Maybe you should've asked before you ordered, not after?" Oh, it was just a test of how well you knew her, and now you'd like to know if you passed that little test. "Really, [pc.name] — whether I like or dislike anything doesn't matter. So long as it's not Meira's poisonous cooking, I'm obligated to eat whatever is put on my plate. Others have worked hard to put it there; it would be awful of me to not finish my share." You point out she's evading the question. Senja huffs. "Like I said, it doesn't matter if I do or don't, I will eat it anyway." There she goes again, not giving a direct answer. For someone who clearly is well-fed, she's rather tetchy when it comes to the question of her tastes... "...Sheesh, you're almost as bad as Meira. Fine, fine — I'm not overly fond of spicy stuff of the kind some of the Jassiran-descended kitties make. Thankfully, Meira's always around, and that kind of stuff is the one thing she's killing to break her diet for. Would you take it off my hands, if I asked nicely?" Well... you'd have to think about that. "There you go, not giving me a direct answer." |Has she wondered what kind of person her father was? Senja shrugs at that. "I wish I knew. Probably someone who came in looking for Mom's services and paid the price she asked. She never cared to tell me, and thinking about it, it wouldn't have made any difference anyways. "Don't get me wrong, I think it would've been nice, to have someone to teach me, or arrange for me to be taught, much of what I know. I'd have liked to have gone through the motions of resenting a parent like that, to not understand his intentions and how hard he would have driven me, and then come to the realization as a young woman and be ashamed... but it's no use daydreaming and fantasizing. Since she uses her means to have us age to maturity in a few Weeks, Mom left me much to my own devices, and so..." Yeah, this conversation just took an awkward turn. "All I'm saying is that it'd be nice to have someone to valorize like that, but while I'm wishing for things I might as well wish for a castle, a pony and a princess hat." |So, does she see herself being a shopkeeper for the rest of her life? "[evergreen.dealtWith |It shows, doesn't it? Even though I'm supposedly the witch of the woods now, I still run it a lot more like a shop than Mother did. Which I think is better — she got too personal with the people who came on a level that I don't really like. That, and the kind of people who come here feel more comfortable with the familiar |It's a fun thing to do. Maintaining a shop is more about just standing in one place and hawking stuff to people; you've got to get stock, keep inventory, be able to balance books... not that I'm doing much of that with my location at the moment, but starting out easy is good practice for the future ]. I really wouldn't mind doing this for the rest of my life, so that answers your question, doesn't it?" A natural-born saleswoman, isn't she? "Well, I don't claim to be good at it, just to like it. And while liking what you do does help, it doesn't guarantee success by far." With a winning smile and humble, likable demeanor like that, she's well ahead of the competition, you'd say. "Now you're just flattering me." ] Thankfully, Rumi chooses this moment to arrive with your order, cutting the conversation short. You tuck in eagerly into the delicious meal — everything served at the Wayfort bar tastes extra great, possibly because you own the place — and relish in the explosion of flavor that graces your tongue. Senja eats quietly, daintily and with a minimum of mess, although despite the appearances you can tell she's really packing it away; you haven't even gone through half your meal before she's already ordering seconds. By the time you're done, there's a small stack of plates in front of Senja and she's patting her stomach in satisfaction. "Oops. I don't usually let myself go that badly, but as you said... there's something about the meal that's really sincere. I think I could sell this, if I ever had a reason to." Well, you're glad she liked it — if she did, that means others will, too. It doesn't look like Rumi's going to be coming for the plates anytime soon, so you take Senja by the hand and lead her out of the bar — the sun is already beginning to hang low in the sky and the daylight is growing long, so you decide to return Senja to her manor before it gets dark. Feeling more than a little full, you head back out of the Wayfort and back to the Evergreens' at a good pace. As you step into the foyer, Senja turns and gives you a small curtsey. "And we're home. Thank you for today, [pc.name]." No, thank her. Plus, it wasn't hard; her tastes are quite simple and easy to cater for. You have the feeling that you're going to be good neighbors from here on out. "If things keep on being this way, we will. Take care now. Don't be a stranger, okay?"
rows.translation: 前往荒废驿堡的路途很短，也没有什么特别的事情发生——毕竟，它就在这条路上而已。森雅一直紧跟着你，或许有点太紧了些，但最终，树木们分开了，你眼前出现了那座古老而坚固的荒废驿堡，它依然保持着昔日的辉煌。当你挽着森雅走过时，有几个人朝你投来了目光，但没有人打扰你。 “拥有一个只属于自己的地方，感觉真好，不是吗？” 是啊 是 将这样的古老废墟恢复成具有实用功能的场所，确实有其值得肯定的地方；能够为那些原本可能早已沦为废墟的地方注入新的活力，确实会带来一种满足感。来吧，你一定要带她去一个你能真正引以为豪的地方。 感到有点饿，你决定把这次约会当作晚餐，于是带着Senja来到了荒废驿堡酒吧。当你们走进门时，她打量了一下酒吧的内部环境，但并没有发表任何评论；这个时候酒吧已经开门了，顾客很多，正在为那些有需求的人提供服务。 [var0 |晚早餐，早午餐 |晚午餐，早晚餐 ]要么就是不管什么时间都不停地吃东西。幸运的是，情况并非如此。 那个 虽然大多数最好的座位都已经被人占了，但在酒吧大厅的边角处还是有几张空座位。你们俩就坐在其中一张座位上，直到鲁米过来询问你们的订单。 “我知道我与其他人的接触主要都发生在鹰棘镇，但通常人们不是会去吧台，而是让调酒师过来服务他们吗？” 鲁米看着森贾笑了笑：“通常情况下不是这样，但我们都欠 [pc.name] 您为我们提供了居住的地方，也让我们能够发挥自己的作用；因此，向您表达我的感激之情，是我最起码应该做的。老板，对于您和您今天的伴侣来说，您需要什么吗？” “嗯，这个地方目前还没有提供正式的菜单，所以就让她来推荐一些食物吧……” “总是有办法的。 [rand |蒸豌豆 |烤饭 |鸡胸肉 ]在这里我们当然不可能吃到什么高档美食，但至少这顿饭是用心准备的。而对于约会来说——鲁米对着仙奈眨了眨眼——我觉得这样已经足够了，没必要刻意追求奢华。” 听起来确实很不错。 给Senja多分一些食物吧，她已经是个大姑娘了。 “嘿……” “身上有点肉并没有什么坏处，尤其是对于你们这种体型的人来说。我见过你的姐妹们在树林边跑来跑去，显然她们都吃得很饱。 好了，稍等一下——我马上就会把你的订单准备好，而且还是免费的。毕竟，不是每天都有机会带女朋友回家吧！” Rumi飞快地吻了你一下，然后又回到了荒废驿堡酒吧热闹的氛围中，而Senja则显得有些尴尬，她把目光重新转向你。 她到目前为止觉得这个地方怎么样？ “这里的氛围确实和鹰棘镇不一样。现在这里的人还不多……” 还不多。 “不仅如此，还有其他一些不同之处。 但显然，你付出了很多努力，才让它不再是我年轻时记忆中那种破败不堪的样子。” 不过，先不说你吧，我们来谈谈她吧。 “ [rand |既然你现在正在请她吃饭，那么她有没有什么食物是特别不喜欢吃的呢？ Senja轻笑了一声：“也许你应该在点菜之前先问问她，而不是事后才问。” 哦，原来这只是想测试你对她的了解程度而已，现在你想知道自己是否通过了这个小小的测试吧。 “真的吗？ [pc.name] — 无论我喜欢与否，其实都无关紧要。只要不是梅拉做的那些有毒的饭菜，摆在盘子里的东西我都必须吃完。别人付出了很多努力才把它们端到我面前，如果我不吃完自己的那份，那就太不地道了。你指出她正在回避这个问题。 赛妮亚哼了一声：“就像我说的，我做还是不做并不重要，反正我都会吃的。” 又来这一套，还是不直接回答。 对于一个显然饮食很丰富的人来说，她在谈论自己的口味时却显得相当挑剔…… “……天啊，你简直和梅拉一样糟糕。好吧，好吧——我确实不太喜欢那些有贾西兰血统的猫咪们喜欢的辛辣食物。 幸好，梅拉总是在身边，而这类东西正是她会为了打破自己的饮食计划而特意去品尝的。真是太好了。 你 拜托了，我这么诚恳地请求你，你就帮帮我吧？” “嗯……你得好好考虑一下才行。” “看吧，你还是没有直接回答我。 |她有没有想过自己的父亲究竟是个怎样的人？ 森雅耸了耸肩：“我真希望自己能知道。大概是个来找妈妈提供服务并支付了相应费用的人吧。她从来都不愿意告诉我这些，而且仔细想想，其实知道也好，不知道也罢，根本没什么区别。 "It's nice to have a place that's all yours, isn't it?" There is something to be said for restoring an old ruin like this into something functional; a certain sense of satisfaction that breathing new, genuine life into what previously may as well have been a corpse. Come on, you'll show her a place that you can be truly proud of. Feeling a bit hungry, you decide to call this a dinner date and lead Senja on to the Wayfort bar. She gives the interior an appraising look as the two of you slip through the doors, but makes no comment; the place is open and busy at this time of day, serving those who desire [var0 |a late breakfast, an early lunch |a late lunch, an early dinner ], or to just stuff their faces regardless of time of day. Happily, it isn't that crowded — while most of the best tables have been taken, there are still a few empty ones at the sides and corners of the bar's common room. It's at one of these that both of you seat yourselves until Rumi comes up to take your order. "I know my experience of other people has been limited to Hawkethorne, but don't people usually go up to the bar, instead of the bartender coming down to you?" Rumi eyes Senja and smiles. "Usually not, but we all owe [pc.name] here for giving us a place to live and make ourselves useful; it's the least I can do to come out to you. Anything you want for you and your date today, boss?" Well, this place doesn't rightly have menus yet for proper food, so you'll just leave it to her to make some recommendations... "There's always the [rand |steamed peas |baked rice |chicken breast ]. We obviously can't get very fancy food here, but it'll be a sincere meal, if nothing else. And for a date — " Rumi winks down at Senja — "I think that's more important than trying to be ritzy." That sounds perfectly fine. And give Senja a bigger serving, she's a big girl. "Hey..." "Nothing wrong with having a bit of meat on you, especially for your kind. I've seen your sisters running around the edge of the woods, and they're obviously well-fed. All right, just hang on a bit — I'll have your orders up pretty soon, and on the house. Not every day you bring a date back home, after all!" Blowing you a kiss, Rumi wanders back into the hubbub of the Wayfort bar, leaving Senja looking a little embarrassed as she turns her gaze back to you. How's she finding the place so far? "It's certainly a different atmosphere than in Hawkethorne. There aren't as many people... yet." Yet. "Not just that, it's something else. But you've clearly worked hard to at least make it more than the crumbling ruin that I remember from when I was younger." Enough about you, though. Let's talk about her. "..." [rand |Since you're treating her to a meal right now, does she have any foods that she doesn't really like? Senja chuckles. "Maybe you should've asked before you ordered, not after?" Oh, it was just a test of how well you knew her, and now you'd like to know if you passed that little test. "Really, [pc.name] — whether I like or dislike anything doesn't matter. So long as it's not Meira's poisonous cooking, I'm obligated to eat whatever is put on my plate. Others have worked hard to put it there; it would be awful of me to not finish my share." For someone who clearly is well-fed, she's rather tetchy when it comes to the question of her tastes... "...Sheesh, you're almost as bad as Meira. You turn with a start as a voice materializes from somewhere within the trees, a familiar prickling sensation crawling on the back of your neck and spreading outwards across your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]. By the time you have your [pc.weapon] out and at the ready, the [dayNight|sun|moon]light filtering through the canopy's grown muted and several shapes detach themselves from the pines, several small wisps of spectral blue fire accompanying them to light their passage in the [dayNight|sun|moon]'s stead. [party.comp arona |"Oh great, more soul-suckers." Arona looks more tired than annoyed at the prospect. "Say the word, [pc.name], and I'll beat their heads in so we can be on our way." ] As the shapes come into view, your suspicions are confirmed: large vulpine ears, manifold tails. The small party of kitsune come to a stop an arm's length from [party.yall]; just enough to be respectful yet close the distance quickly should the need arise. Their colorful, flowing clothing stands out against the muted browns, grays and greens of the Frostwood, and one of them steps forward and gives you a small nod. "Oh dear, it seems like a potential benefactor has caught us at a bit of fun. Whatever shall we do?" You caught them? Shouldn't that be the other way around? The other kitsune exchange sly grins as their leader continues. "Should it? It can get hard to tell in these woods... but I'm sure you must be a little tired. We can fix that for [party.yall], no questions asked. Won't you come and play? I promise that you won't be disappointed... my friends and I will see to that." The group contains: [var0].
rows.translation: 啊…… 你猛地转过身去，因为一个声音从树林中的某个地方传来。那种熟悉的刺痛感从你的后颈开始，逐渐蔓延到全身 [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]等到你得到它的时候 [pc.weapon] 已经准备就绪，随时可以行动。 [dayNight|太阳|月亮]轻型线透过茂密的树冠照射下来，几道幽蓝的火轻型从松树间显现出来，为它们照亮前行的道路。 [dayNight|太阳|月亮]取而代之。 [party.comp arona |哦，太好了，又来了一些吸血鬼。 面对这一情况，阿罗娜看起来更多的是疲惫，而非恼怒。 说出那个词， [pc.name]我会把他们的脑袋打烂，这样我们就能继续前进了。 ] 当这些生物的身影逐渐显现时，你的怀疑得到了证实：它们长着大大的狐妖耳朵，还拥有多条尾巴。这群小狐妖在距离你大约一臂远的地方停了下来。 [party.yall]这种距离正好既体现了尊重，又在必要时能够迅速拉近彼此的距离。他们那些色彩鲜艳、线条流畅的服装，在 霜林 地区那沉闷的棕色、灰色和绿色中显得格外醒目。其中一个人走上前，向你微微点了点头。 哦天，看来有一位潜在的捐助者正好看到我们正在玩得开心呢。我们现在该怎么办呢？ 你抓到他们了？难道不应该反过来才对吗？ 其他那些狐妖们互相交换着狡黠的微笑，而他们的首领则继续说道。 真的需要吗？在这片树林里，有时候确实很难分辨方向……不过我敢肯定，你一定有点累了。我们可以解决这个问题的。 [party.yall]没有其他问题，你快来玩吧！我保证你一定不会失望的……我和我的朋友们会确保你的体验非常愉快的。 该团队包括： [var0].

rows.original: You consider the offer, then decide to throw caution to the wind. While you don't know very much of the structure of kitsune society, you do know they have rules they must live by and it's unlikely that any actual harm will come to you while in their care. Might as well make the most of this chance meeting... "Ah! Thank you so much for the food. We'll make sure you won't regret it..." You can only hope you've made the right choice as the foxy fellows slink towards [party.combatNames], refinement and decorum peeling away to reveal naked, base hunger in their slitted eyes.
rows.translation: 你考虑了一下这个提议，然后决定冒险一试。虽然你对狐族社会的结构了解不多，但你知道他们有自己的规矩必须遵守，所以在他们的照顾下，你不太可能遇到什么危险。不妨好好利用这次偶遇的机会吧…… 啊！非常感谢你们提供的食物，我们一定会让你们不会后悔的…… 你只能希望自己做出了正确的选择，因为那些狡猾的家伙正在悄悄逼近 [party.combatNames]那些矫揉造作、彬彬有礼的表现早已荡然无存，他们那眯缝着的双眼中，只剩下原始而强烈的饥饿欲望。
