While you don't know very much of the structure of kitsune society, you do know they have rules they must live by and it's unlikely that any actual harm will come to you while in their care. Might as well make the most of this chance meeting... "Ah! Thank you so much for the food. We'll make sure you won't regret it..." You can only hope you've made the right choice as the foxy fellows slink towards [party.combatNames], refinement and decorum peeling away to reveal naked, base hunger in their slitted eyes."

rows.original: Beneath their words and pretty euphemisms, you know what they want, and you'll be adequately compensated for your donations.
rows.translation: 在他们那些言辞和漂亮的委婉语背后，你其实知道他们真正想要什么，而你的捐赠也会得到相应的回报。
rows.raw: "Beneath their words and pretty euphemisms, you know what they want, and you'll be adequately compensated for your donations."

rows.original: As persuasive as these foxen imagine they're being, you're not inclined to take them up on their offer. Being a meal for someone else isn't on your to-do list for today, thank you very much. "A pity. I don't suppose we could convince you to change your mind? My friends and I can be rather enticing when we want to be." There's something under the kitsune's thin veneer of polite decorum, a warm tone that chips away at your resistance to what's being suggested. No, and that's your final answer. "A pity. For what it's worth, we're very sorry to have to do this to you." As one, the handful of foxen close in on you, all warm smiles and playful laughter. "Look at what you've gone and made us do." It's a fight!
rows.translation: 尽管这些狐妖自以为自己的说服力很强，但你其实并不打算接受它们的提议。今天，成为别人的盘中餐显然不在你的计划之中，谢谢。 真遗憾，我想我们没能说服你改变主意吧？当我们真的下定决心时，我和我的朋友们可是会变得相当有说服力的。 在那只狐妖那层表面上的礼貌与得体之下，隐藏着某种温暖的态度，这种态度会逐渐消解你对其中所暗示之事的抵触情绪。 不，这就是你的最终答案。 真是遗憾。不管怎样，我们对于不得不这样做感到非常抱歉。 那些狐妖们一齐向你靠近，脸上都带着温暖的笑容，发出嬉戏的笑声。 看看你让我们做了些什么。 这是一场激烈的战斗！
rows.raw: " As persuasive as these foxen imagine they're being, you're not inclined to take them up on their offer. Being a meal for someone else isn't on your to-do list for today, thank you very much. "A pity. I don't suppose we could convince you to change your mind? My friends and I can be rather enticing when we want to be." There's something under the kitsune's thin veneer of polite decorum, a warm tone that chips away at your resistance to what's being suggested. No, and that's your final answer. "A pity. For what it's worth, we're very sorry to have to do this to you." As one, the handful of foxen close in on you, all warm smiles and playful laughter. "Look at what you've gone and made us do." It's a fight!"

rows.original: You really don't feel like being fox-chow today.
rows.translation: 你今天真的没什么心情玩“捉迷藏”游戏。
rows.raw: "You really don't feel like being fox-chow today."

rows.original: Exploring deeper into the Frostwood, you suddenly realize that your surroundings have grown abruptly darker; [dayNight|despite the daylight filtering down through the forest canopy, the shadows about you have lengthened, their cast somehow feeling more... it's not exactly oppressive, but it definitely is imposing in a way that you can't quite describe in words|although it's already extremely dark beneath the nighttime canopy, the shadows have lengthened and patches of pitch-blackness have only grown more intense. It's not an oppressive darkness, it doesn't feel that way, but there is a certain sense of imposition to the sudden darkness, as if someone were tugging you by the arm]. The back of your neck tingles lightly with a sense of foreboding, and you instinctively lay a hand on your [pc.weapon], feeling uneasy. Evergreen's warnings about the forest having grown more dangerous resounding in your mind, you find yourself swiveling to face even the tiniest noise, and you can swear voices are coming at you through the pines. There it is again! As the sounds of laughter and merriment fill your ears, you're sure you're not just imagining it all. You turn this way and that, trying to pinpoint its origin; it's not just coming from around you, but also from above and below, as impossible as that sounds. [party.comp cait brint berwyn arona atugia etheryn einin |"There's magic at play here," Cait remarks, her usually jovial demeanour evaporating as she grips her staff tighter, her lips set into a thin, straight line. "I can smell it." Whoa, she's all business all of a sudden. Your pink kitten shakes her head. "You feel it too, don't you, [pc.name]? It's... it's making us uneasy." | Brint's every bit as guarded as you are, cautiously bringing up the rear as you advance step by step. Choosing to remain silent, the hulking minotaur even makes an effort to keep quiet, which is actually remarkably successful considering how large and noisy he usually is. | "This feels like the lab just before we would set out an experiment," Berwyn murmurs to himself as he follows closely in your footsteps. In fact, he's following so closely that he's practically bumping into your [pc.butt] every other step. "The air's... charged." [party.has cait|"I knew it!" Cait gives her favorite puppy-boy a tap on the back with her tail. "But then if that's the case, we've got [pc.cl blackmage whitemage|three|two] dedicated spell-slingers on duty here. What's to be afraid of, right? Right?"] | On her part, Arona appears to be absolutely aggravated, the orcess getting out her [arona.weapon] and banging on her shield with it, creating an unholy din. "Hey, fuckers! We know you're there, so just come on out and fight already! Or are you lot just too craven to face us in a fair fight?" You've been around Arona long enough to know when her bravado is genuine and when she's faking it, and if that underlying tremor to her voice isn't a dead giveaway, you don't know what is. [party.has brint|"Damn it, green-skin!" Brint says, glaring daggers at Arona. "We're trying to be quiet here!" "No point in that, you load of bull," Arona counters. "Might as well draw them out to a fight and get it over with instead of skulking around. That is, unless they're gh —" "Unless they're what?" "Never mind."] | "This feels kinda familiar," Atugia muses to herself as she sticks close to your side. "I ain't sure where I've felt this kind 'o thing before, but there's a sense like I oughta know what this is all supposed to be about, you get what I mean?" | "I..." Ryn appears equal parts thoughtful and intimidated as she peers into the darkness. "Back in the day, there were reports of things like this happening. Patrols plunged into sudden darkness, surrounded by laughter. And then..." And then what? That information could certainly come in useful right now. She shakes her head. "I'm sorry. Most of them aren't too clear on what happened in between then and being found by other patrols. So many details were missing, I was sure it was just a scary story Alissa made up to keep me awake at night." | Einin's more wary than afraid, the mecian clearly no stranger to blades in the dark and other dangers that lurk within. She doesn't have her [einin.weapon] out yet, but is sniffing at the air and peering into the gloom wordlessly as she follows along; by the looks of it, the voices amongst the trees are fooling her senses as much as they are yours. One isn't sure if that's a good or bad thing... ] Catching a glimpse of motion out of the corner of your eye, you whip around to face it, but are surprised to see that it's but a small flame of spectral blue, hanging in the air. It dances around to and fro, and as you stare into its ghostly light, you find yourself strangely mesmerised by the flitting flame. Your concerns suddenly seem trivial, and you find yourself relaxing unbidden as the ethereal wisp glides along your fingers, leaving behind a warm tingle where it touches you. [flags.KIYOKO_ENCOUNTER| You... you know what this is. Why it's so familiar, and why it conjures up so many good memories for you. Kiyoko... although she doesn't usually leave them hanging around, you know she has the power to conjure similar flames. [kiyoko.numKits 1|Your firstborn daughter, too... ]All the tension in your body melts away as you're convinced there's no danger to be had from this apparition — or at least, no danger that you're not up to braving in your search for answers. If anything, you want to follow this flame to its source... In direct contrast to your clouded thoughts but seconds ago, you've never felt more clear-headed, your resolve stronger than before. Staring directly at the bluish wisp of flame, you direct your thoughts at it, challenging the apparition to lead you onward. The bold, forward nature of your approach causes it to hesitate momentarily, but it eventually darts off between the trees, leaving you to give chase. And that you do. Stepping over old roots and through thick mats of pine needles, you follow the flame as it weaves this way and that, and at last you step out into a small clearing in the woods. At last, the unnatural darkness lifts, [dayNight|restoring the light of day|allowing some small measure of moonlight to filter down and illuminate the clearing], and the flame sputters and winks out of existence in a puff of fragrant smoke. A false trail? You're wondering if you've just been had when a handful of fox-people emerge from the woods, practically flowing all over the place as they step towards you with vulpine grace. Yes, you're certain of it now, especially after seeing the ears atop their heads and manifold tails — while their style of dress is slightly different from Kiyoko's, their garments a little less regal and elegant and more boisterous and colorful, they nevertheless bear the same aesthetic. Well, presumably something's got to change in over more than two centuries, right? They form a half-circle about [party.combatNames], keeping a respectful distance but nevertheless enough to close at a moment's notice. "Ah! A potential benefactor." One of them steps forward, giving you a small bow. "I —" You already know what they want: to feed off you. The kitsune shrinks back a little, clearly not expecting that answer. "Oh! So... you do know." [kiyoko.numKits 4 16 32|Quite intimately, in fact.|You've gotten used to it, to be honest.|At this point, having let Kiyoko feed off you so many times... you don't even notice the drain any more. It's become part of you...|Not very well, but you do get what they're after.] "That... makes things much easier, then. Fewer explanations are required. Fewer chances of... uh, misinterpretation. Odd. You do not smell heavily of these woods, yet know of us... I wasn't aware that the colonization efforts had spread beyond these lands." What was that again? At length, another of the kitsune comes up and tugs urgently at the clothing of the one addressing you. "A moment. Something's wrong. This native has been claimed." "What?" All sense of light-hearted joviality and mischief drains from the atmosphere as the fox-people huddle together in a circle of fluff and tails, their tones low and serious. The sudden shift in their demeanour is unnerving in a sense — you should have been used to it with how Kiyoko goes from calm and refined to playful and breed-hungry and back again at the drop of a hat, but even so... snatches of their conversation come to you, carried out from their hurried discourse. "...Do we?" "I'm starving..." "Is that worth taking the risk?" "...It can't be helped..." At last, the small group of kitsune breaks apart to face you once more, and as one, all of them turn to face you, inclining their heads ever so slightly towards you, ears twitching. "Well then, native... if you know what we would like, you also know that you will be adequately recompensed for your magnanimity. We can make it worth your while... perhaps even more so than whoever you previously had the good fortune to encounter." You can't help but laugh at that. [kiyoko.numKits 1|Nothing they could offer you could ever hope to match what [kiyoko.numKits 8|your beloved fox-wife|Kiyoko] has done and will continue to do...] Just the slightest hint of annoyance creeps over the kitsune's otherwise placid features. "Be that as it may... will you acquiesce to our request?" |As you try to collect your thoughts, the flame suddenly darts off into the darkness that lies between the trees, and you find yourself unable to resist giving chase. While you know you should be more cautious, the lure this apparition represents is simply too much for you to resist; a strange sense of wonder and longing trails in its wake, leading you over old roots and matted heaps of pine needles. [party.has cait |"Hey, wait up!" Cait huffs a bit as she does her best to keep up with you in the forest's close confines. "Don't just go running off like that, [pc.name]! Sheesh..." |[party.has arona |"Hey! Moron! Just where do you think you're letting yourself be led off to?" Arona stumbles after you, her thick, solid frame hampering her in the close confines of the thick woods. "Damn it, what if it's a ghost or something? I won't be able to save you from that, you nitwit!" ] ] At last, though, the unnatural darkness fades, letting [dayNight|strands of warm sunlight pierce through the treetops again|what little ambient luminescence there is to recover itself]. With a soft sputter and hiss, the pale blue flame winks out of existence, its strange hypnotic effect passing and leaving you to wonder just where you are. As it turns out, you've stepped into a small forest clearing, [party.hasCompanions|[party.compNames] bringing up your rear|alive with the sound of wind and small insects]. There's a certain serene atmosphere about the place, and as you cautiously step forward, you hear it again — the unmistakable sound of voices, closer this time. You look around, wondering just where you've been led to, so far out of the way, when a discreet cough just over your shoulder causes you to freeze. Standing but a few handspans from [party.combatNames] is a handful of fox-eared people in flowing clothing, the cut and bright color of their garments and sandals decidedly foreign to the Marches. Each one of them sports at least three tails, and as you hesitate, they edge closer to you, an air of precocious mischief hanging about them. "Why... [party.hasCompanions|potential benefactors|a potential benefactor]," one of the group says, stepping forward with a small, perhaps ingratiating smile. "How kind of you to join us in our little repast." "Ah! You've caught us! It's just so deliciously adorable the way you natives stumble around in the woods..." another one pipes up. "I can hardly resist, myself!" That causes a lull in the conversation as the offending fox receives several sharp glances from the others. Time for you to say something, then. [flags.FOREST_KITSUNE_OPINION| Right. You know what all this is about. They want to feed off you, don't they? That dampens the mood, the kitsunes' joviality a little muted as they take a step back. "Oh! So... you do know." You met some of their number south of the bridge. They were in... not the best of situations, and requested your aid. "Well! I would hope that you were kind to them, [pc.race]. Being unable to feed for an extended period of time is... most unfortunate. It places undue pressure on the body and mind, you see. Very troublesome." Yeah, about that... "Either way, this makes matters so much easier if we do not have to worry about miscontrusions and having to use euphemisms. Will you [party.hasCompanions|and perhaps your friends ]acquiesce to feed us? We're feeling a little peckish... and can make it worth your while. An equivalent exchange for what we take from you." | So, what's their deal in luring you [party.hasCompanions|and your companions ]here? "Oh, don't worry about that You're with us now, that's what's important..." since their appearance, each and every one of the fox-people has been eyeing you with a hungry look, most incongruous with their playful yet respectful demeanour. "You're the catch of the day, [pc.mf|handsome|cutie]! Mm-mm, and [party.som|such a tasty-looking morsel, too.|your friend, too. Both of you are such juicy morsels, yes?|your friends, too. All of you look delicious, wouldn't you say?]" [pc.dcb |You cast the kitsune a dirty look, feeling offended at being likened to food, but the foxy fellow brushes you off with a sly grin. "A turn of phrase, so to speak, although not too far from the truth." |You're not sure whether to feel insulted or terrified at the prospect of the kitsune calling you food, so you settle on a mixture of the two. At length, though, your eyes are drawn to the hungry gleams in the eyes of all the fox-people, and you wonder just how true those words are. They don't look like cannibals, and yet... |Oh! Yeah, you're pretty sure you're yummy all right; like, you've got these [pc.hips] and this [pc.butt] and lots of other stuff, you've got to be plenty juicy! "Oh, my dear [pc.race], I think you misunderstand. But still, maybe that's a good misunderstanding..." ] Awkward silence hangs in the air for a few moments, and the handful of kitsune look between each other, as if waiting for someone to make the first move. At last, the one who'd been speaking to you coughs gently, soft tail-tips poking at the grassy ground in what might be a hint of nervousness. "Now, don't be alarmed, but we're feeling a bit peckish. We'd like a small portion of your life-force..." "It won't hurt a bit, and you'll be as right as rain after some days of rest. Nothing to worry about. In fact, we can make it rather pleasurable for you..." "And you'll be fairly recompensed if you agree to be our benefactor. An equivalent exchange of value for what we take; a fair trade. You won't walk away empty-handed, we can assure you of that..." ] ] [party.comp atugia einin |"They're sounding just like Carmen does when she wants a snack," Atugia says. "I'd wager they're not kidding about being hungry in that sense. Carmen's been feedin' off me for the last two hundred years or so when we don't have any visitors, an' I'm fine... but you oughta make sure they don't overdo it an' drain you dry." |Einin shakes her head and folds her arms across her chest. "Well, I for one don't trust them. All they've got are words, and words are cheap. You're not going to trust someone you just met to keep their word, would you, [pc.name]? I mean, that's just silly." ] One way or the other, the ball's in your court. If these foxen want to feed on you and it's as harmless as they say, will you do it just to get them out of your way[party.hasCompanions| and stop bothering [party.compNames] to boot], or will you take this to the bitter end? The group contains: [var0].
rows.translation: 当你进一步深入 霜林 时，突然发现周围的环境变得异常昏暗起来。 [dayNight|尽管阳光透过森林的树冠洒下来，但你周围的阴影却变得愈发浓长，这些阴影给人的感觉……并不算压抑，但确实有一种难以用言语形容的压迫感。|尽管夜幕降临后，周围已经变得极其黑暗，阴影也变得愈发浓长，那些漆黑的区域更是显得更加深邃。这种黑暗并不令人感到压抑，也没有那种压迫感，但这种突如其来的黑暗确实给人一种强烈的存在感，就好像有人在拽着你的胳膊一样。]后颈突然传来一阵刺痛感，一种不祥的预感油然而生，你本能地伸手按在了那里。 "Never mind."] | "This feels kinda familiar," Atugia muses to herself as she sticks close to your side. Ryn appears equal parts thoughtful and intimidated as she peers into the darkness. "Back in the day, there were reports of things like this happening. Patrols plunged into sudden darkness, surrounded by laughter. And then..." And then what? That information could certainly come in useful right now. She shakes her head. "I'm sorry. Most of them aren't too clear on what happened in between then and being found by other patrols. So many details were missing, I was sure it was just a scary story Alissa made up to keep me awake at night." | Einin's more wary than afraid, the mecian clearly no stranger to blades in the dark and other dangers that lurk within. She doesn't have her [einin.weapon] out yet, but is sniffing at the air and peering into the gloom wordlessly as she follows along; by the looks of it, the voices amongst the trees are fooling her senses as much as they are yours. One isn't sure if that's a good or bad thing... ] Catching a glimpse of motion out of the corner of your eye, you whip around to face it, but are surprised to see that it's but a small flame of spectral blue, hanging in the air. It dances around to and fro, and as you stare into its ghostly light, you find yourself strangely mesmerised by the flitting flame. Your concerns suddenly seem trivial, and you find yourself relaxing unbidden as the ethereal wisp glides along your fingers, leaving behind a warm tingle where it touches you. [flags.KIYOKO_ENCOUNTER| You... you know what this is. Why it's so familiar, and why it conjures up so many good memories for you. Kiyoko... although she doesn't usually leave them hanging around, you know she has the power to conjure similar flames. [kiyoko.numKits 1|Your firstborn daughter, too... ]All the tension in your body melts away as you're convinced there's no danger to be had from this apparition — or at least, no danger that you're not up to braving in your search for answers. If anything, you want to follow this flame to its source... In direct contrast to your clouded thoughts but seconds ago, you've never felt more clear-headed, your resolve stronger than before. Staring directly at the bluish wisp of flame, you direct your thoughts at it, challenging the apparition to lead you onward. The bold, forward nature of your approach causes it to hesitate momentarily, but it eventually darts off between the trees, leaving you to give chase. And that you do. Stepping over old roots and through thick mats of pine needles, you follow the flame as it weaves this way and that, and at last you step out into a small clearing in the woods. At last, the unnatural darkness lifts, [dayNight|restoring the light of day|allowing some small measure of moonlight to filter down and illuminate the clearing], and the flame sputters and winks out of existence in a puff of fragrant smoke. A false trail? You're wondering if you've just been had when a handful of fox-people emerge from the woods, practically flowing all over the place as they step towards you with vulpine grace. Yes, you're certain of it now, especially after seeing the ears atop their heads and manifold tails — while their style of dress is slightly different from Kiyoko's, their garments a little less regal and elegant and more boisterous and colorful, they nevertheless bear the same aesthetic. Well, presumably something's got to change in over more than two centuries, right? They form a half-circle about [party.combatNames], keeping a respectful distance but nevertheless enough to close at a moment's notice. "Ah! A potential benefactor." One of them steps forward, giving you a small bow. "I —" You already know what they want: to feed off you. The kitsune shrinks back a little, clearly not expecting that answer. "Oh! So... you do know." [kiyoko.numKits 4 16 32|Quite intimately, in fact.|You've gotten used to it, to be honest.|At this point, having let Kiyoko feed off you so many times... you don't even notice the drain any more. It's become part of you...|Not very well, but you do get what they're after.] "That... makes things much easier, then. Fewer explanations are required. Fewer chances of... uh, misinterpretation. Odd. You do not smell heavily of these woods, yet know of us... I wasn't aware that the colonization efforts had spread beyond these lands." What was that again? At length, another of the kitsune comes up and tugs urgently at the clothing of the one addressing you. "A moment. Something's wrong. This native has been claimed." "What?" All sense of light-hearted joviality and mischief drains from the atmosphere as the fox-people huddle together in a circle of fluff and tails, their tones low and serious. The sudden shift in their demeanour is unnerving in a sense — you should have been used to it with how Kiyoko goes from calm and refined to playful and breed-hungry and back again at the drop of a hat, but even so... snatches of their conversation come to you, carried out from their hurried discourse. "...Do we?" "I'm starving..." "Is that worth taking the risk?" "...It can't be helped..." At last, the small group of kitsune breaks apart to face you once more, and as one, all of them turn to face you, inclining their heads ever so slightly towards you, ears twitching. "Well then, native... if you know what we would like, you also know that you will be adequately recompensed for your magnanimity. We can make it worth your while... perhaps even more so than whoever you previously had the good fortune to encounter." You can't help but laugh at that. [kiyoko.numKits 1|Nothing they could offer you could ever hope to match what [kiyoko.numKits 8|your beloved fox-wife|Kiyoko] has done and will continue to do...] Just the slightest hint of annoyance creeps over the kitsune's otherwise placid features. "Be that as it may... will you acquiesce to our request?" |As you try to collect your thoughts, the flame suddenly darts off into the darkness that lies between the trees, and you find yourself unable to resist giving chase. While you know you should be more cautious, the lure this apparition represents is simply too much for you to resist; a strange sense of wonder and longing trails in its wake, leading you over old roots and matted heaps of pine needles. [party.has cait |"Hey, wait up!" Cait huffs a bit as she does her best to keep up with you in the forest's close confines. "Don't just go running off like that, [pc.name]! Sheesh..." |[party.has arona |"Hey! Moron! Just where do you think you're letting yourself be led off to?" Arona stumbles after you, her thick, solid frame hampering her in the close confines of the thick woods. "Damn it, what if it's a ghost or something? I won't be able to save you from that, you nitwit!" ] ] At last, though, the unnatural darkness fades, letting [dayNight|strands of warm sunlight pierce through the treetops again|what little ambient luminescence there is to recover itself]. With a soft sputter and hiss, the pale blue flame winks out of existence, its strange hypnotic effect passing and leaving you to wonder just where you are. As it turns out, you've stepped into a small forest clearing, [party.hasCompanions|[party.compNames] bringing up your rear|alive with the sound of wind and small insects]. There's a certain serene atmosphere about the place, and as you cautiously step forward, you hear it again — the unmistakable sound of voices, closer this time. You look around, wondering just where you've been led to, so far out of the way, when a discreet cough just over your shoulder causes you to freeze. Standing but a few handspans from [party.combatNames] is a handful of fox-eared people in flowing clothing, the cut and bright color of their garments and sandals decidedly foreign to the Marches. Each one of them sports at least three tails, and as you hesitate, they edge closer to you, an air of precocious mischief hanging about them. "Why... [party.hasCompanions|potential benefactors|a potential benefactor]," one of the group says, stepping forward with a small, perhaps ingratiating smile. "How kind of you to join us in our little repast." "Ah! You've caught us! It's just so deliciously adorable the way you natives stumble around in the woods..." another one pipes up. "I can hardly resist, myself!" That causes a lull in the conversation as the offending fox receives several sharp glances from the others. Time for you to say something, then. [flags.FOREST_KITSUNE_OPINION| Right. You know what all this is about. They want to feed off you, don't they? That dampens the mood, the kitsunes' joviality a little muted as they take a step back. "Oh! So... you do know." You met some of their number south of the bridge. They were in... not the best of situations, and requested your aid. "Well! I would hope that you were kind to them, [pc.race]. Being unable to feed for an extended period of time is... most unfortunate. It places undue pressure on the body and mind, you see. Very troublesome." Yeah, about that... "Either way, this makes matters so much easier if we do not have to worry about miscontrusions and having to use euphemisms. Will you [party.hasCompanions|and perhaps your friends ]acquiesce to feed us? We're feeling a little peckish... and can make it worth your while. An equivalent exchange for what we take from you." | So, what's their deal in luring you [party.hasCompanions|and your companions ]here? "Oh, don't worry about that You're with us now, that's what's important..." since their appearance, each and every one of the fox-people has been eyeing you with a hungry look, most incongruous with their playful yet respectful demeanour. "You're the catch of the day, [pc.mf|handsome|cutie]! Mm-mm, and [party.som|such a tasty-looking morsel, too.|your friend, too. Both of you are such juicy morsels, yes?|your friends, too. All of you look delicious, wouldn't you say?]" [pc.dcb |You cast the kitsune a dirty look, feeling offended at being likened to food, but the foxy fellow brushes you off with a sly grin. "A turn of phrase, so to speak, although not too far from the truth." |You're not sure whether to feel insulted or terrified at the prospect of the kitsune calling you food, so you settle on a mixture of the two. At length, though, your eyes are drawn to the hungry gleams in the eyes of all the fox-people, and you wonder just how true those words are. They don't look like cannibals, and yet... |Oh! Yeah, you're pretty sure you're yummy all right; like, you've got these [pc.hips] and this [pc.butt] and lots of other stuff, you've got to be plenty juicy! "Oh, my dear [pc.race], I think you misunderstand. But still, maybe that's a good misunderstanding..." ] Awkward silence hangs in the air for a few moments, and the handful of kitsune look between each other, as if waiting for someone to make the first move. At last, the one who'd been speaking to you coughs gently, soft tail-tips poking at the grassy ground in what might be a hint of nervousness. "Now, don't be alarmed, but we're feeling a bit peckish. We'd like a small portion of your life-force..." "It won't hurt a bit, and you'll be as right as rain after some days of rest. Nothing to worry about. In fact, we can make it rather pleasurable for you..." "And you'll be fairly recompensed if you agree to be our benefactor. An equivalent exchange of value for what we take; a fair trade. You won't walk away empty-handed, we can assure you of that..." ] ] [party.comp atugia einin |"They're sounding just like Carmen does when she wants a snack," Atugia says. "I'd wager they're not kidding about being hungry in that sense. Carmen's been feedin' off me for the last two hundred years or so when we don't have any visitors, an' I'm fine... but you oughta make sure they don't overdo it an' drain you dry." |Einin shakes her head and folds her arms across her chest. "Well, I for one don't trust them. All they've got are words, and words are cheap. You're not going to trust someone you just met to keep their word, would you, [pc.name]? I mean, that's just silly." ] One way or the other, the ball's in your court. If these foxen want to feed on you and it's as harmless as they say, will you do it just to get them out of your way[party.hasCompanions| and stop bothering [party.compNames] to boot], or will you take this to the bitter end? The group contains: [var0]."

rows.original: All right. If you're not going to come to any harm and you're going to get something out of it, why not? It might even be interesting. [party.comp einin arona |Einin just shakes her head. "Are you really going to trust them, [pc.name]? Whatever. Your mind's already set. At least it keeps them away from me." |"Suit yourself," Arona grunts. "Nothing doing with me, I'm telling you as much." ] As one, the handful of foxen give you a slight bow, then close in further. Sure, they're not touching you, but the nearness of their auras is palpably heavy, a painful reminder of what lies beneath that brisk joviality. "Since you've chosen to be our benefactor today, [pc.race], I'm sure you'd love to be able to choose the manner in which you'd like to display your generosity..."
rows.translation: 好吧，如果你不会因此受到任何伤害，而且还能从中得到一些好处，那为什么不试试呢？说不定还会觉得挺有意思的。 [party.comp einin arona |艾宁只是摇了摇头。 你真的要信任他们吗？ [pc.name]? 随你便吧。你都已经下定决心了。至少这样他们就不会来找我了。 |随你便吧。 阿罗娜低声哼了一声。 与……无关 我我真是跟你说，就是这么回事。 ] 那几只狐狸一起向你微微鞠躬，然后又进一步靠近了你。虽然它们并没有触碰到你，但它们那强大的气场所带来的压迫感却清晰可感，这无疑是在提醒你：在那层表面的欢快之下，其实隐藏着什么。 既然你今天选择了成为我们的恩人， [pc.race]我相信，你一定很希望能够自行选择展示自己慷慨的方式……
rows.raw: " All right. If you're not going to come to any harm and you're going to get something out of it, why not? It might even be interesting. [party.comp einin arona |Einin just shakes her head. "Are you really going to trust them, [pc.name]? Whatever. Your mind's already set. At least it keeps them away from me." |"Suit yourself," Arona grunts. "Nothing doing with me, I'm telling you as much." ] As one, the handful of foxen give you a slight bow, then close in further. Sure, they're not touching you, but the nearness of their auras is palpably heavy, a painful reminder of what lies beneath that brisk joviality. "Since you've chosen to be our benefactor today, [pc.race], I'm sure you'd love to be able to choose the manner in which you'd like to display your generosity...""

rows.original: Know what? This might be interesting, and if you're going to be compensated for your efforts, why not?
rows.translation: 你知道吗？这可能会很有趣，而且如果你能为自己的努力得到报酬，为什么不呢？
rows.raw: "Know what? This might be interesting, and if you're going to be compensated for your efforts, why not?"

rows.original: No, no way you're doing this. They can dress it up all they want in subtle insinuations and flowery euphemisms, but you don't feel like being a meal to a bunch of soul-suckers today. "Unfortunate. I don't suppose we could encourage you to reconsider your position, can we?" As one, the handful of kitsune close in on you, smiling in that absolutely annoying passive-aggressive matter of theirs. "Sure-ly, you'll be changing your mind..." It's a fight!
rows.translation: 不行，你绝对不能这么做。他们可以用各种隐晦的暗示和华丽的托词来包装这件事，但今天你可没心情成为那些吸血鬼的盘中餐。 遗憾的是，我想我们无法说服你改变你的决定，对吧？ 那几只狐妖齐心协力地向你逼近，它们那令人恼火的、阴阳怪气的笑容一直挂在脸上。 你肯定会的改变主意的…… 这是一场激烈的战斗！
rows.raw: " No, no way you're doing this. They can dress it up all they want in subtle insinuations and flowery euphemisms, but you don't feel like being a meal to a bunch of soul-suckers today. "Unfortunate. I don't suppose we could encourage you to reconsider your position, can we?" As one, the handful of kitsune close in on you, smiling in that absolutely annoying passive-aggressive matter of theirs. "Sure-ly, you'll be changing your mind..." It's a fight!"

rows.original: No way you're going to become food for a bunch of soul-suckers, no matter what they have to offer. You have your dignity.
rows.translation: 无论如何，你都不会成为那些吸食他人灵魂之人的食物，无论他们能提供什么诱惑。你拥有自己的尊严。
rows.raw: "No way you're going to become food for a bunch of soul-suckers, no matter what they have to offer. You have your dignity."

rows.original: You're making your way through the forest when soft whispers and faint, lilting voices come to you from amidst the trees, jovial and playful. Not that you don't already know what this is — you're well-prepared by the point several kitsune emerge into view, their colorful clothing aflutter in the forest breeze. Clearly, though, you weren't what they were expecting. The moment the kitsune catch sight of your face, their smiles and mischievous demeanour evaporate like morning dew in the sun, replaced by solemn reverence. One by one, your fellow foxen fall to their knees, literally kowtowing to you as they press their foreheads to the earth. [pc.isDK|Now that's the kind of respect you deserve, and it's hard not to feel just the tiniest bit smug.|Even knowing the kitsune as they are, it still feels awkward to have them prostrate themselves before you like this. Then again, it only highlights the fact that while you may wear the body, you weren't one of them from the start...] "You grace us with your presence, divine champion.[party.has kiyoko| And the Lady Otomo too, of course.]" Sheesh... now this is getting awkward. Come on, rise, back up on their feet and as they were. Out looking for benefactors? One by one, still fairly uncertain, the kitsune right themselves. You note that none of them will look you in the eye; probably some kind of etiquette thing you still have to grasp in your relatively new role. "That... that is just so, my [pc.mf|lord|lady]. Might you intend to join us?" No, you're just passing through on business. Although... The group contains: [var0].
rows.translation: 当你正在森林中穿行时，树丛中传来轻柔的低语声和悠扬的歌声，那些声音充满了欢乐与嬉戏的气氛。其实你早已猜到了这是什么——当几只狐妖出现在你眼前时，你早已做好了准备。它们色彩斑斓的衣物在森林的微风中飘动。 然而，显然你并不是他们所期待的人。当那些狐妖们看到你的脸时，他们脸上的笑容和顽皮的神情立刻像晨露在阳光下一样消失无踪，取而代之的是庄严的敬畏。一个接一个，你的那些狐妖同伴们都跪了下来，真正地向你行礼，将他们的前额贴在地面之上。 [pc.isDK|现在 那就是 你理应得到这样的尊重，因此很难不让人感到一丝得意。|尽管已经了解了这些狐妖的本性，但看到它们这样向你俯首称臣，还是让人觉得有些尴尬。不过，这也恰恰说明了一个事实：虽然你拥有它们的身体，但从一开始，你就并不是他们中的一员……] 神圣的勇士，您的降临让我们感到无比荣幸。[party.has kiyoko| 当然，还有奥托莫女士。]" 哎呀……现在情况变得有点尴尬了。快起来，重新站好，然后继续去寻找愿意帮助你们的人吧。 一只只狐妖慢慢地站了起来，但它们看起来仍然有些不确定。你注意到，没有一只狐妖会直视你的眼睛；这大概是因为你在这个新角色中还需要掌握一些礼仪规范吧。 那……那真的太，我的 [pc.mf|领主|女士]您愿意加入我们吗？ 不，你只是因公路过而已。不过…… 这个团队由以下成员组成： [var0].

Then again, it only highlights the fact that while you may wear the body, you weren't one of them from the start...] "You grace us with your presence, divine champion.[party.has kiyoko| And the Lady Otomo too, of course.]" Sheesh... now this is getting awkward. Might you intend to join us?" No, you're just passing through on business. Although... The group contains: [var0]."

rows.original:
...Never mind. Good fortune, then, and happy hunting.

        The kitsune bow to you again, a gesture you feel obliged to return, and they remain unmoving until you're well on your way. Tossing a discreet glance back over your shoulder, you find them slipping back into the trees, although now you know that the woods harbour foxes they're as plain as day to your eye. Have to be one to know one, you suppose...
rows.translation:
……算了。祝你好运，祝你能顺利找到目标。

那只狐妖再次向你鞠躬，这是一种你需要回以同样礼节的举动。它们会一直站在那里，直到你离开。你悄悄回头一看，发现它们已经重新钻进了树林里。不过现在你知道了，这片森林里到处都是狐妖，所以对它们来说，你根本就是显而易见的。看来，只有同類之间才能真正理解彼此吧……
rows.raw:
"
        ...Never mind. Good fortune, then, and happy hunting.

        The kitsune bow to you again, a gesture you feel obliged to return, and they remain unmoving until you're well on your way. Tossing a discreet glance back over your shoulder, you find them slipping back into the trees, although now you know that the woods harbour foxes they're as plain as day to your eye. Have to be one to know one, you suppose... "

rows.original: Just be on your way. They certainly aren't going to try and stop you.
rows.translation: 你只需要继续前进就行了。他们肯定不会试图阻止你。
rows.raw: "Just be on your way. They certainly aren't going to try and stop you."

rows.original: If they're out looking for nourishment, you feel like you can share something of what you have. "My [pc.mf|lord|lady]! I — uh, we, —" You wave off the kitsunes' concerns with a sharp gesture, and they immediately fall silent, eyes very studiously affixed to the ground. As the champion of their patron deity, it falls upon you to care for them; this is but the smallest of ways in which you can carry out your duty, by sharing what you have. Are you not right? "T-that is so, my [pc.mf|lord|lady]. Far from it being our place to decline such generosity on your behalf." You smile. While you're not so oblivious as to not know that one kitsune feeding off another is awkward, you're also aware that this is a special dispensation. Hence, there's really no need to be shy — if it still bothers them, they can consider it akin to a parent watching out for a kit's welfare. That sounds about appropriate for the situation here. Now then... how should you go about this?
rows.translation: 如果它们外出寻找食物，你会觉得可以把自己所拥有的东西分享给它们一些。 我的 [pc.mf|领主|女士]我……呃，我们…… 你用一个果断的手势打发了那些狐妖的担忧，它们立刻安静下来，目光紧紧地盯着地面。作为它们守护神的代言人，照顾它们本就是你的责任；而分享自己所拥有的一切，不过是履行这份责任的一种方式罢了，不是吗？ 是、是的，我的 [pc.mf|领主|女士]我们完全没有理由拒绝你这样的慷慨之举。 你微笑了。虽然你并不至于完全不了解两只狐妖互相捕食这种行为有些尴尬，但你也明白，这次情况有所不同。因此，其实并没有必要感到害羞——如果他们还是觉得不舒服，也可以把这种行为理解为父母在关心幼崽的安危。对于当前这种情况来说，这种解释似乎相当合适。 那么……现在该怎么做呢？

I — uh, we, —" You wave off the kitsunes' concerns with a sharp gesture, and they immediately fall silent, eyes very studiously affixed to the ground. Hence, there's really no need to be shy — if it still bothers them, they can consider it akin to a parent watching out for a kit's welfare. That sounds about appropriate for the situation here. Now then... how should you go about this?"

rows.original:
You tell the assembled foxen that you'll take things from here and that they should just relax. If the kitsune have any problem with you sweeping in and assuming control of the situation, they don't let it show on their faces, let alone voice their doubts... you guess they're just glad to have to not go through the hassle of hunting down passers-by for their fix.
    
            Now... was there something you wanted to do with them in particular?
rows.translation:
你告诉那些聚集在一起的狐妖们，你会处理这一切，让它们放松下来。如果那些狐妖对你擅自介入并掌控局面有什么不满，她们也不会表现在脸上，更不会直言不讳……我想，她们只是庆幸自己不必再费心去捕捉路人来获取所需的物品了。

那么……你有没有什么特别想对它们做的呢？
rows.raw:
"
            You tell the assembled foxen that you'll take things from here and that they should just relax. If the kitsune have any problem with you sweeping in and assuming control of the situation, they don't let it show on their faces, let alone voice their doubts... you guess they're just glad to have to not go through the hassle of hunting down passers-by for their fix.
    
            Now... was there something you wanted to do with them in particular?"

rows.original: You'll take charge here and make the most of their natural submissiveness to recognized authority.
rows.translation: 你将负责这里的工作，充分利用他们对于公认权威的顺从心理。
rows.raw: "You'll take charge here and make the most of their natural submissiveness to recognized authority."

rows.original: You tell the assembled kitsune that you're up for a little roleplaying fun, to keep in the spirit of things. Why, they should treat you no differently than a helpless passer-by caught up in their mischief. While you know your role in things, there's really no need to be so formal right now — they are out on the hunt, after all. "Ah, our station, divine champion —" Divine champion of the Trickster, no less. Putting them in a bind like this, having to choose between social etiquette and obedience to authority... it's very much something he would do, wouldn't it? A little more hesitation, and then they come to their conclusion unanimously. "If you say it, my [pc.mf|lord|lady], then we obey. We will act as you desire." Good, good. Now... was there something you'd like to have them do to you[party.hasCompanions| or yours]?
rows.translation: 你告诉聚集在一起的狐妖们，你想要和大家一起玩点角色扮演的游戏，也算是为了保持这种游戏的氛围。毕竟，他们应该把你当作一个被他们的恶作剧卷入其中的无辜路人来看待才对。虽然你很清楚自己在这个游戏中的角色，但现在真的没有必要太正式——他们 是 毕竟，他们现在正在外出狩猎呢。 啊，我们的英雄，神圣的冠军—— 不愧是诡计之神的得力助手。把他们置于这样的两难境地——必须在社交礼仪与服从权威之间做出选择……这种事，他绝对会干出来的，对吧？ 又犹豫了一会儿，他们最终一致得出了结论。 如果你这么说的话，我的 [pc.mf|领主|女士]那么我们就服从。我们会按照你的意愿行事。 很好，很好。现在……有没有什么你想让他们对你做的事情呢？[party.hasCompanions| 或者是你的]?

Why, they should treat you no differently than a helpless passer-by caught up in their mischief. While you know your role in things, there's really no need to be so formal right now — they are out on the hunt, after all. "Ah, our station, divine champion —" Divine champion of the Trickster, no less. Putting them in a bind like this, having to choose between social etiquette and obedience to authority... it's very much something he would do, wouldn't it? A little more hesitation, and then they come to their conclusion unanimously. "If you say it, my [pc.mf|lord|lady], then we obey. We will act as you desire." Good, good. Now... was there something you'd like to have them do to you[party.hasCompanions| or yours]?"

rows.original: You want to see some of that signature foxy mischief and enthusiasm out on display. Have them treat you as if they'd caught and ensnared you.
rows.translation: 你肯定想看看那些标志性的狡黠与热情是如何展现出来的吧。让他们把你当成了他们捉到并俘获的对象来对待你吧。
rows.raw: "You want to see some of that signature foxy mischief and enthusiasm out on display. Have them treat you as if they'd caught and ensnared you."

rows.original: If they're out looking for lunch, perhaps you can help with that. As their social superior, it befits you to show a little noblesse oblige, yes?
rows.translation: 如果他们正在外面找地方吃午饭，也许你可以帮上忙。作为他们的上级，你理应表现出一些高尚的品格，不是吗？
rows.raw: "If they're out looking for lunch, perhaps you can help with that. As their social superior, it befits you to show a little noblesse oblige, yes?"

rows.original: You're pacing along a thin forest trail when the [dayNight|daylight|moonlight] suddenly dims, a dusky veil falling upon your immediate surroundings. Soft laughter and eerie voices play through the trees, and while it might otherwise have been intimidating you already know what's up. And come to think of it, so does Kiyoko. Completely unperturbed by the change in atmosphere, she snaps her fingers with perfect elegance and summons up a pair of ghostly blue flames, one floating above each shoulder. The spectral light slices through the darkness with ease, and she clears her throat and speaks. "You may come out now." And they do. One by one, shapes detach themselves from the shadows and trees, a small handful of kitsune stepping into the light of Kiyoko's conjured fire. Gone is the mischievous atmosphere and soft laughter, replaced by a meek, solemn submissiveness; once they've all lined up, the kitsune give Kiyoko a bow so deep that you're pretty sure they ought to have fallen flat on their faces. Must be all the tails providing counterweight... There's a moment's tension in the air, and then the massed foxen speak as one. "You grace us with your presence, [silly|Myobu-Sama|Lady Otomo]. May we be of service to you and your companion[party.manyCompanions|s] today?" "I am fine, and your concern is appreciated. But how goes the search for benefactors?" "We have no cause to complain, [silly|Myobu-Sama|Lady Otomo]." Kiyoko just chuckles at that and takes you aside. "More than two hundred years out of the world, and some things never change. 'A kitsune will never complain even if you tear her tails off,' as the saying goes... but where I come from, seeing through polite white lies is a skill you learn quickly. I think they're a bit peckish... so I won't mind if you play at being benefactor, beloved. If that is your desire, of course." Is that something you wish to pursue, though? With Kiyoko at your side, the kitsune won't try to stop you if you decide to just leave. Of course, if you do choose to be magnanimous, that's your prerogative... not to mention they're bound to recompense you in some fashion or the other. The choice is yours... The group contains: [var0].
rows.translation: 当你沿着一条狭窄的森林小径前行时 [dayNight|日光|兼职工作] 突然间，周围的一切都变得昏暗起来，仿佛有一层阴暗的面纱笼罩在了你的周围。树丛中传来轻柔的笑声和一些诡异的声响，不过尽管这些声音可能会让人感到恐惧，你其实已经知道发生了什么。 仔细想想，清子也应该明白的。 她完全没有受到周围氛围变化的干扰，以一种极其优雅的动作打了个响指，随即召唤出两道幽蓝色的火焰，分别浮现在她的双肩上方。这些幽轻型在黑暗中轻松地穿梭前行，她清了清嗓子，然后开口说道。 你现在可以出来了。 它们确实这样做了。一个接一个，那些形态从阴影和树木中脱离出来，一小群狐妖走入了清子所召唤的火焰轻型芒之中。那些调皮的气氛和轻柔的笑声消失了，取而代之的是一种温顺而庄严的顺从；当它们全部排好队后，这些狐妖向清子鞠了一个如此深的躬，以至于你几乎可以肯定它们应该会直接脸朝下摔在地上。 一定是那些尾巴在起到平衡作用…… 空气中顿时弥漫着一股紧张的气氛，然后那些成群的狐妖们齐声发出了声音。 您的轻型临让我们倍感荣幸， [silly|宫本大人|大友夫人]我们能否为您和您的同伴提供帮助？[party.manyCompanions|s] 今天吗？ 我没事，你的关心让我很感动。不过，寻找捐助者的工作进展如何了？ 我们没有任何理由抱怨， [silly|宫辅大人|大友女士]." 清子只是笑了笑，然后把你拉到了一边。 与世隔绝了两百多年，有些事情却从未改变。俗话说：‘即使把狐妖的尾巴扯掉，它也不会抱怨’……但在我的家乡，看穿那些客气的谎言是一项很快就能掌握的技能。我觉得它们应该有点饿了……所以，如果你愿意扮演施恩者的角色，我也不会介意的，亲爱的。当然，如果这是你的意愿的话。 不过，这真的是你想要追求的事情吗？有清子在你身边，即使你决定离开，那只狐妖也不会阻拦你。当然，如果你选择慷慨解囊，那完全是你的自由……更不用说他们肯定会以某种方式回报你的。 这个选择权在你手中…… 这个团队由以下成员组成： [var0].

The group contains: [var0]."

rows.original: You shake your head. While you'd love to stay and entertain these fine fox-fellows, you've got places to be and things to do. While you wish them luck in finding benefactors out here, that's about all you have time for. "Certainly. If you are in a hurry, we will refrain from obstructing you." Sure, it's only because you have your beloved fox-wife at your side that they're acting so reverently, but there's a certain satisfaction in watching the usually playful kitsune sweep aside like a bead curtain, their heads bowed as you pass them by. It isn't before you're back on track that the unnatural dimness fades, [dayNight|sun|moon]light rushing back in as if denied for too long. "I understand you are busy, dear, but sometimes it may be beneficial to stop and partake of the smaller pleasures in life," your fox-wife says as she trails alongside you. "Showing beneficence to those beneath your station is quite becoming of a champion, don't you agree? That, and there's plenty of you to go around, so I'm not worried." You look at Kiyoko, and your kitsune wife gives no response but to lick her lips in a fashion that leaves little doubt as to what she means. Ah, well... you'll think about it. "Please do."
rows.translation: 你摇了摇头。虽然你很乐意留下来陪这些友善的家伙们，但你还有其他事情要去做，其他地方也要去。虽然你祝愿他们能在这里找到愿意帮助他们的人，但这也已经是你所能做的全部了。 当然可以。如果您时间紧迫，我们一定不会耽误您。 当然，他们之所以表现得如此恭敬，只是因为有你心爱的狐妖妻子在身边罢了。不过，看着那些平时爱闹着玩的九尾狐们在你经过时低下头、像窗帘一样让开道路，还是有一种别样的满足感的。直到你重新回到正道上，那种不自然的昏暗才会消失。 [dayNight|太阳|月亮]轻型芒仿佛被压抑了太久，此刻终于重新涌了回来。 我明白你很忙，亲爱的，但有时候，停下来享受生活中那些小小的乐趣，也会带来好处哦。 你的狐妖妻子边走边说道。 对地位低于自己的人表现出善意，这才是真正的冠军该有的风范，你不觉得吗？而且你们人数众多，所以我不担心会不够用。 你看着清子，你的九尾妻子没有说任何话，只是舔了舔嘴唇，这个动作清楚地表达了她的意图。 啊，好吧……你好好考虑一下吧。 请务必这样做。

While you wish them luck in finding benefactors out here, that's about all you have time for. "Certainly. If you are in a hurry, we will refrain from obstructing you." Sure, it's only because you have your beloved fox-wife at your side that they're acting so reverently, but there's a certain satisfaction in watching the usually playful kitsune sweep aside like a bead curtain, their heads bowed as you pass them by. It isn't before you're back on track that the unnatural dimness fades, [dayNight|sun|moon]light rushing back in as if denied for too long. "I understand you are busy, dear, but sometimes it may be beneficial to stop and partake of the smaller pleasures in life," your fox-wife says as she trails alongside you. "Showing beneficence to those beneath your station is quite becoming of a champion, don't you agree? That, and there's plenty of you to go around, so I'm not worried." You look at Kiyoko, and your kitsune wife gives no response but to lick her lips in a fashion that leaves little doubt as to what she means. Ah, well... you'll think about it. "Please do.""

rows.original: All right, you get the hint. There's plenty of you to go around, you could do with a little fun, and besides, they're bound by divine law to recompense you fairly for your donation... you'll feed them as you feed your beloved fox-wife, although they'll understand if you always keep the best for her. The assembled foxen have mixed reactions to that — some appear unsure about this, while others are clearly relieved. Seeing this, your fox-wife steps in to ease the situation. "My consort is quite flavorful." To emphasise her point, Kiyoko licks her lips daintily, her nose and cheeks already coloring in a look of salacious perversion. "Truly, [pc.heShe] is something rather unique... please be kind to [pc.himHer], and don't get overexcited." "We are honored to have the privilege of drinking from your fount of spirit, [silly|Myobu-Sama|Lady Otomo]. In that case, we shall not hold back." Kiyoko just gives them a dismissive little wave before turning to you. "It's nice to be able to relax a little every now and then, beloved. Thank you for playing along... was there some trick you'd like to have them perform in particular? It's the least they can do in exchange for the rich meal." Yeah... is there some particular way you'd like this to go down?
rows.translation: 好吧，你们应该明白我的意思了。你们的人数很多，完全够分配的；你们也需要一些乐趣吧？而且，根据神圣的法律，他们有义务为你们的捐赠给予公平的回报……你们喂养他们的方式，其实和喂养你们心爱的狐狸妻子是一样的，不过如果你们总是把最好的东西留给她，他们也会理解的。 在场的狐狸们对这一安排反应不一——有些似乎还不太确定，而另一些则明显感到宽慰。看到这种情况，你们的狐狸妻子便出面来缓和气氛。 我的伴侣可真是‘风味十足’啊。 为了强调自己的观点，清子娇艳地舔了舔嘴唇，她的鼻子和脸颊已经泛起了诱人的红晕，显得格外性感迷人。 真的， [pc.heShe] 这确实是一件相当独特的事情……还请多多关照。 [pc.himHer]并且不要过于兴奋。 我们能够有幸品尝到您这种珍贵的精神佳酿，实在是我们莫大的荣幸。 [silly|宫部大人|大友夫人]那样的话，我们就不会再犹豫了。 清子只是随意地挥了挥手，然后才转向你。 能够偶尔放松一下，真是太好了，亲爱的。感谢你的配合……有没有什么特别的动作或表演你希望他们做出呢？作为一顿丰盛晚餐的回报，这是他们最起码能做的吧。 嗯……你有没有什么特定的方式希望这件事能够进行呢？
rows.raw: " All right, you get the hint. There's plenty of you to go around, you could do with a little fun, and besides, they're bound by divine law to recompense you fairly for your donation... you'll feed them as you feed your beloved fox-wife, although they'll understand if you always keep the best for her. The assembled foxen have mixed reactions to that — some appear unsure about this, while others are clearly relieved. Seeing this, your fox-wife steps in to ease the situation. "My consort is quite flavorful." To emphasise her point, Kiyoko licks her lips daintily, her nose and cheeks already coloring in a look of salacious perversion. "We are honored to have the privilege of drinking from your fount of spirit, [silly|Myobu-Sama|Lady Otomo]. In that case, we shall not hold back." Kiyoko just gives them a dismissive little wave before turning to you. "It's nice to be able to relax a little every now and then, beloved. Thank you for playing along... was there some trick you'd like to have them perform in particular? It's the least they can do in exchange for the rich meal." Yeah... is there some particular way you'd like this to go down?"

rows.original: You let the kitsune know that you'd like to take the lead this time around, if they have no objections. After all, you're the one who's having your life energy sucked upon. The foxen look between Kiyoko and you, then come to a decision. "If that's your wish." No sense in wasting any more time. Is there something — or someone — you'd like to do?
rows.translation: 你告诉那只狐妖，如果你们没有反对意见的话，这次你想来主导这件事。毕竟，正是你的生命能量被不断地吸取掉。 那只狐妖在纪代子和你之间看了看，然后做出了决定。 如果那是你的愿望的话。 再浪费时间也没有意义了。有没有什么事情——或者有什么人——你想去做呢？
rows.raw: " You let the kitsune know that you'd like to take the lead this time around, if they have no objections. After all, you're the one who's having your life energy sucked upon. The foxen look between Kiyoko and you, then come to a decision. "If that's your wish." No sense in wasting any more time. Is there something — or someone — you'd like to do?"

rows.original: Well, you're the one extending yourself, so you ought to be directing how things go.
rows.translation: 嗯，是你主动提出要帮忙的，所以应该由你来决定事情该如何进行。
rows.raw: "Well, you're the one extending yourself, so you ought to be directing how things go."

rows.original: Well, if you're going to be their prey, you might as well get into the spirit of things and let them ravage you and eat you up. Isn't that how this is supposed to go down? "Well. Not unless it's requested... table manners are a thing, after all." You just chuckle at how blaise they're about the whole matter — here these foxen are, raring to feed on your life-force, and they're just euphemising the process as table manners. Although to be fair, it's not a strange thing for you, either... One way or another, you're fine with them taking the lead and being familiar with you; you want to see some of that playful mischief that kitsune are well-known for. "My consort has fairly high standards," Kiyoko purrs as she gracefully sets herself down on a nearby tree stump. "I'm afraid to say I've spoiled [pc.himHer] quite thoroughly... let's see how you match up."
rows.translation: 嗯，既然你注定要成为它们的猎物，那还不如顺应这种安排，让它们肆意摧残你、吞噬你吧。不就是应该这样吗？ 嗯，除非有人提出要求……毕竟，基本的餐桌礼仪还是必要的。 你对他们对待这件事的这种漫不经心的态度只觉得好笑——这些狐妖精明明迫不及待地想要吸取你的生命力，却只是用“礼仪”这种委婉的说法来掩饰这个过程。不过说实在的，对你来说，这种事情也不算什么奇怪的事…… 无论如何，你并不介意他们主动接近你、与你熟悉起来；你反而很想看到那些狐妖精们一贯擅长的顽皮捣蛋行为。 我的妻子标准相当高。 清子轻轻发出呼噜声，然后优雅地坐在附近的树桩上。 恐怕我得承认，我已经把剧情透露了 [pc.himHer] 相当彻底地……让我们看看你的表现如何。
rows.raw: " Well, if you're going to be their prey, you might as well get into the spirit of things and let them ravage you and eat you up. Isn't that how this is supposed to go down? "Well. Not unless it's requested... table manners are a thing, after all." You just chuckle at how blaise they're about the whole matter — here these foxen are, raring to feed on your life-force, and they're just euphemising the process as table manners. Although to be fair, it's not a strange thing for you, either... One way or another, you're fine with them taking the lead and being familiar with you; you want to see some of that playful mischief that kitsune are well-known for. "My consort has fairly high standards," Kiyoko purrs as she gracefully sets herself down on a nearby tree stump. "I'm afraid to say I've spoiled [pc.himHer] quite thoroughly... let's see how you match up.""

rows.original: You'd like to get into the spirit of things; let the foxen take the situation in hand.
rows.translation: 你想要融入这种氛围中，那就让狐狸来处理这件事吧。
rows.raw: "You'd like to get into the spirit of things; let the foxen take the situation in hand."

rows.original: Well, there's plenty of you to go around, and Kiyoko just said she doesn't mind...
rows.translation: 嗯，你们人多得很，足够分配的，而且清子也说她不介意……
rows.raw: "Well, there's plenty of you to go around, and Kiyoko just said she doesn't mind..."

rows.original: You've been surrounded by a handful of kitsune, the colorful vulpine people a mess of fluffy ears and tails as they dance around you in the dim atmosphere amidst the trees. Their clothes are colorful and flowing, lit by the pale blue will-o-wisps that float in their wake; despite their outward levity, there's an underlying hunger to their movements that strongly suggests you take them seriously.
rows.translation: 你被一群九尾狐包围了——这些色彩斑斓的狐妖们，长着蓬松的耳朵和尾巴，在树林间昏暗的光线中围着你跳舞。他们的衣着色彩鲜艳、飘逸动人，身后还漂浮着淡蓝色的萤火虫光晕；尽管他们外表看起来很轻松愉快，但他们的动作中却隐藏着一种强烈的紧迫感，这让你不得不认真对待他们。
rows.raw: "\n    You've been surrounded by a handful of kitsune, the colorful vulpine people a mess of fluffy ears and tails as they dance around you in the dim atmosphere amidst the trees. Their clothes are colorful and flowing, lit by the pale blue will-o-wisps that float in their wake; despite their outward levity, there's an underlying hunger to their movements that strongly suggests you take them seriously."

rows.original:
With an animal yelp, the kitsune realize they've bitten off more than they can chew and decide to cut their losses, fleeing into the safety of the trees. While they're a slippery bunch and fleet of foot, you've probably weakened the foxen enough that you could get your hands on one of them if you decided to give chase.

    Would you be interested in trying to hunt down a fluffy foxen for your personal enjoyment?
rows.translation:
随着一声动物的尖叫，那些狐妖们意识到自己这次惹上了大麻烦，于是决定及时止损，逃进了树林的安全地带。虽然它们行动敏捷、身手部灵活，但你应该已经让这些狐妖们受到了足够的伤害，如果决定追捕的话，应该有机会抓住其中一只。

    你是否有兴趣尝试捕捉这只毛茸茸的狐妖，来满足自己的兴趣呢？
rows.raw:
"
    With an animal yelp, the kitsune realize they've bitten off more than they can chew and decide to cut their losses, fleeing into the safety of the trees. While they're a slippery bunch and fleet of foot, you've probably weakened the foxen enough that you could get your hands on one of them if you decided to give chase.

    Would you be interested in trying to hunt down a fluffy foxen for your personal enjoyment?"

Breaking into a sprint, you dash into the trees after the nearest silhouette, bounding over the uneven forest floor in pursuit of your quarry. Ordinarily, you [pc.agilityRange 65|would have a vanishingly small chance of catching up, if any to begin with|might have had a hard time catching up given how slippery this bugger is], but you manage to close the distance and catch the fleeing foxen by the collar. The kitsune lands on the cool forest earth with a soft %"oomph", scowling. "Pff... what a spoilsport. We only wanted to have some fun..." Oh, you can think up a few ways in which you can have plenty of fun with this little trickster...

"Have you got all your things?" Vari asks, seeing [party.som|you|you and Cait|the three of you] off at the entrance to the village. "Let me know how your adventuring is going every so often, okay? You can rest up here whenever you like."

        "Thanks, Vari," you say, pushing Cait forward a little.
        
        "Goodbye hug!" Cait meows, reaching her arms up into the air.
        
        Vari giggles and catches Cait in a big bear hug, lifting the girl right off the ground and up to face level as they nuzzle their cheeks against each other and purr.
        
        "You'd [party.som||both|all] better stay safe out there," Vari says, reluctantly setting Cait down. "Good luck, not that you'll need it."
        
        "Don't worry about us," Cait says proudly, returning to your side. "[pc.name]'s the [pc.clMulti whitemage blackmage warrior thief charmer|best mage|deadliest mage|strongest fighter|quickest rogue|sexiest charmer] in Savarra. [silly|I ain't worried 'bout nothin'.|I'm not worried about a thing!]"
        
        "Well, good," Vari says, smiling at you. "If you can fight half as well as you fuck, I bet you're amazing."
        
        She blushes instantly and turns away, waving you off. "I shouldn't have said that! Bye[party.som|| you two| you three]!"
        
        You set off with a smile, waving at Vari's retreating back as she glances over her shoulder.
        
        "We'd better go back soon!" Cait warns you good-naturedly, poking you with an elbow. "God, I'd let Vari sit on my face any time she wanted."
        
        "I'll bet," you say, chuckling. "C'mon, let's go."

rows.original: Vari escorts you to the village and expertly brushes off the attentions of the surrounding leothrans, bopping snouts and gently pushing them away until you arrive at what you could only describe as a nursery. Your heart melts at the sight. "Aren't they just amazing?" Vari whispers as you watch a bumbling pile of fur trip over her brother and tumble into three of her siblings. "They're adorable," you murmur. "Why don't you go play with them?" she says, smiling. "I'll wait outside for a while." Then she's gone, and you gently enter the play area to sit down and beckon the curious kittens over. They come slowly, at first, your unfamiliar scent making them cautious and uncertain, but when it becomes obvious that you're there for petting and play they surge forward in a bundle of furry energy. "Whoa!" you laugh, scooping a couple out of the way of their clumsy companions. "Careful there. Oh..." You recognize these markings. With a soft smile you deposit the others on the ground and pick up one of [var0 |[rand|your and Vari's children|your children], |your and Vari's children, |your children, ] raising [rand|him up and giving him a kiss on his little forehead before setting him back down|her up and giving her a kiss on her little forehead before setting her back down] with the others. [var0 |It warms your heart to see both your and Vari's children playing together, twirling around each other like spinning tops until they fall on top of each other. |Stars, they're beautiful. |Vari was right, you observe. They do fit in here. ] You spend the next ten minutes with kittens crawling all over you, alternating between fits of energy and falling asleep across your hand before Vari joins you herself, giving you some food to feed them with. It's a mixture of soft herbs, and apparently delicious. [pc.ra leothran|Funny, it didn't taste that good when you had some...|Doesn't smell quite as good as they make it look, but oh well.] "I spend a lot of time taking care of the kids here," Vari tells you once things have calmed down a little. "The women help, too, of course, but everyone is a hunter or forager. I think the younger adults do better when they know their kittens are being taken care of, you know? It's a weight off their mind." You're inclined to agree. Just looking at Vari, all covered in sleeping tots, is enough to bring a smile to your face. "Thanks, Vari. You're a good mom." Vari turns pink at the compliment. [var1 |And you take the opportunity to give her a kiss on the cheek. |And you pat her hand for a job well done. ] All too soon, it seems, you're returning to your adventure. "Come and see us again soon, [pc.name]," Vari says, waving you off. "We'll be waiting!" You give her a wave and a smile, heading back into the Frostwood[party.solo |. | with [party.compNames] in tow. ]
rows.translation: 瓦里护送你来到那个村庄，巧妙地挡开了周围那些莱奥特兰人的注意——它们不断用鼻子触碰你，瓦里则轻轻地将它们推开，直到你们来到那个只能被称作“育儿室”的地方。看到那一幕，你的心都融化了。 它们真的太可爱了，不是吗？”当你看着那一团笨拙的毛茸茸的小家伙撞到了她的弟弟，然后又滚到了她的另外三个兄弟姐妹身上时，瓦里轻声说道。 “它们确实很惹人喜欢，”你低声回答。 “那你为什么不去和它们一起玩呢？”瓦里问道。她微笑着说：“我会在外面等一会儿。” 然后她就离开了，你轻轻走进游戏区域，坐下来，然后招手把那些好奇的小猫吸引过来。起初它们走得很慢，因为你身上的气味让它们感到谨慎和不安，但当它们发现你是来陪它们玩耍、抚摸它们的时候，它们立刻兴奋地跑了过来，那一群毛茸茸的小家伙充满了活力。 哇哦！”你笑着，把其中几只从它们那些笨拙的同伴身边拨开，“小心点啊……哦……” 你认出了这些标记。带着一丝温柔的微笑，你把其他的动物放在地上，然后捡起了其中一只。 [var0 |[rand|你和瓦里的孩子们|你的孩子们], |你的孩子以及瓦里的孩子们， |你的孩子们， ] 提升 [rand|把他抱起来，在他的小额头上亲了一下，然后才把他放下来。|把她抱起来，在她的小额头上亲了一下，然后才把她放下来。] 和其他人一起。 [var0 |看到你和瓦丽的孩子们一起玩耍，他们像陀螺一样旋转着，直到互相撞在一起，真的让人感到非常温暖。 |星星，它们真是太美了。 |你观察得没错，瓦里说得对，它们确实适合放在这里。 ] 接下来的十分钟里，小猫们在你身上爬来爬去，时而精力充沛地玩耍，时而又在你手中睡着。直到瓦丽亲自过来，给了你一些食物用来喂它们——那些食物是由各种柔软的草本植物制成的，显然非常美味。 [pc.ra leothran|有趣的是，当时吃的时候并没有觉得那么好吃 你 吃了一些……|没有异味 相当 虽然他们已经尽力把事情做得尽善尽美了，但唉，也没办法怎么样吧。] 我花了大量时间来照顾这里的孩子们，”当情况稍微平静一些后，瓦里对你说道，“当然，女人们也会帮忙，但在这里，每个人都是猎人或采集者。我认为，当年轻人们知道自己的孩子有人在照顾时，他们会更加安心地去做自己的事情，你懂我的意思吧？ 这让他们的心里终于松了一口气。” 你也很愿意认同这一点。只要看到vari，她身上那些可爱的小宝宝们，就会让你不由自主地露出微笑。“谢谢你，vari。你真是个好妈妈。” 听到这样的赞美，vari的脸上立刻浮现出了红晕。 [var1 |你趁机在她脸上亲了一下。 |然后你拍拍她的手，以表示对她工作表现的认可。 ] 似乎转眼间，你就要再次开始你的冒险之旅了。 “请务必尽快再来看望我们吧。 [pc.name]我们会在那里等你的！”瓦里边说，同时向你挥了挥手。 你向她点了点头，微笑着，然后转身回到了霜林里。[party.solo |. | 与……一起 [party.compNames] 紧跟其后。 ]

rows.original:
"I'm too busy," you say, heaving a sigh. "Thanks for the offer, Vari."
        
        "Oh, you poor thing," Vari murmurs, leaning in and kissing your forehead. "Adventuring must be tough. Don't worry, [pc.name]. I'm giving them the best care they can get, and the other kittens already love them."
        
        "Thanks," you say, smiling at her. "Good to know."
        
        "Of course!" she says.

我太忙了，”你叹息着说道，“还是谢谢你的好意，瓦里。”

“哦，可怜的你，”瓦里轻声说道，凑近过来吻了吻你的额头，“冒险的日子一定很辛苦吧。别担心 [pc.name]我正在尽我所能地照顾它们，其他的小猫们也已经很喜欢它们了。”

“谢谢，”你微笑着对她说，“知道这样真是太好了。”

“当然！”她回答道。

rows.original: There's a familiar figure here, under a tree — it's Vari, and it looks like she's working hard. You can hear her muttering as you [party.som |approach |and [comp.names] |and your companions ] approach, blissfully unaware of your presence. "Hmm... fujoas are good when they're crushed up... maybe some extra mushrooms, too... and- oh!" Vari yips, toppling over onto her fuzzy butt. "Oh, [pc.name]! Gosh, you gave me a shock.[party.som | | Oh, and you brought a friend! Hello. | And your friends. Hello, you two. ]" "Hi, Vari," you say with a smile, helping the wide-hipped leothran woman back to her feet. You note some of the herbs have fallen out of the sack she's been using to gather, and make to pick them up. "Let me get these for you." "Oh, thank you," she says. "You know, I've been meaning to look for you." "Oh?" you say, your [pc.hasEmoteEars |[pc.ears] |ears ] perking up. "What for, or should I be guessing?" "I'm the one guessing a little, here," Vari says, smiling fondly as you hand her the herbs. She takes your hand and holds it between hers for a second, warming you with her touch. "I think I might be pregnant. That's the guess. If I am, though — the children are definitely yours." "Oh, wow," you breathe, smiling at Vari. "That's..." Words fail you. Instead you sweep Vari into a hug, pulling the giggling leothran woman close and [pc.isHeight 78 |letting her nuzzle her fuzzy face into your neck as she throws her arms around you |nuzzling into her fuzzy chest as she throws her arms around you and lifts you up ]. "Thank you, [pc.name]," she murmurs in your ear. "Thank you for blessing me with the gift of motherhood again..." "You deserve it," you say, squeezing her tighter for a moment before pulling back to smile at her. "You're smart, sexy, and you'll be the best mom our kittens could ask for." "Oh, thank you," Vari purrs, her cheeks turning a dull red under the dappled gray of her fur. "I certainly hope so. It's been a while, but... oh, [pc.name]. You don't know how happy you're making me." Her massive, poofy tail wraps around you as she pulls you into a kiss, long and passionate amidst the silent snow-coated terrain of the Frostwood. You stay there like that for a while, trying not to smile as she loudly purrs from deep in her throat, pressing her body into you. "Aren't you adorable?" you say, reaching up to rub Vari behind the ears. "Do you need help with anything, Vari?" "Mmmnnooo," she sighs happily, closing her eyes and leaning into your scritching. "I'm okay. I just wanted to tell you. Maybe I'll be more demanding later on. It's been so long I can hardly remember what being pregnant is like!" "Yeah? Well, feel free to make some demands when you think it's appropriate," you declare, smiling. "I'll be here." "Uh huh," Vari says, eyeing you up and down with a grin. "Well, I can think of a few already. But for now, just give me another kiss before I get back to picking herbs." You part ways some minutes later, having helped Vari gather up some mushrooms from nearby.[party.has cait | "I bet Vari's kittens are going to be so cute!" Cait says, clasping her hands. You and your mate shouldn't have risked yourselves on my behalf!" Kiyoko waves a hand. Despite your group's experiences, she's managing to keep an even keel. Lucky for her, you suppose, you seemed to bear the brunt of the pack's desires. "It is alright. I assume you are one of Governor Kurokawa's retainers?" "Oh, yes'm. Hana Kyabetsu! At your service, ma'am. And yours, too, [pc.ra kitsune |your eminence |m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ] ]." "What is it you were doing out here all alone, Hana?" Kiyoko asks. |"Wow, that was a rough time. Sorry you had to go through all that for me. It was kind of you to try." You give her a weak smile, pushing yourself into a sitting position that doesn't put too much pressure on your very-sore rear. "[pc.dcb |That'll teach me to stick my nose where it doesn't belong. |I couldn't just sit by and let it happen. |Aw, it's okay. It was kinda fun to have so many hunks on me at once! ]" She extends a hand. "Like I said, the name's Hana. You probably did save me from getting dragged off for a long time in the leo-dens. Those guys had a lot of energy to work off." "[pc.name]," you say. "What were you fighting over anyway?" ] Hana shrugs. "My job's keeping the barbarians away from my peoples' gates, so to speak. Let them roam, and they'll pillage our gardens and harass our womenfolk. Normally I can just waggle my blade at 'em and they turn tail back to the fjords, but sometimes a group gets real randy. I wouldn't mind, except five on one is a little too much even for me!" She groans and rubs at her own abused backside. After a moment, she forces herself up to her feet — though doing so causes a small stream of wasted seed to fall down her thigh. She just grimaces and grabs her weapon, and what's left of her tunic. "Look, I've got a camp a little ways off, under the old bridge that used to cross the fjord. I'm gonna head back, but if you're ever thataway, come by and let me thank you proper for spreading the punishment there. Least I can do is make you a nice home-cooked dinner." You nod and look to your own lost equipment... '

rows.original:
[flags.HANA_CAMP_APPROACH
        |You carefully start to wind your way down the narrow, precarious footpath beneath the bridge, letting it lead you lower and lower down the cliffside. You're maybe halfway down into the green, rocky fjord when you come to a wide plateau on the edge, maybe fifteen feet around. A tent's been pitched up against the sheer stone of the bridge's support beam, and a campfire is slowly burning away in the middle of the clearing.
        
        Hana's standing battle-ready near the edge, bladed staff in hand, when you appear. As soon as she sees who's coming her way, though, [hana.isBlueBalled
            |she tosses her blade aside and runs at you with open arms, sweeping you up into a fiercely tight hug — one that ends up pressing her bulge into your thigh, and letting you feel her hot breath on your neck. "I'm glad to see you, [pc.name]!" she says, giving you a toothy smile. "Was hopin' you'd be coming my way again soon..."
            |she relaxes immediately and gives you [hana.fucked
                |a quick but fierce hug
                |a friendly smile
            ]. "Hey, [pc.name]! Good to see you again." She rolls her shoulders and lets her weapon go down to her side, resting against a foot. The other hand waves you into the camp, towards the welcoming warmth of her fire. "So, what's brought you back my way?"
        ]
        |You carefully start to wind your way down the narrow, precarious footpath beneath the bridge, letting it lead you lower and lower down the cliffside. You're maybe halfway down into the green, rocky fjord when you come to a wide plateau on the edge, maybe fifteen feet around. A tent's been pitched up against the sheer stone of the bridge's support beam, and a campfire is slowly burning away in the middle of the clearing. 
        
        And there's a blade pointed at you from a half-hidden alcove you passed right by. 
        
        "Oh! Keros's tail, it's you!" a familiar voice sighs, as the iron-bladed polearm withdraws. Hana steps into view, hefting the iron weapon up onto her shoulder and wiping the sweat from her brow onto her burnished-red tunic. "Sorry, I thought you were another batch of imps! Damn monsters. Glad to be wrong for once. And to see you're in good health!"
        
        "Likewise." You take a couple of guarded steps towards the camp, which the fox-girl seems more than happy to allow. 
        
        She backpedals towards the fire pit and tosses a bundle of tree twigs onto the embers. "Kurokawa den asked me to keep an eye on the path here," she says, indicating the trail. "It's too close to the clan's hideaway for comfort, so I do what I can to keep leothrans from using it. Easy work, since they gotta come up the path single file-like. Every few days a handful of them try and dislodge me, but I just bonk the leader with the butt of my weapon and he goes tumbling like a sack, takes the rest of his friends with him!"
        
        "Aren't you worried they'll climb up?" you ask, indicating the rough, rocky ascent. There's plenty of handholds, and an overhang that would provide good cover till they were almost upon her little camp.
        
        Hana shrugs. "I ain't really hurting any of them, just scrapes and bruises to discourage 'em, so I expect the same courtesy. Worst that's likely to happen is I end up spitroasted on some sabertooth dicks and then they go raid [party.has kiyoko
            |Lady Kurokawa
            |the old lady
        ]'s gardens or something. They might look big and scary but most leothran aren't any more mean-spirited than you or I."
        
        You blink. "You're not worried about-"
        
        She gives you a wink and a gentle shove on the shoulder. "You wanna be a warrior here in the Marches, you gotta learn to take your lumps. You've probably done worse — and had worse done to you — if you've made it this far. I ain't worried about it and neither should you. Folks are pretty reticent to really hurt one another out here. Absolute worst I hear about happening is some beautiful warrior-babe ends up forced to carry the child of the man that defeats her. Even odds on whether there's a happy ending and marriage at the end of the story, but still. I'd rather end up impaled on some cat-mens' meat swords than the real thing, you know?"
        
        "Fair point."
        
        Hana grins, wagging her single, bushy tail. "Anyway! You probably didn't wander all the way down here to listen to me philosophize about the consequences of battle. Now that you've found my little camp, maybe you wanna stay and chat a spell? Maybe take me up on that offer for a hot meal, what do you say? That and a nice thick bushel of fox-fur in your lap's a mighty fine respite from the bitter chill up top."
    ]
rows.translation:
[flags.HANA_CAMP_APPROACH
        |你小心翼翼地沿着桥下那条狭窄而崎岖的小路向下走去，这条小路将你引向越来越低的悬崖边缘。当你走到半路时，突然来到一片面积约有十五英尺的宽阔高原上。这片高原位于绿色岩石环绕的峡湾之中。 在桥的支撑梁旁，人们搭起了一顶帐篷；在空地的中央，一堆篝火正缓缓燃烧着。

当你出现时，哈娜已经站在边缘，手持法杖，随时准备战斗。 然而，当她看到是谁朝她走来时 [hana.isBlueBalled
            |她把刀扔到一边，张开双臂向你奔来，将你紧紧拥入怀中——这个拥抱如此紧密，以至于她的凸起部位紧贴着你的大腿，你能感受到她热气腾腾的呼吸喷在你的脖子上。“见到你真是太好了。 [pc.name]真的吗？”她笑着说，露出一口洁白的牙齿，“我还盼着你能尽快再来找我呢……
            |她立刻放松下来，然后把……交给你。 [hana.fucked
                |一个短暂而热烈的拥抱
                |友好的微笑
            ]嘿， [pc.name]很高兴再次见到你。”她耸了耸肩，将武器放在身侧，靠在一只足部上。另一只手则示意你往营地走，朝着她篝火散发出的温暖走去。“那么，是什么让你再次来到我这里呢？
        ]
        |你小心翼翼地沿着桥下那条狭窄而崎岖的小路向下走去，这条小路将你引向越来越低的悬崖边缘。当你走到半途时，突然来到一片面积约有十五英尺的宽阔高原上。那里有一顶帐篷搭在桥的支撑梁旁的陡峭岩石上，而在空地的中央，一堆篝火正缓缓燃烧着。 
        
        就在你刚经过的那个半隐蔽的壁龛里，有一把刀刃正指向你。

“哦！原来是凯罗斯的尾巴，是你啊！”一个熟悉的声音说道，同时那把铁刃长矛也被收了回去。哈娜走了出来，将那件铁制武器扛在肩上，用袖子擦了擦额头上的汗水，汗水沾在了她那件鲜红色的束腰外衣上。“对不起，我还以为你们是另一群小妖精呢！该死的怪物……还好这次我猜错了，而且看到你身体健康，我也很高兴！
        
        我也是。”你小心翼翼地朝营地走去，而那个狐狸女孩似乎非常乐意让你通过。

她退回到火堆旁，将一捆树枝扔到余火中。“黑川家族让我照看这条小路，”她说着，同时指向那条小径。 这个地方离部落的藏身处太近了，使用起来不太方便，所以我尽量阻止那些莱奥特兰人使用它。这其实很容易，因为他们必须排成一列才能上去。每隔几天就会有一小群人试图把我赶走，但我只需要用武器的尾部敲打他们的首领，他就会像麻袋一样滚下去，把他的同伴们也一起带下去！"
        
        你难道不担心他们会爬上来吗？”你问道，指的是那段崎岖而多岩石的上坡路。虽然路上有很多可以抓握的地方，还有突出的岩壁可以提供掩护，但他们差不多就能到达她的小营地了。

哈娜耸了耸肩：“其实我并没有真的伤害他们，只是让他们受到一些擦伤和淤青，以此来吓退他们而已。所以我也希望他们能同样手下留情。最坏的情况也就是我会被那些长着剑齿的家伙烤了，然后他们就会继续去袭击别的地方。 [party.has kiyoko
            |黑川女士
            |那位老妇人
        ]那些花园之类的地方吧。它们看起来可能很大很吓人，但实际上大多数利奥斯兰人并不比你我更坏心。”

你眨了眨眼：“你不会担心……”

她朝你眨了眨眼，然后轻轻推了推你的肩膀。 如果你想在边境地区成为一名真正的战士，就必须学会承受挫折。如果你能走到今天这一步，那么你肯定经历过更糟糕的事情，也肯定有人对你做过更过分的事。我并不担心这个，你也不应该担心。在这里，人们通常都不会轻易伤害彼此。 我听过的最糟糕的情况就是，那些美丽的女战士最终被迫去抚养那个击败她的人的孩子。至于这个故事是否会有幸福的结局，以及她们是否能够结婚，其实也很难说……不过，无论如何，这种情况确实挺糟糕的。 我宁愿被那些猫人的肉剑刺穿，也不想遭遇真正的危险，你懂我的意思吧？”

“有道理。”

哈娜咧嘴笑了，她那条又粗又长的尾巴摇来摇去。“总之！你大概不会大老远跑过来，只是为了听我谈论战斗的后果吧。 既然你找到了我的小营地，或许你想留下来聊上几句吧？或者接受我的邀请，一起吃顿热饭，怎么样？再加上一捆厚厚的狐狸毛皮放在你怀里，那可真是抵御山顶严寒的绝佳办法啊。"
    ]

rows.original: There's a short path off the main road here now, which leads to a newly-raised cabin sitting on the treeline. It's a cozy little thing, with a big fire pit outside to cook on and a small herb garden surrounding it on either side. Hana's habitually sat outside it, enjoying the cool breeze of the Frostwood as much as she is the idyllic view, and [kaede.name] is bundled up beside her in a contented doze.
rows.translation: 在这里，主路旁有一条小路，这条小路会引领你来到一座建在树丛中的小木屋前。那是一座非常舒适的小屋，外面有一个很大的火坑，可以用来烹饪；小屋的两侧还种着一些香草。哈娜总是喜欢坐在那里，一边享受着弗罗斯特伍德带来的凉爽微风，一边欣赏那如诗如画的景色。 [kaede.name] 它也依偎在她身边，安心地睡着了。

rows.original:
You veer off the main road and up the dirt path to Hana's little cabin, nestled between your fort's outer walls and the edge of the cold forest. The ranger herself is sitting out by her cookfire in the yard, and she's got [kaede.name] with her, bundled up nice and warm and sitting with her back against a blanket-draped log. Your daughter babbles excitedly as you come into view, and waves her chubby little arms at you. 
    
    Hana grins ear to ear when she sees you, jogging over and wrapping you up in her arms with a kiss. "Hey, love. Been missing you."
    
    You return her kiss, running a hand through the silky fluff of her wagging tail.
rows.translation:
你偏离了主干道，沿着一条土路前往哈娜的小木屋——那座小屋坐落在你的堡垒外墙与寒冷森林的边缘之间。护林员本人正坐在院子里的篝火旁 [kaede.name] 她和你一起，裹得暖暖的，靠在一块铺着毯子的原木上坐着。当你出现在她视线中时，你的女儿兴奋地咿咿呀呀地叫着，还用她那胖乎乎的小胳膊朝你挥动。

哈娜看到你时，笑得合不拢嘴，快步跑过来，把你搂在怀里亲了亲：“嘿，亲爱的，好想你啊。”

你回吻了她，同时用手轻轻抚摸着她那摇摆着的、柔软如丝的尾巴。
