rows.original: Hana wasn't kidding about getting a whole cabin raised while you were out of commission — these kitsune work fast, it turns out. It's a quaint and cozy little thing, parked just off the side of the north road and down a little dirt path. There's a large fire pit outside the front door, already blazing away, and the last bits of furniture are stacked up ready to be hauled inside. There's a ring of warding talismans set up in geometric patterns around the property, fluttering resolutely in the cool breeze. Your fiancee comes out to greet you with a broad smile and a swishing tail. Your daughter, [kaede.name], is wrapped up in a blue bundle in her mom's arms, dozing peacefully. You hurry over and kiss her forehead, then Hana's lips. "You got this place up in no time!" "Ah, Hatsu did all the work. A buncha the other colonists came along too, bringing housewarming gifts and little things for the baby. Look!" Hana takes a small stuffy doll from her pocket, made of thick wool and embroidered with a familiar flame pattern. "Rindo even made this for the little'n herself, and Hotaru came 'round with a bunch of clothes for her. [kiyoko.isFree |[kinu.isInari |And so much food! The young lady Kinu came and gave me six crates of good fresh veg, and made me promise to bring her little half-sister here 'round the gardens sometime. |A few precious things, too. The young lady Kinu came and gave [kaede.name] a silver bell! Made me promise to bring her new half-sister here around the estate sometime soon. ] ]Even Nakano came around and tried to give me a sword for her... though I think she's, ah, a little young to be given gifts of armaments. Put that one in an oilcloth and stuck it under the floorboards for now." [party.has kiyoko |Kiyoko gives you a rather proud look, even while she's gently rubbing [kaede.name]'s cheek with her thumb. ] "So," Hana says, nodding towards the door. "Wanna tour?" You follow her inside, into a quite spacious living and dining room, with a recessed table and sitting mats in the middle.     ] Back in the homeland, noble women are expected to learn to defend themselves and their estates while their husbands are off at war, and no matter your social standing, the spear or glaive are considered traditional weapons of warrior-women. Some big [silly

    "I've been training with the glaive since I was strong enough to pick it up," she adds. A strong step takes her forward along with a trio of lightning-quick lunges into the aether. "Swords and axes and bows, too, but a lady's gotta keep up appearances."

Her long braid flips around her shoulder at the tail end up the maneuver, slapping her square in the face. Hana sputters and starts giggling to herself. "So, your family..."
    
    [flags.HANA_TALK_FAMILY
        |Hana takes a moment to think. "If you want a refresher for some reason, let's see... 
        |"... Is not the Kurokawas, if you couldn't guess," Hana says pointedly. "Not by birth or marriage or anything. I do some work for 'em since I'm here — we kitsune gotta stick together, after all — but that's the end of it.
    ] My family hails from a backwater province of the empire, one of the littler islands that grows a lot of cabbage and, uh, cauliflower. Mom and dad are both warriors; my mother is the only child of an Imperial general, and so learned from an early age to defend her estate with blade and spear while her father was away on campaign. Taught me everything I know about the glaive. My dad is a young lord of the islands, supposedly a prodigy of marksmanship in his youth, and a poet besides."
    
    She grins mischievously and adds, "Daddy married far above his station after impressing grandfather on the field with his valor and skill at arms. He feathered the leader of a minor rebellion, after said leader had already betrayed and murdered a samurai that had come forward to duel him in single combat to avoid the bloodshed of a full-scale battle. With their leader dead, the rebels routed... and he secured any reward that the general could offer. There was only one prize he had his eyes on."
    
    "Did they get along?"
    
    "They didn't have a choice," Hana laughs. "Our island, Hashima, is full of beast-kin. What you'd call orcs and harpies that lived in the northern mountains, and during the summers would come down to pillage and raid. They had to work together to defend the estate and our peasants, so there wasn't exactly a lot of time to fight each other... not that they would have, I don't think. It was more peaceful by the time I was born, but I've never known my father to do anything but dote on mom, and she's a consummate homemaker now. From what the farmers have told me, though, they made a hell of a battle-couple when they were young. I almost wish I'd gotten to see them in their prime, but like I said, there wasn't a lot of fighting left to do by the time I came around."
    
    "Sounds like they were a good match."
    
    "Yeah. I'd bet any money they really do love each other. Even though their social status was so different, and my mom didn't exactly get a choice in the matter... they made it work pretty well. I'm happy for 'em."
    
    "Speaking of their happiness... do you have any siblings?"
    
    Hana nods. "Yeah, a younger brother, Shinji. Sweet kid, but I didn't get the chance to know him very well. I came to the Marches when he was still a little squirt, maybe up to my knee. Dad's probably real glad to have a son to carry on the family name and legacy, especially with me gone now. He grows up half as charming and deadly as our dad and he'll make a great lord someday."
    
    "Do you keep in touch with them at all?"
    
    Hana draws in a heavy sigh and rubs at her tail, pointedly not answering for a few moments. "Well, uh, sorta yes, sorta no. I left them a letter when I set out on the pilgrimage that lost me my tails, and then I got a couple back from them once I'd settled here in the Marches. Went a few years without talking. They weren't happy that I'd left. Didn't understand why; said Keros made us all in perfect harmony with his vision for us. That's fine, I didn't expect much... but it was nice when the second letter came and they said they still loved me and that I was welcome back any time. I just... don't really want to. Even in a remote part of the county, being a noble was so much rigor and pomp and circumstance, so much etiquette and custom that you feel like you're drowning. I've never felt more free than I do out here. So I'm staying. But we swap letters a couple times a year now. Even got one from Shinji himself a while ago. That was... that was real nice."

那么，你的家人……
    
    [flags.HANA_TALK_FAMILY
        |哈娜思考了一会儿，然后说道：“如果出于某种原因你需要复习一下这些内容，那么…… 
        |……如果你猜不出来的话，那他们当然不是黑川一家了，”花尖锐地说道，“既不是通过血缘关系，也不是通过婚姻。我在这里工作的时候偶尔会为他们做一些事情——毕竟我们这些狐族还是应该团结在一起的——但仅此而已，没有其他关系。
    ] 我的家人来自帝国的一个偏远省份，那里是那些主要种植卷心菜和花椰菜的小岛之一。我的父母都是武士：我的母亲是一位帝国将军的独生女，因此从小就在父亲外出征战期间学习如何用刀剑和长矛来保护自己的家园。正是她教会了我关于长剑使用的一切知识。我的父亲则是这些岛屿上的年轻领主，据说他年轻时就是个射击天才，同时还是一位诗人。
    
    她调皮地笑了笑，接着说道：“爸爸在战场上凭借自己的勇气和武艺赢得了祖父的赏识，因此娶到了一个与他身份截然不相称的女人。其实，那个女人原本是某场小规模叛乱的领袖，而在这场叛乱中，那位领袖早已背叛并杀害了那位愿意与他单挑以避免大规模战斗的人员。随着领袖的死亡，叛乱被迅速镇压了……而爸爸也得到了将军能够给予的所有奖赏。不过，他真正想要的，只有那一样东西。
    
    他们相处得还好吗？”

“他们别无选择，”哈娜笑着说，“我们的岛屿，哈希玛，到处都是兽人。那些你们会称之为兽人或女妖的生物，它们生活在北部山区，每到夏天就会下来进行掠夺和袭击。 他们必须齐心协力来保护这片领地以及我们的农民，因此他们根本没有太多时间去互相争斗……其实我觉得他们也不会这么做。在我出生的时候，社会已经变得相对和平了，但我从未见过我父亲做过任何不疼爱母亲的事情，而她现在也已经成为了一个称职的家庭主妇。 不过，根据那些农民们的说法，他们年轻时可是一对非常恩爱、配合默契的夫妻。我真希望能看到他们处于最美好的状态，但就像我之前说的，等我来到这里的时候，他们已经很少有机会一起打架、一起劳作了。"
    
    听起来他们真的很合适。”

“是啊。我敢打赌，他们确实是彼此深爱的。尽管他们的社会地位截然不同，而且我妈妈在这件事上也没有什么选择权……但他们还是把婚姻经营得很好。我为他们感到高兴。
    
    说到他们的幸福……你有没有兄弟姐妹呢？”

哈娜点了点头：“有，一个弟弟，叫Shinji。他是个可爱的孩子，但我并没有机会和他好好相处。我来到这片边境地区的时候，他还只是个小孩子，大概只有我的膝盖那么高。爸爸肯定非常高兴有儿子来继承家族的名声和传统，尤其是现在我离开了家之后。他长大后，一定会像我们的爸爸一样，既有魅力又充满危险性，将来一定会成为一名伟大的领主。
    
    你还会和他们保持联系吗？”

哈娜深深地叹了口气，挠了挠自己的尾巴，好一会儿都没有回答。“嗯，算是吧，也不算吧。我在开始那次旅程、结果失去了尾巴的时候，给他们留了一封信；后来当我在这里的边境地区安顿下来后，他们又把我的尾巴还给了我。 有几年我们都没有联系。他们对我离开感到很不高兴，也不明白我为什么这么做；他们说，凯洛斯的规划让我们所有人都处于完美的和谐之中。好吧，我也没抱有什么期望……但当他们第二封信里告诉我他们仍然爱我，随时欢迎我回来时，我真的很感动。 我只是……真的不想那样。即使在县城的偏远地区，身为贵族也意味着各种严格的规矩、繁琐的礼仪和习俗，让人感觉喘不过气来。而在这里，我从未感到如此自由。 所以我就留下了。不过现在我们每年都会互相交换几次信件。不久前甚至还收到了真嗣亲自寄来的信。那真的……真的很贴心。

    "They didn't have a choice," Hana laughs. "Our island, Hashima, is full of beast-kin. What you'd call orcs and harpies that lived in the northern mountains, and during the summers would come down to pillage and raid. They had to work together to defend the estate and our peasants, so there wasn't exactly a lot of time to fight each other... not that they would have, I don't think. It was more peaceful by the time I was born, but I've never known my father to do anything but dote on mom, and she's a consummate homemaker now. From what the farmers have told me, though, they made a hell of a battle-couple when they were young. I almost wish I'd gotten to see them in their prime, but like I said, there wasn't a lot of fighting left to do by the time I came around."
    
    "Sounds like they were a good match."
    
    "Yeah. I'd bet any money they really do love each other. Even though their social status was so different, and my mom didn't exactly get a choice in the matter... they made it work pretty well. I'm happy for 'em."
    
    "Speaking of their happiness... do you have any siblings?"
    
    Hana nods. "Yeah, a younger brother, Shinji. Sweet kid, but I didn't get the chance to know him very well. I came to the Marches when he was still a little squirt, maybe up to my knee. Dad's probably real glad to have a son to carry on the family name and legacy, especially with me gone now. He grows up half as charming and deadly as our dad and he'll make a great lord someday."
    
    "Do you keep in touch with them at all?"
    
    Hana draws in a heavy sigh and rubs at her tail, pointedly not answering for a few moments. "Well, uh, sorta yes, sorta no. I left them a letter when I set out on the pilgrimage that lost me my tails, and then I got a couple back from them once I'd settled here in the Marches. Went a few years without talking. They weren't happy that I'd left. Didn't understand why; said Keros made us all in perfect harmony with his vision for us. That's fine, I didn't expect much... but it was nice when the second letter came and they said they still loved me and that I was welcome back any time. I just... don't really want to. Even in a remote part of the county, being a noble was so much rigor and pomp and circumstance, so much etiquette and custom that you feel like you're drowning. I've never felt more free than I do out here. So I'm staying. But we swap letters a couple times a year now. Even got one from Shinji himself a while ago. That was... that was real nice." 
    "

rows.original:
"What kind of dangers are you dealing with in the Frostwood these days?"
    
    "Aw, hell, what ain't I dealing with these days? Used to be I just bopped uppity kitty-men until they went back to the fjords with their tails tucked. Sometimes I'd have to scare off a drider, or some elf druids that smelled of winterstem and yowled about spirits and some kinda wyld-something, but that was the worst of it. Nothin' really serious. But ever since the weather turned a ways back, it's like the floodgates've opened for weird shit. I've been dealin' with swarms of these little red fuckers flying around wobbling their cocks all over the place, and evil witches covered in shifting ink tattoos and not much else. I never minded a good excuse for the Right of Conquest, but everything's gotten so sexualized out here! It's weird!" 
    
    You laugh. "Yeah, that's the way things have been going lately. How're you handling it?"
    
    Hana slaps the haft of her polearm. "Same way I always have. Just have to be more careful. Even with Lord Keros's protection, somethin' about these new demons don't feel right to me. I don't really wanna touch 'em if I can help it. Like there's... I dunno, something poisonous about 'em. Makes my skin crawl." 
    
    "[pc.isDK
        |It's not that bad," you assure her.
        |Probably for the best," you say.
    ]
    
    The vixen glances towards the treetops nearby and shudders. "These're strange times, [pc.ra kitsune
        |your eminence
        |[pc.name]
    ]. I'm not sure I like the way the world's turning lately, but I'm not gonna be deterred from my duty[hana.isMom
        |, to our family and to the den alike
    ]."
rows.translation:
这些天在冰原森林里，你都在面对什么样的危险呢？”

“哎呀，天哪，这些天我哪有不在面对危险啊？以前我只需要把那些自大的家伙揍一顿，他们就会夹着尾巴逃回峡湾去了。 有时候，我只需要赶走那些驱魔者，或者那些身上散发着冬茎气味、还会大喊着关于精灵和什么野性生物的精灵德鲁伊罢了，但这些其实都算不上什么严重的事情。但自从天气开始变暖之后，各种奇怪的事情仿佛都开始接连发生了。 我一直都在对付这些到处飞来飞去、摇摆着它们那小东西的小红家伙，还有那些身上纹着不断变化的墨色纹身、几乎什么衣服都不穿的邪恶女巫。我本来并不反对找个合理的理由来行使“征服权”，但现在这里的一切都变得太带有性暗示了！ 真是奇怪！” 

你笑着说：“是啊，最近事情确实都是这样发展的。你是怎么应对的？”

哈娜拍了拍她手中的长柄武器：“还是用我一直以来的方法。只是需要更加小心一些。即便有凯洛斯大人的保护，但这些新出现的恶魔还是让我觉得有些不对劲。 如果可以的话，我真的不想碰它们。总觉得……不知道，它们身上有种让人不寒而栗的东西，让我浑身不自在。[pc.isDK
        |其实并没有那么糟糕，”你安慰她道。
        |或许这样反而是件好事，”你说道。
    ]
    
    那只母狐妖瞥了一眼附近的树梢，不禁打了个寒颤。“现在是些奇怪的时代 [pc.ra kitsune
        |阁下
        |[pc.name]
    ]我不确定自己是否喜欢最近这个世界的发展趋势，但我绝不会因此而放弃自己的责任。[hana.isMom
        |对我们全家来说，也同样如此。
    ]."

rows.original: [var0 |"You said something about owing me a dinner?" "Oh, yeah, that I did!" the kitsune girl says with a grin, hopping up and heading for her tent. "You're in for a treat. I just took a boar earlier in the week, and I've still got plenty of tender meat left over. Hope you're hungry!" You find a seat by the campfire as Hana dips inside, and returns with a big iron [pc.ra kitsune |wok |bowl ] that she plants over the flame on a set of stakes. Another trip into the tent, and she brings out a cutting board, knife, and a sack full of fresh veg. She sets out dicing up onions, daikons, cauliflower, and zucchini with remarkable flourish, twirling her razor-sharp knife around her fingers between lightning-fast cuts. [kinu.isInari |You're pretty sure at least those big, juicy radishes came from your daughter's garden. ] Hana taps one of the plump white cauliflowers she's brought with her knife. "Kohaku's been doing me a real favor, sourcing all this fresh food for me. My family back home has great big farms all around the estate, y'know. Hashima's as fertile as an island can be. But I've never had a lick of luck growin' anything myself. But what I can do is cook! Whenever I could get away from my pa's training, I was always under the servants' legs in the kitchen, watchin' doe-eyed while they sliced and sized and seasoned. Later on after I left home, I spent half a year with this tanuki chef in Achinai who ran an amazing restaurant, where he cooked right in front of the samurai. Every meal was like a show!" She flings a zucchini up in the air and lets it fall straight down on her upright blade, slicing it straight in half. "Couldn't tell ya for sure, but I'm sure he musta been a ninja before. Was a wizard with a knife." "You clearly picked up his tricks," you note, watching Hana flick diced veg into the cookery with a splash of oil. She gives you a bashful smile. "You're kind to say so. But I'm just a, ah, an enthusiastic hobbyist!" Nevertheless, she's dexterous as they come with that blade. Pretty quickly, Hana's adding in strips of finely-sliced meat to the already mouthwatering concoction she's brewing on the campfire. She starts aggressively stirring and flipping the contents, adding in dashes of spice and a salty black sauce as she goes, until everything's cooked through and thoroughly seasoned. The smells coming off it have you on the edge of your seat, deep in anticipation for the coming feast. rows.raw: " [var0 |"You said something about owing me a dinner?" "Oh, yeah, that I did!" the kitsune girl says with a grin, hopping up and heading for her tent. "You're in for a treat. I just took a boar earlier in the week, and I've still got plenty of tender meat left over. Hope you're hungry!" You find a seat by the campfire as Hana dips inside, and returns with a big iron [pc.ra kitsune |wok |bowl ] that she plants over the flame on a set of stakes. Another trip into the tent, and she brings out a cutting board, knife, and a sack full of fresh veg. She sets out dicing up onions, daikons, cauliflower, and zucchini with remarkable flourish, twirling her razor-sharp knife around her fingers between lightning-fast cuts. [kinu.isInari |You're pretty sure at least those big, juicy radishes came from your daughter's garden. ] Hana taps one of the plump white cauliflowers she's brought with her knife. "Kohaku's been doing me a real favor, sourcing all this fresh food for me. My family back home has great big farms all around the estate, y'know. Hashima's as fertile as an island can be. But I've never had a lick of luck growin' anything myself. But what I can do is cook! Whenever I could get away from my pa's training, I was always under the servants' legs in the kitchen, watchin' doe-eyed while they sliced and sized and seasoned. Later on after I left home, I spent half a year with this tanuki chef in Achinai who ran an amazing restaurant, where he cooked right in front of the samurai. Every meal was like a show!" She flings a zucchini up in the air and lets it fall straight down on her upright blade, slicing it straight in half. "Couldn't tell ya for sure, but I'm sure he musta been a ninja before. Was a wizard with a knife." "You clearly picked up his tricks," you note, watching Hana flick diced veg into the cookery with a splash of oil. She gives you a bashful smile. "You're kind to say so. But I'm just a, ah, an enthusiastic hobbyist!" Nevertheless, she's dexterous as they come with that blade. Pretty quickly, Hana's adding in strips of finely-sliced meat to the already mouthwatering concoction she's brewing on the campfire. She starts aggressively stirring and flipping the contents, adding in dashes of spice and a salty black sauce as she goes, until everything's cooked through and thoroughly seasoned. The smells coming off it have you on the edge of your seat, deep in anticipation for the coming feast. Even with just one cookpot, she's able to make something that'd be fit for the table of the [pc.ra kitsune |the Lady Governor herself |baroness ]. "Here we are!" Hana finally says, scooping a hefty helping into a [party.som |pair |trio |quartet ] of bowls. You take it eagerly, unable to resist the mouthwatering aroma coming from the piping-hot stir fry. The foxy fighter's attention's riveted to you as you take your first bites, watching for your reaction; when your eyes light up, delighted by the rich, savory taste, she breaks out in a grin that stretches ear to wiggling ear. "This is really good," you [pc.dcb |admit |tell her earnestly |giggle ]. "You sure [pc.dcb |you're actually a samurai and not a chef |you're not a professional |you're not like, secretly a master chef ]?" Hana barks a laugh, and takes a big bite out of her own bowl. "Like I said, you should meet a real master from the Old Country! Mmm! This is pretty good if I do say so myself, though!" She grins at you, and starts chowing down with gusto. [party.has kiyoko |"You are a remarkable campfire cook, Lady Kyabetsu," Kiyoko remarks softly, delicately pecking at her food. ] [party.has cait |Cait gasps after her first bite, eyes lighting up. "This is so good! Makes me wish we'd gone to Kitsuhon before we came to the Marches!" ] [party.has etheryn |Ryn's ears wiggle after she takes a couple of bites. "I've never tasted anything quite like this before. It's so tasty..." ] [party.has arona |"Damn. This ain't bad!" Arona says, already halfway through shoving the meal into her gob. "Coulda used more of that pork though! Too many veggies for my taste!" "Ironic, from the big green lady," Hana says with a smirk. ] You join her in devouring the meal in a matter of minutes, filling your belly with the fox's fine cuisine. Hana's not much of a conversationalist when she's eating, turns out, wholly engrossed in stuffing her face in a most unladylike fashion. Perhaps the samurai's been living rough for a bit too long! She's even got a little sauce clinging to her chin now... |"[pc.dcb |I'm starving," you tell the fox.[hana.fucked | You grab a handful of her ass through her tunic. "Make me something to eat." ] |Are you hungry?" you ask Hana. "Because I'm starving." |Hey, Haaaaaana, I'm starving!" you smile, giving her your most helpless face. "Feed me?" ] [hana.pregStage 2 |The kitsune girl slinks closer, putting a hand on your [pc.belly]. "Getting some cravings, are ya?" She grins, rubbing your baby bump affectionately. "Guess I oughta take responsibility, huh? You just tell me what sounds good, and I'll whip it up in a jiff for ya!" |The kitsune's ginger tail flicks. "Happy to oblige! You're in luck, I took a [rand |bear |elk |boar |buck ] not long ago and I've got some fresh veg courtesy of the colony's stock-mistress. Let me whip you up something nice!" ] Hana ducks into her [hana.atCamp |tent |cabin ] and returns with her wok, setting it up and stoking the fire beneath with fresh wood. Another trip, and she's got slabs of meat and a sack of fresh veggies on her cutting board, and sets about dexterously slicing them all to tasty little ribbons with her cooking knife. Watching Hana work is always a treat: she's happy to put on a little show of trick cuts and flips with the knife, even using a little azure foxfire to set some cooking oil alight in her wok before she tosses in the meat. You can only imagine what she could do in a real kitchen, rather than sitting [hana.atCamp |around a campfire by the fjords |outside her little cabin by the roadside ] — but you know full well this is the sort of life Hana prefers. In no time at all the [hana.atCamp |camp |front lawn ] is awash in mouthwatering smells. You and Hana chat while she's vigorously stirring up the wok's contents, talking about [rand |your most recently adventures |the state of the world these days |Hana's continuing campaign to keep leothrans out of the gardens |the best ways to fight a horde of flying imps |campfire cooking techniques ] until she's ready to fill [party.som |a pair of |your ] bowls with piping-hot chow. "It's [pc.dcb |pretty damn good |so good |soooooo tasty ]!" you say between bites. rows.original:
"[pc.dcb
        |I'm starving," you tell Hana, grabbing a handful of her ass. "How about you make us something to eat?"
        |Are you hungry, Hana? Because I'm starving!"
        |I am soooo hungry. Could you feed me? Please?"
    ]
    
    Hana grins, glancing between you and [kaede.name] sitting beside her. "How 'bout we make it a family meal, then?" 
    
    You nod, and pick your daughter up while Hana ducks inside to[hana.numKids 2 3| gather up your second born and| gather up the rest of your kits from their nursery and] bring out her cookware. She makes a second trip inside, and returns with a platter laden down with meat and vegetables, with her knives hanging from her belt. [kaede.name] giggles, eyes wide as saucers when Hana puts some oil in the wok and makes it flame up with a spark of foxfire, before tossing in her ingredients and filling the yard with mouth-watering scents. 
    
    She's a bit more cautious with her knife work than she once was — no flipping them around while her child[hana.numKids 2|ren are| is] in reach. Still, her skill and dexterity are on full display as she slices, dices, and seasons the meal step by step, before combining it into a savory stir-fry that has your tummy growling before it's even on your plate. You can only imagine what she could do in a real kitchen, rather than sitting outside her little cabin by the roadside — but you know full well this is the sort of life Hana prefers. And with your child[hana.numKids 2|ren] watching... you can safely say you'd rather be nowhere else.
    
    You and Hana chat while she's vigorously stirring up the wok's contents, talking about [rand
        |your most recently adventures
        |the state of the world these days
        |Hana's continuing campaign to keep leothrans out of the gardens
        |the best ways to fight a horde of flying imps
        |campfire cooking techniques
        |[kaede.name]'s latest and cutest antics
        |the weary work of parenting
        |the various bits and bobs Hana's been doing around the house
    ] until she's ready to fill [party.som
        |a pair of
        |your
    ] bowls with piping-hot chow. 
    
    "It's [pc.dcb
        |pretty damn good
        |so good
        |soooooo tasty
    ]!" you say between bites. The compliment earns you a kiss on the cheek, and keeps a smile on Hana's freckly face all through the meal. She plops [kaede.name] on her knee while she eats, and while your daughter's far too young to be chowing down on adult food, Hana's content to let the baby suck on her thumb through the meal — sharing essence with her, you imagine.
    
    By the time your done, her wagging tail's left a trench in the snow behind her seat. 
    
    Hana whisks away the dirty dishes when you're done[pc.dcb
        |
        |, firmly denying your offer to clean up in thanks for her cooking
        |, no matter how much you try and insist you should help
    ]. "Happy to cook for ya any time, love! [party.has kiyoko
        |And you too, m'lady! 
    ]Nothing makes me happier'n seeing somebody smiling with a full belly!"

rows.original:
You lean over to Hana and brush the dark bit of sauce off her pale flesh. Your thumb passes softly over the kitsune's lower lip, bringing a sudden red flush to her freckled cheeks before she realized what you're doing. 
    
    "O-oh, ah, thanks. Sorry, I guess I must've lost my table manners somewhere along the road." Hana lets out an embarrassed little laugh, but her tail flicks rapidly behind her. 
    
    "It's cute," you assure her, flicking your fingers clean.
    
    "Ah!" Hana's cheeks darken further. "Well if ya think you can stand my barbaric behavior, you're certainly invited around for dinner any time..."

You ] lean over and cup one of Hana's cheeks, holding her steady while you sensually flick your [pc.tongue] from her chin to her lower lip, drawing a gasp of surprise from her. Hana's cheeks flush as red as her hair, but her tail starts wagging like an eager puppy's. "Wh-what was that for?" "You had something on your chin," you say, still close enough to feel the heat of her breath on your [pc.lips]. Tempting, tempting... Hana manages an embarrassed little laugh. "Oh, where're my manners? Here I am acting the barbarian in front of my [pc.mascFem |charming |beautiful ] savior, too..." "It's cute," you assure her. "Ah. Well." Hana glances to the side, chewing her lip. "You sure you got it all?" You can make sure. You lean in and repeat the motion, drawing your tongue more slowly over her lips this time, gently drawing Hana in until they're pressed against your own. The foxy fighter's breath catches, still surprised despite what you're sure was an invitation, but a little nibble on her pretty pink kissers has her melting in your arms. Her ears flatten and her lonely red tail coils around you, so warm and soft against the cold of the forest. "I did hear you Westerners had a saying about kissing cooks," Hana murmurs, withdrawing after a moment and hiding her flushed cheeks behind a hand. "Didn't know ya took it so literal..." "Only the pretty ones," you say with a smile, leaning back into your own seat. "Especially when they make such good food for me." You can see Hana's smile behind her hand. "Then I'll just have to make ya dinner again then, huh?"

rows.original:
"You've got something there," you say, pointing to Hana's chin. 
    
    "Huh? Aw, heck!" The foxy fighter quickly rubs herself clean on the back of a hand, cheeks flushing a little with embarrassment. "Sorry, I guess I must've lost my table manners somewhere along the road."
    
    "It's alright," you assure her. "You've been out here all alone for a while, huh?"
    
    She sighs. "Yeah, I'll say. Turning halfway into a barbarian out here. Gonna find me in a loincloth with a club in my hand sooner or later!"
rows.translation:
你那儿有点东西呢，”你指着哈娜的下巴说道。

“啊？哦，天哪！”这位机灵的战士迅速用手背擦了擦，脸颊因为尴尬而微微发红。“对不起，看来我在路上把礼仪都忘得一干二净了。”

“没关系，”你安慰她，“你一个人在这里待了很久吧？”

她叹了口气：“是啊，可以说是这样。在这里待久了，连半点文明礼仪都忘得一干二净了。迟早会变成一个穿着缠缠腰布、手里拿着棍棒的‘野蛮人’的！

rows.original: You both laugh it off, and finish your meals in short order. Hana's having a hard time keeping herself from smiling and giggling while you two talk — a consequence of forcing herself to slow down a little. When you're finished, she takes up your bowls and sets her cookery in the snow to cool off, and make some rinse-water in the process. "Y'know, I appreciate you comin' around, [party.som |[pc.name] |y'all |y'all ]. I do spend an unhealthy amount of time out here all by my lonesome. It's surprisingly nice to just sit around with somebody. I... just, thanks. Makes me feel like a civilized lady again." You [pc.dcb |smirk |give her a squeeze on the shoulder |a big hug, squishing her into you as hard as you can ]. "Thanks for the meal, Hana!" "Hey, any time you're here and hungry, I'm happy to oblige!" You turn towards the path back [hana.atCamp |up to the road |towards the 8fort ], rubbing your full belly as you walk.

哈娜皱了皱嘴唇：“就像我说的，我们是最好的朋友，已经很久了。我们……哦，你是想问我们有没有………哎呀，不不！我们之间最亲密的行为也就是一起洗澡，有时候我会帮她把舒缓油涂抹在那些她自己够不到的地方。这可不是因为她的烧伤伤痕，你懂的！我想我是为数不多的、不会因为疤痕而回避这些行为的狐族成员之一吧。 |不过，如果你想让我们三个人一起上床的话，我也不会拒绝——但我更希望你成为那个焦点。可不想让任何人产生误解啊！ |我相信。 [rindo.isConcubine|在她的妾室身份中，她得到了很好的照顾。|最终，肯定会有个好男人出现来追求她。只不过，那个人不会是我而已。]. ] 无论如何，能成为她的朋友，我就已经很开心了。 rows.original:
"You and Takahiro seem like you'd have a lot in common."
    
    "Oh, yeah, he's my favorite sparrin' partner among our little colony. Actually has a sense of humor and unlike Nakano, he can pull out some maneuvers that weren't written down by his great-great-ancestor who won such-and-such battle. Taka's... you know, I'd say he's a sweet guy, but truth is he's got a mean streak that comes out when you push him. Sometimes I worry I'll have to deck him, but more often he makes me laugh and laugh 'til I can't remember what I was mad about in the first place. [var0
        |Too bad he's such a wastrel, can't pull himself outta his cups. He'd make somebody a good husband if he'd just get his act together.
        |I'm glad he's gotten his act together recently. It's a nice change, even if it's left him fawning over Azami at all hours.
    ]
    
    She shrugs. "Doesn't matter to me, though. I know a lotta people in the colony and elsewhere ain't huge fans of his, but I'm happy bein' his friend. Lord knows the boy needs one."

“哦，没错，他是我们这个小团体里我最喜欢的练习伙伴。他其实很有幽默感，而且与中野不同，他能够使出一些连他的高祖父在某场战役中都没有使用过的招式。 塔卡的……嗯，我得说他是个挺不错的家伙，但事实上，当他受到压迫时，他也会展现出阴狠的一面。有时候我甚至会担心自己得揍他一顿，但更多时候，他的行为反而会让我开怀大笑，笑到根本想不起自己最初为什么生气了。 [var0
        |真可惜，他这么浪费时间，就是无法改掉自己的坏习惯。如果他能振作起来，一定会成为一个好丈夫的。
        |我很高兴他最近终于开始认真做事了。这种变化确实很好，尽管这也让他无时无刻不在讨好阿兹米。
    ]
    
    她耸了耸肩：“不过，这对我来说并不重要。我在殖民地和其他地方认识很多人，他们其实并不是他的粉丝，但我很高兴能成为他的朋友。毕竟，这个孩子需要这样的朋友。

rows.original: "How about Nakano?" you probe. "He's the leader of the colony's fighters, right? Do you answer to him?" Hana shrugs. "When needs must, yeah, I reckon. But it's not like we're a formal army out here or anything. Most of the time I'm free to do whatever I think's best for the greater good. Which is, mostly, sitting out making sure bandits and leothrans, and now whatever in Keros's tails is coming out of the Rift and the mountains, stay the hell away from us. Nakano doesn't come out here givin' me orders or anything unless it's urgent." "That all the contact you two have?" "You mean if we're friends or something? Naw, I mean... when I first got here, saw a handsome young Kurokawa boy with his gleamin' sword and all those black tails, I admit my heart had itself a little flutter. I mean, he's a handsome guy, great swordsman — if a little dry in the creativity department, if I do say so — plus he's from a real good family. I'd sure be marrying up if I bagged a Kurokawa boy, even one out here in the colonies. But uh, a little flirtin's as far as any of that ever went. I'm not sure he's capable of noticing any gal's attentions, and even if he were, his ass's got such a stick up it these days that I'm not sure he'd know what to do about it.[kinu.isHime | Don't worry none, I'm not movin' in on your son-in-law-to-be. ] He's the very traditional sort, kind that don't even look at a girl his grandma didn't introduce to him... and won't look twice at a girl that isn't gonna give his family strong, virile heirs, which I am ill-equipped to do.[kinu.isHime | | Shame, too... when I met 'im I woulda given anything to lock my thighs around that boy's head and squeeze that borin' personality out of him. He'd be a real keeper for any gal, and I'd have been a happy concubine. Ah well. ]"
rows.translation: 那中野怎么样？”你问道，“他可是这个殖民地战士队伍的领导者吧？你是不是要向他汇报工作？” 花耸了耸肩：“如果有必要的话，是的，我想是的。不过我们这里毕竟不是正规的军队，大多数时候，我都可以自由地做那些我认为对整体利益最有帮助的事情。 也就是说，我们主要是待在原地，确保那些强盗、兽人，以及现在从凯罗斯后方、裂谷和山脉中涌出来的那些东西，都远远地避开我们。除非情况紧急，否则中野是不会特意来这里给我下达命令或什么的。这就是你们俩之间的全部联系吗？” “你是说我们是不是朋友之类的关系？不，我的意思是……当我第一次来到这里的时候，看到那个英俊的黑川少年，他拿着那把闪闪发光的剑，还有那些黑色的尾巴……我得承认，当时我的心确实有点慌乱。 我的意思是，他其实就是个 英俊的 伙计，他可是个了不起的剑客——虽然说实话，他在创造力方面有点欠缺。而且他出身于一个非常不错的家庭。要是能嫁给黑川家的男孩，哪怕是在殖民地这边，我肯定也会欣然接受。不过，其实也就只是有点调调情而已，并没有什么实质进展。我不确定他是否能够注意到女孩子的关注，就算注意到了，这些天他也太固执了，恐怕根本不知道该如何应对。[kinu.isHime | 别担心，我绝对不会抢走你的准女婿的。 ] 他属于那种非常传统的人，那种连奶奶都没有介绍给他的女孩都不会多看一眼……而对于那些无法为他的家族带来强壮、有男子气概的后代的女孩，他同样也不会多看一眼，而我显然不符合他的这些要求。[kinu.isHime | | 真可惜……当我遇到他的时候，我愿意付出任何代价，把我的大腿紧紧缠在那个男孩的头上，把他那无聊的性格从他身上挤出去。他对任何女孩来说都是个值得珍惜的人，而我也会成为一个幸福的妾室。唉，算了。 ]"

I'd sure be marrying up if I bagged a Kurokawa boy, even one out here in the colonies. But uh, a little flirtin's as far as any of that ever went. I'm not sure he's capable of noticing any gal's attentions, and even if he were, his ass's got such a stick up it these days that I'm not sure he'd know what to do about it.[kinu.isHime | Don't worry none, I'm not movin' in on your son-in-law-to-be. ] He's the very traditional sort, kind that don't even look at a girl his grandma didn't introduce to him... and won't look twice at a girl that isn't gonna give his family strong, virile heirs, which I am ill-equipped to do.[kinu.isHime | | Shame, too... when I met 'im I woulda given anything to lock my thighs around that boy's head and squeeze that borin' personality out of him. He'd be a real keeper for any gal, and I'd have been a happy concubine. Ah well. ]" "

She returns with a shortbow slung over her shoulder, and a satchel full of snacks and traps across the other. Your quarry is close... ] "

rows.original:
"Look there," the gingertail whispers, pointing through the frosty brush. You can only just make it out through the foliage, but there's a titan of an elk grazing in a clearing up ahead. The thing's taller at the shoulders than the tips of Hana's ears, and the rack of horns on that bastard's so broad the fox could probably lay herself out across them like a bench. 
    
    "He's [pc.dcb
        |a big fucker!
        |huge, isn't he?
        |like... the bigliest ever,
    ]" you say, putting your hand to your own [pc.weapon]. 
    
    Hana just nods. "Can probably cause some real damage to the folk around here if he gets mad, too. We should drop him 'fore that happens. Plus I bet he'll be great eating." 
    
    Sounds like you've found your quarry, then.
rows.translation:
看那边，”姜尾轻声说道，手指着被霜冻覆盖的灌木丛。透过树叶的缝隙，你勉强能看到前方的一片空地上，有一头巨大的麋鹿正在吃草。那头麋鹿的肩部高度甚至超过了哈娜耳朵的顶端，而它那一对角架简直宽得足以让一只狐狸躺在上面当长凳使用。

“它在那儿 [pc.dcb
        |真是个大麻烦！
        |他可真大啊，不是吗？
        |像……有史以来最大的那个一样。
    ]你是这么说的，不过你自己也得亲身体验才行。 [pc.weapon]哈娜只是点了点头。“如果他发怒的话，恐怕也会对这里的居民造成严重的伤害。我们最好在那种事情发生之前除掉他。而且，我敢打赌，他肯定很好吃。”

听起来你已经找到了目标了啊。

rows.original: Go forth and slay the beast!
rows.translation: 去吧，把那头野兽消灭掉！

rows.original: You shouldn't pick a fight with this majestic monster. Let him go in peace.
rows.translation: 你最好不要惹这个威武的怪物，让它安静地离开吧。
rows.raw: "You shouldn't pick a fight with this majestic monster. Let him go in peace."

rows.original:
With a final, plaintive bellow, the titanic elk collapses. Hana finishes it with one quick, painless slash from her blade, ending the beast's suffering. She takes a knee beside it and bows her head. "Thank you Velun for your wildlands' bounty. I swear we take no more than we need for hearth and home, else may your thorns strike me down."
    
    Hana stays with her head low for a few moments in respect to the great beast before finally pushing herself up wearily to her feet. "That was a good scrap. I'm glad it was us that fought him, and not some poor herb-pickers."
    
    You nod your agreement. "Let's get him back [hana.atCamp
        |back to camp
        |home
    ]."
    
    It's a laborious process, given the size of the beast, but with some ropes and muscles, you're able to drag the elk back to Hana's place, whereupon the ranger sets about her grim work of converting beast into future meals. While you're content to leave Hana to it, she insists you not leave for a while — at least not until she's had the time to make sure you get your fair share. 
    
    When she's ready, Hana [hana.atCamp
        |pulls her pans off the cookfire
        |comes out from her small indoor kitchen
    ] and begins filling a number of hefty wooden boxes with fresh meat and well-cooked veg over rice, and tops them with fresh peppers. 
    
    "Here ya go," she says, presenting a stack of them to you. "And there's plenty more where that came from, you just gotta ask and I'll be happy to whip you up dinner any time! Now if you'll excuse me, I gotta start salting some steaks and making sausages. This bad boy's gonna keep me fed for the winter."
rows.translation:
随着一声最后的悲鸣，这只巨大的麋鹿倒下了。哈娜用她那锋利的刀刃迅速地划了一刀，没有让这只野兽再受任何痛苦，从而结束了它的生命。她跪在它的旁边，低下了头：“谢谢你，维伦，感谢你为这片荒野带来的丰富资源。 我发誓，我们只取走维持家庭生活所需的东西，否则愿你的荆棘刺倒我。”

哈娜低头致敬了那头巨兽片刻，然后才疲惫地站了起来。 那场战斗真是精彩极了。我很高兴是我们与他交手，而不是那些可怜的采药人。”

你点头表示同意：“我们一定要把他抓回来。 [hana.atCamp
        |返回营地
        |家
    ]这确实是一个费力的过程，考虑到那头野兽的体型，但只要有一些绳索和足够的力气，你还是能够把那头麋鹿拖回到哈娜的地方。然后，护林员就会开始她那繁琐的工作——将这只野兽加工成未来的食物。虽然你很想让哈娜独自完成这些工作，但她坚持让你留下来等一会儿——至少要等到她确保你也能得到你应得的那一份食物之后。

等她准备好了，哈娜 [hana.atCamp
        |把锅从炉子上拿下来
        |从她那小小的室内厨房里走出来
    ] 她开始把新鲜的肉类、煮得恰到好处的蔬菜以及米饭装进几个沉重的木箱里，还在上面撒上了新鲜的辣椒。

“给你，”她说着，把一叠食物递给你，“还有很多呢，只要你开口要求，我随时都乐意为你准备晚餐！现在，请原谅我，我得去给那些牛排撒盐、制作香肠了。这些食材足够我过冬了。

rows.original:
"Ah, fuck. RUN FOR IT!" Hana screams, grabbing your arm and bolting for the hills. You're dragged along behind her, dazed and confused, but you manage to keep ahold of your weapon until you're well away from the giant elk — more thanks to the density of the trees snagging its antlers than to any particular speed the two of you manage.
    
    When the coast seems clear, Hana drops to her knees and starts making a sound somewhere between a ragged pant and a laugh. "H-holy shit... Keros's tails... that was close!"
    
    "Too close!" you agree, dry heaving a little. You've faced plenty of battles in your days, but rarely do you come so close to just getting trampled to actual death. Giving Hana a reassuring shoulder rub, you flop down in the snow with her to catch your breath. 
    
    It's a good few minutes before you've recovered enough to help your [party.som
        |foxy companion
        |friends
        |friends
    ] up and stagger back home.
rows.translation:
啊，快跑！快跑！”哈娜尖叫着，抓住你的手臂，朝着山坡方向冲了出去。你被她拽着一起跑，头晕目眩、不知所措，但还好你紧紧抓住了手中的武器。多亏了周围茂密的树木阻碍了那只巨型麋鹿的行动，你们才得以成功逃离它的追击——其实这更多是因为树木阻碍了麋鹿鹿角的移动，而不是因为你们俩跑得有多快。
    
    当似乎已经没有危险时，哈娜突然跪倒在地，发出一种介于喘息与笑声之间的声音：“天啊……凯罗斯的尾巴……真是太危险了！”

“确实太危险了！”你也同意道，同时忍不住干呕了几声。 这些年来，你经历过无数场战斗，但很少有哪一次会如此接近被彻底击败、丧命的边缘。你轻轻拍着哈娜的肩膀，然后和她一起倒在雪地里，喘着粗气。 
    
    你需要花费好几分钟的时间，才能恢复到足以帮助他人的状态。 [party.som
        |狡黠的伴侣
        |朋友们
        |朋友们
    ] 踉踉跄跄地走回了家。

rows.original:
"Let's not," you say, putting a hand over Hana's as she's reaching for her naginata. 
    
    "Wha— alright, alright. I can see you're set on it. I hope the locals know to keep away from him too."
    
    You gesture at the clearing, watching the majestic beast start to plod away. The ground practically shakes underfoot. "I'm sure they do."
    
    Hana shakes her head and turns back towards [hana.atCamp
        |the fjords
        |the Wayfort
    ]. "Alright, I said. Let's head back."
    
    You fall in behind and let her lead you home.
rows.translation:
别这样吧，”你说着，当哈娜伸手去拿她的薙刀时，你握住了她的手。

“哇——好吧，好吧。我看你真是下定决心了。希望当地人也知道要远离它。”

你指向那片空地，看着那只雄伟的野兽开始缓缓离开。地面都在它的脚步下震动。“我相信他们知道的。”

哈娜摇了摇头，然后转身继续前进。 [hana.atCamp
        |那些峡湾
        |荒废驿堡
    ]好吧，”我说，“我们回去吧。”

你跟在后面，让她带着你回家。

rows.original: "Bear's been this way. Big one too," Hana says, taking a knee beside a patch of flattened grass. "Whew, baby, lookit the size of those [silly |pawbs |deadly mitts ]." She splays her hand out beside the track for comparison. It's barely a quarter of the size of the bearpaw. Gods be damned that is a large lad. Hana gives you a wink and pulls her bow off her back, starting to slink along the path carved by the rotund creature — and it's a wide path, indeed, with its broken branches and trampled ground giving your hunting party plenty of room to quietly stalk its creator. There's evidence of a scuffle along the path. You call a stop when you recognize that this is no old battlefield but a site of recent carnage... and not against another animal either. You see bits of imps scattered across the ground... and the bushes... and up in the trees. Torn wings and viscera have been flung everywhere by the rampaging brute. It's enough to make your stomach turn, even without the smell. "Hell's bells." Hana covers her mouth. "[silly |That's a lotta damage |He really tore them to pieces ]," you say, searching for where the tracks resume. Your ginger companion makes a face. "Least that's five... or maybe six... less of these demons to deal with." The bear, when you finally find it, is sitting on the edge of the fjord not all that far from Hana's [hana.atCamp |camp |old camp ]. It's dragged half an imp along with it, and is chowing down like it's enjoying a snack while it watches the ocean in the distance. The creature's every bit as big as you feared, its dark fur matted with blood and a few arrows sticking out of its hide in shadow wounds. There's a few magic burns across its hide too, evidence of a sorcerer among the demons it eviscerated. You and Hana exchange glances, and the ranger slowly switches from bow to blade.
rows.translation: 熊也是这样的。而且体型还很大呢，”哈娜说着，跪在一片被压平的草地上。“哇，宝贝，看看那家伙有多大 [silly |pawbs |致命手套 ]她将手伸到铁轨旁边进行对比——那只手的大小仅有熊爪的四分之一。真是见鬼了 是 那个身材高大的小伙子。哈娜向你眨了眨眼，然后从背上取下弓，开始沿着那只圆胖生物开辟出来的小路悄悄前行——这条小路确实很宽，那些折断的树枝和被踩得发软的地面为你们的狩猎小队提供了足够的空间，让他们可以悄悄地接近那只生物的创造者。 有小路旁发生过打斗的痕迹。当你意识到这里并非古老的战场，而是一处刚刚发生屠杀的地方时，你立刻停下了脚步……而且这场屠杀的对象并非其他动物。你看到地上散落着一些小妖精的残骸。……还有那些灌木丛……还有树上的那些地方。那只疯狂的野兽把撕裂的翅膀和内脏扔得到处都是。即便没有那些气味，光是看到这一幕也足以让人作呕。 “天啊。”哈娜捂住了嘴。 "[silly |那可真是造成了巨大的破坏啊。 |他把它们彻底毁掉了。 ]你说得对，”你边说边寻找那些足迹重新开始的地方。 你的红发同伴做了个鬼脸：“至少可以少对付五只……或者六只这样的恶魔了。” 当你终于找到那只熊时，它正坐在峡湾的边缘，离哈娜的位置并不远。 [hana.atCamp |营地 |旧营地 ]它拖着半个“小恶魔”一起移动，一边大口进食，一边仿佛在享受零食一般，同时注视着远处的海洋。这只生物确实如你所担心的那样庞大，它那黑色的毛皮上沾满了鲜血，几支箭也插在它的皮肉上，留下了阴影般的伤口。它的皮毛上还有一些魔法灼伤的痕迹，这证明在它吞噬的那些恶魔中，肯定有巫师的存在。 你和哈娜对视了一眼，然后那位游荡者缓缓地将弓换成了刀。

rows.original: This hunt is getting unbearable! Bring it to an end!
rows.translation: 这次狩猎真的让人难以忍受了！赶紧结束它吧！
rows.raw: "This hunt is getting unbearable! Bring it to an end!"

rows.original: You shouldn't pick a fight with this majestic monster. Let him go in peace.
rows.translation: 你最好不要惹这个威武的怪物，让它安静地离开吧。
rows.raw: "You shouldn't pick a fight with this majestic monster. Let him go in peace."

rows.original: This bear is a machine that turns demons into dinner. Go with Velun, big man.
rows.translation: 这只熊简直就是一台能将恶魔变成美餐的机器。大块头，跟维尔伦一起行动吧。
rows.raw: "This bear is a machine that turns demons into dinner. Go with Velun, big man."

rows.original: You need to be a white mage or have an at-will healing prayer memorized to try this with any hope of success.
rows.translation: 如果你想成功尝试这个方法，就必须成为一名白魔法师，或者记住某种可以随意使用的治愈祷文。
rows.raw: "You need to be a white mage or have an at-will healing prayer memorized to try this with any hope of success."

rows.original: "He deserves to live after everything he's done," you tell Hana, stepping out of the brush. "He what?" You ignore the fox-girl and stride openly towards the bear, hands outstretched disarmingly, making as much noise as you can while you're at a distance to avoid startling him up close. The bear turns and looks at you with dark, small eyes... but they look so weary, somehow. He must be in pain from all the damage the imps did to him, and he doesn't seem eager for a second fight. "Easy, buddy," you say, inching closer. Now that you're near him, the sheer size of this overgrown lad really dawns on you. He's as hefty as two oxen strapped together, and twice as fat. "You've been eating good lately, huh? Ready for winter?" The bear watches you[pc.isBimbo | but seems utterly unconcerned. You just give him a pretty smile and hum a little song as you get up to him, keeping everything nice and calm and friendly. Your bubbly persona can disarm even fearsome beasts, it seems! |, unafraid but clearly wary. You take your time getting up to him, speaking gently all the while. ] The bear makes a single, deep-voiced "Harrumph!" at you, but otherwise makes no effort to stop you getting within reach and chanting a prayer-spell at him. When the spell begins to take effect, though, the bear does grunt and scratch at himself, inspecting his wounds as they heal. Arrows fall out of him, clattering to the dirt, and the bear casually picks one up and chucks it into the fjord. It almost seems contemptuous. "Atta boy. You're gonna be just fine," you tell him when the spell's done its work. You turn back and give Hana a thumbs up. When you return to her, Hana's just chuckling. The bear turns and looks at you with dark, small eyes... but they look so weary, somehow. He must be in pain from all the damage the imps did to him, and he doesn't seem eager for a second fight. rows.original:
"Let's not," you say, putting a hand over Hana's as she's reaching for her naginata. 
    
    "Wha— alright, alright. I can see you're set on it. I hope the locals know to keep away from him too."
    
    You gesture at the clearing, watching the majestic beast start to plod away. The ground practically shakes underfoot. "I'm sure they do."
    
    Hana shakes her head and turns back towards [hana.atCamp
        |the fjords
        |the Wayfort
    ]. "Alright, I said. Let's head back."
    
    You fall in behind and let her lead you home.
rows.translation:
别这样吧，”你说着，当哈娜伸手去拿她的薙刀时，你握住了她的手。

“哇——好吧，好吧。我看你真是下定决心了。希望当地人也知道要远离它。”

你指向那片空地，看着那只雄伟的野兽开始缓缓离开。地面都在它的脚步下震动。“我相信他们知道的。”

哈娜摇了摇头，然后转身继续前进。 [hana.atCamp
        |那些峡湾
        |荒废驿堡
    ]好吧，”我说，“我们回去吧。”

你跟在后面，让她带着你回家。

rows.original:
With a final, plaintive bellow, the rotund dire bear collapses. Hana finishes it with one quick, painless slash from her blade, ending the beast's suffering. She takes a knee beside it and bows her head. "Thank you Velun for your wildlands' bounty. I swear we take no more than we need for hearth and home, else may your thorns strike me down."
    
    Hana stays with her head low for a few moments in respect to the great beast before finally pushing herself up wearily to her feet. "That was a good scrap. I'm almost sad to be rid of him after all those demons he munched, but I 'spose it was inevitable he'd turn on common folk 'fore long now that he's got a taste for bipedal meat."
    
    You nod your agreement. "Let's get him back [hana.atCamp
        |back to camp
        |home
    ]."
    
    It's a laborious process, given the size of the beast, but with some ropes and muscles, you're able to drag the bear back to Hana's place, whereupon the ranger sets about her grim work of converting beast into future meals. While you're content to leave Hana to it, she insists you not leave for a while — at least not until she's had the time to make sure you get your fair share. 
    
    When she's ready, Hana [hana.atCamp
        |pulls her pans off the cookfire
        |comes out from her small indoor kitchen
    ] and begins filling a number of hefty wooden boxes with fresh meat and well-cooked veg over rice, and tops them with fresh peppers. 
    
    "Here ya go," she says, presenting a stack of them to you. "And there's plenty more where that came from, you just gotta ask and I'll be happy to whip you up dinner any time! Now if you'll excuse me, I gotta start salting some steaks and making sausages. This bad boy's gonna keep me fed for the winter."
rows.translation:
随着一声最后的哀鸣，那只圆滚滚的凶熊倒下了。哈娜用她那锋利的刀刃迅速地划了一刀，没有让这只野兽再受任何痛苦，就这样结束了它的生命。她跪在它的旁边，低下了头：“谢谢你，维伦，感谢你为这片荒野带来的丰富资源。 我发誓，我们只取走维持家庭生活所需的东西，否则愿你的荆棘刺倒我。”

哈娜低头致敬了那头巨兽片刻，然后才疲惫地站了起来。 那场争斗真是精彩极了。想到他吃了那么多恶魔，现在却要被我们除掉，我还有点舍不得呢……不过，既然他已经尝到了‘两足动物的肉’的味道，迟早会背叛普通人的，我想这也是不可避免的吧。”

你点了点头，表示同意。 让我们把他找回来吧。 [hana.atCamp
        |返回营地
        |家
    ]这确实是一个费力的过程，毕竟那头熊的体型实在太大了。不过，只要有几根绳子和足够的力气，你还是可以把熊拖回哈娜的家。然后，那位护林员就会开始她那繁琐的工作——把熊加工成未来的食物。虽然你很想让哈娜独自完成这些工作，但她坚持让你留下来等一会儿——至少要等到她确保你能得到你应得的那一份食物之后才行。

等她准备好了，哈娜 [hana.atCamp
        |把锅从炉子上拿下来
        |从她那小小的室内厨房里走出来
    ] 她开始把新鲜的肉类、煮得恰到好处的蔬菜以及米饭装进几个沉重的木箱里，还在上面撒上了新鲜的辣椒。

“给你，”她说着，把一叠箱子递给你，“还有很多呢，只要你开口要求，我随时都乐意为你准备晚餐！现在请原谅我，我得去给那些牛排撒盐、制作香肠了。这些食材足够我过冬了。

rows.original:
"Ah, fuck. RUN FOR IT!" Hana screams, grabbing your arm and bolting for the hills. You're dragged along behind her, dazed and confused, but you manage to keep ahold of your weapon until you're well away from the giant bear — more thanks to the sheer rotundity of the fat lad, and perhaps his lingering injuries — than to any of your own speed. 
    
    When the coast seems clear, Hana drops to her knees and starts making a sound somewhere between a ragged pant and a laugh. "H-holy shit... Keros's tails... that was close!"
    
    "Too close!" you agree, dry heaving a little. You've faced plenty of battles in your days, but rarely do you come so close to just getting mauled to actual death. Giving Hana a reassuring shoulder rub, you flop down in the snow with her to catch your breath. 
    
    It's a good few minutes before you've recovered enough to help your [party.som
        |foxy companion
        |friends
        |friends
    ] up and stagger back home.
rows.translation:
啊，该死！快跑！”哈娜尖叫着，抓住你的手臂，朝着山坡方向冲了出去。你被她拽着一起跑，当时你还处于茫然和混乱之中，但幸运的是，你还是设法握住了手中的武器。直到你们离那只巨熊足够远的时候，你才意识到，之所以能成功逃脱，主要是因为那个胖家伙体型庞大、行动迟缓，再加上他可能还带着一些未痊愈的伤势，而不是因为你的速度有多快。 
    
    当似乎已经没有危险时，哈娜突然跪倒在地，发出一种介于喘息与笑声之间的声音：“天啊……凯罗斯的尾巴……真是太危险了！”

“确实太危险了！”你也同意道，同时忍不住干呕了几声。 这些年来，你经历过无数场战斗，但很少有哪一次会如此接近被彻底击败、丧命的边缘。你轻轻地拍着哈娜的肩膀，然后和她一起倒在雪地里，喘着粗气。

过了好几分钟，你才终于恢复到可以帮忙的程度。 [party.som
        |狡黠的伴侣
        |朋友们
        |朋友们
    ] 跌跌撞撞地走回了家。

rows.original:
You call Hana over to examine a set of tracks — not just one creature, but several, each with webbed feet about the size of your hand, maybe a little bigger, that leave deep claw gouges in the wintery soil. [pc.bg hunter
        |You take a knee beside the tracks, examining them closely. "Looks like sluasaid," you say.
        
        Hana nods. "Yep. Whole pack of rock-puppies."
        
        "Could be thirty or forty..."
        
        "Yep. Must've just finished breeding season. Ought to thin the herd a little, before they start picking the forest clean."
        |"What do you think these are?"
        
        "Sluasaid," Hana decides, taking a knee with you beside the tracks. "Whole pack of rock-puppies. Maybe as many as thirty, forty."
        
        "That's a lot." 
        
        She nods. "Must've just finished breeding season. We ought to thin the herd before they graze the forest clean."
    ]
    
    [party.has ryn
        |Ryn sighs. "They're so cute, though..."
        
        "I know, honey," Hana says, patting Ryn's head.
    ]
    
    The foxy ranger takes point, following the pack's trail. She's not kidding about them overeating: you pass by several berry bushes that have been decimated by their passing, and a few small game carcasses that have been picked clean down to the crunched-apart bones.
rows.translation:
你把哈娜叫过来，让她检查那一串足迹——不是某一种生物留下的足迹，而是好几只生物的足迹。这些生物的足部上都有蹼，足部掌的大小大概和你的手掌差不多，甚至可能稍大一些。它们的爪子在冬天的泥土上留下了深深的痕迹。 [pc.bg hunter
        |你在铁轨旁单膝跪地，仔细观察着那些东西。“看起来像是岩犬吧，”你说。

哈娜点了点头：“没错，一整群岩犬呢。”

“可能有三十到四十只吧……”

“没错，它们应该刚刚结束繁殖季节。在它们开始把森林里的动物都吃个精光之前，最好把它们的数量减少一些。
        |你觉得这些是什么？”

“是岩狗，”哈娜蹲下来，站在你身边说道，“一整群岩狗，大概有三十到四十只吧。”

“数量真不少。”

她点了点头：“它们应该刚刚结束繁殖季节。我们得把这群岩狗的数量控制一下，否则它们会把森林里的草都吃光。
    ]
    
    [party.has ryn
        |瑞恩叹了口气：“不过它们真的太可爱了……”

“我知道的，亲爱的，”哈娜一边说，一边轻拍着瑞恩的脑袋。
    ]

rows.original:
"How do we want to handle this many?" you ask as you walk. "I don't think we should try fighting so many at once."
    
    Hana gives you a grin and pulls her bow off her back. "You leave that to me, [pc.mf
        |handsome
        |cutie
    ]. One thing I know for sure about sluasaid is their ears are even keener than mine!"
    
    It's not much longer before you reach where the pack's stopped for the [dayNight
        |day
        |night
    ]. There's just as many as you'd feared, more than three dozen wolf-sized stone-scaled reptiles lounging around in a clearing near the forest's western reach. Several small ones are playing together, bumping their ridged heads together and clawing at the dirt; others are busily digging holes to sleep in. Only a handful are stalking around, still alert for danger — and they must hear you coming, too, as their stubby tails start wriggling and they bare their teeth. 
    
    Hana draws an arrow from her quiver, and in one smooth motion nocks it, draws, and looses it. Rather than aiming for one of the guard-pups, though, she's shot directly over the clearing — and her arrow lets out a horrific wail as it flies, a piercing screech that sends the startled creatures falling all over each other. Most of the pack darts for the trees, trying to escape what they must think is some apocalyptic attack, but a few of them — a much more manageable number — keep their wits and charge in your direction.
rows.translation:
我们该怎么处理这么多人呢？”你边走边问道，“我觉得我们不应该试图同时对付这么多人。”

哈娜对你笑了笑，然后从背上取下她的弓，“这个交给我吧。 [pc.mf
        |英俊的
        |可爱的人或物
    ]有一件事我可以肯定：铲头兽的听力比我的还要敏锐！”

再走不久，你就会来到那群动物停下来休息的地方。 [dayNight
        |天
        |夜晚
    ]正如你所担心的那样，在森林西部的那片空地上，确实有三十多只体型如同狼一般的、身披石质鳞片的爬行动物正在闲逛。有几只较小的家伙正在一起玩耍，它们用带棱纹的头部互相碰撞，用爪子抓挠地面；而其他的则忙着挖洞准备睡觉。 只有寥寥几只仍在四处游荡，它们依然保持着对危险的警惕——而且它们肯定也听到了你的脚步声，因为它们的短尾巴开始扭动起来，牙齿也露了出来。

哈娜从箭袋中取出一支箭，动作流畅地搭上箭弦，拉弓，然后射了出去。 然而，她并没有瞄准那些护卫犬，而是直接将箭射向了空地对面——她的箭在飞行的过程中发出了一声可怕的哀鸣，那尖锐刺耳的声音吓得那些受惊的生物纷纷跌倒在地。 大多数飞镖都射向了树木，那些飞镖显然是为了躲避他们所认为的某种末日般的攻击，但其中有那么一小部分飞镖——数量相对较少——却让那些人保持了清醒的头脑，然后朝着你的方向飞了过来。

Most of the pack darts for the trees, trying to escape what they must think is some apocalyptic attack, but a few of them — a much more manageable number — keep their wits and charge in your direction.

rows.original:
The last of the sluasaid collapses in a lump on the ground, giving you and Hana a chance to quickly end the rear guard. The ranger bows her head in reverence to the packs' spirits, whispering a prayer to Velun as she works. "Lord of the woods, we thank you for this bounty, and may your thorns strike us down if we have overreached ourselves..." 
    
    "Most of the pack escaped," you say, looking to the forest. [pc.bg hunter
        |They scattered pretty thoroughly, though."
        
        Hana nods. "
        |
        
        Hana shrugs. "They scattered pretty thoroughly, though! 
    ]Sluasaid are pack creatures, but nowhere near as loyal to each other as wolves. It'll be a long time, if ever, before this herd comes back together. That should ease the burden they put on the Frostwood. And the danger they pose to the folk living here."
    
    "Mission accomplished, then," you say.
    
    "Yep, yep. Help me gather up the bodies, would ya? These're gonna be good eating." 
    
    It's a laborious process, given the number of hefty creatures you've taken, but with some ropes and muscles, you're able to drag the rockpups back to Hana's place, whereupon the ranger sets about her grim work of converting beast into future meals. While you're content to leave Hana to it, she insists you not leave for a while — at least not until she's had the time to make sure you get your fair share. 
    
    When she's ready, Hana [hana.atCamp
        |pulls her pans off the cookfire
        |comes out from her small indoor kitchen
    ] and begins filling a number of hefty wooden boxes with fresh meat and well-cooked veg over rice, and tops them with fresh peppers. 
    
    "Here ya go," she says, presenting a stack of them to you. "And there's plenty more where that came from, you just gotta ask and I'll be happy to whip you up dinner any time! Now if you'll excuse me, I learned a technique from some elves about fermenting these bad boys I wanna try out!"
    
    [party.has ryn
        |Etheryn gives you a concerned look. "I-I don't think that's a good idea..."
        
        Hana winks at her. "Don't you worry about me, Ryn, I can handle the taste of anything!"
        
        "I would be more worried about the smell..."
    ]

“大部分兽群已经逃走了，”你望着森林说道。 [pc.bg hunter
        |不过，他们确实分散得相当开了。”

哈娜点了点头。
        |

    ]斯拉萨伊德是一群群居的生物，但它们之间的忠诚度远不如狼群。这个兽群要重新聚在一起，恐怕需要很长时间——甚至可能永远无法实现。这样一来，它们对霜林造成的压力，以及它们对这里居民构成的威胁，都应该会得到缓解。那么，任务完成了，”你说。

“没错，没错。帮我把那些尸体收集起来，好吗？这些可都是很好的食物呢。”

考虑到你们捕获的那些体型庞大的生物数量，这个工作确实相当繁琐。不过靠着一些绳索和体力，你们还是把那些动物拖回了哈娜的地方。随后，这位护林员便开始着手将这些动物加工成未来的食物。 虽然你愿意让哈娜自己处理这件事，但她坚持要求你暂时不要离开——至少在她有时间确保你能得到应得的份额之前，你不能走。

等她准备好了，哈娜就会 [hana.atCamp
        |把锅从炉子上拿下来
        |从她那小小的室内厨房里走出来
    ] 她开始把新鲜的肉类、煮得恰到好处的蔬菜以及米饭装进几个沉重的木箱里，还在上面撒上了新鲜的辣椒。

“给你，”她说着，把一叠箱子递给你，“还有很多呢，只要你开口要求，我随时都乐意为你准备晚餐！现在，请原谅我，我刚从一些精灵那里学到了一种腌制这些食材的方法，我想马上试试看！
    
    [party.has ryn
        |伊瑟琳担忧地看了她一眼：“我……我觉得那个主意不太好……”

哈娜朝她眨了眨眼：“别担心我，瑞恩，任何味道我都能接受！”

“我反而更担心那味道会散发出来……
    ]

rows.original:
"Ah, shit, there's STILL too many!" Hana screams, grabbing your arm and bolting for the hills. You're dragged along behind her, dazed and confused, watching over your shoulder as a whole pack of rock-puppies start charging after you. The fleeing sluasaid have rallied, now, and are charging after you with murderous rage. Shit! 
    
    You bolt as fast as you can, though you're eating Hana's dust for the better part of a mile before the damn things finally give up the chase. 
    
    When the coast seems clear, Hana drops to her knees and starts making a sound somewhere between a ragged pant and a laugh. "H-holy shit... Keros's tails... that was close!"
    
    "Too close!" you agree, dry heaving a little. You've faced plenty of battles in your days, but rarely do you come so close to just getting ripped apart by a pack of angry sluasaid. Giving Hana a reassuring shoulder rub, you flop down in the snow with her to catch your breath. 
    
    It's a good few minutes before you've recovered enough to help your [party.som
        |foxy companion
        |friends
        |friends
    ] up and stagger back home.

It's a short trek, made easier by the graceless path made by the bulky leothran men. "So what happens now?" you ask. "You go fight some big, bad demon queen I've been hearing about, I reckon," Hana says. "And then... then you've got a fort. I won't have to keep the colony safe from imps. Seems like it'll work itself out." You cup her cheek. "I have to wait that long to have you all to myself?" She laughs. "You've got me any time you want me. But I've still got my duty... for now. As do you, Champion of Frost. But that won't last forever. Love, though, can." You [pc.mascFem |chuckle |giggle ]. "Such a romantic..." "Mmhm." Hana leans in and kisses you. "Now what say I walk you home?" "You've got the longer walk. Let me." The two of you take your time getting dressed again, and you're halfway to the edge of the field before Hana remembers she did actually want to gather some wild onion after all. Laughing, the two of you turn around to do some quick picking, filling up that wicker backet before finally returning to the ranger's little camp on the cliffside... You lean Hana with a deep kiss on the lips, and a promise to return soon.

rows.original:
"I enjoy your company, Hana, but-"
    
    "But you don't feel that way," she says with a sigh. "Yeah, I had a feelin'. But I wasn't about to go through life kickin' myself for not taking my shot. Hope I haven't ruined a good thing."
    
    You pat her hair. "It's fine. [pc.isDK
        |I know I'm irresistible.
        |Sorry.
    ]"
    
    Hana chuckles and pushes herself up to her knees, returning her hands to the onions. "Right, well, these ain't gonna pick 'emselves, so we'd best get to it." 
    
    You help Hana fill her basket with fresh onions, trying to keep the conversation light as you work. Eventually her ears manage to return to their perky uprightness, and her tail manages a few swishes through the grass before she's gotten the last of her harvest gathered. She stands, stretching enough to crack her back. "Right then. That's enough for today. Let's head on back, shall we?"
    
    You follow Hana's lead back to her camp, and part with her at the edge of the fjord.

rows.original: "Have you ever thought about having a family?" you ask. "You know... kids?" Hana blinks, then lets out a little laugh and sits back on the log outside her tent. "Where'd that come from? Aha, don't answer that, I can see where you're starin'." She gives you a wink. "Honestly? No, I haven't. That's not me sayin' no to havin' 'em, mind you, but just that now that you mention it, it's not something I can remember ever really thinking about. Not since I left home, anyway. Back then, sure, havin' to think forward to whatever arrangement my parents would make for me sparked some consideration on the subject, but by and large filled with abject dread." The vixen lets out a breath and flicks her tail into her lap. "Ya gotta remember, Kitsuhon society being what it is... for someone like me, being stuck in something so rigid and formal, and havin' to try and raise a family in it, I just couldn't cope with the idea. Even now, I don't think I'd wanna go having a kid in the colony, though it's a sight different than home. Even there, I feel like an outcast more than I don't. Can't really see myself raising children there." She shrugs helplessly. "Lucky you, it wouldn't have to be in the colony," you say, taking a seat next to Hana. "You know somebody who happens to own a whole fortress just down the road." "I, uh... huh..." the vixen's lips scrunch. Maybe the idea really hadn't crossed her mind. "Y-yeah, I guess you're right, at that. I mean, I know we had that wonderful talk in the fields a bit ago, but... would you really be okay with that? Could you support that?" [var0 |"I already do," you admit. "From other relationships." Hana takes that in stride. "Ah, well then... |You nod. "I'm sure I could manage." "Well then... ]" she murmurs, rubbing her chin. "Ah, sorry. This is all kinda sudden. Feels like yesterday I was just... y'know, on my own. You're a damn whirlwind, you know that, right? Come into my life and shake it all to pieces..." You smile, and put a hand on Hana's leg. She covers it with hers and beams at you. "Y'know I love it, though. Every damn second of it. So... so if you're serious..."
rows.translation: 你有没有考虑过组建家庭？”你问道，“你知道的……生孩子什么的？” 哈娜眨了眨眼，然后轻笑了一声，重新靠回帐篷外的原木上。“这个问题是从哪里冒出来的啊？啊，别回答了，我猜你在想什么。她向你眨了眨眼。”说实话？没有，我并没有那么做过。请注意，我并不是在拒绝拥有它们，只是现在你提到这个，我才想起来，其实我从来没认真考虑过这个问题。至少自从我离开家以后，就没有再考虑过。 那时候，确实，一想到父母会为我安排什么，我就开始思考这个话题，但总体来说，我心中充满了恐惧。 那只母狐狸叹了口气，把尾巴甩到腿上。“你得明白， Kitsuhon的社会结构就是这样的……对于我这样的人来说，被束缚在如此严格、如此正式的环境中，还要努力在那里抚养家庭，我真的无法接受这样的生活。即使到现在，我也不想在殖民地生孩子，虽然那里的环境和家乡有所不同。但在那里，我仍然会觉得自己像个异类，实在无法想象自己能在那里抚养孩子。 她无奈地耸了耸肩。 “你真幸运，这件事本来不必在殖民地解决，”你边说边在哈娜旁边坐下，“你认识一个人，他就住在不远处，拥有一整座堡垒呢。” “我，呃……嗯……”那只狐狸的嘴唇微微一紧。也许这个想法确实从未出现在她的脑海中。“嗯，你说得对。虽然我们之前在田野里有过那次愉快的谈话，但是……你真的愿意这么做吗？你确定你能接受吗？ 支持 那个？ [var0 |我已经这么做了，”你承认道，“在其他的感情关系中也是如此。” 哈娜对此反应很淡定：“啊，那好吧…… |你点了点头：“我相信自己一定能处理好。” “那么…… ]她摩挲着下巴，轻声说道：“啊，抱歉，这一切发生得太突然了。感觉就像昨天我还一个人生活着一样……你简直就像一场旋风，对吧？你闯进了我的生活，把一切都搅得乱七八糟……” 你微笑着，把手放在哈娜的腿上。她用自己的手盖住了你的手，然后灿烂地笑着对你说：“不过，你知道吗？我真的很喜欢这样。每一刻都让我感到开心。所以……如果你是认真的话……

rows.translation: 你只是询问了一下未来的可能性，并不是说现在就要生孩子啊！

rows.original: "I am," you say, squeezing Hana's hand. "Then... I've got a condition, if you'll indulge me," the vixen says, slipping her fingers from yours. This time you're the one blinking in confusion, watching Hana hop up from her perch and dash into the tent. When she returns, you can tell she's got something clutched tight in her hand, though she's shying away from revealing it just yet. Rather than taking her seat again, she squats down between you and the campfire, trying to hide the deep flush on her cheeks. "I might be a stray these days, but I'm still a gal of good breedin' and standin'. At least on paper. Ahah, what I mean is, well, it wouldn't do to leave a trail of bastards in my wake. An' even if I didn't think my folks'd come over here personally to slap me for it, I wanna do things right. So, well, ah..." Hana puts a knee in the ground, and opens her hands to reveal a ring. "H-Hana! [pc.isDK|You're serious!" Even you feel a rising in your heart seeing a band of gold and diamond in the vixen's hand.|Oh my-" You cover your mouth in both hands. Your eyes are transfixed by the band of gold and diamond in hers. "Hana..."] [party.has kiyoko|You glance to the side, and see a faint but knowing smirk on Kiyoko's face. Did she know about this...?] "I know I don't have money," Hana admits, "or really much at all worthy of a landed [pc.mf|lord|lady] like yourself. But this was my grandmother's. She wanted me to pass it down to whosoever it was I'd someday wed. You'd do me a great honor by saying yes."

"For now, though, let's change the subject before you plant some thoughts in my head that keep me up at night, hm?"

rows.original: You glance pointedly away. "Hana, I-" The vixen winces and closes her hands. "Ah. So not that serious about the whole kids thing, huh?" She sighs and sits back on her ankles. "I get it. It ain't like I'm the finest catch in the sea here. I... sorry, I shouldn't have... ah. Still, my point stands. I'm not having kids with anybody I'm not planning of making an honest [pc.mf |boy |woman ] outta. So let's just call the matter settled and pretend we never had this talk, yeah?" "Yeah. For the best." "For the best."

rows.original:
You spend a few minutes catching Hana up on the events that transpired outside the Grave of Saints, and your encounter with the masked assassin on the mountainside. The huntress frowns, nodding along with your story right up until you describe the assassin's leaping escape. 

    "I'm sure a mere fall from the cliffs won't do her in. Kunoichi — female assassins from the Old Country — are notoriously hard to kill."
    
    "So what's her story?" you ask. "Surely the colony knows one of their own's gone rogue?" 
    
    Hana spreads her hands. "These're the Frost Marches, [pc.name]. There's only one way in for us foxen, but infinite ways out. There's not a small number of us who come here and then just... fade away into the forest, never to be seen again. [hana.isMom
        |Until we got together, half the colony figured it was only a matter of time before I did too
        |I'm sure half the colony thinks I'm just biding my time until I do, too
    ]." She shakes her head. "But a dark-haired kunoichi... sorry, I can't say it rings a bell. Maybe she came here before my time? Could ask [party.has kiyoko
        |the Lady Governor
        |Granny
    ] back at the colony. She's been here since the start, and knows dang near everybody!"
    
    That'll have to do, then.

    我敢肯定，仅仅从悬崖上掉下来并不会要了她的命。那些来自古老国家的女刺客——Kunoichi——可是出了名的难杀。”

“那么，她的来历是什么呢？”你问道，“难道这个殖民地的人不知道他们当中有一个人叛变了吗？哈娜摊开双手部说道：“这些就是霜冻之地。 [pc.name]对我们这些狐狸来说，只有一条路可以进入这里，但却有无数条路可以离开。有相当一部分人来到这里之后，就会……消失在森林里，再也不会被人看到。 [hana.isMom

    ] 回到殖民地去了。她从一开始就在这里，几乎认识所有人呢！”

那也只能这样了。

rows.original: You pause, teetering on your feet. Your hands go straight to your [pc.belly], wrapping around yourself. Ohh, that feels... not bad per se, but certainly weird. Like you've just fallen 20 feet without warning, but only your stomach's felt it. A lurch, that's it. You pause long enough to take a deep breath, fighting back a wave of nausea. Now that you think about it, your gut's getting a little soft. Are you...?

You recover come morning, as much as you can. Hana brings you breakfast in bed, though you have to pause to feed your fussy baby halfway through.

rows.raw: ' You spend a good while in your lovers' arms, trading playful kisses and pretty fluffy fox-tails while you all catch your breath. "I really needed this," you admit to the girls, finally pulling yourself up. "You two are amazing." Rindo just smiles and blushes, while Hana's tail starts swishing. "We oughta get goin' 'fore somebody stumbles on us. Thanks for lettin' us borrow your special place here, Rindo. And your, uh, you." The white-haired fox laughs at that, letting you help her up to her feet and back into her kimono. "My pleasure. But you are right, I must get back to things. There is never a lack of work in such a large garden..." You give her a peck on the cheek, and a squeeze on the rear as she starts to make her way back to her duties. Hana gives you a smirk. "Us too. C'mon." The pair of you leave a different way, taking a leisurely stroll all the way back [hana.atCamp |to Hana's camp |home ], hand in hand. '

rows.original:
"How about we go to the shrine?" you suggest. 
    
    Hana gives you an eager nod. "That sounds nice. Ought to pay my respects to m'lord. He's given me more blessings than I can count." 
    
    [hana.isLover
        |The wink she follows that up with makes your heart soar.
        |You get the feeling she means more than just her figure, too.
    ] She takes your hand and leads the way through the tree's sprawling gardens and beneath the torii gate that separates the sanctuary grounds from the colonial commons. There's a palpable change when stepping through it, a quieting of the bustle outside to a faint whisper in the back of your mind, barely noticeable over the rustle of the wind through the sakuras. Hana lets a breath go, tension releasing from her shoulders. 
    
    "Enjoying the isolation?"
    
    "Ha! You know me well. There won't be services for a couple of hours, so we've got the place more or less to ourselves. 'Cept for the twins, anyway." 
    
    You pause, waiting for the invocation to summon one or both of them, but it seems even they occasionally have something to actually do around here. Seems Hana was thinking the same thing, and the two of you both break out in giggles at the same time. 
    
    "C'mon, let's go pay our respects," your [hana.fucked
        |lover
        |friend
    ] says, nodding towards the steps up to the shrine. 
    
    You follow her all the way to the open door, through which you can see the playfully-smiling statue of the Trickster himself presiding over the small temple's interior. As much of a bumpkin as she is, here in her god's house, even Hana manages to maintain an air of formality as she ritually rings the temple bell and bows to the statue. You follow her lead, and the two of you both clap your hands in unison. There's something oddly sombre about the whole affair, a stark contrast to the deity's own chaotic nature... but that's the kitsune as a whole, isn't it? Boil them down and it's all ritual and formality wrapped around their wild hearts. 
    
    "I've got plenty to pray for," Hana whispers.
rows.translation:
我们去神社吧？”你提议道。

哈娜热情地点了点头：“那听起来很不错。我应该去向我的主人表达敬意。他给予我的恩惠多得数都数不过来。 
    
    [hana.isLover
        |她随后做出的那个眨眼动作，会让你的心跳加速。
        |你会有这样的感觉：她所代表的，不仅仅是她的外表而已。
    ] 她牵着你的手部，引领你穿过那片繁茂的树林花园，穿过那道将圣域与殖民地公共区域分隔开的鸟居大门。当穿过那道大门的瞬间，你会明显感受到周围环境的变化——外面的喧嚣声渐渐消失了，只剩下脑海中若有若无的轻声低语，这种声音在樱花随风摇曳的沙沙声中几乎难以被察觉。 哈娜松了一口气，肩上的紧张感也随之消失了。

“喜欢这种独处的感觉吗？”

“哈！你真了解我。接下来几个小时都不会有任何服务，所以这个地方基本上就只属于我们两个人了。 除了那对双胞胎之外，嗯。”

你停顿了一下，等着那个召唤语能把他们中的一个或两个叫过来，但看来就连他们偶尔也会有一些事情要忙。显然，哈娜也是这么想的，于是你们俩同时忍不住笑了起来。 
    
    来吧，我们一起去表达我们的敬意吧。”你的 [hana.fucked
        |恋人
        |朋友
    ] 她说着，同时指向通往神龛的台阶。

你跟着她一直走到那扇敞开的门前，透过门，你可以看到那个总是面带戏谑笑容的骗子神像，它就矗立在那座小神殿的内部。 尽管她是个乡下人，但在这座她的神殿里，就连哈娜也能保持一定的庄重感——她按照仪式依次敲响寺院的钟声，然后向雕像鞠躬。你跟着她的动作，两人一起有节奏地拍手部。 整件事给人一种奇怪的阴郁感，这与那位神明本身混乱的本质形成了鲜明的对比……但这就是狐族的本质吧？归根结底，他们的一切行为都只是围绕着他们那狂野的心灵而进行的仪式和形式而已。 
    
    我有许多事情需要祈祷，”哈娜轻声说道。

rows.translation: 看在哈娜的份上，请尊重她吧。

rows.translation: 看在哈娜的份上，也为那位调皮捣蛋的神祈祷吧。

rows.translation: 既然你来了，不妨去请求那位诡计之神为你的事业赐予祝福吧。

rows.original: You ought to be praying to Lumia if you want a blessing while you're pregnant!
rows.translation: 如果你在怀孕期间希望得到保佑，那就应该向卢米亚祈祷吧！

rows.original:
You nod, keeping your respectful silence while she communes with her patron deity. 
    
    That quietude hangs over the shrine for maybe two minutes before Hana's ears flick up and she opens her eyes. She bows once more to the divinity statue and then flashes you a toothy grin. "Y'hear that? Coulda sworn the wind was whispering..." 
    
    You pat Hana's hair. "Now what?" 
    
    "Now... we go get some rice and sake, I reckon."
    
    Well, you can't argue with that plan. You take Hana's hand and lead the ginger fox back to the commons of the tree, where the two of you get a proper lunch together. Your companion seems quite a bit more cheery now, blithely ignoring the occasional queer look she gets from her fellow kitsune while she stuffs her face with fish, rice, and wine. 
    
    After that, there's nothing to do but head home. When you suggest it, Hana's tail swishes under her kimono. You [hana.fucked
        |take her hand
        |squeeze her shoulder
    ] and walk the pretty fox home. 
    
    "That was... that was nice," Hana admits once you're back. "Having you around really does make going there a lot more tolerable. Nobody even talked to me." 
    
    That must be a high bar. You laugh, and accept a big hug from Hana. "So you'd be okay doing this again?"
    
    "Well, maybe once in a while..."
    
    You ruffle her ears. Good enough.

这种宁静在神龛中持续了大约两分钟，直到哈娜的耳朵突然动了动，她睁开了眼睛。她再次向那尊神像鞠了一躬，然后露出了灿烂的笑容。 听见了吗？我差点以为风在低语呢……”

你轻拍着哈娜的头发，问道：“接下来怎么办？”

“嗯……我想我们该去弄些米饭和清酒来吧。”

这个计划确实没什么可反对的。你握住哈娜的手，带着这只姜黄色的狐妖回到了树丛中的聚集地，两人一起享用了一顿美味的午餐。 你的同伴现在看起来开心多了，她一边大口吃着鱼、米饭和酒，一边毫不在意地忽略着其他狐妖伙伴们投来的那些古怪目光。

之后，就没什么事情可做了，只能回家了。 当你提出这个建议时，哈娜的尾巴在和服下摆动着。你 [hana.fucked
        |牵她的手
        |轻拍她的肩膀
    ] 然后陪那只漂亮的狐妖一起回家。

“那真是……太好了，”当你回到她身边时，哈娜承认道，“有你在身边，去那里确实会让人感觉好受很多。甚至没有人跟我说话。”
